description: Spotlight Fantasy is the brand new edition of the cooperative game where you and your friends search for hidden wacky characters and funny items. Use your lantern to find pictures hidden in the dark – the more you find, the more steps you take toward the end goal! Manage your lanterns wisely to keep the light from running out, or share them to help friends in need!
Can you find all of your targets before sunset?

The game is played over five rounds. Each player has a different board composed of a transparent layer on top, depicting a different part of the game scene, and a black cardboard background, that makes everything dark and difficult to see.

At the beginning of each round, the hidden picture to search is determined by looking at the card on top of the deck. When everybody is ready, players start looking for the hidden picture on their board with their “magic” lantern, which can illuminate the board thanks to its white spot.

When the sand timer runs out, players must stop searching, put down their lanterns, and set their dial on the number of hidden picture they think they have found. Then, they reveal the back side of the hidden picture card, which shows how many it was actually possible to find. The more you found, the more your pawn advances on the track…but beware, the Moon pawn will advance, too!

If the Moon overtakes any player’s pawn, you can spend a rush token to get them back in front of the Moon, but if you lack rush tokens, the game is over and you all lose! If all players cross the finish line without being caught by the Moon, you all win!

Adrift on the open sea, a creaking raft carries a glittering pile of stolen treasure. Gems slide and tumble across the deck as pirates rock the raft to grab the richest prizes… Gather the sparkling loot and load it into your Lifeboats, and make sure to grab as much loot as possible before the Pirate Flag signals the end. When the chaos settles, the pirate who rescued the most valuable treasure wins!
NOAH is a full-fledged connoisseur game in pocket format – compact enough for your backpack, variable enough for hundreds of games, no two of which ever feel the same.
Getting started is simple: all you need is the Heroes Core Box with all the factions – and at least one Enemy Box full of enemies, just waiting to be unpacked. That's all it takes to jump in.
They never die alone.
They look like us. They talk like us. And across thousands of miles, they are linked – one mind, spread across many bodies.
You corner one of them in a parking garage in Hamburg. And somewhere in Lisbon, one you have never seen flinches. You strike, and the wound travels. You weaken one – and strengthen the next.
Hitting them isn't enough. You need to know which one, and where.
Gameplay

The Aliens share their life points through a hidden network. To beat them, you first have to pull them apart: move them between locations, isolate the weak spot, and strike together – in the right place, at the right moment.

Arrange numbers instead of words in a crossword-style puzzle, creating intersecting equations with every move. Combine arithmetic operations, think ahead, and make clever use of premium spaces to score the most points.

Abaku is an elegant tile-placement game that blends the satisfaction of crossword puzzles with engaging mathematical strategy. First published in 2008, it has remained a favorite among puzzle enthusiasts and has also been played online continuously since 2009.

The Latecomers expansion adds variety to the Night at the zoo game with 4 new animals — a crocodile, meerkat, monkey, and turtle — each bringing its own unique movement pattern. The core gameplay stays the same while offering fresh new challenges and combinations.
Roll with your paws but think with your claws!

Mad Cat Sad Cat is a dice game with barely any downtime. Either it is your turn to roll the dice and create poker combinations. Or you try to mooch off of the dice roller's success by predicting which dice they will set aside.
In both cases, you want to play to your own outs as much as you want to outwit your opponents.

In the forgotten realm of Leda, the great species have awakened: cats, pandas, sharks, scorpions, and many more. Each animal clan has developed its own civilization, language, and ambitions. Through a strange energy grid pulsing in rhythm with the world, they build, evolve, clash — and seek to impose their vision of the future. In this world balanced on a knife's edge, war is not everything; cunning, adaptability, memory, and deep bonds with nature are the keys to triumph. Who will carve their name among the legends of Leda?

LEDA is an asymmetric card game for two players in which each player embodies an animal clan with its own rules, objectives, and playstyle. Each player begins with a 4x4 grid of basic tiles, which they will modify during the game by upgrading them and playing clan cards onto them. On each turn, the action tile determines a zone of the grid to activate, triggering the effects located in that zone. Players must optimize their activations, manage their food (the main resource), and improve their engine in order to fulfill their clan's unique victory condition — all while racing for military victory!
Get 25 wild and crazy new Mortals in this mini-expansion for Almighty, plus 10 mythological Creatures that add a new rules twist for experienced deities!

You are a powerful and moody ancient god!And YOU deserve the most offerings, the most belief, the most glory! Get it by creating, manipulating and smiting those puny mortals to win their worship in great festivals to your greatness.
Will the mortals lead full, prosperous lives, or suffer terribly by your hand?
​You decide...YOU are ALMIGHTY!
Rank my Denk! is a cooperative party game where it’s not just what you perform – but how well you do it!
Act, draw, describe or make sounds to help your team guess a word. But there’s a twist: you secretly have to perform on a specific level from 1 (terrible) to 5 (brilliant).
Can your team guess the word and figure out how good – or hilariously bad – you were trying to be?
The better you can read each other, the more points you score together!
Similo: Wonders is a cooperative deduction game where all players work together to identify a secret card using a series of Clues!

This new edition of the critically acclaimed deduction game featues 36 buildings and monuments from all around the world, including ancient wonders and modern marvels, all beautifully illustrated by Naiade. The deck box comes with two different covers (North American and International), but the decks contain the same cards.

The Clue Giver must lead the Guessers to identify one Secret Card by playing other cards from their hand as Clues. There are two kind kinds of Clues: Remove Clues (cards played horizontally, which have something similar to one or more cards the the Guessers should remove) or Keep Clues (cards played vertically, which have something similar to one or more cards the Guessers should keep).

For example, The Secret Card is the Colosseum. You could play Petra as a Keep Clue, to suggest to the Guessers that the wonders to keep are buildings, made of stone, or part of the New 7 Wonders of the World. Or, you might play the Statue of Liberty as a Remove Clue, to point out that the wonders to remove are statues, made with metal, or built in modern times.

Master spectacular drifts through a busy harbour, weaving between cargo containers in search of the perfect racing line. Every corner demands precision, clever planning, and flawless control to achieve the fastest lap.

Harbordrift is a compact expansion for the strategic dice-placement and deck-building rally game Dirt & Dust. It introduces a brand-new harbour track built from 10 track cards, offering fresh racing challenges and even more opportunities to push your driving skills to the limit.

At the heart of the Vastwood stands a gigantic tree, whose immense branches stretch far up into the heavens. It is called the Heart Tree, and it holds within it the Crystal, source of all life. Nori and Tan are Sylvans, a people who live inside the Heart Tree. As secret guardians, they watch over the Tree and the Crystal. To light the countless tunnels that wind through the trunk, the Sylvans have tamed fireflies, whose natural glow lights their way. The inhabitants of the Vatswood call them “the firefly tamers.”

Fireflies is a cooperative game for two players that invites you to embark on a fantastic adventure: the epic journey of Nori and Tan to save the Vastwood from the Darkness. Guiding your partner across otherworldly and perilous landscapes, you’ll explore hostile lands, meet a full cast of characters, and complete grand quests. The Fireflies story consists of 8 Chapters, each representing a game, with its own objective and additional rules.

On your turn, explore your surroundings by playing a Firefly token from the shared reserve on your board: your interactive booklet visually and textually recounts your character's adventures. Your choices will change the course of events, and you must use each uncovered item and secret wisely.
Two heroes with two intertwined storylines… but only together, by sharing discoveries and ideas, will you unravel the mysteries of this epic odyssey…
Stadt, Land, Tralala – der Spieleklassiker „Stadt, Land, Fluss“ als Kartenspiel

Eine Stadt mit B war gestern! Mehr als 100 abwechslungsreiche Kategorien sorgen für Spielspaß bei Jung und Alt. Dank der immer neuen Kartenkombinationen bleibt es bis zur letzten Runde spannend – ganz ohne Stift und Papier.

Ein Laubbaum, eine Fernsehsendung oder etwas, das giftig ist: Habt ihr die passenden Buchstabenkarten auf der Hand? Hier sind Wissen und Kreativität gefragt. Und vielleicht hilft euch auch ein Joker aus der Klemme.
Ein kurzweiliges Kartenspiel für Familie und Freunde, bei dem eine bekannte Spielidee auf überraschende Kategorien trifft.

Aliens, zombies, ghosts and vampires have infiltrated our everyday lives – hidden, disguised and right in your neighborhood. The great, celebrated heroes? Too busy, too overwhelmed, or off shooting their next Hollywood blockbuster. That’s exactly why you exist: secret organizations that officially don’t exist.

“NOAH – Not Officially Authorized Heroes” is a cooperative hand-management and monster-battling adventure that rewards forward planning and clever resource management. Each of you takes command of one of four asymmetric factions and, on every turn, recruits unique crew members from your deck to prepare your next strike. The twist: you never know when your turn comes around again – the turn order keeps shifting. So you weigh your options as a team, plan ahead and get ready, because the many enemies of the NOAH series strike without warning.

Along the way, multifunction cards request clever decisions – all the way to a pact with the dark side that grants supernatural powers at the price of your soul. But beware: time is short, and it’s playing against you too.

And the best part: thanks to the clever Mix & Match system, you combine enemies and locations into a near-endless series of missions. No two games ever play the same. And because we’ve stripped the game down to what truly matters, you get full experience-level depth that fits in any bag. Save the world, even if no one will ever thank you for it.

The animals have secretly escaped the zoo for a night-time adventure—but now they must find their way back before the keepers notice! Guide them through the darkened zoo by drafting and placing tiles, creating the best routes home and making clever use of each animal's unique abilities. Every game offers new tactical choices and fresh challenges.
Night at the Zoo is an accessible strategy game by Tomáš Holek (SETI, Tea Garden, Galileo Galilei), featuring beautiful artwork by Tereza Kovandová.

Step into mythical 19th-century Prague, where legendary creatures roam the streets. Use their unique abilities to rebuild the flooded city, shape its future, and compete for influence. This euro-style worker placement game lets players create their own action spaces, master unique powers, and explore Prague's magical legends.

West Story: Pioneers is a collection of cards and tokens introducing more variety and complexity to the game. The expansion includes Automa Cards to play solo or with an additional automated opponent Tom!

There are new buildings like Sheriff, a new animal Racoon and cards introducing the Gold Nugget Symbol, which all get marked and executed immediately on purchase. For players looking for more asymmetry, there are Starting Cards to be put on player boards before the game even kicks off.

expands.name: West Story: A Town Building Game

description: Four Greek city-states — Athens, Sparta, Corinth, and Thebes — compete for dominance across the Aegean in the first phase of the Peloponnesian War (431–421 BC). Each has its own strengths — Athens' fleets, Sparta's army, Corinth's economy, Thebes' striking power — yet none is locked into a single path. Scoring happens in three categories — city-states you control, coins you collect, and mints of your own — each faction weighting them differently. Wealth comes from trade along the routes you establish; power from territorial control and combat. Coin scoring uses a hidden, simultaneous fist commit — everyone opens at once, and no one knows in advance how much the others will stake. Two modes: a competitive Sandbox and an event-driven Campaign.
The NOAH System – Build Your Own Nightmare
NOAH is a full-fledged experienced level game in pocket format – compact enough for your backpack, variable enough for hundreds of games, no two of which ever feel the same.
Getting started is simple: all you need is the Heroes Core Box with all the factions – and at least one Enemy Box full of enemies, just waiting to be unpacked. That's all it takes to jump in.
They don't stop. Ever.
The first one was a coincidence. The second was a warning. By the fifth, you stopped counting.

They aren't fast. They aren't clever. They just keep coming – out of basements, out of sewers, out of apartments where nobody has turned on a light in weeks. For every one you drop, two more come shuffling.
And while you're still swinging, the one thing you really need is slipping away: time.
Gameplay line

Zombies don't go down in one hit – it takes several attempts. Worse, they keep dragging reinforcements into play, pushing your clock forward without mercy. Hesitate here and you won't lose the fight. You'll lose the game.
Noch mehr Fragen. Noch mehr Teamwork. Noch mehr Dreamteam!

Mit 350 neuen Fragen aus über 30 Wissensgebieten geht euer Quiz-Abenteuer in die nächste Runde. Wie immer ist echte Zusammenarbeit gefragt: Kombiniert euer Wissen, diskutiert, ergänzt euch – und findet gemeinsam die richtige Antwort.
Denn nur als echtes Dreamteam könnt ihr erfolgreich sein!
Diables is a mid-heavy eurogame designed by Dani Garcia for 1–4 players in which you lead a colla in the spectacular Mediterranean tradition of the Ball de Diables.

Manage your troupe of performers, coordinate different types of fireworks, and adapt to evolving events to stage the most breathtaking street performances. Carefully plan your actions to captivate the crowd, build momentum across the parade, and earn the highest prestige.
A game of Diables is played over 3 rounds, each divided into 4 phases:
Performances: Players take turns sending their performers into the streets to carry out actions and engage the crowd. This is the core of the game, where key decisions are made.
Passage of Time: The time marker advances, intermediate scoring is resolved, and carts are refilled with new fireworks.
Advance the Parade: Crowd cards move forward along the streets, and performers return to players’ boards, ready for the next round.
Attract the Crowd: New crowd cards are added to each street, bringing fresh opportunities and challenges.
Balance timing, resource management, and positioning to outshine rival colles and deliver the most unforgettable performances.
Collect 3 bees and win the game!

Each player starts with 5 cards, and the multicolor bee is placed in the center along with the decks. On your turn, place a card next to the hive without exceeding the value of the central bee. If it matches the color of another card, remove it! Complete the hive without going over and the bee is yours. If you can’t play, the last person who placed a card takes the bee. If you run out of cards, the bee escapes and no one scores. At the end of each round, refill your hand and reveal a new bee. Keep playing until someone collects 3 bees and becomes the champion!

The Amazing Journey is a globe-trotting game for 2 to 4 travelers. Check which transport vehicles are available in each date, then plan accordingly to make sure you can keep on moving without losing time. Gather Experiences to have an amazing story to tell back home and meet other players at checkpoints: the destination is as important as the memories you made along the way!

They have just put the food to all the pets and they want to get there first. During your turn, you will choose two of the three animals you have, and turn a card to see who pets advance. If it´s the same pet you choosen, It will advance as many spaces as the card said. Besides, you can disguise your pets to cheat another players and advance faster. Will you be the owner of the pets that arrive first? A game of prediction, deception and luck.

Descend into the fiery depths where rivers of lava, towering infernal fortresses, and relentless enemies await. Face dangerous new challenges, defend the last sanctuary of hope, and decide whether to fight alone, together, or with new heroes at your side.

Karak 2: Inferno is the third expansion for the adventure board game Karak 2. It introduces four modular expansions—Infernal Descent (solo/cooperative mode), Infernal Towers, Last Bastion of Peace, and two new Heroes. Each module can be added individually or combined with any other Karak 2 expansion for an even richer adventure.

The restaurant’s kitchen is a disaster and customers keep ordering different kinds of omelettes! In Omelette Express, you have to cook your omelette so that it will be exactly as ordered when you flip it over. Will you be able to complete the challenge before the other players?
In this crazy restaurant, players must be the first to collect 5 or more Order cards to win the game.

All players simultaneously try to correctly cook the omelette shown on their Order card as quickly as possible, placing the required Ingredient tiles into their pan from their own perspective. But be careful! You must visualize how the Ingredient tiles will look once the pan is flipped.

It's a DISASTER! A disaster movie, that is, and you've got a big disaster scene planned for your film. The new Disaster Movie Story Pack adds new Disaster Scene cards with special variable Crew requirements and rewards, new Catastrophes that will suddenly and permanently hobble your production (so plan ahead!), new Scripts, and a ton of thematic tokens to gussy up the devastation you're putting on the silver screen.
31.bggName: Roll Camera!: Disaster Movie Story Pack

expands.name: Roll Camera!: The Filmmaking Board Game

description: Shrine – Duel of Light combines elegant abstract strategy with a real illuminated game board. Position crystals, blend colors, master powerful abilities, and outplay your rival in a visually stunning tactical duel.
Macht aus jedem Abend eine Date Night!

Wann habt ihr das letzte Mal etwas völlig Neues zusammen ausprobiert? Date Night bringt frischen Wind in euren Paaralltag und verwandelt einen ganz normalen Abend in ein echtes Date – mit 60 abwechslungsreichen Mini-Spielen, die euch zum Lachen, Reden, Rätseln, Bewegen und gegenseitigen Herausfordern bringen.
Dabei entscheidet ihr selbst, worauf ihr gerade Lust habt:
Gemeinsam: Im kooperativen Modus tretet ihr als Team an, meistert Challenges zusammen, versucht auf einer Wellenlänge zu sein und sammelt gemeinsam Punkte.
Gegeneinander: Im Duell-Modus fordert ihr euch gegenseitig heraus. Wer kennt den anderen besser? Wer ist geschickter, kreativer oder einfach ein bisschen cleverer?

Von verrückten Geschicklichkeits-Challenges über kreative Aufgaben und Quizfragen bis hin zu Spielen, bei denen ihr euch gegenseitig einschätzen müsst: Jede Date Night ist anders. Wählt einfach die Spiele aus, die zu eurer Stimmung passen, spielt zehn davon für einen kompletten Abend – oder macht so lange weiter, wie ihr Lust habt.

Ob frisch verliebt oder seit Jahren ein Team: Date Night sorgt für gemeinsame Erlebnisse, überraschende Momente und jede Menge Gesprächsstoff – und lässt euch einander vielleicht noch einmal ganz neu kennenlernen.
60 Mini-Spiele. Zwei Spielmodi. Unendlich viele Date Nights.
The Plank das spannende Push-your-Luck Würfelspiel, bei dem es darum geht „Letzter“ zu werden.
Meuterei !

Meuterer haben dein Schiff übernommen und schicken dich und deine getreuen Matrosen über die Planke. Bei jedem Zug versucht ihr, euch so wenig wie möglich zu bewegen. Doch je näher ihr dem Ende der Planke kommt, desto geschickter müsst ihr würfeln und Eure Münzen einsetzen, um immer niedrigere Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
Sammelt Münzen, um zusätzliche Würfe zu erhalten oder Würfel zu ignorieren, oder sammelt Schwerter, um die anderen Piraten näher an den Rand der Planke zu drängen.
Der Pirat, der als Letztes auf der Planke steht, wird verschont, darf auf das Schiff zurückkehren und gewinnt das Spiel
In Boktor, you and your team of heroes must navigate an ever-changing dungeon, battle monstrous creatures, and defeat the Tyrant before the Vortex devours the world.

With simple, intuitive rules, Boktor delivers epic, fast-paced gameplay where every choice matters. Uncover new tiles, battle fearsome creatures, and create powerful combos with your allies to emerge victorious together.

In Jolly Christmas, the Christmas tree is decorated from top to bottom. It is filled with complete strings of lights, cleverly placed ornaments, and finished with the finest tree topper. Make sure to pay attention to what your opponents need so you can snatch ornaments away from them. Whoever has the most beautifully decorated tree at the end wins the game!

Each player builds their own Christmas tree by collecting decorations. In each round, players take turns placing their elf on one of the decoration cards to claim it. The claimed card is then added to the player’s personal Christmas tree. The way in which the elves claim the cards determines the turn order for the next round. By placing ornaments strategically in the tree, players earn points. You must also pay attention to the lights in the tree: if you manage to complete full light strands between the cards, you earn additional points.

After fourteen rounds, it’s time to place the tree topper. Everyone has now created a beautiful tree with fourteen cards. The topper is placed above the two topmost cards, completing the tree. Then all points from the ornaments in the tree are counted, together with the points from completed strings of lights and the topper placed at the top. The player with the highest score has created the most beautiful Christmas tree and wins the game!
Das “Gelingt immer”-Puzzle - das Puzzle für Senior:innen mit Demenz
Das „Gelingt immer"-Puzzle "Gemüse" ist das Puzzle mit Erfolgsgarantie für Menschen mit Demenz. Denn dieses Puzzle gelingt immer, egal wie die vier Puzzle-Teile zusammengesetzt werden.

Puzzles zählen zu den beliebtesten Spielen für Senior:innen. Auch mit Demenz. Denn Puzzles sind ihnen vertraut. Doch oft trauen sie sich nicht mehr, ein Puzzle zusammensetzen. Zu groß ist die Sorge, dass es nicht gelingt. „Das kann ich nicht!“, „Das schaffe ich nicht!“ sind typische Reaktionen von Menschen mit Demenz beim Puzzeln, da sie sich oft überfordert fühlen.
Doch das SingLiesel-Puzzle gelingt immer. Egal, wie die vier Teile des Puzzles zusammengesetzt werden – sie ergeben immer ein Motiv!
Das “Gelingt immer”-Puzzle - das Puzzle für Senior:innen mit Demenz
Das „Gelingt immer"-Puzzle "Obst" ist das Puzzle mit Erfolgsgarantie für Menschen mit Demenz. Denn dieses Puzzle gelingt immer, egal wie die vier Puzzle-Teile zusammengesetzt werden.

Puzzles zählen zu den beliebtesten Spielen für Senior:innen. Auch mit Demenz. Denn Puzzles sind ihnen vertraut. Doch oft trauen sie sich nicht mehr, ein Puzzle zusammensetzen. Zu groß ist die Sorge, dass es nicht gelingt. „Das kann ich nicht!“, „Das schaffe ich nicht!“ sind typische Reaktionen von Menschen mit Demenz beim Puzzeln, da sie sich oft überfordert fühlen.
Doch das SingLiesel-Puzzle gelingt immer. Egal, wie die vier Teile des Puzzles zusammengesetzt werden – sie ergeben immer ein Motiv!
Welcome to Grinivil, a modern, eco-conscious town that all players develop together—while competing to become its most successful developer.

Acquire land, expand roads, plant trees, trade concrete, wood and steel on a changing market, and construct homes, businesses and public buildings. A building may be completed floor by floor by different players, so cooperation can be profitable—but every shared project may also create an opportunity for a rival. Fulfill the visible and hidden desires of Residents, sell them suitable homes and shape a town they would truly want to live in.

At the heart of the game is the modular Time Action Ring. Every action costs time, each player sets their own pace, and money can even be used to act faster. Variable action-tile setups create a different strategic landscape in every game.

GRINIVIL is a highly interactive economic strategy game with a sandbox-style freedom and many viable paths to victory: construction, real estate, infrastructure, resource trading, fulfilling Residents’ needs or keeping the town green. A final Sudden-death Round rewards timing, preparation and careful observation of your opponents.

Despite its short time on the market and the limited number of copies in circulation, GRINIVIL has already received highly positive feedback from players, as well as the prestigious Sax Serenade Keeper award from Game Boy Geek.
GRINIVIL is a language-independent game; printed rulebooks are available in English, German and French.

SPIEL Essen 2026 marks GRINIVIL’s first presentation to the general public following its limited crowdfunding release. Early players have particularly praised its interaction, originality and distinctive time-action system.
39.theme: Contemporary eco-conscious town development, real estate and local economy—competing developers shape one shared town around the visible and hidden needs of its residents.

description: New characters have been invited to the Queen’s Table. Diplomats and confidants will upset the balance of power, but will also allow for new alliances to be made.
With this expansion, you will be able to play Courtisans with up to 6 players. Two new roles, the Diplomat and the Confidant, have arrived with new special effects.
This will also allow you to play in teams of 4 or 6 players.
Bag Of Bugs is a real-time party game in which players try to collect the best set of colored bugs while trying not to go bust.
While one player draws bugs one at a time from the bag, the others will choose in real time a Grab token, which determines how many bugs they will get at the end of draw.
Try to get as many as you need to create the best bug collection, but don’t overshoot it!

Embark in a thrilling chase across the globe! Play as Angela Farbank, a genius counterfeiter traveling the world to cash $1,000,000 in forged checks, or Jessah Hope, an unyielding FBI agent who dreams of putting Farbank behind bars. Bluffing and anticipation are the key words in this gripping pursuit. Will you be able to thwart your opponent's plans and win before they do?

Playing as Angela, you must travel the world and cash counterfeit checks totalling $1,000,000. Use your personal world map to secretly record your movements and your fake identities to escape if you are captured.

As Jessah, blow Angela's cover by locating her, then arrest her before she can carry out her plan. Fortunately, you have the FBI's virtually unlimited resources at your disposal: as the checks are cashed, your superiors will give you new means to take action.

Regardless of your role, 4 randomly drawn Action cards determine the choices available to both of you each round. Take turns placing your tokens face down to plan when and how to act, then resolve the actions according to their value – travel to a nearby city, cash a check from your hand (if you're in the right continent), draw a new check, or add/remove radars and road-blocks on the map.

Sam is a sweet little doggy who is fascinated with looking for and finding the objects that the people of her village lose. She’s so good at it that her neighbours come to her and her friends whenever they lose something and can’t find it. Help Sam and her friends to find the objects the people of the village lose.

A fully cooperative trick-taking game by Petr Čáslava, set during Catherine the Great’s journey to Crimea. Use your character’s unique abilities to rebuild villages along the Dnieper River and create the illusion of prosperity. Only through teamwork can you deceive the Empress and win.
44.theme: Historical, Catherine the Great, Crimea, Dnieper River

description: Davor oder danach?
Das Ratespiel rund um kleine und große Ereignisse der letzten Jahrzehnte

Am Puls der Zeit oder aus der Zeit gefallen? Testet euer Wissen zum Zeitgeschehen der letzten Jahrzehnte: Wurde die erste deutsche IKEA-Filiale vor oder nach der Wiedervereinigung eröffnet? Was wurde zuerst erfunden: der Teebeutel oder die Konservendose? Und was kam zuerst: das Smartphone oder die "Ehe für alle" in Deutschland?
Seid gespannt auf 100 unterhaltsame und abwechslungsreiche Quizfragen zu Sport, Musik, Film und Fernsehen, Politik, Gesellschaft und vielem mehr.
Ein Wissensspiel für die ganze Familie, Ratespaß für Jung und Alt!

Your travels through Alula have sharpened your senses. You are more attuned to the world of the Spirits—those who, immersed in their millennia-long slumber, watch over the world of the living. Aware of their presence, you strive to reestablish the connection so that you may live in harmony with them.

Beyond the Veil brings common objectives to Faraway, in the shape of 13 Spirit cards. The first player to complete an objective (or to expand on it, if they already met the requirements when the card was made available) slip the Spirit card underneath the last Region card they played, granting it new resources and scoring.
Reiseträume – das Memo-Spiel für Senior:innen mit extragroßen Bildkarten

Reisen zu berühmten Sehenswürdigkeiten und besonderen Orten schaffen Erinnerungen, die ein Leben lang bleiben. Das SingLiesel-Memo „Reiseträume“ zeigt bekannte Sehenswürdigkeiten aus ganz Europa und lädt dazu ein, vergangene Urlaubserlebnisse wiederzuentdecken und neue Reiseziele zu erträumen.

Die extragroßen Bildkarten sind gut zu erkennen und leicht zu greifen. Dadurch eignen sie sich auch für Menschen mit Demenz. Denn vertraute Motive können Erinnerungen wecken und zum Erzählen, Rätseln und gemeinsamen Austausch anregen.

Neben dem klassischen Memo-Spiel lassen sich die Karten vielseitig zum Benennen, Zuordnen und Raten einsetzen. So verbindet „Reiseträume“ Generationen und sorgt für gemeinsame Erfolgserlebnisse – ganz ohne Leistungsdruck.

The grand fairytale castle is overrun by monsters. Set off with your familiars, cuddle other creatures along the way to join your undertaking and ultimately relieve the castle of the monsters with a large and powerful group, followed by a grand celebration.
Explore this extraordinary deck-building game with its increasing difficulty levels – and its exceptional cuddling factor!

The Tokyo deck is an expansion to Scribble City that introduces multi-shape buildings! Buildings with more than one shape and type expand your possibilities and compound your problems. Maximise your placement bonuses for maximum rewards!
Scribble City is a city-building drawing game for 1 to 4 players that plays in 60 minutes.
In Shijin, players face off in a duel between celestial spirits to determine who will become the divine protector of the newborn heir to the Emperor.

The four guardians: Seiryū, the Azure Dragon of the East; Byakko, the White Tiger of the West; Genbu, the Black Tortoise of the North; and Suzaku, the Vermilion Bird of the South, each can claim the role of the Imperial Prince’s tutelary guide.

This abstract strategy game unfolds on a 5×5 board. Each player places their Guardian miniature and four Seal tokens of their color onto the board. A player’s turn is quick and intuitive: move your Guardian or one of your Seals to an adjacent empty space, or perform a special move with a Seal if it is adjacent to your Guardian.
The first player who manages to place all four of their Seals adjacent to the opposing Guardian captures it and wins the game.
Don’t be fooled by the game’s elegant simplicity every move hides deep strategic possibilities.
Each Guardian also possesses a unique special ability, enabling distinctive plays and strategies.
Shijin is a fast, accessible, yet deeply strategic game that will truly put players’ minds to the test.
50.theme: Thrilling tactical battle of wits and positioning

description: IQ Flow - Schaffst Du alles in den Flow zu bekommen?
Voll im “flow“ – geschmeidig die Spielsteine gleiten lassen! Beim IQ FLOW werden die Spielsteine ins Spielfeld hinein geschoben anstatt gelegt zu werden! IQ Spielspaß neu definiert – get the flow!
120 Aufgaben im verschiedenen Schwierigkeitsstufen

World Order is a game that simulates international relations, with players leading one of the four 2010s global superpowers (the United States, China, Russia, and the European Union), competing for dominance through diplomacy, economics, and military strategy. The game combines area majority with deck-building, offering asymmetric strategies unique to each superpower. Born from a successful crowdfunding campaign that raised over €2,000,000 from more than 13,000 backers across Kickstarter and Gamefound, World Order makes its first appearance at SPIEL Essen, where visitors will have the chance to discover and purchase the game.
Eine neue Bedrohung kommt aus Richtung Meer. Der Orca-Klan greift mit List, Kraft und Unberechenbarkeit an. Wenn er schlagartig angreift, welches Reich wird dann standhalten?

Doch aus dem Meer erhebt sich nicht die einzige Macht. Auch in der Dunkelheit regt sich Bewegung. Die Spatzen im Schatten – klein und unscheinbar – wurden lange übersehen. Sie fliegen nicht in Formation oder kämpfen mit Zähnen und Klauen, doch manchmal genügt ein einziger Spatz, um die Waage der Macht zum Kippen zu bringen.

A War of Whispers: Erweiterter Einfluss ist die neue Erweiterung von A War of Whispers – Die Mächte der Manipulation – einem gehobenen Familienspiel mit Area-Control- und Arbeitereinsetzelementen für 2–5 Anführer von Geheimbünden ab 14 Jahren von Spieleautor Jeremy Stoltzfus. Die Illustrationen zeichnet Tomasz Jedruszek.
ACHTUNG: Zum Spielen wird das Grundspiel benötigt!
Dino Parade - Hilf den süßen Dinos, ihre Plätze auf dem Spielbrett zu finden.

Bewege Dich vorsichtig durch den Urzeitspielplatz! Kannst du den süßen Dinos helfen, ihre Plätze auf dem Spielbrett zu finden, ohne auf die Eier zu treten? Dieses Vorschulspiel bietet 48 schlaue Herausforderungen mit der perfekten Mischung aus spaßigem Gehirnjogging und fantasiereichem Rollenspiel.
Locker Pack is a boxed accessory set for Table Buster — a modular board game accessory system designed to expand and organize the playable area around the table.

The pack includes magnetic lockers dedicated to the Table Buster Base. Lockers help build and customize a personal player area, creating dedicated spaces for cards, tokens, components and other game assets.

Thanks to the magnetic mounting system, lockers can be attached, removed and rearranged quickly during setup or between games. This makes it easy to adapt the table layout to different titles, player needs and component-heavy setups.
Locker Pack is designed as a clean and practical expansion for players who want more control, better organization and a more flexible Table Buster setup.
This is not a standalone board game, but a premium accessory pack for the Table Buster system.
55.theme: Board game table expansion and organization

description: In “River Rivals,” even the most peaceful animals engage in fierce competition in their search for fresh fish: Using their strengths and highly effective gear, two animal clans compete for dominance on the river, and they won’t shy away from paw swipes and claw attacks. “River Rivals,” published by the Vienna-based game publisher Piatnik, is a clever family game for two players ages ten and up, in which every attack from your opponent requires a smart response.

Purple and turquoise fish dart about in the river, while on its banks, lynx, raccoons, and others prepare to set out on their hunt. It’s sure to be exciting, as the two Danish designers, Christian Kudahl and Mads Fløe, have given each animal competitor unique strengths and abilities. Effects such as “Quick Catch” or “Claw Attack” can be activated immediately upon playing a card from your hand. If, at the end of your turn, three animal cards are in a column (i.e. in front of a river section), great! If the total strength of these cards is now higher than that of the competition in the opposite river section, you may catch fish of your own colour—provided there are enough empty fish spaces on your animal cards. Otherwise, you’ll have to wait for the next opportunity.

Tactical approach and planning are important, but they aren’t everything in “River Rivals”: The draw pile contains a wide variety of animal cards, some of which can even trigger a chain reaction of additional effects. And just like that, the duel can take a completely different turn!

This animal showdown by the river never gets boring, even after repeated play sessions. That’s thanks to the challenging Advanced Mode, which features 18 additional equipment cards that provide plenty of variety with one-time or permanent special effects. Spring-loaded shoes, a picnic barricade, and lucky greens are just three of the imaginative tools that can be used in the battle for the best fishing spot. All cards—as well as how to get started with this tactical two-player game—are explained in detail in the clearly structured rules. After about twenty minutes of play, the duel—vividly brought to life by illustrator Lars Besten—is decided, and the animal clans are ready for a rematch.
River Rivals – At a Glance
An easily accessible “Lane Battler” (battle for different areas/sections of the river)
Exciting mechanics like “Take That” (dealing damage to other players) and unique animal abilities bring tactics and variety to the game!
Advanced mode with 18 additional equipment cards
Overview cards for quick understanding
Compact, portable format
Made in Austria
56.theme: An animal showdown for the best fish!

description: What do a barista, an astronaut, and a fisherman have in common? “Maybe not perfect,” the clever game by best-selling author Friedemann Friese, invites you to rack your brains over this question. One person comes up with a clue that fits one of the professions a little (maybe), none at all (not), and one really well (perfect). Take water, for example: The angler is literally surrounded by it. The barista also works with water, but not exclusively. And wherever the astronaut is, there’s probably the least amount of water. Would you have explained it exactly that way? Great! Because together, you’ll try to match as many clues as possible to the right professions. Sounds easy? Let’s see...
Bei Yellow Brick Road spielst du einen Bauarbeiter, der gerade den gelben Ziegelsteinweg baut, welcher sich durch das Land Oz schlängelt.
Es ist deine Aufgabe, den gelben Ziegelsteinweg zu erweitern! Auch wenn du dabei von den schelmischen geflügelten Affen gestört wirst, willst du den längsten Ziegelsteinweg ohne Sackgassen bauen!
Während deines Zuges baust du mit deinen Karten ein 3x3 Raster, welches so viele miteinander verbundene Straßenkarten wie möglich enthält, um damit mehr Punkte als dein Mitspieler zu erzielen.

Welcome to Nenuphar Jazz, the board game where you become the manager of a talented frog band! Every night, the swamp transforms into a vibrant stage where the finest jazz talents improvise their melodies. In the mysterious wetlands of Louisiana, your frogs are ready to embark on an exciting quest for instruments and form the most spectacular jazz band ever to conquer New Orleans.

Yorkshire, 1928. After a daring robbery at the police station, the officers set a trap in an elegant mansion. They suspect the thieves will return for their loot… but lurking among the police and the thieves is a spy with an agenda of their own.
Deception, suspicion, and strategy: will you manage to complete your mission without revealing your true identity?
Ein kooperatives Kartenspiel in der idyllischen Natur

Schnürt die Stiefel, füllt die Wasserflaschen und macht euch bereit für eine gemeinsame Reise: In Fernweh begebt ihr euch als Gruppe auf eine Wanderung voller Herausforderungen, Überraschungen und Entscheidungen. Ziel des Spiels ist es, gemeinsam verschiedene Etappen zu meistern, Hindernisse zu überwinden und schließlich einen Aussichtspunkt zu erreichen. Dabei ist jede Wanderung wie eine kleine Kampagne aufgebaut, die sich aus zufällig zusammengestellten Szenarien zusammensetzt und so immer wieder neue Erlebnisse bietet.
Fernweh ist ein kooperatives Kartenspiel vom Kobold Spieleverlag für 2-5 Spieler ab 8 Jahren, bei dem ihr gemeinsam alle Karten abspielen wollte um neue Wandereungen und Hindernisse freizuschalten.
Landmarks of the Lost Atlas introduces four new modules to expand your Railways of the Lost Atlas games. These modules can be included individually or in any combination:
Landmarks add new strategies as well as added flavor to maps that include them.
The Metropolitan Transit Department adds a neutral Corporation to the game that players can use to benefit their own interests and/or hinder others.
Events create temporary changes to the core rules of the game that players will need to adapt to.
New Minor Companies and Major Corporations add variety to the Company abilities available in the game.
Bear Necessities is a competitive tableau‑building game featuring simultaneous drafting with a reserve, in‑game scoring, and honeypots!
During each round, players draft two cards from their starting hand: one to add to their tableau and one to save for the next round, then pass the remaining cards to the player on their left.

The card you add to your tableau must be placed orthogonally adjacent to an already placed card, and it activates immediately, granting you victory points. It also triggers all of its adjacent neighbors, creating powerful combos and cascading effects.
The cards you receive from the other player are combined with the one you saved from the previous round, and you draft again until your hand is empty.
At that point, you replenish your hand and repeat the process until everyone has completed a 4‑column by 3‑row grid: after 12 rounds, the game ends and the player with the most points is the winner!

In Hot Heads, you play as a reckless pilot in a hot-air balloon race. Try to reach incredible heights, but be careful not to fly too high. After all, high flyers catch a lot of wind and get lost in the storms raging high in the sky. Low flyers, however, score few points and won’t lead you to victory. If you can find the perfect balance, you might just emerge as the winner of the race.

During the game, on their turn, players draw one card and play one card. You may place this card either in front of yourself or in front of an opponent. This way you can help your own team rise, or sabotage an opponent. Cards with positive values make your balloons rise, while cards with negative values pull them down.

If a player draws a storm card, the storm begins. During a storm, all players must play cards from their hand into their own team. The number of cards that must be played depends on how many storm cards have appeared in the game. Each storm card means more cards must be played from your hand, causing your hand to shrink and your choices to become more limited. When the fourth storm card is drawn, players place all their remaining hand cards into their team, and the game ends.

When the game ends, players total the points for each type of hot-air balloon in their team (there are four types in total). For each balloon type, the balloon with the highest value catches too much wind and flies into the storm. Balloons that fly into the storm do not count toward the final score and are discarded. After removing the highest balloon of each type from the table, players add up the points of their remaining team members. The player with the most points wins the game!
The football game that turns every match into a Champions League final
If you love intense matches, unexpected twists, and friendly rivalry, Player 12 turns any table into a stadium.
Attack, defend, take risks… and score the winning goal at the last moment.
Every decision counts, and any play can change the course of the match.

In Crescendo card game, you will try to be the first to organize your cards in perfect order, from the lowest to the highest number. More than just having a good memory, you will have to use logic and interact with the other players in order to be the first to claim Crescendo. Draw a card or use the special power that is available. Take a chance, react quickly, and start your engines! Memorize, Sort, Gamble (Risk), React Quickly and Interact!
66.theme: Organize your cards in perfect order,

description: In Stars of Ilumeïa, you compete to become the most powerful deity in a distant galaxy. To do so, you must win the favour of the many planets and fulfil their prophecies.

You collect star cards and assemble them into constellations according to specific rules. In return, you receive victory points or other bonuses from the planets. On the star cards, you must not only consider the number and position of the stars, but also other features such as comets, symmetry, flame stars, and much more. New star cards can be purchased from a display. Particularly large constellations earn you a lot of points, but it may also be advisable to quickly create many small constellations. You must also try to generate additional divine energy with certain constellations, which allows you to perform more actions per turn. If a constellation fulfils special characteristics, you can claim particularly strong bonuses on some planets with energy cubes, but the energy available to you is limited.
In Mark Veit's exciting solo mode, the galaxy must be saved from the rule of the sinister deity Obzqurion. Who will set the most powerful celestial signs for the planets of Ilumeïa?

In the busy streets of the Tang Dynasty, clothes are not just to keep you warm—they show your status and power. As a top tailor, your goal is to make the most beautiful clothes for everyone, from royalty to everyday people. In this game of fashion and competition, you will:
Dye Fabrics: Choose the perfect base colors and add beautiful patterns to make the best cloth.
Complete Orders: Cut the cloth perfectly to make the right clothes for every customer and event.
As you finish more and more clothes, the rich life of the palace and the city will come alive on your table. Who will earn the most fame and become the ultimate "Master Tailor" Pre-order
68.theme: Set against the backdrop of the Tang Dynasty (618 to 907 CE)...

description: Finde deinen Weg zur vollständigen Erleuchtung!

Satori ist der japanische Begriff für Erleuchtung: ein Geisteszustand, in dem man ausschließlich in der Gegenwart existiert; Vergangenheit und Zukunft lösen sich auf, um Klarheit der Gedanken durch Transzendenz zu erreichen.
In Satori versucht ihr über 5 Runden, auf eurer spirituellen Reise voranzukommen.

Ihr müsst die Gläubigen zu verschiedenen Altären führen , um dort zu meditieren und zu beten. Außerdem müsst ihr die Mönche in die Berge führen, wo sie Weisheit und Erleuchtung suchen oder dem Architekten beim Bau der Großen Pagode helfen.
Am Ende des Spiels gewinnt, wer den großartigsten Weg zum Satori gewählt hat, was auf der Wertungsleiste angezeigt wird.
Doch der Weg zur Erleuchtung fordert euch viele taktische Entscheidungen ab, um die vielen eng verzahnten Aktionsmöglichkeiten zu meistern.

A mountain town that had cultivated natural dyes for generations was transformed by the discovery of coal. Bridges and railways now span the valley, while sky lanterns—symbols of wishes and hope—once again rise into the night sky.

In Valley of Sky Lanterns, players take on the roles of local leaders. Over six rounds, they take turns selecting dice from the central board and placing them onto their own player boards. Using a versatile multi-use card system, players can launch sky lanterns, develop railway infrastructure, or fulfill a variety of orders. The player who contributes the most to sky lantern launches and railway construction wins the game.

Republic of Rome on a Tiny Epic scale with the diplomatic bite of Queen's DilemmaYou are the head of a Senatorial Family in the Roman Republic using daggers & diplomacy to claw your way to the top and become the most prestigious family in Rome.

Play Actions to add Busts to your Familia, appoint them as Governors to Provinces you have conquered or stolen in an Election. Tax your Provinces for extra Legions, Governor Busts or Prestige. But be careful that those behind you don’t stab you in the back!

At its heart, this is a game about dealmaking. Almost everything in this game is legitimate currency. So you are encouraged to do deals as much and as imaginatively as you can - just don’t be surprised to find a dagger in your back if you break your word too often.

Start Skript is a cooperative card game in which you work together to program the perfect rocket launch sequence. Round after round, you'll try to play your cards in the correct order while relying on teamwork and careful coordination to achieve a successful launch.

The rules are easy to learn, but the real challenge lies in understanding your teammates. You'll need to anticipate each other's decisions, think ahead, and coordinate without having perfect information. Every card played can mean the difference between a successful launch and a failed mission.

With exciting team decisions, clever card combinations, and a steadily increasing challenge, Start Skript delivers tense and rewarding gameplay filled with suspense, discussion, and unforgettable moments of success. It's a cooperative experience for friends, families, and anyone who enjoys solving challenges together.
A snappy and sweet push-your-luck card game about avoiding bad apples, collecting furry fruit critters ...and selling them for maximum profit!

Each round the market will change with new cards displaying the demands for the round. The players will then decide to draw cards, or stop and sell according to demand. The deck does not only contain charming furruits however, there are quite a lot of bad apples in there, as well as effects that will change the market and your furruits...
The most successful furruit merchant after 3 rounds wins the game!
In the hush of twilight, where moonlight threads through ancient leaves, the Wee Folk stir. They dance in patterns unseen by mortal eyes, leaving trails of magic etched in shape and shadow.

Wee Folk is a two-player game of gentle rivalry, where you’ll slide cards like stones across still water, weaving polyomino patterns to echo the hidden sigils of the fae. Where strategy wears the robes of story, and each game is a spell softly cast.
Wee Folk is a 2-player card game where you are attempting to arrange various Wee Folk into pattern in order to collect them.
Collected cards might include actions which may be spent to alter a player’s personal tableau. Cards shift in a “Candy Crush” style whenever sets are removed from the play area.
Wer schnappt sich als erstes die Karte zum Sieg!
Sei der Erste, der eine Zahlenfolge von 1-8 bildet oder alle 4 Honigkarten erbeutet. Drehe klug, riskiere mutig und sichere dir die süßeste Beute!
Ein Memoryspiel für die ganze Familie für 2 bis 5 Spieler*innen ab 8 Jahren.

A word guessing game where your teammate uses different methods to explain words to you. Try to guess the words within the time limit and get high scoring words to form the highest scoring sentences at the end!
Wollt ihr Landlubber auch mal legendäre Seeungeheuer jagen und uralte Schätze heben? Dann kommt und schnappt euch euer Deck!
Besiegt legendäre Monster und erbeutet sagenumwobene Schätze, um Kronen zu erhalten.
Wer am Ende der Partie die meisten Kronen hat, herrscht fortan über die Sieben Weltmeere!
Und so wird gespielt:
Der Käpt’n zählt laut bis 3. Bei 3 deckt ihr ALLE GLEICHZEITIG die oberste Karte eures Piratendecks auf und legt sie offen vor euch in euren Spielbereich.
Hat eine aufgedeckte Karte einen Effekt, handelt ihn ab, bevor ihr weiter macht. Alle Effekte treten sofort ein. Manche Effekte wirken sich auf andere Personen aus.

Habt ihr alle Effekte der aufgedeckten Karten abgehandelt, zählt der Käpt’n erneut bis 3 und ihr deckt wieder jeweils 1 Karte auf. Ihr dürft so lange weitere Karten aufdecken, bis ihr „FREIWILLIG VERZICHTET“ oder (eher unfreiwillig) „SCHIFFBRUCH ERLEIDET“ …
Wenn alle fertig sind wird gezählt:
Hast du die meisten Entermesser erschlägst du das Monster
Hast du die meisten Dublonen, krallst du dir die beste Beute.
Einige Karten haben Sondereffekte die den verlauf unvorhersehbar machen!
Beide verheißen Kronen und damit den Sieg!
Aber bist du zu gierig und deckst 3 Schädel auf, säufst du ab!
Bei Crazy Sherlock wurde ein fürchterliches Verbrechen verübt! Sherlock Holmes, derzeit mit einem anderen Fall beschäftigt, überlässt euch die Aufklärung dieses Rätsels.

Über das Ausschlussverfahren kommst du an die Wahrheit! Wenn du den Tatort, die Tatzeit, sowie die Größe, Augenfarbe und das Accessoire des Täters ermittelt hast, gewinnst du die Runde. Sobald du zwei Runden gewonnen hast, gewinnst du das Spiel
In diesem Reich gehen Magie und Intrige Hand in Hand. Hilfreiche Wesen und mächtige Artefakte wechseln die Besitzer, bis jemand schließlich seine Bestimmung erfüllt!

Biete in deinem Zug eine deiner Handkarten zur Auktion an. Deine Mitspieler bieten mit Karten aus ihrer Hand. Der Höchst bietende erhält die Karte und ihren Effekt, während du die gebotenen Karten bekommst und so deine Hand für die nächsten Auktionen stärkst. Doch Vorsicht: Wer keine Handkarten mehr hat, scheidet aus - jedes Gebot kann dein letztes sein!
The table is set, now it’s time to clear it before it’s too late!
In All You Can Eat Buffet, each player has a deck of Mood cards, which they play to grab food from the table.
During a round, these cards are revealed simultaneously and then resolved in player order and according to their instructions.
But beware: if two players play the same Mood card, they must clink glasses and take a drink token.
Too many drink tokens might go to your head, and you may no longer be able to decide which card to play!
After 10 rounds, the game ends and points are tallied from the different food cards each player has collected.
Foods all score differently: meat gives you straightforward points, fruits reward you for collecting the most types, garlic will cost you points unless paired with parsley, and so on…
The player with the most points wins!
Calling things by their name is easy… describing them is a bit harder, especially when words are limited!
Can you create clear definitions and meaningful sentences using an exact number of words?
The gift of brevity is your only friend. Draw a card, roll the dice, and help your team guess the word using just the right number of words.
It sounds easy, right? Maybe. But time is running out!

Ants are invading the kitchen, heading straight for every snack that’s fallen on the floor. To mark their route, they use words—favoring long ones that let them move faster and reach the food before their rivals. This is going to be a word buffet!

Word Buffet is a fast-paced word game where players score victory points by connecting their nest to different food tokens using chains of words. Use your magnifying glass to reveal the letters on the board and quickly find the word that will help you reach your goal.
A word game with area-majority mechanics!

Trencadís is a mosaic made of irregularly shaped tile shards and an iconic feature of Modernist architecture, especially in the works of Gaudí. In this game, there is a shared mosaic, and each mosaic card contains a letter!
Secretly write a word related to the round’s prompt.
Place your tokens on each letter card in your word.
At key points during the game, the player with the most tokens on a letter claims that card!
Collect trencadís cards to complete famous landmark buildings from Valencia and Barcelona!

Kooperativ aufbauen. Taktisch gewinnen. Einmal gespielt – immer wieder gewollt. TURM – Das Duell ist das einzige Kartenspiel, das beides kann: gemeinsam bauen und gegeneinander gewinnen. Ein Spielgefühl, das ihr so noch nicht kanntet.
DAS PERFEKTE SPIEL FÜR 2 PERSONEN: Konzipiert als reines Zwei-Spieler- Duell
SCHNELL GELERNT, SCHWER GEMEISTERT: Die Regeln sind in 5 Minuten erklärt – doch die taktische Tiefe begeistert Runde für Runde. Spielzeit 45–60 Minuten, perfekt für entspannte Spieleabende.

DESIGN, DAS BEGEISTERT: Die stabile TURM-Box ist gleichzeitig Spielfeld, Aufbewahrung und Blickfang. Authentische Steinmauer-Optik, hochwertiger Druck und liebevolles mittelalterliches Design – ein Spiel, das man gerne auf den Tisch stellt und gerne im Regal hat.
84.theme: Kartenspiel für 2 Personen, Die Verpackung wird zum Spielbrett

description: Quick to teach. Clever to solve. Always worth another round.
Leaves is a small-box visual puzzle race for players who want something quick—but not mindless.

Spot shared features, stack matching leaf cards, and race to turn scattered leaves into one perfect pile. The rules are simple, but every card changes your path, and the best move is not always the first one you see.
Play solo for a quick brain teaser, or compete with friends and family for that satisfying moment when the pattern finally clicks.
Easy to bring out between bigger games, while waiting for the next table, or anytime someone says, “Let’s play something short, but clever.”
Small box. Simple rules. Real puzzle satisfaction.

Tea is no longer an exotic luxury, but a staple of everyday life and a driving force behind London’s prosperity. From the salons of high society to the bustling docks, demand is booming, and the City stands at the heart of a vast trading empire.

As the head of an import office, you must seize this opportunity. Secure the finest teas to fulfil lucrative contracts across the City, then reinvest your profits in the stock market and profit from the growth of the most successful companies.
Manage your resources wisely, serve the Crown, and outmanoeuvre your rivals. In the capital of the world, only the sharpest merchant will build the greatest fortune and claim victory.
86.theme: Tea trade in the 19th-century Victorian England

description: BEAN to BAR – Die Welt feinster Schokolade

In BEAN to BAR schlüpft ihr in die Rolle eines Chocolatiers und begleitet den gesamten Weg der Schokolade – von der Auswahl bester Kakaobohnen bis zur fertigen Tafel. Baut eure eigene Marke auf, bezieht hochwertigen Kakao, entwickelt Rezepturen und stellt Fachkräfte ein. Bringt eure Kreationen über Märkte, eigene Geschäfte und Wettbewerbe unter die Leute und macht euch einen Namen in der Welt der feinsten Schokolade.

Entwickelt vom japanischen Autor Masaki Suga (bekannt durch Airship City), verbindet BEAN to BAR ein cleveres Aktionsrondell mit einem 3×3-Raster aus Aktionsplättchen. Eure Position auf dem Rondell bestimmt, welche Aktionen euch offenstehen – Bewegung und Aktionen kosten Zeit, sodass ihr genau abwägen müsst, wo ihr Tempo herausnehmt und wo ihr Prioritäten setzt.
Am Ende zählt, wie überzeugend eure Schokoladenmarke aufgebaut wurde: Produktqualität, Fachkräfte, eigene Geschäfte, Kooperationen und Wettbewerbserfolge fließen gemeinsam in die Wertung ein.
Vroom is a cooperative racing game.
Evaluate your speed, move your car without board nor reference points and try to cross the finish line in the correct order.

Draw a Speed card and move your car on your made up circuit. With values between 1 and 7, the cards won't make you move with consistency and you'll need to evaluate the distance your car will move; with no board and tiles to guide you. Only your car movement will give a clue about the card you drew.
At the end of the fifth round, everyone must be ordered in correlation with the sum of the 5 Speed cards they drew.
Events and other optional modules will shake up your strategies a little once you get the hang of it: Jump stunts, landslides, weather and more…

Watson & Holmes is a deduction game for 2 to 7 players in which each participant assumes the role of Dr Watson and accompanies Sherlock Holmes in the investigation of a series of unpublished mysteries. To solve them, players must visit different locations where they will gather clues taken from the doctor’s diaries and attempt to piece them together logically before their rivals. Only the player who uncovers the truth most quickly will earn the trust of the genius of Baker Street.

This new volume includes ten new cases recounting in full detail some of the most extraordinary adventures experienced by Watson alongside his inseparable friend and detective. As in the first volume, players will immerse themselves in Victorian England to put their deductive skills to the test.
89.theme: Deduction game set in Victorian London

description: The world is in turmoil. Regional conflicts, shifting alliances, and new economic agreements challenge the world's leading powers like never before. World in Turmoil brings 60 Event cards to World Order, drawn from real-world developments that reshaped the global geopolitical landscape since 2010, including the Arab Spring, Brexit, the US-China Trade War, the COVID-19 pandemic, and Russia's invasion of Ukraine. Confront these crises, respond to threats, and identify opportunities as you guide your superpower through the shifting currents of the emerging world order.

Distop-IA (SurvAIval) is a card game set in a near-future dystopia where analog objects are banned. Players take on the role of smugglers trying to transport books, toys, and cassette tapes between districts and across the border while avoiding patrolling robotic guards.

The game is played in alternating turns. On each turn, a player chooses one of their districts, picks up all the cards in it, and distributes them counterclockwise, as in a game of Mancala. Players must carefully plan how to sneak valuable goods past the guards and into rival districts. Throughout the game, alarm cards with sirens may appear, causing the guards to move and making smuggling even more difficult.

The game ends when the deck runs out or when a player has a guard in every district. Players then score points for the valuable goods they have successfully kept, but each guard eliminates one valuable card from the final score. The player with the most points wins. An advanced mode adds mission cards with scoring modifiers, along with other special cards for greater strategic depth.
Mit den Outcasts kommen neue Helden aus dem Dice Throne-Universum zu euch auf den Tisch. Unberechenbar, unbarmherzig und voller neuer Ideen!
Mit den Outcasts kommen neue Helden aus dem Dice Throne-Universum zu euch auf den Tisch. Unberechenbar, unbarmherzig und voller neuer Ideen!

Verwechselt die gereizte Bleiche Lady nicht mit einer mageren, zarten Blume. Ihre Gegner werden durch ihre gerissenen Manipulationen in die Enge getrieben. Nachdem sie sich dann in ihre furchterregende Werwolfgestalt verwandelt hat, wird sie zu einer wilden Gegnerin.

Der kopflose Reiter terrorisiert seine Gegner mit seinem schrecklichen Kürbiskopf! Stürze dich mit donnernden Hufen, geschwungenen Äxten und Hochgeschwindigkeitsaction in die Schlacht mit diesem klassischen Schlitzer!
WHY PLAY YOUR OWN CARDS?

Play a card or ask someone else to play it by saying “Jusayo.” You can also call the out if you think they do not have it. However, if your request cannot be fulfilled, or you call out wrong, you are out. The last surviving player wins.
- “Jusayo means “please give me” in Korean.
- Play your highest card of the current color, or play someone else’s card by telling them “Jusayo”
- Deduce everyone’s hand by remembering card values and colors.
- If you think somkeone cannot play the card, call them out.

In diesem Euro-Worker-Placement-Spiel erschafft ihr gemeinsam neue Aktionsfelder und nutzt die besondere Aktionen der verschiedenen Nachbarschaften, die die sagenumwobene Geschichte Prags neu erzählen. Erlangt einzigartige Fähigkeiten und kämpft um Einfluss in den vier Nachbarschaften.
Faszinierendes Kennerspiel für 1 bis 4 Spieler*innen ab 14 Jahren.
94.theme: Historisches Setting in Prag im 19. Jahrhundert

description: Chroniken von Brighthelm – 4 Erweiterungen für Aufbruch in BrighthelmKehrt zurück nach Brighthelm – mit vier neuen Erweiterungen voller Geheimnisse, Gefahren und Geschichten.
DIE MONDTÜRME

Entdeckt das Geheimnis der unheimlichen Mondtürme und ihrer seltsamen, ätherischen Wächter auf 400 Karten mit neuen Städten, Dörfern, Gefahren, Schätzen, Ausrüstungen und Quests. Außerdem gibt es 14 neue Vogelgefährten sowie Talente, die eure Habenichtse lernen können, und Flüche, unter denen sie leiden müssen. Ein ganz neues Abenteuer!
DIE KOPFSTEINPFLASTER-INSEL

Erkundet die bunten Straßen von Brighthelm mit dem neuen Stadtregions-Deck oder handelt mit der Cutty Wren, die an der Küste entlang segelt und exotische Waren verkauft. Zusätzlich gibt es persönliche Quests für jeden Habenichts, mehr Vögel, Talente und Flüche sowie zwei neue Spielmodi: kooperativ oder ein schnelleres Spiel für weniger Tugenden.
DIE BRIGHTHELM-BODACHS
Spielt als heimtückische Bodachs und verbreitet eure bösartige Macht im ganzen Land. Betrügt und belohnt andere Spieler und versklavt Kreaturen, damit sie für euch kämpfen.
GESCHENKEBRINGER

Es ist Weihnachten in Brighthelm. Fordert gegnerische Habenichtse heraus, eure Knallbonbons zu ziehen, verteilt Geschenke im Namen der Nächstenliebe und spielt mit neuen festlichen Habenichtsen und Vögeln.
Wichtiger Hinweis: Das Grundspiel Aufbruch in Brighthelm wird zum Spielen dieser Erweiterungen benötigt.
IQ Puzzler Deluxe - Ein Klassiker bekommt eine Deluxe Ausgabe!
Ein zeitloses Spiel im neuen Gewand - 2D auf der einen Seite und 3D auf der anderen Seite des Spielfeldes.
Ein schönes Holzbrett mit großen Puzzleteile sorgen für eine angenehme Spielzeit, es fühlt sich so gut an, wie es ausschaut!
120 Aufgaben in unterschiedlichen Schwierigkeitsstufen

In Card Trip, we plan a road trip across Europe. Try to fill your days as efficiently as possible with different attractions. Attend a cycling event in France, hike through nature in the Dolomites, stroll through Prague, and finish with the tulip festival — it’s all possible in this Card Trip. Make sure to schedule enough rest moments between busy days and plan the most memorable trip this way.

Each player creates their own Card Trip of 16 cards, in which the different locations must be alternated. You cannot visit two locations of the same type in a row, so you’ll need to mix them carefully to make your week as interesting as possible. Your energy per day is limited, so between activities you’ll need to rest at the campsite before starting a new week.

To add cards to your trip, you must always make sure the card you play has a higher number than the previous card in your week. Visiting the campsite (a card with the campsite side face up) resets your week, allowing you to start fresh on a new adventure. Keep a close eye on your energy as well: each week you can have a maximum of 7 stars, after which you’ll need to return to the campsite.

All players simultaneously select 2 cards from their hand and place them face down in front of them. Once everyone has chosen, the cards are revealed and added to the week. The remaining cards in hand are then passed to the player on the left. So make sure to pick the best locations for yourself before you have to pass your hand along. After 8 rounds, the game ends and it’s time to count the points. Each location type has its own way of scoring, and the player with the most points has created the best Card Trip and wins the game!
Microlonies is an asymmetric strategy game in which each player controls a unique ant species, striving to ensure the survival and dominance of its colony.

The game is played on a modular map representing the insect micro-world: hunting grounds, strategic areas, environmental bonuses, and a highly contested central termite mound. Each player begins with their own anthill, the core from which their colony expands.

The game features 16 ant species, all fully asymmetric, each with its own rules, strengths, limitations, and playstyle. Mastering your species while understanding the behavior and threats of others is key to success.
Throughout the game, players will:
Deploy ants to claim hunting zones
Take advantage of environmental bonuses
Complete species-specific objectives
Adapt to the presence and pressure of rival colonies

The central termite mound can become a powerful strategic asset, granting significant advantages, but it comes with a critical responsibility: feeding your population. Overexpansion or poor planning may lead to starvation and collapse.
In Microlonies, every choice matters. Growth, area control, direct interaction, and resource management are tightly interwoven in a demanding game where only the most adaptive colony will prevail.

In an ambitious operation to end the war, the Axis are launching an experimental super carrier across the Atlantic. Find these plans before it can launch, or infiltrate it to bring down this war machine from within!
The new expansion features two brand-new maps along with a host of new mechanics and abilities for both the sniper and the defenders.
Armoured vehicles roll out in the Norman Village!

Infiltrate the ruined Norman Village to find intel on Operation Kraken, but beware of the defenders’ new armoured cars patrolling the area. These armoured vehicles give the defenders lots of exciting options, as driving one lets a defender move faster, search for, and attack the sniper better, while also protecting the defender inside. These vehicles add a significant new threat to the sniper but thankfully the open space around the village allows for multiple points of ingress and quick flanking manoeuvres.
Close-quarters action aboard the Super Carrier!

Stow yourself away aboard the massive Super Carrier to sabotage the ship before it launches, crawling through air ducts armed with explosives and bolt cutters. This is an unique and close-quarters map with opportunities for tense play across the three levels of the Super Carrier. The doors between rooms can be locked by the defenders, which the sniper will need to unlock with either their new loadout cards, or by shooting. Line of sight is restricted as there aren’t any internal windows adding to the claustrophobic feeling for the sniper who'll struggle to find positions for long range shots.
In Chimerium, a game by Éric Dubus & Olivier Melison, you are a magician striving to save magic in a Victorian world threatened by industrialization.

Enter the Chimerium and master the art of alchemy in this strategy game! Select dice to study new species and obtain powerful Artifacts for your laboratory. Manage your resources to create unique Chimeras and trigger cascading combo effects.
Timing is everything. You must aim to release your creatures into the Aether Nexus at the perfect moment to extend your influence.
Manipulate dice values, anticipate your opponents’ moves, and dominate the majority battles to become the true Master of the Chimerium!
Features:

Deep Engine Building: Build a unique engine in your Laboratory. Use Gems, Scrolls, and Elixirs to manipulate the value and color of your dice, creating the flexibility needed to chain powerful combos and maximize your turns.

Tactical Majority Battles: Interaction is key! Releasing Chimeras isn’t just about scoring; it allows you to place cubes in the Nexus. Fight for control in tense majority battles that shift every round, requiring constant adaptation to your opponents’ strategies.

Robust Solo Challenge: Face off against the Archmage Sapphia Lorekeeper herself. The dedicated Solo Mode features an intelligent “Automa” deck with variable behaviors and difficulty levels, offering infinite replayability for solo strategists.
You are a would‑be master thief cat, striving to become the greatest cat burglar by stealing gems from safes or from your fellow thieves.

Each round, a random number of gems will be available in the current safe, and each cat burglar chooses how much they want to steal using a numbered nyanko card. In clockwise order, players reveal how much they plan to steal. Gems are then taken from least to most greedy burglar. But beware: if a player is too greedy and there are not enough gems left when their turn arrives, they will receive useless pebbles instead. If a player reveals the same nyanko number as someone who went before them, they will steal all the gems (and pebbles) that the earlier player acquired that round.

Acquired gems are then hidden away, nyanko cards are returned to hand, and a new round begins. Play continues until all safes have been robbed blind, after which the number of gems and pebbles will determine who may crown themselves Cat Master Thief.
Azimath is an educational board game that helps children develop mental arithmetic through play.
Players solve additions, subtractions, multiplications and divisions while having fun.
Designed for families, schools and educational activities, the game combines learning, strategy and enjoyment.
The multilingual edition includes French, English and German rules.
Set sail to find Isla Bomba!
Embark in your submarine, free your crew from prison, raid the observatory, and find the mythical island!
This expansion for Captain Flip adds 4 new Adventure boards and 5 new Treasure Maps for even more explosive games!
Game Type: Worker placement and engine-building game for 2-4 players, ages 14 & up. Playing time: 30 minutes per player.
The game has a basic & advanced version, the advanced version can be added to the basic game in layers as seen fit (page 24).
Setting: Near-future Earth, deep beneath the surface.
The Premise: In a bid to safeguard humanity from the harsh surface environment, specialized Corporations, controlled by
the players, are utilizing advanced technology in a bid to safeguard humanity.
Your task as a Sub-Corporate Leader is to establish and manage a thriving subterranean society. Dig underground, explore
suitable ground layers to find the ideal terrain to build up your society based on your strengths & unique abilities. Secure
the favour of The Corp by diligently completing assigned tasks and delivering necessary goods and resources. The Corp’s
valuable perspective is crucial for the society’s success; failure will result in irreparable damage to the player’s reputation.
Core Gameplay & Objectives:
• Sub-Corporate Specialization: Each sub-corporation possesses unique expertise in certain environments. Partial
collaboration is essential; you may need to hire the specialized skills of rival teams to successfully evolve your society.
• Resource Management: You must efficiently manage your resources to fund your workforce, keep them fed, and
maintain high morale to build the most successful society.
• Executing Orders: Each turn, The Corp issues a set of orders for you to select from, accompanied by small bonuses.
Success depends on your ability to strategically prioritize these tasks within your managing console.
• The Corp Relationship: Occasionally, you’ll need to “send gifts” to The Corp. Some call them bribes, but we prefer
to view it as a demonstration of your exemplary leadership, designed to gain extra resources or boost your reputation.
• Missions & Victory: The Corp lays out random mission objectives for players to complete, offering Corporations a
chance to gain more reputation. In the end, only one corporation will emerge victorious, earning the exclusive rights to
all future subterranean development. Will your leadership prevail?
Die Zukunft eures Clans – und der Inka-Zivilisation – liegt in euren Händen.

In Ayar - Die Kinder der Sonne schlüpft ihr in die Rolle eines der ersten Clans, der mit den Ayar durch die Anden zieht. Folgt ihren Lehren und verbessert eure Fähigkeiten in Landwirtschaft, Töpferei, Weberei und beim Binden von Schilf.

Ihr müsst nicht nur euren eigenen Clan voranbringen, sondern auch den Fortschritt der Ayar beeinflussen und das Überleben derjenigen sichern, die eure besten Fähigkeiten belohnen. Versucht durch langfristige Strategien die Gunst von Mama Quilla zu gewinnen und Inti mit taktischem Geschick zufriedenzustellen.
Passt auf, dass ihr euch keinen dieser eifersüchtigen Götter zum Feind macht, denn am Ende des Spiels entscheidet derjenige, der euch am wenigsten mag, über eure Gesamtpunktzahl.

Ayar - Die Kinder der Sonne ist ein komplexes Expertenspiel, in dem euch jede Runde wenige Aktionen zur Verfügung stehen. Durch die Verzahnung der verschiedenen Aktionen und dem besonderen Fokus auf dem Timing müsst ihr nicht nur langfristig strategisch planen, sondern auch taktisch auf die bevorstehenden Wertungen reagieren.

In Avalon: The Riven Veil, an Arthurian-based area-control and exploration game, you lead mighty factions through the misty veil to discover what awaits on the mystical isle of Avalon. Explore the mists, discover legendary items of power, bond mythic beasts, hunt for the grail, and prepare for war.
Train hard and defeat enemies with your Katana Spirits!
Players assume the role of canine swordsmen who train their elemental Katana skills with polyomino tiles and defeat multiple enemies to earn points.
On each player’s turn, the player is required to perform one of the following actions:
• Training: Move the Training Token within the Training Area, then take a polyomino Katana Tile and place it into the Player Card, or Rest to recover health.
• Combat: Gather Katana Tiles to defeat an enemy by meeting or exceeding the enemy's Combat Requirements.
The final round when all players have taken the same number of turns will be triggered after all Bosses are defeated, or Minion Card Deck is depleted.
The player with the most points wins the game.
RPG Crossover Episode.
Four scientists vanished without a trace. Can you find them in time?
This episode can either be played standalone or as a prequel for the NEON HOPE RPG Nowhere to Go setting. Also includes Clue cards that serve as hand-outs for the RPG.
This standalone episode is only available in English (as is the NEON HOPE RPG).
100% AI free. NEON HOPE is art made by humans.
Made in Germany. Manufactured by Friedmann.
