In the deepest part of the Enchanted Forest, the shadow of the Evil Queen is longer than ever. Snow White has been enchanted, the victim of a spell that can only be broken by the Queen’s death.

You are one of the Seven Dwarfs. You manage to escape when the Queen’s Henchmen and fearsome Bosses arrive to capture you, but your companions have not been so fortunate. Armed with your axe, your courage and whatever you can gather along the way, you must carve a route forward, defeat her servants and free the other Dwarfs. Each ally rescued will give you strength; each Reward, a new breath of hope.
Your final destination is the Castle. There the Queen awaits you, more powerful than ever. Only by defeating her will you be able to break her spell and free Snow White. Your adventure begins now…
157.theme: Roguelike dice game in the Snow White universe

description: Ein Abenteuer zwischen Realität und Magie

Ein kooperatives Abenteuer für 1 bis 5 Personen, das Strategie und Zeit miteinander verbindet und in dem ihr in einem sich ständig verändernden magischen Anwesen gegen böse Monster und Kreaturen kämpft.
Tauche ein in die magische Welt von Weirdwood Manor, wo die geheimnisvolle und gefährliche Welt der Feen auf die alltägliche Welt der Realität trifft.

Ihr müsst zusammenarbeiten, um gegen die Zeit und eines von drei asymmetrisch gestalteten bösen Feenmonstern und ihre heimtückischen Schergen, die Uhrwerkskarabäen, zu kämpfen, die in das Anwesen eingedrungen sind.

Inspired by the legend of Jure Grando, Europe's first documented vampire, this cooperative board game for 1–4 players takes place in 17th-century Istria, Croatia. Explore the village, manage rising terror, prepare for the final ritual, and confront the vampire in a tense folk-horror adventure rooted in Croatian folklore and European vampire legends.

Would you like to become a disciple of the greatest alchemist, a master whose knowledge extends to the deepest mysteries of this ancient art? However, it won't be easy as his temperament is sullen and his patience is short. He does not tolerate ineptitude, and will demand unstinting effort and dedication from you. If you manage to win his approval, by skillfully overcoming his challenges and proving your prowess in potion-making and formula mastery, he will reveal to you the secrets of elixirs and concoctions of unimaginable power. Are you ready to accept the challenge?

Dice Arcana is both a game and a story. The narrative is divided into Practicum or Alchemy lessons. In each of these lessons, you must solve a formula using the correct ingredients, represented by dice. Each step will bring you closer to mastering the secrets of this ancient art, combining wit and strategy to achieve mastery.
160.theme: Alchemist apprentice in a fantasy world

description: The Battle of Bailén is a two-player historical simulation game that recreates one of the most important battles of the Spanish War of Independence. As part of the prestigious NAC History collection, it offers an accessible, dynamic, and deeply historical experience that will satisfy both new players and veteran military simulation enthusiasts.

Each game reenacts the decisive hours of the clash between Spanish and French forces, allowing players to take command of both armies and face the same strategic and tactical challenges that their historical commanders had to resolve.

Summer of 1808. The French imperial eagles dominate Europe. From the plains of Italy to the battlefields of Prussia and Austria, Napoleon Bonaparte’s armies have defeated the continent’s greatest powers one after another. The Grande Armée seems invincible, and no one imagines that its advance can be stopped.

Spain, officially an ally of France, finds itself in an increasingly tense situation. What began as a military operation intended to control Portugal ends up becoming an occupation of Spanish territory. The imposition of Joseph Bonaparte as king and the popular uprising of May 2nd trigger a war that will soon spread throughout the Iberian Peninsula.

In Andalusia, a Spanish army composed of regular troops, volunteers, and militias organizes to confront the French forces of General Pierre Dupont. Convinced of the superiority of his veteran soldiers, Dupont launches a campaign that should culminate in a swift victory. However, the Spanish generals had other plans. As the French columns advanced under the stifling Andalusian heat, the forces of Castaños, Reding, Venegas, and Coupigny maneuvered to isolate the invaders and force them to fight under unfavorable conditions. Little by little, both armies converged around the small town of Bailén.
On July 19, 1808, a battle breaks out that will change history.

For hours, the French infantry launches desperate attacks against the Spanish positions. Artillery shakes the battlefield. The cavalry seeks to exploit any weakness. Reinforcements march toward the fray, with no one knowing when they will arrive or what effect they will have on the final outcome. Much more than control of an Andalusian town is at stake. For the first time in the Napoleonic Wars, a French field army risks being defeated and forced to surrender. If Spain manages to hold out, the myth of Napoleonic invincibility will be shattered in the eyes of all Europe.
In The Battle of Bailén, you’ll have the opportunity to relive one of the most momentous episodes in Spanish military history and decide for yourself the fate of both armies.
The day the Napoleonic Empire discovered it was not invincible
161.theme: Recreate Napoleon's first defeat in less than 90 minutes

description: Starter Pack Spin Dock is a boxed starter set for Table Buster — a modular board game accessory system designed to expand and organize the playable area around the table.

Table Buster helps create extra space for cards, tokens, components and player assets, making games cleaner, more comfortable and easier to manage. It is especially useful on smaller tables, but also works perfectly for larger games where every player needs a clear personal area.

This starter pack introduces the Spin Dock, adding a rotating and easily accessible play area to the Table Buster system. It is a compact entry point for players who want flexible table organization, quick access to components and a setup that can later be expanded with additional bases, docks, lockers and other accessories.
This is not a standalone board game, but a premium accessory set for board gamers who want more space, better organization and a smoother game night.
162.theme: Board game table expansion and organization

description: Yoyo Tea is now open and bubbling with energy! Fresh specialty milk teas with different flavors and cup sizes are ready to steal your heart. Come sip the fun!

As a loyal fan of Yoyo Tea, it's time to take on a super cute matching challenge! Sharpen your eyes, spot those hidden milk tea matches, and collect as many adorable milk tea cards as you can. Race to claim the title of "Tasting Master" , and if you pull off the perfect Ultimate Triple Match, the champion crown is yours in a snap!
Dive into this bubbly, adorable milk tea matching madness now~
Pre-Order Now!: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSexOj0cPwsjAFO_VwcIFoiIAtRlTO1gSh3brkO3HsXDpXdQ6w/viewform

Lurking in the shadows of the tall grass, the Snakes are making their entrance in LEDA with this clan expansion! Featuring 11 cunning creatures, this clan deploys face-down as eggs, waiting for the perfect moment to reveal themselves. When you activate an area of your grid, the eggs hatch and the Snakes burst forth, each unleashing its power. Some of them can manipulate the egg and snake sides of cards to weave combos that are as unexpected as they are devastating. The Serpents embody the art of cunning: hide your intentions, strike at the decisive moment, and gain the upper hand by surprise!
Spiel ESSEN is the official release of the LEDA : Snake expansion.
Eigenständige Erweiterung für One Card Dungeon

Das Tor zur Hölle ist geöffnet. Feuerstürme wüten, Schatten winden sich und der Herrscher der Unterwelt erhebt sich, um seine finstere Herrschaft anzutreten. Du musst in den Abgrund hinabsteigen und dich ihm in einer letzten Schlacht entgegenstellen, um das Tor zur Hölle für immer zu versiegeln.
Hell's Door ist die neue Erweiterung zum kompakten Dungeon Crawler One Card Dungeon für 1 Held ab 10 Jahren.
Mit dieser Erweiterung kommen zwei neue Module ins Spiel:
Feuerstürme
Es gibt in jeder Ebene ganz besondere Felder, auf denen Feuerstürme toben. Befindet ihr euch auf einem davon, wenn die Monster an der Reihe sind, dann bekommen sie bestimmte Boni auf ihre Basiswerte!
Der Stein der Verdammnis

Bei dieser Erweiterung gibt es in jedem Level einen Stein der Verdammnis. Dieser wird durch einen 4-seitigen Würfel dargestellt. Zerstört ihr diesen Stein, erleiden alle Monster einen Schadenspunkt. Allerdings erhaltet auch ihr einen Schadenspunkt, weshalb ihr sorgfältig abwägen müsst, ob sich dieses Opfer lohnt.
Diese eigenständige Erweiterung enthält eine Dungeon-Karte, eine Boss-Level und eine Dungeon-Karte, eine neue Klasse, fünf Gegenstände und drei Würfel (1 W6, 1 W12 und W4)

The Song Dynasty was an era with unprecedented prosperity of the commodity economy. In A Dream of Splendor in Song Dynasty, you will feel like being in Bianjing (the capital of Song Dynasty, today’s Kaifeng) and witnessing the style of this flourishing age. As the new owner of this street on the edge of downtown, you are faced with unlimited possibilities, but also need to pay off the debt of 50 taels. All you have to do is use your talents to rebuild the street, pay off all the debts, and restore the street to its former prosperity under your management!
Pre-Order Now!: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSexOj0cPwsjAFO_VwcIFoiIAtRlTO1gSh3brkO3HsXDpXdQ6w/viewform

Twilight is falling in the rainforest. Life is gradually awakening among the swaying leaves of the dense canopy, and the first sleepy forest dwellers are peeking out from their hiding places. After building a wobbly tree out of cards, you carefully feel your way through the foliage to dismantle the jungle giant piece by piece. As you do so, you want to snag as many sleepy and valuable forest dwellers as possible. But be careful: If you’re too greedy, you’ll cause the canopy to collapse… and give away valuable points to the others!

Everrealms of Eterna unfolds as an epic adventure spanning a total of 20 chapters, each offering around 50 hours of gameplay and guiding characters up to level 100 - precisely balanced using a proprietary balancing tool. The journey follows the “easy to learn, hard to master” principle and lets players experience a classic hero’s journey from humble peasant to mighty warrior.
At its core are a dynamic cover system with destructible environments and deep progression elements.
Spells level up continuously and grow in power, while duplicate weapons can be forged to upgrade existing gear.
Through alchemy, players can brew valuable potions and poisons from collected plants.

Should fate strike during combat, the Realm of the Dead mechanic kicks in, allowing individual players to avoid immediate death and free themselves from the underworld on their own (as long as the entire group doesn’t fall at the same time).
Variety is guaranteed, as each chapter features about 20 different enemy types (around 100 including guild variants), 80 pieces of equipment, and 40 spells.

Everrealms of Eterna also aims to make things as easy as possible for the game master. The game world is perfectly optimized for Foundry VTT (Version 9.269) and works on a plug-and-play basis. Once the world folder has been copied, all enemies, maps, obstacles, line-of-sight elements, light sources, sounds, music tracks, and animations are immediately available for use, eliminating the need for individual preparation.
In addition, the gameplay experience can be customized by choosing from a wide range of difficulty levels for each player.

In terms of content, each chapter offers special highlights. While Chapter 1 serves as an accessible introduction, allowing players to learn the mechanics at their own pace, Chapter 2 features a massive puzzle dungeon that weaves 16 puzzles into a gripping story. Currently, the first two chapters are fully completed.
Chapter 1 - The Beginning of Everrealms of Eterna - A Pen & Paper RPG by Gamers for Gamers!
The first of a total of 20 planned chapters, which flow seamlessly into one another and offer a total of 1,000 hours of gameplay for up to 5 character classes up to Lv. 100!
What’s included in the package?
Everything you need to play
Foundry VTT port for version 9.269
The first 5 maps for 5 different character classes up to Lv. 5
50 hours of exciting adventures
100 different enemies
80 different pieces of equipment for various builds
Plus, the unique guild, Underworld, randomizer, and cover systems, which give the game even greater tactical depth and high replayability!
Click here for Chapter 1!

Kinoko Kombat is a game in which players build teams of Kinokos and score points based on their combinations at the end of each round. You can recruit Kinoko cards from other players to strengthen your team, with all players’ teams built in secret. The player with the highest score at the end of the game wins.

Impersonate a paraglider racing to reach three antennas before landing on the central target. Victory points are earned for flying above those antennas and other landmarks as well as performing stunts during your race. Always be prepared to adjust your navigation strategy in response to the changing weather and the terrain configuration.

This game could be classified as a navigation puzzle. During your turn you just need to move your pawn, while managing your unique precious resource: your altitude. Moving fast will make you lose altitude but let you take the lead of the race, while taking a detour to move above mountains or under clouds will make you gain altitude but avoid landing prematurely. With a smart map setup procedure generating unique maps, and a random weather forecast, the game will bring you a different navigation challenge every time.

In Cena, every move is shared and every alliance is a risk. Set around a medieval banquet, this trick-taking game transforms the table into a web of shifting loyalties, where your fate depends as much on your neighbors as on yourself.

You don’t win tricks with your own card alone. Each play is part of two simultaneous alliances: one with the player on your left and one with the player on your right. Together, your cards form the winning combination, forcing you to cooperate, anticipate intentions, and quietly influence outcomes on both sides of the table. Reading the game becomes essential.

Cena blends classic trick-taking rules with a unique alliance system and constant tension between cooperation and sabotage. At the end of the feast, your score reflects the performance of both your neighboring alliances, rewarding those who can balance trust, deception, and perfect timing.
Colors collide and numbers add up in this fast, clever card race!
Match the face-up card by color, number, or by mixing colors and adding values. On your turn, play either 1 or 2 cards from your hand to match the card on the face up discard pile.
Chain together smart plays, surprise your opponents, and empty your hand first to claim victory!
Played and enjoyed by gamers ages 5 to 87. :)
Das epische Spiel über unterirdische Königreiche!

Mit dem ersten Tauwetter kommt Bewegung ins Herz der Wiese. Tief verborgen unter dem frischen Grün regt ihr euch als Königin in eurem unterirdischen Nest. Euer Reich - monatelang stumm - beginnt zu pulsieren.

Eure Soldatinnen kriechen empor, bereit, euer Terrain gegen hungrige Tausendfüßer und fremde Kolonien zu verteidigen. Währenddessen graben eure Arbeiterinnen unermüdlich Tunnel und erweitern das Labyrinth. Inmitten der Dunkelheit erwachen die ersten Larven - winzige Versprechen einer kommenden Generation, die schneller wächst, sich entwickelt und anpasst.

Jede Bewegung folgt einem größeren Plan, jeder Schritt dient dem Kollektiv und als die Sonne die Erde wärmt, marschieren eure Ameisen los - nicht nur um zu überleben, sondern um die Wiese neu zu erobern.

Ihr spielt Ameisenköniginnen und versucht, eure junge Kolonie zum Sieg zu führen. Erkundet die unbekannten Weiten der Wiese, entwickelt eure Ameisen, um neue Arten zu erschaffen, sammelt Ressourcen, um euer Nest zu versorgen, und kämpft um die Kontrolle des Großen Tunnels! March of the Ants: Krieg im Unterholz ist ein offenes Strategiespiel mit einer einzigartigen Mischung aus Engine Building, Gebietskontrolle und Karten, in dem viele Wege zum Sieg führen.
Azimut XL is a large-format outdoor orienteering game designed for families, schools, youth groups and sports clubs.
Up to four teams compete using directional cards, movement challenges and strategic decisions to reach the correct destinations.
The game combines physical activity, teamwork and navigation skills in a fun and educational experience.
Rules are available in French, English and German.
174.theme: Orienteering, Navigation, Outdoor Adventure, Team Challenge, Nature

description: Just another exciting day in the jungle. The Monkey, Snake, Toucan, and Chameleon are playing on the leaves. Who can sneak into the opponent’s base to win this little war in the jungle?

Jungle is a 2-player abstract strategy game. Your goal is to move your animals into your opponent's base to win the game. What's tricky here is that your animals don't move by their own rules; rather, they have to mimic the movement of their adjacent animals. Therefore, you must pay extra attention not only to the dynamic interaction of the animal clusters, but also to avoid leaving your animal alone (so they can't move at all).
If one of your animals moves into your opponent's base, or none of your opponent's animals can move anymore, you win!
Ps. The modular boards and the special effects on the leave tiles contribute to the map variety and replay value of the game.
Werde zum einflussreichsten Händler des Römischen Reiches!

Thessaloniki entführt dich in das geschäftige Handelszentrum des 4. Jahrhunderts, als die gleichnamige Hafenstadt unter der Tetrarchie zu den bedeutendsten Wirtschaftszentren des Römischen Reiches zählte. Zwischen belebten Märkten, einlaufenden Handelsschiffen und politischen Intrigen kämpfst du als einflussreicher Patrizier um Reichtum, Ansehen und die Gunst der Mächtigen.

Als ehrgeiziger Kaufmann handelst du mit wertvollen Waren wie Getreide, Öl, Wein und Fleisch, erfüllst lukrative Aufträge und knüpfst Handelsbeziehungen zu verbündeten Städten. Dabei gilt es, den richtigen Zeitpunkt für Verkäufe zu finden und deine Lieferungen an die profitabelsten Ziele zu senden, um den größtmöglichen Gewinn zu erzielen.

Doch wirtschaftlicher Erfolg allein genügt nicht. Über die Einflussleiste kannst du die Beliebtheit verschiedener Handelsziele mitbestimmen und dir zusätzliche Vorteile sichern, wenn deine Waren zur richtigen Zeit am richtigen Ort eintreffen. Wer seine Handelsrouten geschickt plant und die politischen Entwicklungen im Blick behält, verschafft sich entscheidende Vorteile gegenüber der Konkurrenz.

Besonders wertvoll sind erfüllte Verträge, die starke Boni freischalten und neue strategische Möglichkeiten eröffnen. So entsteht ein spannender Wettstreit, bei dem Handel, Planung und Einfluss eng miteinander verknüpft sind.

Mit seinem gelungenen Mix aus Ressourcenmanagement, Auftragsabwicklung und taktischen Entscheidungen bietet Thessaloniki ein anspruchsvolles Strategiespiel, das jede Partie aufs Neue abwechslungsreich gestaltet.
Nutze deine Handelskunst, gewinne politischen Einfluss und schreibe deinen Namen als erfolgreichster Kaufmann in die Geschichte Thessalonikis!
In the Caribbean, waves crash under cannon fire: Great Brittonia and the Kingdom of Ibberia battle for dominance of the seas. In disguise, pirates and privateers prepare to strike and seize victory.

A hidden-role game in which you must sink your opponents’ ships, accumulate doubloons, and do everything you can to claim the ultimate treasure. Are you on the side of the Ibberians or the Brittish? Or are you a sneaky pirate, interested only in getting your hands on the precious loot?
Hoist the sails and load the cannons: Rule the seas or go down with honor!
DISCOVER THE FOREST!
Get points by observing wildlife and collecting berries and mushrooms. Get the most points to win.
- Choose the route for your hike by moving your meeple.
- Go for the most enjoyable hike by choosing the most abundant path.
- Laid back gameplay with nature theme.

Space Qubes is a cooperative sci-fi game for 1–4 players. As the crew of a stranded research vessel, you'll search the damaged ship for vital spare parts, equip yourselves with useful gear, and defend against corrosive slime aliens known as Quantum Biological Entities (Qu.B.Es).

Variable ship layouts, a wide variety of characters and equipment, and 8 exciting scenarios—each introducing new mechanics and objectives—provide high replayability and fresh challenges every time you play.

With easy-to-learn rules, quick setup, and exciting cooperative decision-making, Space Qubes offers an engaging adventure for families and casual gamers alike. Packed in a compact A6-sized box, it's the perfect game to take with you wherever your next adventure leads.
Tauche ab in düstere, apokalyptische Meere
Ion Core ist ein thematisches Sandboxspiel im Kennerbereich für 1-4 Kapitäne ab 12 Jahren von dem Spieleautor Chris G. Sifonios, das in einer postapokalyptischen, dystopischen Meereswelt spielt.

Bei Ion Core wollt ihr der ruhmreichste Kapitän werden, indem ihr Wracks auf dem Meeresboden plündert, gefährliche Kreaturen jagt und in Städten handelt. Um dies zu erreichen, müsst ihr eure Mannschaft vergrößern und euer Schiff verbessern.

Ihr seid jedoch nicht alleine auf den Meeren unterwegs. Feindliche Schiffe und ein mysteriöser, unerbittlicher Gegner verfolgen jeden eurer Schritte. Plant eure Schritte gut, geht Risiken ein und erkämpft euch die totale Kontrolle!
Only one spirit can dominate the forest, flow with water or embrace the flames of fire. Which will you choose? Himizu, the new game from the designer of La Cuenta.

An eternal battle of nature unfolds in the middle of a forest clearing: two spirits, Fire (Hi) and Water (Mizu), clash to prove who truly rules. Take control of one of these spirits and help it dominate the forest by spreading blazing terrain and scorching the land as Fire, or defending the forest for 10 turns and extinguishing the flames as Water.

Himizu is a strategic grid-movement game where players place tiles and use unique abilities to control the forest. On each turn, players must carefully choose which actions to perform in order to gain control of the board and limit their opponent’s next moves. Players can move their figures, place tiles (burning terrain, scorched terrain, puddles, and mud), and interact with enemy tiles and figures. Fire and Water feature asymmetric abilities with different costs that help accelerate each side’s victory conditions. Fire seeks to consume everything in its path by placing all 16 burning/scorched terrain tiles, while Water aims to stop the flames for 10 turns or extinguish the 3 flame figures from the board. Every ability used requires power tokens, which are immediately given to your opponent. The more abilities you use, the more power you grant the opposing element for their next turn.

You must carefully plan every move as the board evolves. Be cautious: desperation may trap you or empower your opponent too much. Patience and perseverance will guide you to victory, brave spirit, but do not hesitate to strike when your opponent is vulnerable and unprepared.

If you enjoy strategy, area control, and asymmetric gameplay, this 2-player game is for you. Every turn matters. Its Japanese-inspired aesthetic immerses players in a duel between kami: nature against nature, destruction against preservation, strength against resilience.”

Sitting Bull, leader of the Hunkpapa Lakota, occupies a key place in history for his role in the Battle of Little Bighorn in 1876, where the Lakota and Cheyenne nations defeated the Seventh Cavalry. Since then, his name has become a symbol of his people’s resistance and the preservation of their traditions.
Experience the daily life of one of the Council Fires, the tribes that make up the Lakota people.
Guided by Sitting Bull, travel the territories in search of game, participate in Lakota traditions and beliefs and witness feats and exploits in the era before the conflict with the US expansion.

The goal will be to accumulate the greatest amount of Prestige Points (PP) at the end of the game. Prestige Points are obtained through the strategic placement of tribe members, the control of the five regions, overcoming milestones and accumulating sacred stones.

Isle Tiles is a dynamic tile-laying game in which you work together to build an island, but always want to own the best areas for yourselves. The island grows quickly, because the higher an area is, the more points it’s worth at the end of the game... at least if you still own it by then. The simple rules let you jump right in, but every turn presents you with new decisions.

Beasts and DiplomacyIn Beasts and Diplomacy, players enter a fantasy world of majestic creatures, intriguing diplomats, and ambitious knights. It is a strategic card game where every decision matters: from choosing the beasts that will join your collection to welcoming diplomats who will have expectations of you, but will bring great prestige to your exhibition. Everything revolves around finding the perfect balance between managing short-term risks with long-term vision, all while maximising your efficiency.

Each game unfolds over three “days”, divided into phases: dawn, morning, noon, afternoon, and evening. These that set the pace of play. Every day you’ll exchange secret quests, send your workers to draft cards, and manage your ore resources to maintain your beasts and fulfill your scoring objectives. Interaction is constant: you’ll compete with other players for the cards that work the best for you and must anticipate and react to their moves to avoid being left behind.

At the heart of the game lies a never before seen combination of open drafting, tableau building and worker placement. Beasts bring prestige, diplomats reward loyalty, traders provide vital resources, and personnel allow you to gain an unconventional and rule-breaking edge. Choosing what to draft and when to draft it, when to keep and when to sell can make the difference between victory and defeat. With multiple paths to scoring, every match is a fresh opportunity to try out new strategies and optimize your choices.

Designed by Mike Kribel and published by Dragon Dawn Productions, Beasts and Diplomacy delivers dynamic sessions (25 minutes per player), both in competitive play and in its solo or family variant. Its blend of drafting, worker placement, resource management, and set collection makes it a fresh and challenging proposal, ideal for those who enjoy efficiency games and strategic building with a strong dose of interaction.

Proviant, die Crew und vor allem haufenweise Schätze: all das braucht Platz an Bord. Jetzt ist es an der Zeit, dein Boot allen Herausforderungen anzupassen und schließlich mit einem prachtvollen Schiff die Karibik zu durchkreuzen!

Mit Pirates of Maracaibo: Shipbuilders lässt du neue Schiffe vom Stapel und verzierst sie mit zwei neuen Galionsfiguren. Ein schmucker Startspielermarker rundet diese dritte Erweiterung für Pirates of Maracaibo ab.
Und wieder heißt es: Leinen los, die Schätze rufen!
That Shape ... Looks Familiar.
"What is that ?! "
Mystery Chain is a game in which players draw and guess the mysterious silhouettes that takes shape with the chain.
The game changes every 10 seconds, revealing more clues. Bringing you closer and closer to the truth. Can you guess what the final answer is?

In Viking Traders, players will sail the Fjords to trade for fortune! Command your longships through the twisting fjord, where every stop brings new trading opportunities. Gather goods, trade at bustling ports and watch prices shift with each exchange. Position your fleet carefully and time your sales for maximum gain. At journey's end, strike a final lucrative deal with distant merchants. The Viking leader with the greatest fortune is hailed as the master trader of the fjord.
With a modular board that creates ever shifting seas, the game has infinite playability and will be a true treasure for any game table.
Includes 8 Double-sided board, 12 wooden longships, 16 wooden price markers, 105 cards, 86 cardboard coins, instructions.
Wir schreiben das Jahr 1971, doch es ist nicht die Geschichte, die wir kennen.

Endlich ist es so weit! Du bist mit deinem Forschungsteam im ewigen Eis der Antarktis angekommen. Doch das ist erst der Anfang einer Reihe aufregender Expeditionen in dieser alternativen Ära. Eure Ziele sind klar vorgegeben: Erschafft ein hocheffizientes Netzwerk aus Stationen, erkundet die unbarmherzige Umgebung und stoßt als Erste zur Einsturzstelle des mysteriösen Meteoriten vor. Nutzt die knappen Ressourcen mit eurem technologischen Wissen, um euch für kommende Expeditionen auszurüsten und bahnbrechende wissenschaftliche Projekte umzusetzen. Selbst bei Temperaturen tief unter dem Gefrierpunkt müsst ihr die Ruhe bewahren. In dieser stürmischen Landschaft entscheidet das Abwägen von Risiko und Wagemut über Triumph oder Untergang. Letztendlich wird nur ein Forschungsteam in die Geschichtsbücher eingehen.

Minikin City is a strategic game where every card you play has a double meaning. Colors and values give you rewards each round, while icons and effects give you points at the end, but only if you fill the card with Minikins!
Reward cards at the center determine the best color for each round. The cards played in that round determine the players' ranking.
Choose to play a card with a high value in the best color to get the most powerful reward, or play a card with an effect you like... or both!

Many effects on the cards and rewards at the center give you Minikins that you can place on your cards. At the end of the game, only the cards that you have filled with the required number of Minikins will activate their scoring effect.
Create your cute city in this clever card game!

A secret nationality, a trip around the world, a bunch of prejudice cards you can use to your own advantage or against others, and lots of fun! But beware, your actions can also harm the environment and ultimately lead to Armageddon, thus "Game Over" for everyone.
Erlebe den Weg vom Kind bis ins Erwachsenenleben!

In Coming of Age durchlebst du deine ganz persönlichen Reise durch Kindheit und Jugend bis ins Erwachsenenalter. Jede Entscheidung, jede Erfahrung und jede Begegnung prägt deine Persönlichkeit und beeinflusst, welchen Lebensweg du einschlägst.

Zu Beginn startest du als Kind mit einer begrenzten Auswahl an Interessen und Fähigkeiten. In dieser Lebensphase spielen deine Eltern eine wichtige Rolle und unterstützen dich dabei, neue Erfahrungen zu sammeln und dich weiterzuentwickeln. Mit den Jahren wächst deine Selbstständigkeit, deine Interessen verändern sich und immer mehr Möglichkeiten stehen dir offen.

Auf deinem Weg knüpfst du Freundschaften, verliebst dich, meisterst Rückschläge und sammelst unvergessliche Erinnerungen. Jede Erfahrung formt deinen Charakter und hilft dir dabei, deine persönlichen Träume und Lebensziele zu verwirklichen.

Das Herzstück des Spiels bildet ein cleveres Würfelmanagement-System. Mit deinen Würfeln besuchst du verschiedene Orte der Stadt, sammelst Erfahrungen und entwickelst unterschiedliche Eigenschaften deiner Persönlichkeit weiter. Diese spiegeln sich auf deinem persönlichen Spieltableau wider und eröffnen neue Chancen, deine individuellen Lebensziele zu erreichen.
Durch die Vielzahl möglicher Entwicklungen, unterschiedlichen Lebenswege und persönlichen Entscheidungen verläuft jede Partie anders und erzählt eine ganz eigene Geschichte.
Gestalte deinen Lebensweg, sammle wertvolle Erfahrungen und finde heraus, welche Persönlichkeit aus dir wird!

The Queen’s Dilemma is a competitive narrative legacy game where you shape the fate of the Kingdom of Ankist across a web of branching storylines. Play as one of six unique nobles, govern your lands, and navigate moral and political conflicts defined by clashing ideologies. Your choices will define not just the kingdom’s destiny, but your own.
Branching narrative: Shape a unique story through your Council’s choices.
Play your own character: Choose from six nobles, each with personal goals and secret storylines.
Evolving legacy system: Past decisions leave lasting marks on future events.
New political paradigms: Balance ideologies like Tradition vs Progress and Order vs Liberty.
Territory management: Expand, construct, and govern your lands.
Mystery boxes: Unlock secret legacy content that transforms the campaign.

In a game of The Queen’s Dilemma, players face a sequence of unique Dilemma cards, each bearing an important decision for the Council to make. There are always two ways to answer the question posed by the Dilemma card and resolve it. Over tense voting sessions, players will decide which direction to take by investing their Power to push for their desired outcome, exchanging Resources to bribe other players and bring them on their side, and make deals to push their Agenda forward.

The city’s natural history museums are competing with one another to show the mostoutstanding dinosaur fossils, models, and exhibitions. In Dino Museum you must manage your paleontological museum. Over 5 rounds, try to be the fastest at excavating fossils and conducting research to attract the most visitors.
193.theme: Dino exposition in the natural history museums

description: THINK YOU KNOW YOUR FRIENDS?
A player picks a subject and ranks answers from other players. Best and worst answers get higher points. Get the most points to win.
- Guess the preferences of other people.
- Learn about others, and perhaps yourself.
- Great for ice breaking.
Everrealms of Eterna – Chapter 2: The Shadows of Lorrant
The journey continues—and the true secrets of Everrealms of Eterna begin to unfold.
IMPORTANT: Chapter 2 requires Chapter 1 of Everrealms of Eterna and continues the story seamlessly.
After the heroes have overcome their first dangers, their journey takes them on to the city of Lorrant. Here, the great mystery behind the world of Everrealms of Eterna slowly begins to unfold.

With 5 new maps, around 70 hours of new gameplay, 100 new enemies, 40 new spells, 80 new pieces of equipment, and an entirely new game mechanic, Everrealms of Eterna grows not only in scope but also in tactical depth.
What’s included in the package?
Everything you need to play Chapter 2
Fully prepared Foundry VTT port for version 9.269
Plus, all base data provided separately for other VTTs or classic pen-and-paper gaming
5 new maps (Maps 6–10)
Character progression from Level 6 to 10
Approximately 70 hours of new adventures
100 new enemies and monsters
40 new spells
80 new pieces of equipment
New conditions, effects, and tactical mechanics
The new verbal duel system
The mysterious NPC: The Gambler
The Largest Puzzle Dungeon Yet
Maps 7 and 8 together form the largest puzzle dungeon in Everrealms of Eterna to date.
A total of 16 interconnected puzzles in the style of an escape room await you.
The focus here isn’t on combat, but rather on communication, observation, creativity, and teamwork. Many puzzles build on one another and reward observant groups.
This dungeon alone offers around 40 hours of gameplay and provides a completely different gaming experience than previous maps.
New Mechanic – The Word Duel
Not every enemy has to be defeated with weapons.
With Chapter 2, Everrealms of Eterna introduces the Word Duel system.
Instead of a classic battle, select bosses can be defeated on a special Word Duel map.
Here, your arguments, strategy, and decisions determine victory or defeat. Depending on how the conversation unfolds, enemies can be persuaded, unsettled, or overcome in entirely different ways.
New NPC – The Gambler
During your journey, you’ll encounter the mysterious Gambler.
This ghostly gambler will repeatedly offer you dangerous bets.
The rewards can be extraordinarily powerful...
...but the stake is never gold.
The stake is your life.
Only those willing to risk everything can win it all.
The story picks up speed:

The true story of *Everrealms of Eterna* begins with the heroes’ arrival in Lorrant. For the first time, they encounter clues that extend far beyond their journey so far. Why does the ancient battle between the angel Ashas and the demon Malfegor suddenly seem to be regaining significance? What really happened during the long-forgotten War of the Sparks, which turned ordinary beings into nearly godlike spellcasters? Why does the young girl Elspeth seem to be at the center of all these events? And what secrets does the enigmatic curio dealer truly hold?
Chapter 2 answers the first questions...
...while raising even bigger ones.
New enemies, spells, and builds:
With over 100 new enemies, 40 new spells, and 80 additional pieces of equipment, the tactical diversity of Everrealms of Eterna continues to grow.
New conditions, effects, and mechanics open up further build possibilities and ensure that every group develops differently.
The numerous class combinations, spells, and equipment give rise to ever-changing strategies and playstyles.
Ready to play immediately in Foundry VTT:
Like Chapter 1, Chapter 2 is fully compatible with Foundry VTT version 9.269.

Simply copy the included “Worlds” folder into the ‘Worlds’ folder and the modules it contains into the “Modules” folder—and all maps, enemies, spells, animations, light sources, walls, music, and sound effects will be fully set up and ready to use.
No need for hours of preparation—just start the game and jump right in
Also suitable for other VTTs and classic pen-and-paper gaming
In addition to the fully prepared Foundry VTT project, the package also includes a separate folder containing all the basic data.
This folder includes, among other things, monster stats, maps, equipment, spells, and other game-related content.
This means that Everrealms of Eterna can also be set up for other virtual tabletops (e.g., Roll20) or as a classic pen-and-paper game using paper and pencil.
Please note, however, that this requires significantly more preparation time on the part of the game master, as Foundry VTT’s automatic setup is not available in these scenarios.
Click here for Chapter 2!
In the enchanted arena of Edera, champions battle for glory and loot. Choose your identity, play your cards wisely, and become a legend!

Epic Melee is an explosive card game where players throw their champions into a boiling arena to seize coveted loot in a merciless melee. Its key mechanic? You choose two cards… but only one will remain in play when the torch reaches you. Bluffing, strategy, and dirty tricks shape every confrontation. Get ready: here, only the most cunning will triumph.

Pandora Celeste: Pirates & Salvage takes the winning formula of Action Cards, Agendas and Emergency Protocols which made the original so much fun and adds yet another chaotic twist as an anarchic team of Pirates board the Ship to pursue a whole new set of Missions in this Expansion to Pandora Celeste.

3 new Pirate characters: Wekka Wabbit, Androidgyna and The Whistler enter the Ship via their Pirate Shuttle (which is formed from the box they come in) and lets you turn Pandora Celeste into a PvP team game which pits the Pirates against (some of) the Crew, or simply play fully-co-op as the Pirate Crew. Are they on a mission to rescue the Crew, steal the Company's secrets or simply loot anything that's not nailed down?

And an expansion wouldn't be an expansion without NEW NASTIES to terrorise the Ship. So enter the Cyber-Slaver on a mission to Augment all intelligent life; the Garr'Goyle with skin of stone; and the Ulaar, a genocidal alien driven mad by the impenetrable armour it has encased itself in - the only way to kill it is by spraying the Flu Vaccine from a MediKit into its ventilation grille.
New Crew, new Nasties, new Missions. Think things were bad? They just got worse!
GET THE EXPANSION + CORE GAME AT A SPECIAL CONVENTION PRICE OF JUST 129 EUROS
Grow Sky is a game about engine building, both mechanically and thematically, as players compete to become the best sky ship master by flying and developing their own sky ships.

Each round, players roll and draft dice to determine their ship's actions, some combination of flying to gain resources and medals, developing their ship for more effective future actions, or going on standby to gain resources. Most actions have a mechanic of their own, from the polyomino-filling of engine room development to the upgradable rondel of each player's flight track.

Over the course of the game, players compete to gain medals and to complete two types of missions - route missions, which grant benefits only to the first person who completes them, and goal missions, which rank the players in order of completion. These missions may range from having specific resources available to specific configurations of parts in the engine room.
The game proceeds until someone gains 15+ medals or fills up their engine room, at which point the final round proceeds, and the player with the most medals wins the game.
The inevitable will come. Cities will fall.
Yet from their ashes, you may rise again.
Plan carefully. Endure wisely.
Preserve what truly matters.
Will your civilization be remembered as the one that left its mark?
Ashes & Amber is a competitive civilization tableau-building card game where cities are living stacks of cards: expand them, protect them, and rebuild them after devastating catastrophes.
- Build cities as stacks of cards and activate the top cards
- Protect your valuable cards or see them burn when the catastrophes strike
- Raise Wonders to show the world your accomplishments
- Achieve greatness by saving your Amber to the end but beware when the major event is triggered
The game unfolds across five eras, Prehistory, Antiquity, Middle Ages, Age of Discovery, and Modern Era, one era per round.
You build your civilization by creating cities. A city is a stack of cards, and only the top card can be activated. The more cities you have, the more cards you can activate and combine.
But the more cities you have, the greater the danger, because at the end of each era, a Catastrophe strikes.
If you do not protect your valuable cards properly, they will turn to ashes. You will need to acquire cards to protect them.
One card in particular is precious, your Amber card. You have it from the beginning, and it symbolizes the resilience of your people through time.

If you protect it and shape your civilization wisely, your Amber card can become a major source of victory points in the final era, when humanity reaches its defining moment. You see this goal from the start and plan your strategy around it.

Players will use five different decks, one per era, for a total of over 700 cards. Each player also selects a unique personal deck, a Tribe, with asymmetric mechanics, which they will develop throughout the game.
Player interaction is indirect, with players racing to claim cards from the shared display, from vital protection to powerful Ambition cards that shape the final score.

The game features 19 unique Tribes, each with its own distinctive play style. Some encourage greater player interaction, others sacrifice a strong start for a spectacular finish, and others bend the rules in unconventional ways.
Build. Burn. Rise Again.
Unterstützt den Widerstand in den Niederlanden in den letzten Jahren des Zweiten Weltkriegs

Es ist der Beginn des Jahres 1943. Die eindringenden Nazi-Truppen sind immer gefährlicher geworden und haben dich und andere niederländische Bürger der Unterdrückung ausgesetzt. Sie durchsuchen ständig eure Häuser, nehmen euch die Freiheit und schicken deine Familie, Freunde und Bekannte nach Deutschland. Ihre Schicksale sind unklar, aber du ahnst das Schlimmste.
Du hast genug! Du bist entschlossen etwas an dieser Situation zu ändern, und du wirst um jeden Preis Widerstand leisten. Selbst wenn es den Tod bedeutet, es muss sich etwas ändern.
Es ist klar, dass du das nicht allein tun kannst. Du hast andere gesucht, die deine Ansicht teilen. Gemeinsam werdet ihr den Widerstand formen und helfen, die Niederlande zu befreien.

Widerstand: Oranje wird siegen! ist ein kooperatives Spiel, bei dem ihr die Rollen echter Mitglieder des niederländischen Widerstands in den letzten Jahren des Zweiten Weltkriegs übernehmt. Das Spiel ist szenariobasiert, wobei sich jedes Szenario auf eine der Aufgaben konzentriert, an denen der Widerstand arbeitete.

Beim Aufbau wählt ihr ein bestimmtes Szenario aus, das eigene Ziele und Sonderregeln hat. Diese Ziele können den Ausbau eines Netzwerks, die Sicherheit der Menschen oder das Transportieren wichtiger Gegenstände beinhalten. Um zu gewinnen, müssen alle Szenarioziele erreicht werden. Es gibt 4 Schwierigkeitsstufen (leicht, normal, schwer, extrem), die bestimmen, wie ihr das Spiel aufbaut.

Während der Partie müsst ihr sicherstellen, dass euer Alibi gut ist, die Moral hoch bleibt und dass ihr jeden Ort sicherhaltet, damit es keine Durchsuchungen gibt. Das ist nicht einfach, denn die Besatzer kontrollieren viele Straßen und sind unterwegs um herauszufinden, wer die Widerstandsmitglieder sind.

When the town falls asleep, the secret messages begin. The hidden ones use their animals to send word across the rooftops while avoiding the attention of the villagers. In Midnight Mail you play tiles and position your animals so that matching pairs line up in a clear path — when they do, one delivers a hidden message to the other, and the farther it travels and the higher the ground it crosses, the more points you score. Better yet: one delivery can clear the way for another, so a single well-placed tile can set off a whole run of messages — and the bigger the chain, the bigger the bonus.
201.theme: secret nighttime messengers delivering hidden messages through animals across a sleeping town

description: In Endeavor: Deep Sea, players explore the vast depths of the ocean, hiring dedicated workers and completing objectives in an effort to chart the environment and help protect it. The Endeavor: Deep Sea Uncharted Waters expansion will push players to the edge with challenging new missions, undiscovered depths to explore, and a whole new team of specialists looking to join your crew and make an impact on the world. Players will also get to incorporate new mini-expansions tasking them with saving endangered aquatic wildlife, exploring deeper depths than ever possible, and restoring the fragile balance of the marine ecosystem.
Unforgettable… but can you capture it?
Between concerts, food, the crowds and all the crazy festival moments, your mission is to tame the chaos and snap that one ultimate shot: the perfect group photo of your happy crew.

Boaromia brings the Festival Vibe straight to your tabletop. In this cooperative game you work together to keep your energy up, have fun, and reach the right stage at the right time. Only with meticulous planning, teamwork and a touch of festival magic can you claim victory.
So grab your coins, stick with your friends, and get ready for the most chaotic, fun festival ever!

ERULEBOOKAn expansion by Richard Wilkinsfor 1 to 4 players, ages 12 and upIn Duplicity, nothing in the network is as it first appears. A new SMC alternates between two states, forcing you to constantly adapt. To help counter this threat, dual-colored Deckers can flip their profile card, revealing a different special ability when they flip.Dive straight into the action with the two new missions and freely combine the new content with the base game to challenge old adversaries in new ways.
Erlebt den erbitterten Wettstreit zwischen Leonardo da Vinci und Michelangelo
In den italienischen Stadtstaaten des frühen 16. Jahrhunderts bedeutete Kunst nicht nur Schönheit, sondern auch Macht.

Die Ateliers konkurrierten heftig um Ansehen, während die Künstler unermüdlich daran arbeiteten, Meisterwerke – von großartigen Fresken bis hin zu Marmorstatuen – zu erschaffen, wobei jedes Werk ein Ausdruck ihres Könnens und ihrer Vision war.

Ihr unterstützt die konkurrierenden Ateliers von Leonardo da Vinci und Michelangelo Buonarroti, um Ruhm und Aufmerksamkeit des Adels an verschiedenen Höfen und in Galerien auf der gesamten italienischen Halbinsel zu erlangen.

In Maestro - Künstler & Rivalen repräsentiert ihr alleine oder als Team von zwei Spielern die Ateliers von Leonardo da Vinci und Michelangelo. Dabei führt ihr abwechselnd mit euren Karten Aktionen aus, um Kunstwerke zu erschaffen, diese in den nördlichen Provinzen von Italien auszustellen und um die Aufmerksamkeit und Gunst der mächtigen Sammler und der lokalen Elite zu erlangen.

Maestro - Künstler & Rivalen ist ein asymmetrisches Karteneinsetzspiel im Expertenbereich mit Area-Control-Elementen für 1–4 Künstler ab 14 Jahren von Spieleautor Andrea Robbiani, welches in der Renaissance angesiedelt ist.

In Drops of Evil, players take on the role of witches competing to brew the most powerful poison. Gather ingredients from the forest by sending out your Familiars, then combine them in your Alchilab, a powerful device used for the synthesis of lethal mixtures. Place Ingredients strategically to improve their toxicity and unlock bonuses. Recruit shady Assistants and follow grim Recipes to make your draught even more wicked. Can you brew the deadliest poison?
Trigger Warning is a fast, laugh-out-loud party game for 2–6 players where only one player or team walks away alive.

Inspired by Russian roulette with a wild western twist, every turn is a gamble. Push your luck, outsmart your opponents, sabotage their plans, and use powerful items to turn certain defeat into an unexpected victory.

Learn the rules in under two minutes and play a full game in just 15 minutes. Trigger Warning is the perfect filler to kick off game night, break the ice, or bring to the pub. Multiple game modes, including team play, and support for up to 12 players with two copies make it ideal for groups of any size.
Fast. Chaotic. Unpredictable. One more round?
The number 8 is considered the luckiest number in Chinese culture. You will compete with others to accumulate the most wealth and fortune.

Place your dice on one of the 4 bet mats to steadily earn coins while blocking opponents to do the same. Change your dice fortunes by purchasing yun cards or go for the big payout by playing the jackpot.
There are limited koban coins in the pot so it's a race against time to be the richest person at the table!
Wir müssen dringend einen sechs- stelligen digitalen Code entziffern. Sammle Informationen, schreib sie dir auf. Erkenne Muster, kombiniere, und sei schneller als deine Mitspieler.
Nur so wirst du auf die richtige Lösung kommen und Digit Code gewinnen!

The Dutch bees need your help! Their habitat is shrinking, and now wasps are starting to bother them as well. This must be stopped. Surround the larvae with honey to protect them from the wasps so they can no longer be stolen!

In Honey Wall, you try to score points by surrounding bee larvae with honey. By rolling dice, you can draw larvae or honey on your game board. If you roll a wasp, you may steal larvae from your opponent that are not surrounded by honey and score points with them at the end of the game. Large groups of larvae are worth more points, but they are also more vulnerable to wasps from your opponent. The player who has scored the most points with larvae at the end of the game wins!

Each player receives their own sheet with a game board. On this board, players draw their own area with larvae and honey. A turn consists of four phases: a dice phase, a honey and larvae phase, a wasp phase, and a flower phase. When it is a player’s turn, they begin by rolling 2 or 3 dice (depending on which have been unlocked by the player). The player may reroll one or more dice once before moving on to the next phase.

The second phase is the honey and larvae phase. In this phase, all dice showing a honey or larvae symbol are resolved. The active player colors in spaces on their board where possible to place honey and larvae.

After this comes the wasp phase. During the wasp phase, the player may try to steal larvae from other players. If a larva is not fully surrounded by honey, it is vulnerable to wasps and can be stolen. A player who rolls one or more wasps may place a wasp symbol on other players’ boards to indicate that a larva has been stolen. At the end of the game, stolen larvae give points to the player who stole them.

In the final phase, the flower phase, the active player checks whether they have completed a flower on their board. If so, they may move up one step on the tree at the bottom of the board to unlock bonuses. After this phase, the next player takes their turn, and play continues until an end condition is met.

The game ends immediately when a player has either two areas with seven or more enclosed larvae each, or five areas with fewer than seven enclosed larvae each. The player who has collected the most points from (stolen) larvae wins the game!
Welcome to FaeKin. A fast-paced, beautifully twisted game of social deduction, where everyone can lie but no one has to.

With the balance between Summer and Winter shattered, it’s up to you to uncover who truly serves which court. In true Fae fashion, mischief is encouraged, deception is expected— but nothing is required. The choice to lie, mislead, or stay silent is entirely yours.
Duel your fellow Fae. Play cards face down. Peek. Bluff. Expose.
Touch the Crown and Dagger to make a claim.
Convince, deceive, or be deceived. But once your decision is cast - the truth will be revealed.
Crown the right Heir AND dagger the right enemy - and your Court claims victory. But choose one wrong and the rival Court wins everything.

PLAY THAT SONG! FILMMUSIK Edition Musik-Quizspiel mit App für Film- & Serienfans. Erlebt die bekanntesten Songs und Soundtracks aus legendären Filmen und unvergesslichen Kino-Momenten! Die Filmmusik Edition enthält 250 Playcards mit insgesamt 1.500 abwechslungsreichen Fragen. Scannt den QR-Code, startet den Song über die kostenlose PLAY THAT SONG! App und stellt euer Wissen über Filme, Stars und Soundtracks unter Beweis. Mit Punkteinsätzen, A/B/C-Cards und der PLAY-Taste für schnelle Antwortdiebe wird jeder Spieleabend zum musikalischen Kinoerlebnis.

The skyscrapers of New York City and Tokyo soar high into the sky. An impressive skyline characterizes both cities, whose real estate markets have always been fiercely competitive. The buildings keep growing taller and taller, their value often determined by their proximity to central landmarks. This is also the case in the innovative deck-building game “Project Skyline” from the Viennese game publisher Piatnik, which features a strategic competition centred on building skyscrapers and developing attractive neighbourhoods on a large game board.

In “Project Skyline,” designed by Florian Maas, players who build smartly are always a step ahead of the competition—and often even a floor ahead. Floor by floor, players shape the city and can also make use of existing buildings. But true pros know: it’s not just the height of the buildings that matters, but also their location. In “Project Skyline,” it’s therefore advisable to keep an eye on the surroundings while constructing buildings and, when developing neighbourhoods, to pay attention to where residential, commercial, industrial, and recreational areas are located. A direct connection to central landmarks or well-known monuments usually proves to be particularly lucrative. Monitoring the competition is therefore part of daily business, because in these mega-cities, everyone is striving to make the most money.

This is also the goal of the game, where strategic planning and quick reactions help players achieve continuous improvement of their own card deck (deck-building). At the start of each turn, players can purchase new cards or upgrade cards in their hand, with the aim of using their effects as profitably as possible for building or earning money—and, ideally, triggering a scoring event.

The rules and glossary explaining the various card functions are easy to understand, allowing ambitious builders to quickly tackle new projects and bring their construction plans to life. After about an hour of play, the two to four construction-savvy players (ages 12 and up) tally their accumulated money, and it becomes clear who has most skilfully outpaced the up-and-coming competition.

“Project Skyline” expands the new “Strategy Games” category in the Piatnik portfolio with more complex game worlds for young adults and frequent players. The metropolitan setting offers an innovative combination of deck-building and three-dimensional city-building that never loses its appeal, even after repeated plays: This is due not only to the high-quality production of the game components and the appealing illustrations by Lars Besten, but also—and in particular—to the countless card combinations that constantly present new challenges to the players. The rules are slightly modified for two-player games and, in certain details, also for scoring in the two metropolises on the double-sided game board. This allows each new game to unfold its own unique allure, but sky-high scores are possible in all variations.
A video about “Project Skyline” is available on the “Piatnik Spiele” YouTube channel at: https://youtu.be/WNrkhMByyNo
213.theme: Build skyscrapers in New York or Tokyo and win big

description: Behalte den Überblick – oder schieb die Karte clever weiter!

Chamäleons können Farben unterscheiden … aber Zahlen sind nicht so ihr Ding! Darum liegt es an dir, die richtige Anzahl an Symbolen zu sammeln – aber nicht zu viele! So sicherst du dir den Sieg. Mit Taktik, einer Prise Glück und einer gut platzierten List wirst du Chamälio-Champion!

In diesem farbenfrohen und taktischen Kartenspiel versucht jedes Chamäleon, die besten Karten für den eigenen Spielbereich zu sammeln und gleichzeitig die Mitspieler vor schwierige Entscheidungen zu stellen.

Zu Beginn werden alle normalen und speziellen Karten gemischt und als verdeckter Stapel in die Tischmitte gelegt. Eine Karte wird offen daneben ausgelegt, sodass dir immer zwei Möglichkeiten zur Verfügung stehen: Du kannst entweder die offene Karte wählen, bei der du alle Informationen kennst, oder die verdeckte Karte nehmen, bei der nur ein Teil der Informationen sichtbar ist.

Nachdem du dich für eine Karte entschieden hast, musst du taktisch abwägen: Behältst du die Karte selbst oder gibst du sie einem anderen Chamäleon weiter? Besonders spannend wird es bei verdeckten Karten, denn hier musst du entscheiden, wer die Karte bekommt, bevor sie vollständig aufgedeckt wird.
So entsteht ein unterhaltsames Spiel voller Bluffen, Einschätzen und cleverer Entscheidungen, bei dem du nie genau weißt, welche Überraschung die nächste Karte bereithält.
Bist du bereit für den verrückten Söldner?
Willkommen bei Dice Throne!
Herzrasen garantiert! Dice Throne ist schnell gespielt und fordert geschickten Karteneinsatz und clevere Würfelmanipulation. Euer Spieleabend wird eskalieren!

Tritt den Avengers bei! In Marvel Dice Throne schlüpfst du in die Rolle eines berühmten Marvel-Helden! Jeder Held von Marvel Dice Throne wurde sorgfältig entworfen und ausbalanciert, um das bestmögliche thematische Erlebnis zu bieten, so dass du deine Lieblingshelden wirklich verkörpern kannst wie in keinem anderen Spiel. Mit brandneuen Fähigkeiten und asymmetrischen Designs sind dies die bisher innovativsten und aufregendsten Charaktere!

Greife deine Gegner an und aktiviere Fähigkeiten, indem du mit den fünf einzigartigen Würfeln deines Helden würfelst. Sammle Kampfpunkte und gib sie für Karten aus, die eine Vielzahl von Effekten haben, wie z.B. permanente Heldenaufwertungen, Statuseffekte und die direkte Manipulation von Würfeln (deine eigenen, die deines Teamkollegen oder sogar die deines Gegners).

Der respektlose Söldner mit der großen Klappe, Deadpool, durchbricht immer wieder die vierte Wand. Dabei kämpft er mit seinen stets gefährlichen Fingerpistolen gegen Bösewichte, während er gleichzeitig seinen Heißhunger auf Chimichangas bei seinem treuen Taco-Truck stillt und sich auf seine unaufhaltsame Mutantenheilung verlässt.
Diese Deluxe-Ausgabe enthält den Helden Deadpool sowie Deluxe-Aufwertungen
