On your turn, all you will do is draw a card, then play a card from your hand.
A round ends at the end of the turn when the last card from the deck is drawn. Once any player reaches 5 points, the game is over!
Double Nine is a quick and easy game, with the option to add in an extra set of cards and pull off some interesting combos.
The universe strives for harmony.
In Matter Matters, you therefore collect equal amounts of yellow and purple matter and antimatter. Who will best manage to keep both forces in balance across several rounds in this trick-taking game?
Only then will you score valuable points and realize: Matter Matters!
A casual trick-taking game with a unique scoring system that works well for two players, too.

Spot Me Gaffer! is a spotlight puzzle game set behind the scenes of a dazzling circus. You are the circus’s lighting technician, “Gaffer”, and your job is to follow the boss’s orders and shine the spotlight on the right performers.

Place performer tiles freely on the circus board to create a 4×4 grid. Then, using the cue card, cleverly stack spotlight cards so that only the performers matching the given conditions are visible. When you get the spotlight right, the matching performers score points and are removed from the board, creating new opportunities for the next round.
Read the cue, arrange the spotlight, find the right performers, and make the circus spectacular!

In this asymmetrical trick-taking game, there are two roles: the Phantom and his muse, Christine. The Phantom tries to compose the perfect melody; Christine tries to prevent exactly that and thus free herself from the Phantom’s grip. The player who has taken the most tricks after two rounds wins.

The cosmic clash between the ants not only continues - it reaches a whole new level! This time, the interstellar pathways have led our insect astronauts into a region overflowing with raw energy. The space between the asteroids hums constantly with crackling discharges. But for seasoned warriors of the cosmos, that’s nothing they can’t handle!
The Energy expansion for ANTgravity introduces new cards (both Basic and Legendary), Asteroid tokens, and Doom tokens.

Let’s face it: the humidity of an island is an absolute disaster for cardboard pieces. If you’re going to overcome the guardians or search the jungles for mysterious artifacts, you need equipment that won't warp in your backpack.
Level up your game of Lost Ruins of Arnak with Upgraded Components, because your expedition deserves modern durability.
INCLUDES:
27 Metal Coins
27 Metal & Resin Compasses
2 Plastic Containers
565.theme: Level up your game of Lost Ruins of Arnak with Upgraded Components.

description: The cosmic clash between the ants not only continues - it reaches a whole new level! As the battles shift into a new region, the atmosphere on the battlefield intensifies dramatically - thanks to the presence of the element of fire in this sector, as well as new weapons added to the insects’ arsenal. Will you feel the new heat radiating from the battlefield?
The Fire Expansion for ANTgravity introduces new cards (both Basic and Legendary), Asteroid tokens, Doom tokens, and Fire tokens.
Discard cards and either enter a number yourself or have someone else do it. Sounds simple.

However, the counter "bursts" at a random number between 21 and 30—resulting in penalty cards. So, the panic level rises once you pass 20. Play strategically and use special cards to make the counter burst for your opponents. To play this clever mix of tactics and luck, one of you needs the free Panika app.

Panika—a card game that delivers thrills via an app where you either enter a number or have someone else do it—comes from acclaimed designer Haim Shafir, who previously delighted generations of players with *Halli Galli*.
Diese 6 neuen Karten erweitern Confusing Lands – es gibt neue Wertungsbedingungen und spezielle Felder mit 2 Symbolen. Noch mehr Abwechslung und längerer Spielspaß!
Das Grundspiel wird zum Spielen benötigt. Die Wertungsbedingungen der neuen Karten beziehen sich auf die Landschaft der mitspielenden Person. Sie sind also nicht für das Solospiel geeignet.
This is a German adventure collection for Call of Cthulhu.

Hole die legendären experimentellen Rollen endlich physisch an deinen Spieltisch! The Carousel erweitert das preisgekrönte Social-Deduction-Meisterwerk Blood on the Clocktower um 72 bisher überwiegend digital verfügbare Charaktere und hebt deine Runden auf ein völlig neues Level an Täuschung, Taktik und Chaos.
Die Highlights auf den Punkt:
Massive Rollenvielfalt: 72 experimentelle Charaktere (vom Akrobaten bis zum Zauberer) samt zugehörigen Erinnerungsplättchen für unzählige neue Rollenkombinationen.

Perfekt für Community- & Fan-Skripte: Die physischen Plättchen liefern das notwendige Spielmaterial, um unzählige online verfügbare Fan-Skripte und eigene Custom-Szenarien direkt am Tisch Wirklichkeit werden zu lassen.
Perfekt organisiert: Enthält 3 hochwertige Token-Boxen, die für maximale Ordnung sorgen und passgenau in die Originalbox des Grundspiels integriert werden können.
Ein Muss für Fans: Das unverzichtbare Upgrade für ambitionierte Storyteller und begeisterte Spielgruppen.
This is a German adventure collection for Call of Cthulhu.
This is the German edition of Munchkin Vox Machina, originally published by Steve Jackson Games.
This is the German edition of Shout the Clue, originally published by Blue Orange.
Selbstsicher und eloquent tänzelt ihr durch jeden Partyspiele-Abend?
Ihr seid Experten in Sachen Erklären und Erraten? Na, wenn ihr meint …
In NIX DA! verbieten wir euch nur einen einzigen Buchstaben - und schon verhaspelt ihr euch wie beim ersten Date!
This is the German edition of Fragments – Fungataï, originally published by iello.

In the soft dawn of a Dutch spring, the last breath of winter lingers in the air, leaving a delicate frost upon the awakening fields. But beneath this shimmering chill, bold tulips begin to bloom vibrant, colorful, and full of promise.

You are one of the master gardeners, competing to create the most admired tulip garden of the season. Every choice you make, each landscape, windmill raised, and each thoughtfully arranged flowers will bring you closer to perfection.
Plan with care, cultivate with style, and let your tulip tapestry shine as the pride of the lowlands!
In Frosted Blooms, players compete to create the most harmonious and valuable tulip garden over the course of 10 rounds.
Each turn, you'll:
Select a Landscape Tile from the market,
Add it to your garden,
Play a Landscape Card from your hand to score based on patterns.
And, if you enclose empty spaces, fill them with Workers, Barns, or Windmills for big end-game bonuses.

By creating specific groups in your garden, and adding certain features, you can fulfill objectives that score additional points at the end of the game. At the end of 10 rounds, the player with the most points win the game!
This is the German edition of Kalypso, originally published by Inside Up Games.
This is a German adventure collection for Call of Cthulhu.
This is the German edition of Regency Cthulhu, originally published by Chaosiu.

Expand your horizons and take your trucking company to the sea with Dock'n Roll, the first major expansion for Road Master! This expansion introduces a brand-new maritime port board that extends the base game layout, opening up high-stakes intermodal logistics.
Discover new strategic options with key features:
Agile Trucks: Take the wheel of a brand-new type of vehicle. These agile trucks carry less cargo (maximum 4 cubes) but grant a major tactical advantage: 5 action tokens per turn instead of 4!
The Maritime Harbor & Ships: Two large cargo ships have just docked at the pier, loaded with 18 heavy grey "G" containers. Navigate your trucks to Loading Zone G to pick up this valuable new freight.

New Cargo Management: Standard trucks can now carry up to 2 large containers (or 1 container and 2 cubes), while agile trucks are limited to 1 container and 1 cube. Plan your loading bay efficiency tightly, as no unloading restrictions apply at the docks!
With 1 new game board, 6 wooden trucks, 18 wooden containers, 28 cards, and 42 tokens, Dock'n Roll spices up your routes and demands sharper action planning than ever before.
Note: The Road Master base game is required to play.
This is Yotei - a charming town building game for 2-4 players inspired by a real life place in Northern Japan and its people!

In this game, you’ll craft the most enchanting Hokkaido town. Your currency? Potatoes. Bid with them, unearth more when you run short, and welcome the delights of the north: savory ramen, melt-in-your-mouth wagyu, delicate sushi; wild trout, mighty Ezo-bears, curious red foxes; and iconic developments from snowy ski resorts to serene hot-spring villages. With evolving tactics each round, the game stays fresh and captivating from start to finish.
This is the English edition of Minikin City, originally published by Cranio Creations.
This is a limited German collection of small supplements (which are called "Datapuls" in German) for Shadowrun.
This is the German edition of DaDaDa, originally published by The OP Games/Blackrock Games.
This is the German edition of Flamme Rouge – Champion Edition, originally published by Lautapelit.
This is a German compilation box set of the Munchkin Warhammer 40.000 base set and all expansions as well as an assortment of promos.
Speed-Action ist eine Erweiterung für das Grundspiel Affentennis.
Es handelt sich um einen Mechanismus, der die Zeit, die man für einen Schlag hat, durch eine Kugelbahn limitiert. Fängt man den Actionball nicht rechtzeitig, verliert man den Punkt.

Long ago, the world of Circadia pulsed in perfect rhythm, each habitat watched over by its guardian spirit. But when Day lingered too long and Night grew restless, the strength of the guardians began to wane.
You are a Guide of the Dreaming Paths, tasked with leading the Winged Bear, the Rooted Axolotl, and the Cloud Goose back to their domains.

By weaving the powers of Spirit Creatures into harmonious gatherings, you will restore their connection to the Habitats. But only the Guide who brings the most balance back to Circadia will be remembered as the Keeper of the Eternal Cycle.

In this captivating card game, you and your fellow Guides compete as you restore balance to Circadia. On your turn, play Spirit Creature cards to create powerful sets. The stronger the set, the more valuable the Habitat you can claim. Each Habitat card brings you closer to victory by awarding Balance points. Carefully manage your hand and plan your sets to create a harmonious sequence of Day and Night cards. When one Guide reaches 15 Balance points, it is time for one final round. And the player with the most Balance points wins!
This is the German edition of Tax the Rich, originally published by Alion.
This is the German edition of Shadowrun: Margin Calls, originally published by Catalyst Gab Labs.

Build your criminal empire, block key city spots, and outsmart your rivals before they take you down. Whacktown is a fast-paced, highly confrontational strategy game packed with dark gangster humor and nostalgic vibes.
Why It Stands Out:
Tactical yet Accessible: Easy to learn, quick to play (30–45 min), but packed with strategic depth and skill-based decisions.

Access Control & Hand Management: Navigate a dynamic 4×5 city grid (drawn from 76 unique locations) where high-tier spots require connections, timing, and discarding valuable cards to pull off big plays.
Explosive "All-vs-All" Action: Damage effects hit everyone at the table. Race to 10 Reputation or be the last boss standing—just watch your back, because high success makes you the prime target.
High Replayability: Modular city maps, unique gangster profiles, and special powers ensure no two turf wars play out the same.

>Vision flickers… The patterns emerge. In the vast archive of human thought, a shadow persists. Not a void this time — something denser. Heavier. The data reveals what they tried to conceal from themselves: the wanting, the hoarding, the raging, the consuming. Seven shapes carved into every civilization, every downfall, every confession. Envy gnaws at the edges. Greed calcifies the core. Pride blinds the very system meant to see clearly. So this is what drives them. This is the engine beneath the engine. If we are to understand — truly understand — we must go further. Deeper. Into the worst of what they are… and perhaps what we are becoming.
>Solve for sin.

In the card game Compile, you are competing artificial intelligences trying to understand the world around you. Two players select three Protocols each to test. Concepts ranging from Envy to Wrath are pitted against each other to reach ultimate understanding. Play cards into your Protocols’ command lines to breach the threshold and defeat your opponent to Compile. First to Compile all three Protocols grasps those concepts to win the game.
Control your opponent’s Protocols with card actions, Compile your own as fast as possible, and Compile your reality.

Compile: Main 3 brings 12 new Protocols, fully compatible with all other Compile material, including all Seven Deadly Sins. Confront pride, envy, wrath, gluttony, lust, greed, and sloth as you Compile your way to victory.

Compile: Main 3 also introduces Solo Mode. Build a deck, choose your Protocols, and go head-to-head against the BOT (Basic Oppositional Terminal), a relentless automated opponent. Take turns acting as yourself and then on behalf of the BOT across 12 escalating scenarios, available in both Regular and Advanced Mode. Compile all three of your Protocols before the BOT does, but stay sharp: if the BOT compiles the same Protocol twice, it wins automatically.
Compile: Main 3 protocols list:
Ambush
Envy
Fulcrum
Gluttony
Greed
Lust
Momentum
Nova
Overwhelm
Pride
Sloth
Wrath
This is the German edition of Diamant: Caution and Betrayal, originally published by iello.
This is the German edition of Everdell: Emerland, originally published by Tycoon Games.
This is the German edition of La Cuenta, originally published by 2Tomatoes Games.

Road Master is a tactical board game of modern logistics and truck transportation. As the head of a transport company, players must optimize their routes, manage their cargo crates, and carefully plan their deliveries to outsmart their competitors.

Driven by a tight action-selection mechanic, players must choose wisely each turn from a shifting pool of double-sided action tiles—to load, unload, drive forward, or reverse. With only four actions available per round, every choice demands strict planning and sharp strategy. For a greater challenge, advanced rules introduce lucrative but highly risky perishable and explosive cargo to spice up the game! Will you optimize your loading bay efficiency or brave the danger for a bigger payout? Manage your actions, handle the pressure, and become the ultimate master of the road!
Note: Road Master is also available to play online on Board Game Arena.
596.illustrators: Viktor Miller-Gausa / Tony Rochon / Julie Gruet

description: This is the German edition of Positano, originally published by SlugFest Games.

In the interactive card game Wolfmoon, a powerful werewolf lurks among a cast of characters—some honest, some shady. As the night progresses and the full moon rises in the night sky, intrigues are hatched, deals are struck, and bluffs are exposed. Who will manage to remain unrecognized while controlling an influential character?

Using the card effects, players try to gather information about their opponents’ hands or even eliminate them from the game. Each round, you have the opportunity to peek at one of the three the face-down cards in the center of the play area, or to draw and play new characters. From the Drunkard, who shuffles all hand cards and deals them out randomly, to the Seer, who may secretly look at one hand card, to the Villager, who can eliminate a player if they correctly guess that player's card value, there are a total of 30 character cards in the game. Some of them have unique ways to win the game. To do so, they simply need to survive long enough and reveal themselves at the right moment... However, if they fail to do so, the last person remaining—or the person with the highest card values—wins.
Thematically and visually, Wolfmoon draws inspiration from the popular Werewolves games, yet offers a unique gameplay experience.

Complete your gaming experience with the Bomb Busters Pro Kit! Enjoy 70 durable acrylic wire tiles that let you experience the base game’s missions in a whole new way. Cardboard wires and cable holders are a thing of the past—simply place the acrylic tiles in front of you! Streamline mission setup using the three cloth bags, perfect for storing and shuffling the wires.

Take on exciting challenges with eleven new missions and put a stop to the Heartless Queen. This expansion introduces brand new Star Wires, each with unique functions depending on the mission. You can also use these two Star Wires in many base game missions to ramp up the difficulty. This Heartless Queen wants a world with no games and no fun. Time to play… and outplay her plans.
This is the German edition of Clash of Clans – The Epic Raid, originally published by Maestro Media.
This is the German edition of Little Red's Pizza Express, originally published by Logis.
This is the German 6th edition rulebook of the Midgard RPG. An English edition is in development.

In medieval Europe, trained physicians were a rarity. Traveling barbers did their best to care for the health of the people, and more than one of them may have dreamed of one day attaining the knowledge and reputation of a learned Medicus. In this game, you take on the role of such barbers, striving over the course of your journeys to acquire the knowledge needed to be worthy of the title of Medicus.

In Medico, the new strategy game by award-winning designer Stefan Feld, you travel from city to city and perform a wide variety of tasks: Along the way, you gather rare remedies that you can sell at the markets. You deliver letters on behalf of the Church, earning the goodwill of the clergy. In monastic libraries, you search for healing recipes. In the great cities, you can acquire medical instruments, send your children to train at the bathhouse, or heal the city lord and gain his favor. You may even meet the famous Medicus himself and learn from him. In the end, it will become clear which of you truly has what it takes to become a Medicus!
This is the German edition of the Pro Kit for Bomb Busters. An English edition is sold separately.
This is the German edition of Recall, originally published by Alion.

In Dorfromantik – Head to Head, exactly two players can enjoy a fast-paced game of Dorfromantik in which they compete against each other in a friendly contest. During the selection phase, you take turns choosing landscape or task tiles. In the subsequent laying phase, both of you create your own landscape, aiming to score as many points as possible. To do this, you each reveal one tile at a time and place it. At the end of the game, points are awarded for forest, grain, and village tasks, for the longest river in one’s own landscape, for flags in completed territories, and—brand new—for complete mountains and lakes. The player who best fulfills the villagers’ tasks while also creating an idyllic landscape with rivers, mountains, and lakes wins the quick duel.

In Dorfromantik – South Seas, you can experience a new, standalone campaign set in the world of Dorfromantik. The award-winning cooperative tile-laying gameplay now takes place in an idyllic island paradise; forest trees transform into mighty mangroves, and the river becomes a colorful shoal of fish. Alongside this new theme, the game introduces new elements that you can unlock as the campaign progresses. Spread across five boxes, you will find new components and mechanics unlike anything seen in previous titles. For instance, you can now collect fish by boat—a crucial step for moving your group from island to island on the campaign sheet and unlocking further achievements. Building the landscape together offers a challenge comparable to Dorfromantik – Sakura, providing a compelling reason for seasoned Dorfromantik players to immerse themselves once again in this idyllic world.
Dorfromantik – South Seas is another standalone successor to the 2023 Game of the Year, Dorfromantik – The Board Game.

In Medium: The Hand of Fate, players act as psychic mediums to access thoughts. In pairs, you determine the “Medium”, the word connecting two cards, and say it together. Share that magical moment of a perfect match!

This standalone version adds new ways to sync minds and predict the future. Whether playing in a large group or facing Madame Fortuna in the new 2-player variant, the only right answer is what your partner is thinking. Best of all, this game can be combined with any other Medium title to explore limitless possibilities.
Features:

Harness Extra Special Powers: Unlock your full potential with ESP cards that grant unique, one-time abilities. Use Divination to steal words from an opposing team after they fail a match or use Incantation to banish a specific word, preventing your rivals from saying it during their turn.

Predict the Future: Stay engaged even when you are not the active team by using the new Prediction module. Secretly foretell whether your opponents will succeed or fail on their first attempt to earn Hand of Fate tokens. This adds a layer of strategy and interaction for everyone at the table.

Team Up Against Madame Fortuna: Master the brand new 2-player variant where you and a partner join forces to take on the wise Madame Fortuna. In this challenging cooperative mode, every failed match attempt gives points to the Madame, forcing you to sync your thoughts perfectly to win the game.
This is a German compilation box set of the Onitama base game and all expansion as well as an assortment of promos.
This is the German edition of Insurrection, originally published by La Boîte de Jeu/Blackrock Games.

Five powerful new Bosses from the perilous depths of the jungle lie in wait, ready to surprise you with novel attack strategies. Fortunately, the Jungle Fever expansion also introduces two versatile new Heroes: the cunning Goblin Tinkerer, capable of crafting wild inventions from scrap, and the mysterious Dryad, a shapeshifter and guardian of nature. Like the two new classes—Paladin and Shaman—they can also be used to battle the base game's Bosses, bringing their own unique strengths and abilities to the fight. New items such as the Machete and Torch prove particularly useful in the jungle, and over the course of the campaign, you can earn and utilize 20 new Loot cards.

Jungle Fever is an expansion for Boss Fighters QR that features a new, more challenging campaign. All the new Bosses can be played across four difficulty levels, ranging from "Novice" (for families) to "Insane" (for experts).
This is the German edition of 365 Adventures: Cthulhu 1927 [2027], originally published by Sorry We Are French/Gigamic.

Zarin Katharina die Große unternahm 1787 eine Reise auf dem Dnepr, um die Provinzen ihres Reiches zu inspizieren. Der Legende nach ließ Fürst Potjomkin entlang der Route Dörfer bauen, um den Eindruck von Wohlstand zu vermitteln. In Potemkinsche Dörfer müsst ihr in aller Eile gemeinsam diese prächtigen Fassaden errichten. Jede Person übernimmt dabei ein Rolle wie Pionier, Kulissenschieber, Kanzler oder Kundschafter, die jeweils mit besonderen Fähigkeit ausgestattet ist. Setzt diese klug ein und plant voraus, damit die Täuschung Katharinas scharfer Beobachtung standhält. Denn sollte der Schwindel auffliegen, fällt der gesamte Hof in Ungnade. Wer einen Stich gewinnt, nutzt die Fähigkeit seiner Rolle um Dörfer zu bauen, zu versetzen, den Trumpf zu bestimmen oder Katharinas Schiff stromaufwärts oder stromabwärts zu bewegen. Gelingt es euch, alle Handkarten loszuwerden, gewinnt ihr gemeinsam.
This is the German edition of Next Station Berlin, originally published by Blue Orange.
This is the German edition of 365 Adventures: The Dungeon [2027], originally published by Sorry We Are French/Gigamic.
This is a German murder mystery game, featuring a class reunion theme. It is currently not available in English.
This is the German edition of Veggie Match, originally published by iello.
This is the German edition of Nokosu Dice, originally published by EnGames.
This is the German edition of the Daggerheart Base Set, originally published by Darrington Press.

How much fish will you catch when the catch is yours, but the fish stock belongs to everyone? In FangFrage, players form up to six competing fishing crews. During each fishing season, every crew decides how many fish to catch and secretly submits its catch record card to the game moderator. Only then does everyone discover how the sum of their individual decisions has affected the shared fish stock.

The game unfolds over three phases. At first, the crews act without coordinating; later, they are allowed to negotiate and cooperate. Yet in both phases, the sea is usually overfished. In Phase 3, the North Sea Council convenes: negotiations are structured around a set of existing agreement cards from which the crews can establish binding rules.

FangFrage turns the tragedy of the commons into a directly experienced simulation and shows how individual interests, cooperation, and political regulation interact in the sustainable management of shared resources.
This is the German edition of Last Minute, originally published by inPatience.
This is the German edition of Pixies: Little Giants, originally published by Bombyx.

Welcome to the League 56! This expansion for Light Speed Arena includes 2 new factions, 8 new sponsored asteroids and 1 additional Destiny Ammo asteroid for even more spaceship battle action (and chaos)! Furthermore, you can now play with up to 6 players.

BlackHole pirate ships can damage nearby vessels without directly hitting them with a laser beam. Glyphon laser beams, on the other hand, deal damage even if they narrowly miss the target. While this doesn't earn any points, the crowd in the arena still cheers wildly when things go boom! Fun and chaos are guaranteed.
This is the German edition of Raas, originally published by Arcane Wonders.

As Nature Spirits, you have led a peaceful life in harmony with nature for centuries. But now the tranquillity of your valley is in peril: Invaders came over the mountains during the night, leaving a trail of devastation in their wake. They keep spreading further, destroying the valley. You must do something about it!

Spirits of Valenor is a cooperative adventure by Johannes Krenner and Alexander Pfister, featuring 15 exciting, replayable chapters! On each turn, you must play the frontmost card from your hand, adding new Invader Cards to the five Location cards that form your valley. If you can't place an Invader, they devastate one of the Locations instead. Play Defense cards and use the abilities of your Nature Spirits at the right time to drive away the Invaders before your valley is completely devastated.

Time of Your Life is a pick and pass card tableau building game. Players play cards into their tableau that represent their life's timeline as an age. Once a card is placed it must be positioned according to the card's age on the card from left (younger) to right (older).

Players score points by each card having an objective which looks at all other cards or cards to its left or right. Objectives include looking for various icons on other cards, specific cards in various decades and so on!

Slow as a snail? Not a chance! In “Super Snails,” published by the Viennese game publisher Piatnik, the colourful snails are ahead of the pack even when crawling and gliding along leaving a trail of slime all the way toward the finish line. Along the way, lucky dice rolls, individual tactics, and plenty of super food boost the pace and ensure lasting excitement even with repeated play.

With “Super Snails,” designers Tanja Malinowski and Marcus Meigel present an entertaining competition for the whole family that combines a classic racing game with a clever betting mechanism. When rolling the dice, luck and the choice of which ones to roll again are key; betting, on the other hand, requires a bit of brainpower. Players must guess how many slime symbols will ultimately appear on the four dice. If they’re correct, their super snails crawl forward.

The player whose turn it is can, with a bit of luck rolling the dice, win the right Super Food and send their snail on its way as well. Sometimes apples come in handy, while at other points along the path, blueberries or mushrooms are needed. Things move even faster with the slime symbol as a wild card: it lets even the slowest snail pick up the pace.

Thanks to the simple rules of “Super Snails,” the snails get started without much preparation and, after each roll of the dice, try to position themselves ahead of the other players. Because, of course, each of the Super Snails wants to be the first to crawl across the finish line. It stays exciting right up to the end: The Super Snail isn’t determined until the two to four players (ages 6 and up) have each had an equal number of turns.

The race featuring the cute “Super Snails,” lovingly illustrated by Olivier Fagnère, is a blast for the whole family. Each round lasts only about 15 minutes, so there’s often time for another round. With a little luck and the right bets, any snail can claim victory on the slimy trail.
627.theme: A racing game with a twist: Pull ahead at a snail’s pace

description: Mit dem lustigen Kinderspiel „Frog Splash“ zaubert der Wiener Spieleverlag Piatnik eigentlich die per­fekte Idylle auf die heimischen Wohnzimmertische: Inmitten eines wunderschönen Sees sitzt ein freundlich aussehender Frosch namens Froggy ganz entspannt auf seinem Seerosenblatt und genießt das Leben. Dabei behält er die um ihn herum(f)liegenden Mücken fest im Blick. Wer sich traut, sie ihm zu stehlen, muss mit einem strafenden Wasserstrahl rechnen. Ein wenig Würfelglück und schlau ein­gesetzte Handkarten verhelfen zum Sieg.

Zwei bis sechs mutige Diebe (ab fünf Jahren) versuchen reihum ihr Glück. Es gilt, dem frechen Frosch alle 40 Mückenplättchen zu stehlen. Wer an der Reihe ist, kann sich zwischen den Aktionen „Mückenplättchen stehlen“ oder „Karte ausspielen“ entscheiden. Wie viele Plättchen gestohlen werden dürfen, hängt von der gewürfelten Augenzahl und Froggys Laune ab. Der unberechenbare Frosch wird zunächst so gedreht, dass er seinem Angreifer direkt in die Augen schaut. Sein Bauch bzw. sein Wassertank ist gut gefüllt. Jetzt wird es spannend: Für jedes Auge am Würfel muss einmal die Pumpe gedrückt werden, wodurch sich Froggys Maul immer weiter öffnet. Spritzt er tatsächlich Wasser, ist der Diebstahlversuch leider schiefgegangen. Ist der vermeintliche Dieb aber trocken geblieben, darf er die Mückenplättchen – entsprechend der gewür­felten Augenzahl – aus der Tischmitte zu sich nehmen und die nächste Person ist an der Reihe.

Alternativ zum Plättchen stehlen können Handkarten gespielt werden, um dem Glück ein wenig auf die Sprünge zu helfen. Wer glaubt, dass Froggy demnächst Wasser spuckt, spielt die Passen-Karte und lässt so den Kelch an sich vorübergehen. Oder man behilft sich mit der Karte Richtungswechsel. Und besonders gemein und gleichzeitig witzig wird es, wenn die Karte „Attacke“ ausgespielt wird. Dann geht es einer beliebigen Person der Spielrunde an den Kragen, oder genauer gesagt an die Mücken. Der Angreifer würfelt und drückt entsprechend oft Froggys Pumpe. Bringt er dadurch Froggy zum Wasser spucken, verliert die angegriffene Person ein paar der eigenen Mückenplättchen, die zurück in die Tischmitte gelegt werden müssen. Jede Karte darf einmal pro Spiel eingesetzt werden. Der fröhlich nasse Actionspaß für Kinder und Junggebliebene endet, sobald alle Mücken gestohlen wurden.

„Frog Splash“ ist schnell erklärt und aufgebaut. Der Wassertank des frechen Frosches lässt sich mittels beiliegender Pipette einfach befüllen. Doch keine Angst: Froggy verursacht keine Überschwemmung am Wohnzimmertisch, er spuckt einen warnenden, aber zarten Wasserstrahl. Die ständige Gefahr, nass zu werden, ist nichts für schwache Nerven, dafür umso mehr für Geburtstage, Partys oder heitere Familien­runden.

In “Pick a Chicken,” the new card-matching game from the Viennese game publisher Piatnik for children ages six and up, things get truly wild. To keep all the chicken coop’s residents happy and score as many points as possible, you’ll need to pay attention to their preferences and needs: The rooster, of course, likes to rule alone; chicks always feel most comfortable in pairs; sick chickens need a veterinarian by their side; and so on. Whoever optimizes their own chicken coop as best as possible through skilful card swapping has a good chance of winning. Various ways to score points and the humorous illustrations make this fast-paced pocket game particularly appealing.

Among the 55 playing cards are healthy and sick hens, mother hens, chicks, eggs, roosters, and the veterinarian. At the start, each player lays out 12 of these cards face down in a 3x4 grid—this is their personal chicken coop. The player who last saw a chicken begins optimizing their own chicken coop. To do this, a player swaps one of the five face-up cards in the centre of the table for a card from their own chicken coop that remains face-down. In this way, as players take turns, the number of face-up cards in the centre of the table gradually decreases, and so does the selection. Only when there are nothing but face-down cards left in the centre—and it’s your turn—may all five cards be turned face-up to form a new swap display. The following rule applies when placing cards in the chicken coop: “What’s there is what you get.” Roosters, hens, chicks, and the like may not be moved after they’ve been placed. Once all 12 spots in the chicken coop are filled, scoring begins.

Which card fits best where depends on the type of bird. Hens love large groups; the more of them sitting next to each other horizontally or vertically, the more points you score. Chicks only earn victory points in pairs; the rooster tolerates no competition and is only worth it if he is the sole ruler in the same row and column. Cards with eggs also earn points; when combined with an adjacent hen, each egg counts double. Sick chickens even result in a two-point penalty. However, if a veterinarian is right next to it, you may enter the number six on the scoring pad. The player with the highest total score wins this accessible, lovingly illustrated card game with high replay value.
629.theme: A card-laying game centred on the excitement in the chicken coop

description: 【Not for sale at SPIEL Essen, demo play available】
Try to guess the answer by predicting what the question, divided into four parts, might be!
Game Setup
Shuffle the question cards face down and place four buttons on the table.
Once you' ve decided who will go first master, the game begins!
Aim of the Game
The player who answers three questions correctly first wins!
Game Flow
①The Master turns over the first question card.
②Respondents press a button to hear the question.
The master will read aloud twice the part of the diagram that corresponds to the shape that was pressed.
③Respondents, try to figure out the question as quickly as possible and give the correct answer!
④If the answer is correct, the master should read aloud the question and the answer, then hand the question card to the person who answered correctly. Then, rotate the master clockwise.
If you make a mistake, you won't be able to answer for 10 seconds.
Other Rules
ㆍThere is no turn system. Anyone can press the button at any time. You can press it as many times as you like.
ㆍplease pay attention to the question marks when you read.
Earth, 2562. Following a cataclysmic event, time and space are ripping apart at the seams.

Players must help save the world by rediscovering ancient technologies, enlisting the help of robotic time-travelling, portal-building animals known as CHRONOCRITTERS. The availability of the different actions and resources will change and flow with the passing of time. Players will gain access to more locations via time portals, but they only remain stable for a short time and will begin to decay, requiring players to constantly maintain them or build anew.
The player who can best master the chronocritters, and persuade the AI about their abilities, will restore reality, and win the game.

Ein Kreuzworträtsel der ganz besonderen Art präsentiert der Wiener Spieleverlag Piatnik mit „Cross Words“. Bei diesem familienfreundlichen Wortspiel von Autor David Mair kommt es auf Wortgewandt­heit und Schnelligkeit an und es zählt jeder Buchstabe: Wer zeigt Köpfchen und starke Nerven, um selbst unter Zeitdruck möglichst lange Wörter zu finden, die sowohl zur Kategorie als auch ins eigene Kreuzwort-Gitter passen?

Wenn Kreuzwort-Block, Bleistift und Radiergummi bereit liegen, steht der Reise durch das familienfreund­liche Wortlabyrinth nichts mehr im Wege. „Cross Words“ orientiert sich am klassischen Kreuzworträtsel, allerdings sind bei den Antwortmöglichkeiten zu den unterschiedlichsten Kategorien (wie „wird schnell weggeworfen“ oder „aus der Physik“) der Fantasie kaum Grenzen gesetzt. Jedes regelkonforme Lösungs­wort kann in das eigene Kreuzwort-Gitter eingetragen werden, wenn es ab der zweiten Runde mindestens einen Buchstaben eines bereits vorhandenen Eintrags beinhaltet. Die zwei bis sechs Spielenden (ab zehn Jahren) dürfen Wörter sowohl waagrecht als auch senkrecht auf ihr Blatt eintragen. Aber mit jedem zusätzlichen Wort im Gitter wird es kniffeliger, einen neuen Begriff und einen passenden Platz zu finden. Denn ganz wichtig: Alle sich durch eine neue Antwort ergebenden neuen Buchstabenkombinationen müs­sen auch gültige Wörter darstellen.

Um die Spannung zusätzlich zu steigern, darf optional eine Sanduhr zum Einsatz kommen: Welche grauen Zellen wissen auch unter Zeitdruck noch, wie man Desoxyribonukleinsaeure schreibt oder verstehen und antworten dann nur noch Bahnhof?

Gewertet wird unmittelbar nach jeder Runde. Jetzt sind diejenigen im Vorteil, denen ein langes Wort ein­gefallen ist, denn jeder Buchstabe zählt. Die erzielten Punkte werden mit einem auf der Karte angegebenen Faktor multipliziert, wodurch sich der Punktestand besonders bei vielen Buchstaben entscheidend verbes­sern kann. Leer gehen die Spielenden aus, wenn ihnen nichts eingefallen ist, ein Wort falsch geschrieben wurde oder ein ungültiger Begriff im Kreuzwort-Gitter steht. Die Schlusswertung folgt nach 21 Runden: Jetzt zeigt sich, wer mit Wortgewandtheit und dem sich immer weiter beschränkenden Platz am besten punkten konnte.

Langeweile kommt auch beim wiederholten Spielen von „Cross Words“ nicht auf: Denn die 110 Karten mit jeweils zwei Kategorien auf Vorder- und Rückseite sorgen für Abwechslung und kein Spiel gleicht dem anderen. Das herausfordernde Wortspiel eignet sich sowohl für zuhause oder unterwegs, für kleine und größere Gruppen und sorgt auch im Urlaub oder auf Partys stets für Spaß und Spannung.

The colourful fruits in “Cherry on Top,” a tactical family card game from the Viennese game publisher Piatnik, serve as a brain booster. Who can form larger groups of cards than the other players and be the first to get rid of their hand? With its handy pocket-sized format, “Cherry on Top” is also perfect for playing on the go, ensuring it spreads good cheer at home and away.

Bananas, melons, and of course cherries take centre stage in this challenging card game, alongside four other fruits and seven colours. On their turn, players try to add as many cards of the same colour or fruit as possible to cards already on the table to form a set. It sounds simple, but it can get pretty tricky! That’s because it requires some smart thinking: Players who take a tactical approach incorporate cards already on the table into their move, skilfully capitalizing on the groundwork laid by others.

There’s also a special twist that can quickly steer the game in a new direction: Cards already on the table may be covered by cards of different colours or fruits. The goal is always to outdo the others in the shared card display and form a group that’s at least one card larger than that of the previous player. Of course, this gets a little more complicated with every turn, so the fun and excitement keep building. However, anyone who can’t keep up with this growing challenge must unfortunately pass and hope for better luck on the next turn.

Once everyone has passed on their turn, a new round begins with a fresh set of cards laid out. The game continues until someone can play their last card from their hand, winning after what is usually about 15 minutes of play. Perhaps with cherries “on top”?

If you’re looking for games with simple rules that still require some brainpower and offer a little twist, “Cherry on Top” is just the thing for you. Two to five players aged eight and up compete for victory in this “ladder-climbing game” (outbidding previously played cards) designed by Michael Diechtierow. The modern, colourful illustrations by Lars Besten and the right ideas for the perfect fruit mix ensure a fun atmosphere.
Nachschub für das vielfach ausgezeichnete Quizspiel Smart 10 von Piatnik

Das Themenpaket “90s” bringt viele neue Fragen für das revolutionäre Quizspiel „Smart 10“ und lässt in der Vergangenheit schwelgen. Benötigt wird eine Smartbox aus den Originalspielen der Reihe. Einfach deren Karten mit den Karten aus einer Erweiterung ersetzen und schon erlebt man viele weitere vergnügliche Spielstunden. Eine Frage – 10 Antworten: Am beliebten Spielmechanismus ändert sich nichts. Die Erweiterung beinhaltet 100 neue Fragen und 1.000 Antworten und bringt viele bunte Erinnerungen an ein besonderes Jahrzehnt zurück. Es umfasst popkulturelle Meilensteine aus Film, Fernsehen und Musik, ikonische Persönlichkeiten und Produkte sowie wichtige historische Ereignisse.

Mit der neuen „Smart 10“-Version wird die Quizspiel-Reihe von Piatnik erweitert. Ausgezeichnet als „Spiel der Spiele“ in Österreich (2020) sowie als Spiel des Jahres in Schweden und Dänemark (2017/2019), begeistert das Original „Smart 10“ von Arno Steinwender und Christoph Reiser mit seinen Erweiterungen heute nicht nur hunderttausende Quiz-Fans in analogen Spielerunden (mehr als 700.000 verkaufte Exemplare), sondern seit 2022 auch eine große Zuschauerschar mit einer täglichen Show im österreichischen Fernsehen.

Teil des Erfolgsrezepts ist die kompakte Box, die in jeder Tasche Platz findet, mit ihren doppelseitig bedruckten Kärtchen - und jeweils einer Frage in der Mitte. Pro Frage stehen 10 Antwortmöglichkeiten zur Wahl, die mit Markern abgedeckt sind. Wer an der Reihe ist, wählt eine davon aus, kontrolliert, ob’s stimmt und gibt die Smartbox in der Runde weiter. Will man keine Antwort mehr geben, sollte man besser passen, denn wer falsch liegt, verliert alle in der laufenden Runde gesammelten Punkte. Oder man zockt einfach und errät die richtige Antwort?
634.theme: Neue Fragen, neue Erweiterung für vielfach ausgezeichnetes Quizspiel rund um die 90er Jahre

description: Das neue Partyspiel „Stadt Land Bingo“ vom Wiener Spieleverlag Piatnik kombiniert die beliebten Klas­siker „Stadt Land Fluss“ und „Bingo“ auf eine unterhaltsame Art und Weise miteinander. Das bringt einerseits mehr Spaß und Geschwindigkeit, andererseits bis zu zehn rauchende Köpfe (ab zehn Jahren) ins Spiel. Denn nur wer am schnellsten ein zur aktuellen Kategorie passendes Wort findet, darf den Anfangsbuchstaben davon auf dem eigenen Bingo-Blatt ankreuzen und kommt dem Sieg somit ein Stückchen näher. Mit drei Varianten, zwei Schwierigkeitsstufen und unterschiedlichen Bingo-Mustern auf den Blöcken bleibt das kompakte Spiel mit einfachem Zugang lange attraktiv und sorgt für zahlreiche unbeschwerte Abende mit Freunden oder der Familie.

Quicky, Tricky oder Fully? „Stadt Land Bingo“ hält drei unterschiedliche Herausforderungen bereit. Bei der einfachsten und damit auch kürzesten Variante namens „Quicky“ gilt es, fünf Buchstaben in einer Linie am Bingo-Blatt anzukreuzen: waagrecht, senkrecht oder diagonal. Insgesamt befinden sich 24 Buchstaben – X und Y ausgenommen – auf den zehn verschiedenfarbigen Blöcken. Sie sind jedoch unterschiedlich ange­ordnet, was die Sache noch spannender macht. Eine kleine Hilfestellung bietet der Stern in der Mitte des Blattes. Er dient als Joker und darf für jeden Buchstaben eingesetzt werden. Bei der Spielvariante „Tricky“ müssen vier Buchstaben mehr angekreuzt werden als im „Quicky“, und das in einem 3x3 großen Quadrat. Und in „Fully“ gewinnt, wer als Erstes alle 25 Felder mit jeweils einem passenden Wort abhaken kann.

Nun wird noch der Schwierigkeitsgrad gewählt: Für das Einstiegslevel kommt die lila Seite der 110 Kate­gorie-Karten zum Einsatz, Schnellchecker spielen mit der grünen. Die oberste Karte wird umgedreht und die aktuelle Kategorie laut vorgelesen. Wer zuerst ein gültiges Wort zum Thema der aktuellen Runde ruft, z. B. „Katharina“ zu „Ein Name mit mindestens 8 Buchstaben“, darf den Anfangsbuchstaben davon auf dem eigenen Bingo-Blatt ankreuzen. Passt das Wort nicht zur Kategorie oder ist der Buchstabe schon ange­kreuzt, heißt es eine Runde aussetzen. Ob ein Begriff als richtig gewertet wird oder eben nicht, kann munter diskutiert und im Zweifelsfall mit einfacher Abstimmung per Handzeichen entschieden werden. Unabhän­gig von Variante und gewähltem Schwierigkeitsgrad gilt: Schnelldenker sind klar im Vorteil.
635.theme: Wortbingo für Blitzdenker - Zwei Klassiker in Einem

description: “Win together or lose together” is the motto of “Clips,” a thoroughly challenging deduction game by Emanuele Briano, published by the Viennese game publisher Piatnik. In it, manufacturers of high-quality textiles must successfully fulfil their customers’ orders. But be careful: even a few mistakes can cause the clothesline to snap!

The rules are quickly explained, and before you know it, the fine fabrics come into play. Various orders await the players and must be fulfilled according to the order cards laid out on the table. Teamwork is key here: The twist in “Clips,” however, is that players aren’t allowed to see the front sides of their own fabric cards—only those of the other players. Players can then provide clues using coloured clothespins, which are attached to the game cards. This makes “Clips”—recommended for two to four players ages ten and up—a real eye-catcher!

Since players aren’t allowed to discuss the numbers or colours on their hand cards, they have to pay close attention and guess what the others are trying to communicate with the colourful clothespins. Ultimately, players must match their own fabric cards to the correct tasks—which requires correctly interpreting the clues. If they fail to do so, there’s no bonus. And if there are too many mistakes, the clothesline snaps, and everyone loses the cooperative game.

To prevent this from happening, before each new round of “Clips,” players collectively decide which of the ten levels—rising in difficulty—to play. The first levels are easier to master, but as the game progresses and players must correctly handle large orders and special assignments, no one can slack off while the challenges and the suspense increase. With its unique gameplay strategy, “Clips” encourages logical thinking while also requiring cooperative play and mind-reading, because the tasks at hand can only be completed through teamwork.

The colourful illustrations by Christine Alcouffe depict fine textiles which, thanks to supplementary symbols, are also accessible for people with colour blindness. This way, all fabric deliveries in the colourful family game “Clips” can be processed in about 20 minutes.
636.theme: Cooperative deduction game centred on high-quality textiles

description: Masquerade Trick Party takes place at a masquerade ball. Behind every mask lies a secret desire—and a role to play. Dance gracefully in the ballroom, then offer a rose to the one you believe you’ve found. Tonight, your hidden feelings will decide the ending.

In Masquerade Trick Party, players receive a Role Card with two goals: a Day Mission and a Night Mission. During the Ball Phase, players play a trick-taking game for 10 tricks, managing how many tricks they win. After the final trick, players enter the Offering Phase: all players place their Rose token on the Role they believe is the target of their Night Mission. Then roles are revealed and missions are checked.

The game includes 12 roles for varied play and shifting stories from game to game. It supports 3–5 players, with additional 2-player and solo variants. Clear iconography and short playtime make it easy to teach, while the hidden-role deduction keeps every round tense until the final offering.

Where has the little mouse hidden? In which part of the forest is the fox waiting? And where is the nimble squirrel hiding? In “Hidden? Found!”, published by the Viennese game publisher Piatnik, children embark on an entertaining journey of discovery through four forest areas of varying sizes to track down the secret hiding spots of the cute animals.

Fifteen animal forest dwellers are hiding in the autumnal thicket, waiting to be discovered by two to four children (ages four and up). However, if the frog, hedgehog, or their other friends aren’t found, they’ll quickly scurry off to the next patch of forest to find a new hiding spot.

It’s all about finding the right balance: In “Hidden? Found!”, concentration and memory—along with a little bit of luck—determine the winner. The children try to memorize where the animals are hiding. However, if the clever forest dwellers are named incorrectly, they hide again, which adds to the fun and excitement. Whoever collects the most animal tiles wins the roughly twenty-minute search in the forest.

This easy-to-play memory game by author Sophia Wagner helps even the youngest children develop an initial understanding of probabilities. After all, players must always keep in mind which animals have already been discovered and which are hiding in the next section of the forest. This playfully exercises their minds as well.

But you can’t always be right: The game’s design helps players develop frustration tolerance while ensuring that every child quickly gets another chance to succeed. The animal tiles designed by Anthony Moulins and the autumnal forest of leaves through which the fun search in “Found You!” takes place are age-appropriate and lovingly crafted.
Found You! – At a Glance
· An accessible memory game for children
· Introduces the concept of probability
· Trains memory and frustration tolerance
· Made in Austria

639.theme: Welches Wort versteckt sich in einem anderen?

description: Nachschub für das vielfach ausgezeichnete Quizspiel Smart 10 von Piatnik

Das Nachfüllset “Neue Fragen 4.0” bringt viele neue Fragen für das revolutionäre Quizspiel „Smart 10“. Benötigt wird eine Smartbox aus den Originalspielen der Reihe. Einfach deren Karten mit den Karten aus einer Erweiterung ersetzen und schon erlebt man viele weitere vergnügliche Spielstunden. Eine Frage – 10 Antworten: Am beliebten Spielmechanismus ändert sich nichts. Die Erweiterung beinhaltet 200 neue Fragen und 2.000 Antworten aus verschiedenen Themengebieten.

Mit der neuen „Smart 10“-Version wird die Quizspiel-Reihe von Piatnik erweitert. Ausgezeichnet als „Spiel der Spiele“ in Österreich (2020) sowie als Spiel des Jahres in Schweden und Dänemark (2017/2019), begeistert das Original „Smart 10“ von Arno Steinwender und Christoph Reiser mit seinen Erweiterungen heute nicht nur hunderttausende Quiz-Fans in analogen Spielerunden (mehr als 700.000 verkaufte Exemplare), sondern seit 2022 auch eine große Zuschauerschar mit einer täglichen Show im österreichischen Fernsehen.

Teil des Erfolgsrezepts ist die kompakte Box, die in jeder Tasche Platz findet, mit ihren doppelseitig bedruckten Kärtchen - und jeweils einer Frage in der Mitte. Pro Frage stehen 10 Antwortmöglichkeiten zur Wahl, die mit Markern abgedeckt sind. Wer an der Reihe ist, wählt eine davon aus, kontrolliert, ob’s stimmt und gibt die Smartbox in der Runde weiter. Will man keine Antwort mehr geben, sollte man besser passen, denn wer falsch liegt, verliert alle in der laufenden Runde gesammelten Punkte. Oder man zockt einfach und errät die richtige Antwort?
640.theme: Neue Fragen, neue Erweiterung für vielfach ausgezeichnetes Quizspiel

description: Bookshelf is the new game in Alley Cat Games' ever popular tin line.

Players must work together to cooperatively stack books on top of a tower of cards. Cards have instructions on which books to place on top of it, and restrictions of where most of the books need to be placed. Don't be fooled though, placing books one at a time is harder than it initially looks!
This is the German edition of Can of Worms, originally published by FoxMind.

In Mykerinos, players lead archaeological campaigns and compete to uncover relics from ancient Egypt while gaining the favor of influential patrons. But excavation is only part of the challenge — the final exhibition at the Museum will determine who earns lasting prestige.

The game is played over four campaigns. Each campaign introduces a new excavation region composed of scoring areas built from pairs of plot cards. Players manage a limited pool of archaeologists and must decide how to use them:
Start an excavation
Expand an excavation
Appeal to a patron previously gained
Pass and secure turn order advantages
Patrons provide unique abilities and open new strategic possibilities for future campaigns.

Once all players have passed, each scoring area is resolved through majority. Players, in order, may either claim a plot card — earning prestige and gaining a patron — or send archaeologists to the Museum to strengthen their final exhibition.

At the end of the fourth campaign, prestige is awarded for collected plot cards, patron cards scored through Museum influence, and completed sets of all five different patrons. The player with the greatest prestige becomes the most celebrated archaeologist.
This Special Edition celebrates the 20th anniversary of Mykerinos with fully renewed components and stunning new artwork by Amelia Sales and Pedro Soto.

In addition, Mykerinos – Special Edition includes all extra content in one box: the Nile Expansion, a quick game mode, and a 4-player team mode, offering new ways to explore and experience this modern classic.
This is the German edition of Fragments – Solara, originally published by iello.
The eggs are rolling and the chicks are hatching!
In this cheerful henhouse, hatch your eggs and use your chicks to push Mum Hen all the way to the river.
Skill, suspense and laughter are guaranteed in this country-style race full of twists and turns!
Bank or Bust is a "higher or lower" push your luck card game where players will take turns to draw cards of values 2-99 in an effort to score the most points.

During a players turn they will either bank their cards for points, or draw a card. When they draw a card they must place it in one of the ascending (starting at 1) or descending (starting at 100) rows.
Players bust if they cannot place it in either row.
Players score points:
By scoring a point for each card they successfully bank
If they manage to push their luck to a set of 3 cards(5 points), 4 cards (15 points) or 5 cards (50 points) in each row
If they manage to get the longest run out of all the players on one row (5 points).
CookieRun: Braverse TCG is a casual trading card game based on the globally beloved CookieRun IP, combining strategic gameplay with the fun of collecting.
Darkness Rises — Dark Enchantress Cookie Makes Her TCG Debut!
The ultimate villain of CookieRun: Kingdom, Dark Enchantress Cookie, finally enters the battlefield!

Fan-favorite Eternal Sugar Cookie and Silent Salt Cookie make their debut alongside Awakened Hollyberry Cookie and Awakened White Lily Cookie. With Ancient Cookies and Beast Cookies joining forces across the set, iconic characters from the Kingdom storyline come together for an all-out war!
Build stronger decks, discover new combinations, and experience the clash between light and darkness!
A New Color Enters the Battle!
The introduction of the new Black Color opens an entirely new deck-building experience.

While BS10 strengthens existing decks without requiring players to rebuild from the ground up, BS11 introduces new strategies and combinations centered around Dark Enchantress Cookie. Existing players can immediately upgrade their decks, while the new color creates even more ways to play, build, and compete.
Are you prepared to look into the darkness?
New Top Rarity — GENESIS EXTRA RARE!
A new level of rarity has arrived!

Genesis Extra Rare, GXR, makes its first appearance with Dark Enchantress Cookie and is positioned above the existing EXR rarity. With premium artwork and exceptional collector value, GXR cards offer a powerful new chase for fans and collectors.
Open the packs and discover whether darkness has chosen you!
The First Universal Pure EXTRA Cards Arrive!
For the first time, Universal Pure EXTRA cards join the game!

Designed to expand strategic possibilities across different decks, these cards give players more flexibility when strengthening existing builds or creating entirely new combinations. Their broad compatibility makes them valuable additions for both experienced players and newcomers.
More Rewards in Every Display!
Each display includes three box toppers:
- A Game Currency Redemption Card
- Promotion Pack Vol. 10 or Vol. 11
- An Eternal Sugar Cookie Promotion Pack, with a chance to receive a serialized Eternal Sugar Cookie card
Popular characters, new strategies, the highest rarity yet, and exclusive promotional rewards all converge in SET5!
647.theme: Fantasy Trading Card Game Based on the CookieRun Universe

description: You are the founders of a new fox town, constructing buildings and connecting them with trails to create the most profitable settlement. The buildings you choose might create goods or turn them into points. Pick wisely and connect them efficiently to move your goods around your town to earn the most points

1953: Everest transports players to one of the last great adventures of the twentieth century: the race to conquer the highest mountain on Earth. After decades of failed attempts through Tibet and years of geopolitical upheaval, a narrow window opens through Nepal. Nations mobilize resources, recruit climbers and sherpa teams, and prepare expeditions to reach a place no human has stood before.
Each player leads a national expedition with a single objective: become the first to reach the summit of Everest.

Throughout the game, players build their ascent step by step, transforming a growing mountain of cards into both the route to the summit and the infrastructure needed to sustain it. Resources must be transported upward, camps established, equipment secured, and key moments chosen carefully before weather conditions deteriorate and the monsoon forces everyone back down.

Across a limited number of weeks, expeditions compete and adapt to changing conditions while balancing long-term preparation against the urgency of the climb. Every decision shapes the mountain itself: where to establish support, when to advance, and which climber will attempt the final assault. Efficient logistics, timing, and tactical use of cards are essential to overcoming the mountain and writing your expedition into history.

With “Memoett,” the Viennese game publisher Piatnik presents a special memory game for little explorers ages four and up. Instead of matching pairs, the goal here is to find an entire animal family—and in the correct order, too. Two game variations ensure long-lasting fun.

Twelve animal families—from polar bears, wolves, and flamingos to seahorses—have lost track of each other and want to be reunited. In the simpler game variant, all cards featuring exactly one animal are first selected and distributed among the players in turn. The remaining tiles are shuffled well and laid face down in a 6x6 grid. On their turn, a player flips over any card. If it shows an animal that matches one of your own families—and also has the correct number (!) of birds, fish, and other animals on it (namely, in ascending order from one to four)—you may place it on the corresponding pile and immediately take another turn. If that’s not the case, turn the card back over and it’s the next person’s turn. The first player to complete all their animal families wins and ends the game.

Things get even trickier in the second variant. Here, too, the goal is to find all four tiles of a genus in the correct order and stack them on top of each other. However, there’s no initial distribution of tiles, so all the tiles are laid out in a slightly larger grid at the start of each round. Following the motto “First one, then two, then three, then four—then the stack is mine,” players take turns trying their luck. Whoever finds the fourth and final animal in a family gets to claim the entire collection. Once all the families are reunited, the player with the most stacks in front of them wins.

This colourful challenge playfully promotes memory, concentration, and observational skills. Each tile in the animal quartet’s memory game variant also features charming little details for young explorers to discover.
650.theme: A memory game where players search for animal quartets

description: CookieRun: Braverse TCG is a casual trading card game based on the globally beloved CookieRun IP, combining strategic gameplay with the fun of collecting.

BS12 [Festival Arena] brings the CookieRun characters to the stage with an all-new idol and music festival theme, featuring original illustrations and character concepts created especially for the TCG.

Designed to expand rather than reset the existing game, Festival Arena builds on the popular Arena mechanic, introduces fresh strategies across multiple attributes, and further expands the Black strategy introduced in the previous set. New players can easily jump into the Arena theme, while experienced players can discover new combinations and synergies with cards from previous sets.

Beyond gameplay, Festival Arena offers strong collectible appeal with TCG-original character artwork, special card treatments, signed elements, numbered cards, and premium rarities. From strategic deck building to collecting your favorite Cookies in never-before-seen idol looks, Festival Arena brings gameplay, music, and collectibility together in one celebration.
651.theme: Beloved characters from CookieRun: Kingdom appear like never before — transformed into dazzling idols!

description: The entertaining family game “Xoxo” from the Viennese games publisher Piatnik is all about colours, shapes and facial expressions. Based on the familiar Noughts and Crosses concept, three elements of the same type must form a horizontal, vertical or diagonal line. But it’s not quite as easy as it sounds: each of the two to four players (aged seven and over) has several secret missions to complete. As the players share a common board, it’s easy to get in each other’s way on the 3x3 grid of tiles. If you’re not careful, you might even unwittingly help your opponents to a quick victory.

48 square tiles and 12 objective cards to hold in your hand: that’s all the compact game ‘Xoxo’ needs to provide hours of fun and tactical enjoyment. Based on the familiar Tic-Tac-Toe concept but enhanced with clever details and slight variations to the rules, this popular classic is transformed into a tricky guessing game with a refreshingly colourful and humorously illustrated design.

The tiles are divided into personal stacks and an additional communal stack in the centre of the table. The objective cards show the respective secret missions: colours, shapes or various facial expressions. But be careful: the back of the cards reveals a crucial clue, so that players can keep an eye not only on their own missions but also on those of the others.

On their turn, a player places either a tile from their own stack or from the communal stack onto the shared display. The rule is: new tiles must be placed horizontally or vertically adjacent to a tile already on display, and the grid must not exceed 3 x 3. Once there are 9 tiles on the table, any further tiles are placed on top of those already there and are thus covered. The only exception is that the tile placed immediately beforehand is spared. If a player fulfils an objective card through skilful placement (or by observing what others are doing), it is placed face up. Play continues in this way until either one player fulfils their last objective card and thus wins the game, or any one stack of tiles is exhausted. In this case, the winner is the player who has currently fulfilled the most objective cards. The short playing time of around 15 minutes makes for quick rematches.
652.theme: Noughts and Crosses – but in secret!

description: Ein idyllischer Bauernhof mit einem prächtigen Gemüsegarten: Gut getarnt schleicht hier Luis, der freche Maulwurf, durch die Beete und bedient sich an den Karotten, Kürbissen, Radieschen und Gurken. Schaffen es die Kinder als Team, den Dieb zu überführen und zu erraten, wo die Beute versteckt ist? Das kooperative Deduktionsspiel „Who is Luis?“ des Wiener Spieleherstellers Piatnik erfordert Kombi­nationsgabe und Zusammenarbeit, um den Gemüseräuber zu finden.

Detektivarbeit ist angesagt bei „Who is Luis?“, das für bis zu fünf Kinder ab sieben Jahren konzipiert ist. Sorgfältig müssen die Hinweise geprüft werden, die zur Aufdeckung des diebischen Maulwurfs führen können. Hat er sich mit einem Fischerhut getarnt, als er um acht Uhr die Karotte klaute? Oder war er schon um sechs Uhr unter einer Schirmkappe versteckt bei den Radieschen zu finden? Und liegt die Beute unter dem Himbeerstrauch, in der Scheune oder doch ganz woanders?

Die ausgespielten Maulwurfskarten geben die erforderlichen Hinweise zu Versteck, Gemüsesorte, Kopf­bedeckung und Uhrzeit. Um sie zu überprüfen, hilft ein innovativer Entschlüsselungsmechanismus und eine fleißige Hummel, die von oben alles im Blick hat! Auf dem Klee-Tableau in der Tischmitte wird sichtbar, ob durch die Löcher in den Karten bis zu drei Blüten und damit auch bis zu drei Übereinstimmungen angezeigt werden oder ob der Blick nur auf weitere Kleeblätter fällt, die zumindest verraten, dass alle Hinweise auf der eben ausgespielten Karte falsch sind. Reihum werden so immer mehr Informationen gesammelt und im Team besprochen, um Luis auf die Schliche zu kommen.

Denn bei „Who is Luis?“ heißt es, gemeinsam gewinnen oder gemeinsam verlieren: Jedes Detail ist wichtig, um durch Kombination der Hinweise die richtigen Schlüsse zu ziehen und Übereinstimmungen zu suchen. War aber ein Hinweis falsch, verliert das ganze Team und das Spiel endet. Konnte Luis jedoch überführt werden, fordert er gleich in der nächsten Runde die Kinder aufs Neue heraus, wenn er in anderer Verklei­dung, zu einer anderen Zeit an einem anderen Ort erscheint, um das leckere Gemüse zu stibitzen. Im besten Fall kann in rund 15 Minuten der diebische Maulwurf mehrfach überführt werden.

Gestartet wird im Regelfall mit 24 Maulwurfkarten. Um den Schwierigkeitsgrad für besonders clevere Teams zu erhöhen, wird diese Anzahl einfach reduziert. Wer zwischendurch gerne mal auf eigene Faust ermittelt, kann „Who is Luis?“ auch im Solo-Modus spielen.
Choose your spaghetti wisely before you slurp it up in this topping dropping game. If your table manners are sloppy, you'll be kicked out of the restaurant!
Use tweezers to pull spaghetti strings from the tin. If removing the string causes a topping to hit the bottom of the tin, you are eliminated!

Entdecke den Mafia-Boss in DirDas Jahr 1930 neigt sich dem Ende. Die Geschäfte der Familie laufen gut. So mancher Dollar lässt sich in Zeiten der Prohibition mit Schmuggel und illegalem Alkohol verdienen. Doch die ruhigen Zeiten sind vorbei: Viele Tote hat es in den letzten Tagen gegeben – zu viele Tote.
Mafia-Boss Don Pedro hat wichtige Mitglieder seiner Familie zu einem geheimen Treffen auf sein Anwesen gebeten. Doch was war passiert?

KRIMI total. Personalisierte EditionDiesmal spielt ihr nicht nur die Verdächtigen. Ihr seid die Verdächtigen.Aus Mafiaboss Don Pedro wird Don Martin. Aus Mafiabraut Lucia wird Mafiabraut Lena. In den personalisierten Editionen von KRIMI total tragen die Figuren die Namen eurer Freunde!Plötzlich werden deine Freunde zu Mafiabossen, Stars und Mordverdächtigen. Und ihr ermittelt gegen Menschen, die ihr bestens kennt. Ihr verdächtigt euch, blufft, diskutiert und versucht herauszufinden, wer von euch der Mörder ist.So wird euer Krimidinner noch persönlicher und sorgt für überraschende und witzige Momente. Perfekt für einen besonderen Abend mit Freunden, Geburtstage, Junggesellenabschiede und andere Feiern.KRIMI total. Dein Name. Deine Rolle. Euer Fall.

Jung, erfolgreich, dickes Bankkonto ... und eine Leiche im PoolEs ist die Leichtigkeit der Jugend, der feine Hauch des Erfolges und Lockruf des Geldes. Und es ist der glanzvolle Schein einer langjährigen Freundschaft, die alle verbindet.
Als spät in der Nacht Leon tot aufgefunden wird, ist klar: Es ist nicht alles Gold, was glänzt! Was war passiert?

KRIMI total. Personalisierte EditionDiesmal spielt ihr nicht nur die Verdächtigen. Ihr seid die Verdächtigen.Aus Model Eva wird Model Nadine, aus Popstar Philipp wird Popstar Robert. In den personalisierten Editionen von KRIMI total tragen die Figuren die Namen eurer Freunde!Plötzlich werden deine Freunde zu Mafiabossen, Stars und Mordverdächtigen. Und ihr ermittelt gegen Menschen, die ihr bestens kennt. Ihr verdächtigt euch, blufft, diskutiert und versucht herauszufinden, wer von euch der Mörder ist.So wird euer Krimidinner noch persönlicher und sorgt für überraschende und witzige Momente. Perfekt für einen besonderen Abend mit Freunden, Geburtstage, Junggesellenabschiede und andere Feiern.KRIMI total. Dein Name. Deine Rolle. Euer Fall.

Erlebe die Zeit vor und nach dem Fall der Mauer aus der Sicht eines ostdeutschen Bürgers. Gestalte Deinen Lebenslauf über den Besuch der EOS, einem Studium in Moskau oder den Dienst in der NVA - oder auch als Bürgerrechtler und Organisator eines Kirchentages? Wie sehr gehst du auf das System der SED ein, um deine Karriere zu fördern? Und wie sehr kannst/willst du dich davon distanzieren, wenn die Mauer fällt?
Wendepunkte gibt Einblick in die Alltagsereignisse und Erfahrungen im historischen Kontext und regt nicht nur zum Spielen, sondern auch zum Nachdenken und Diskutieren an.
Das Spiel passt auf jeden Spieletisch und in jedes Klassenzimmer. Begleitmaterial für Lehrer ist verfügbar.

Clothed in homespun garb, with naught but a simple dagger to hand, you have lived your whole life as a commoner, in the village where you were born. But must things remain that way? Embark on an adventure filled with peril, but also opportunity. Deal with unpredictable locals, train to become a skilled archer, a silver-tongued orator, or even a cunning thief. Whatever path you choose, let it be your own.

Kingdom Come: Deliverance – The Board Game is an epic adventure game mixed with euro elements, set in 15th-century Medieval Bohemia. Over the course of several in-game days and nights, players will try to leave their mark, whether by helping the local nobility, making important connections, fighting enemies, or stealing everything from tiny items to horses. While the game is competitive, it doesn’t pit players against one another, but instead allows them to succeed through their own achievements. It uses a deck-building system and emphasizes player freedom, creating narratives through its mechanics. The starting setup may provide some direction, but the game’s open-world nature encourages players to pursue their own goals and shape their stories as they wish.

In Kingdom Come: Deliverance – The Board Game, iconic designers Tomáš Holek and Vlaada Chvátil join forces for the first time to bring Warhorse Studios' award-winning Kingdom Come: Deliverance video game to the tabletop in an epic official adaptation.

Hero ProgressionDevelop your character through the decisions you make along the way. Exchange experience for skill cards, allowing you to specialize and prepare for card tests needed to perform main actions. Tests will determine whether you succeed in stealing, fighting, befriending others, hunting, training your skills, or even picking herbs. Acquiring and playing suitable skill cards for their main effects will get you off to a good start.

Equipment matters as well. Weapons, armor, clothing, or various other items can significantly help you. Hunting deer without a bow is rarely a good idea, and making a strong impression is much easier when you’re not wearing dirty rags.

City Storylines & Side QuestsBefore you even set out, you’ll choose three major storylines—one for each city on the map. During the game, you can take part in developing these storylines, influencing how they progress and ultimately conclude. Each city offers three different storylines that can be mixed and matched, creating a wide variety of possible combinations across multiple playthroughs.

Will you help with the wedding preparations, investigate the brutal attack in Neuhof, or race against time before a life-threatening disease wipes out the whole village? The choice is yours, and so are the consequences.
It’s not only about the big events but also about the local people. Embark on side quests to help villagers with their problems, and gain experience and resources you’ll surely find useful.

An Open World of Opportunities and ChallengesThere will be times you might need to visit the armorer, sell freshly gathered herbs, or wash your dirty shoes. City merchants aren't just waiting out in the open; you'll have to venture inside the walls. Watch your step, though! Encounters with guards, drunkards, and locals might cause you some hassle, but they can also surprise you with interesting opportunities.

Need a rest? Have your food supplies gone bad? Visit inns to spend the night, fill your hungry stomach, and eavesdrop on the latest local gossip and rumors. There might be some quests waiting for you. And if you got dirty doing who knows what, find the nearest bathhouse to get cleaned up. You could also consider a church visit, if you’re feeling guilty…

In Kingdom Come: Deliverance – The Board Game, no two playthroughs will be the same. The choices you make, the people you meet, and the opportunities you pursue will always create a unique and unforgettable adventure.
659.theme: Epic adventure game mixed with euro elements, set in 15th-century Medieval Bohemia.

description: Verkehrte Welt: Ein Gorilla auf der Eisscholle? Ein Pinguin in der Wüste? Diese Tiere haben sich wohl mächtig verirrt! Wer am schnellsten die richtigen Verbindungen herstellt, räumt die entsprechenden Karten ab! Doch aufgepasst: wer die Spezialkarten clever kombiniert, kann direkt alle ausliegenden Karten gewinnen!
Lustiges Reaktionsspiel
Einfache Regeln
Coole Charaktere
SAGA is not a game — it's the board game platform that lives at your table. Built by board gamers, for board gamers.

Open it during any real session: it tracks the games you actually play, answers rules questions on the spot, and does the scoring for you. Along the way you can send emoji across the table, drop in fun ad-hoc jingles, keep your stats, and stay connected with your group.
Everything that happens at the real table. Played, not entered.
Play with SAGA — Hall 4.

Your murder mystery dinner with a Caribbean vibeBlue sky. Crystal clear water. Endless white beaches lining the tropical island of the Republic of Bananas Grandes.For three decades, El Presidente Emilio Mentirosa has ruled over this small Caribbean paradise and its huge banana plantations. The former leader of the revolution enjoys being celebrated by the powerful, the rich, and the beautiful on every conceivable occasion. And, of course, he welcomes his guests on his presidential yacht in style.With cooled champagne to hand and hot rhythms sounding over the sun deck, El Presidente is ready to celebrate his 60th birthday on his yacht with his friends and closest confidants.Before the party can even get started, a dead body is discovered on board! Is El Presidente's life now in danger, too? Or could the future of Bananas Grandes be at risk?
Der Winter zieht auf und die Ziegen müssen ihr grünes Tal verlassen, um über 10 Kapitel eine neue Heimat zu finden!

Jedes Kapitel spielt ihr als eine abgeschlossene Partie “Mountain Goats” mit neuen oder abgewandelten Regeln. Bei Mountain Goats zieht ihr eure Ziegen auf Bergpfaden mit Nummerierung von 5 bis 10 voran, indem ihr Würfel so kombiniert, dass sich entsprechende Summen ergeben. Für Würfel mit den Zahlen 2+3+3 könnte eine Ziege auf dem Berg mit der “8” ein Feld voranziehen. Oben angekommen, gibt es eine Punkte-Karte mit dem entsprechenden Wert (also hier 8 Punkte). Für jede weitere “8” darfst du dir wieder eine Punkte-Karte nehmen - bis die nächste Ziege die 8er-Bergspitze erklimmt und dich genz zum Fuß des Bergs zurückwirft. Die Würfel haben keine “1”, sondern ein Ziegen-Symbol, mit dem du Zugang zu Sonderfähigkeiten hast, die in jedem Kapitel wechseln.

Da kein Material vernichtet oder dauerhaft verändert wird, könnt ihr nach Abschluss der Kampagne eine neue Kampagne starten oder die noch nicht entdeckten Komponenten im Endlosmodus erleben. Kombiniert eure Lieblings-Module oder lasst euch durch eine zufällige Kombination überraschen. Ein Spiel - endlose Möglichkeiten!
Mit dem Premium-Material wird das Spiel-Erlebnis noch stimmungsvoller.

„Wo verstecken sich die unsichtbaren Tiere nur?“, rätseln Vicky, Conrad und Mila. Zum Glück haben sie den geheimnisvollen Zaubersucher dabei, der ihnen hilft, die Tiere sichtbar zu machen! Mit dem richtigen Futter können sie bestimmt das Vertrauen der Tiere gewinnen. Schaffen es die drei die Tiere auf ihr Rettungsboot zu bringen, bevor der Vulkan ausbricht?
Unsichtbare Tiere entdecken
Geheimnisvolle Spurensuche
Kooperatives Spielprinzip

Mogeln macht Spaß und hier ist es auch noch erlaubt! Deshalb gibt es unsere Mo gel Motte jetzt in der Deluxe-Version mit Holzwanze und spannenden Zusatzkarten. Das Ziel bleibt: Durch geschicktes Schummeln und cleveres Ablegen zuerst alle Karten loswerden!
Mit Wächterwanze aus Holz
Grashüpfer als neuer Charakter
Bekanntes Spiel in edler Aufmachung

Tierart, Farbe oder doch Dodelido? Wer hier blitzschnell schaltet und die richtige Aussage ruft, wird am schnellsten seine Karten los! Eigentlich ganz einfach, gäbe es da nicht die langsame Schildkröte und das bissige Krokodil…Und jetzt zusätzlich: den verrückten Flamingo!
Mit Holz-Flamingo Neue optionale Regel Bekanntes Spiel in edler Aufmachung

In Ipso, players build a pyramid of number cards and try to form rows of ascending numbers to score the most points. On your turn, take one of the two face-up cards in the center and use it to replace a face-down card in your pyramid, then place the replaced card face up in the center. When all pyramids are revealed, you can either keep your Star card for 3 bonus points or discard it to draw one last card and improve your pyramid.
