Könnt ihr die vier Relikte finden und das Leuchtfeuer rechtzeitig wieder entfachen? In einem Zug kann ein Spieler neben seiner Spezialfähigkeit bis zu 3 Aktionen ausführen. Ob Karte ziehen, Abenteurer an einer Pforte treffen, Karten übergeben oder aber Schatten beseitigen. Jede Aktion muss im Team gut überlegt sein, denn nur so werdet ihr die Relikte bergen und das Spiel gewinnen.
HOLOMONSTERS – Sammeln, tauschen und die meisten Sterne sichern!

Taucht ein in die Welt der HOLOMONSTERS! In diesem schnellen Kartenspiel versucht ihr, ein möglichst starkes Monster-Team zusammenzustellen und dabei Holomonster in vier verschiedenen Farben zu sammeln.

Doch nicht jedes Monster ist gleich wertvoll: Die Karten bringen unterschiedlich viele Sterne – und am Ende zählt pro Farbe nur ein Holomonster. Deshalb heißt es clever auswählen, Karten abwerfen, neue Monster ziehen und im richtigen Moment mit euren Mitspielern tauschen.
Aktionskarten und Joker sorgen zusätzlich für überraschende Wendungen und machen jede Runde aufs Neue spannend. Wer am Ende mit seinen vier Farben die meisten Sterne gesammelt hat, gewinnt!
Dank der einfachen Regeln und kurzen Spielrunden ist HOLOMONSTERS ein ideales Kartenspiel für Kinder und die ganze Familie – mit einer gelungenen Mischung aus Glück, Taktik und Interaktion.
3–6 Spieler | ab 6 Jahren | ca. 15 Minuten | 55 Karten
To fulfill a wish, a Mortal makes a plea to the Magician. This time, the price is three silver coins — what will it be next?
In "Bubble and Shadow", players take turns acting as the Magician, forging pacts with each other, and engaging in transactions centered around varying prices.
The Magician offers to use 3 Silver Coins to buy 2 of your Wishes. Will you accept it or counteroffer to pay 3 Silver Coins for 2 of your Wishes?
But, do you have enough money?
Reign of Hades immerses players in a visually stunning and modern interpretation of Greek Mythology with its captivating blend of dungeon crawler elements and action-driven storytelling.

Very Big Monster is a family card game with a twist on drafting. Build your exploration area, choose the best card for yourself, and decide who gets the rest of your hand. Designed for team play, every choice matters: help your teammate, disrupt your opponents, and use hidden information on card backs to anticipate their strategies. Build the best team — and watch out, because your final score is only as strong as your lowest-scoring player!

Build your best poker hand by wisely recruiting the perfect crew for your Mission to Mars. Simply draw Cards from any of the face-down six decks! The twist: Some of the players' cards are visible, others are hidden. Can you really be sure the others will end up with a better crew than you?! Once everyone has five cards, it’s time to shine. The strongest hand … uh, crew wins the ticket to Mars.

Centuries ago, the rich lands around the Rhine formed the heart of Europe. Powerful dukes controlled their duchies from fortified castles along the river, gaining wealth from the prosperous cities they ruled. Conflict between duchies was common and often settled by intervention from the church.
Now is your chance! Can you expand your influence and outmaneuver your opponents to rule the Rhine?

Council of Serpents is a manipulative tug-of-war game with hidden objectives. Three noble Houses are vying for power, but you are not one of them... You are a member of the Council of Serpents, and manipulate these Houses to achieve your own ambitions.

You scheme to orchestrate the triumph or collapse of one of these great Houses by manipulating their three attributes; the strength of their army, the amount of gold in their coffers and their popularity with the people. If one of these attributes ever reaches the top of its track, the game is immediately over, and that House triumphs. Whereas if an attribute reaches zero, the game is also immediately over, and that House collapses.

You achieve this by playing Influence cards to cause Conflicts, escalate Conflicts into Wars, prepare for these Wars by playing facedown Intrigue cards, make Peace and orchestrate support from powerful Guilds. After playing an Influence card, you enact the top card of the timetrack, often causing the Houses themselves to act. When the timetrack runs out of cards you collectively build it anew, shaping the plans of the Houses for the turns to come.

The sheep, with four different colours wool, are grazing in a circle around the table, spread across grass fields and players’ stable fields. Each player controls a stable made up of two fences placed in front of them, while the spaces between players form shared grass fields that also hold sheep.
Players aim to collect sets of sheep of the same colour in their own stable fields. By scoring sheep the player earns small bonusses to be used in future rounds.

On your turn, you place one fence on top of an existing fence anywhere around the table — either on one of your own fences or on an opponent’s. Each fence shows arrows indicating which sheep colours jump to the left and which jump to the right when that fence is activated.
After placing a fence, you immediately activate it and move the indicated sheep. Then, you also activate your own fence or fences that have not yet been activated this turn.

There are four different sheep breeds, each with its own special behaviour. Some sheep may bring another sheep along when they move, while others will kick a sheep out of a field when they arrive. Mastering these unique behaviours — and predicting how they interact — is key to clever herding, and scoring.
Variant: The Wolf
For players seeking a tougher challenge, the Wolf can be added. Each turn, the wolf prowls the Highlands and steals sheep from the fields, leaving less to lead into the stable.
Stubborn Sheep is a tactical game of positioning, timing, and controlled chaos, where every fence placement can shift the balance — and no sheep ever goes exactly where you expect.

Eine musikalische Reise durch die Hits, die Deutschland liebt! Die Deutsche Playlist Edition enthält 250 Playcards mit insgesamt 1.500 Fragen zu nationalen und internationalen Songs, Künstlern und Musikgeschichten, die in Deutschland besonders beliebt sind – von zeitlosen Klassikern bis zu aktuellen Chart-Hits. QR-Code scannen, Song starten und zeigen, wer die deutsche Lieblingsplaylist wirklich kennt. Punkteinsätze, A/B/C-Cards und die PLAY-Taste sorgen für Spannung, Überraschungen und echte Partyatmosphäre.
On Point is a game of intuition, visual association, and precise communication.

Five images are placed on a target-shaped board, each connected by sixteen hidden positions. The Clue Giver secretly discovers one of those positions and gives a single-word clue that links two nearby images.
The rest of the team must determine exactly which position was chosen—not just which images the clue refers to, but how strongly it connects them.
Simple clues often lead to surprisingly deep discussions, as every word can suggest different interpretations and subtle nuances.
Play in competitive teams or work together in the cooperative mode, where communication and shared intuition become the key to achieving the highest score.
Every clue is a balancing act between precision, creativity and understanding how others think.

Regulus High-Fantasy Arena-Sports is a highly tactical skirmish boardgame. To win the game, player must score 10 victory points by: knocking-out opponents, score public objectives or have their characters standing in the Regulus zone, a king of the hill center of the map where points can be scored at the end of three rounds.

The unique initiative system lets players strategize when a character starts their turn. Playing a low numbered initiative card will let a character start early, dishing out some hard hits or eagerly avoid any potential danger.

When a character starts their turn they may do up to two actions, which include: movement, attacks, spells, laying down traps, healing and pushing and pulling your enemy's to spaces they don't want to go. Position your character's just right and you can even attack with powerful off-turn Reactions!

Regulus features 4 asymmetrical teams of 3 characters, which can be customized even further with equipment cards. Characters can bring 3 equipment cards with them, adding a once per game action and a lasting passive per card. This vastly changes the playstyle of a character and will lead to new and exciting gameplay opportunities.

Introduction:Did you ever play the old computer game “Lemonade Stand” on the Apple IIe computer? Well we did and we loved it! It was a simple, fun, educational game that really influenced a lot of people growing up in the early 80s. We have been trying for a couple of years to recreate the simplicity yet realistic feel of this classic game. We wanted to recreate this experience in a card game, yet keep the supply and demand calculations and complex math to a minimum. Designer Trevor Cram was able to create what we hope you will agree is a simple, unique game that allows young and old alike to participate in their own business of setting prices, stocking inventory and making advertising decisions. Each of these decisions will affect the profits or losses each player realizes, coupled with external forces like the weather and other players special action cards.

In the end the player with the most money after seven turns will win and become the envy of the other would-be entrepreneurs. This game plays 1-4 players (or up to 8 players with a 2nd copy of the game) in about 20 minutes and no two games are alike. Will you suffer bad luck from poor weather or will you play too aggressively or conservatively? Find out as you venture back to your wonder years gone by and compete with the other kids on the block to build the best Lemonade Stand.

In this shedding game you play “clusters” to get rid of your cards but also draw cards if it is not full. A cluster is an uninterrupted sequence of cards, with multiple cards of the same number playable. Each successive hand must be a stronger cluster, either more cards played or the lowest number must be higher if the same number of cards is played. Be first to shed all your cards!

There are 10 cards each of 1 to 10. 11 starting cards each are dealt, with an emphasis on lower numbers, and deck cards, with an emphasis on higher numbers, will be drawn later. On a turn players may play a “cluster” of cards or pass. However, you draw as many cards as are needed to fill out the cluster into a rectangle. Play successively stronger clusters, until all other players pass and the table is cleared. Get rid of all your cards to win!

It’s Halloween! You and your friends, dressed in your coolest costumes, are out trick-or-treating. Grab lots of candy and magic spells - but don’t get too greedy! Too much candy will make you sick, unless you have the right magic spell... Will you grab the tastiest treats, or will your friends snatch them from under your witchy nose?
The game is played over three rounds. Each round has two phases:
the Grab Phase and the Puzzle Phase.
Grab Phase

Starting with the first player and continuing clockwise, players take turns playing one candy or spell card from their hand into the central Candy Jar. Candy cards show 1 to 4 pieces of candy and come in five different candy types.
At any moment, when a player likes what’s in the Candy Jar, they may slap their hand on it and grab the entire pile, placing all the cards into their personal Candy Jar.
The fastest grabber wins the pile, so do you wait for one more delicious card, or snatch the pile before a friend beats you to it?
Across the entire game (that is all three rounds combined)) each player may grab a maximum of 7 times.
After a set number of grabs, depending on the player count, the Grab Phase ends and the Puzzle Phase begins.
Puzzle Phase
Now it’s time to score points using the candies and spells in your personal Candy Jar.
Candy is great, but don’t grab too much! Each candy is worth 1 point, but if you collect more than 5 candies of a type, that type scores 0 points. Grab exactly 5, and you earn 3 bonus points.
Luckily, the spell cards you’ve collected let you magically manipulate your candy, so puzzle out the best combinations to maximise your points!
After three rounds, the greediest grabber with the most points wins the game... and becomes the Halloween candy champion!

You are a well renowned rollercoaster engineer faced with new challenges every day. Clients want the biggest, the fastest and the most excitement inducing rollercoasters to be the centerpiece of their theme parks. Of course you have plenty of wickedly thrilling ideas up your sleeve but so do your fellow creative engineers. Which team of engineers can work together to put the best rides together? Ensuring not only happy clients but even happier guests? And most of all, who proves to be the most imaginative engineer, the race is on.. ready, set, launch!
In Coaster Clash you and your fellow engineers work together in 6 quick rounds to conjure up the best rollercoasters the world has yet to ever ride!

The engineers are divided up into duo's, each turn the turn-order alternates. Making communication a tricky endeavour. Trust your best judgement.. Is it wise to stick to your clients wishes or is the customer not always right?

Each turn you're dealt 3 element cards, you choose one card for each coaster set and discard the third. You have your eye on the prize and can already hear the screams of excitement as your creation takes up shape in your mind. If only your fellow engineer doesn't mess up and sabotages your perfectly curated design.
Not knowing what your neighbor is conjuring up makes this a challenge in every regard. And they might not be working out an idea for the same coaster at all.

As the engineer to your left gets to place his element first your heartbeat quickens.. You breathe a sigh of relief as the element he placed down now makes the one you had in mind reach perfect speed! Maybe they do know what they are doing.. Either way happy guests means you've looped your way closer to victory. And next turn.. you luckily get to go first.

Regulus High-Fantasy Arena-Sports is a highly tactical skirmish boardgame. To win the game, player must score 10 victory points by: knocking-out opponents, score public objectives or have their characters standing in the Regulus zone, a king of the hill center of the map where points can be scored at the end of three rounds.

The unique initiative system lets players strategize when a character starts their turn. Playing a low numbered initiative card will let a character start early, dishing out some hard hits or eagerly avoid any potential danger.

When a character starts their turn they may do up to two actions, which include: movement, attacks, spells, laying down traps, healing and pushing and pulling your enemy's to spaces they don't want to go. Position your character's just right and you can even attack with powerful off-turn Reactions!

Regulus features 2 asymmetrical teams of 3 characters, which can be customized even further with equipment cards. Characters can bring 3 equipment cards with them, adding a once per game action and a lasting passive per card. This vastly changes the playstyle of a character and will lead to new and exciting gameplay opportunities.

Scales of Influence is a modern tarot-based social deduction game for 3-7 players. Light and Shadow sages have disrupted the energetic state of the universe. Given a secret identity, players use the custom, 78-card Traveler’s Tarot deck, Influence tokens, and Energy crystals to alter the outcome of the universe. Energy on the scale will determine if Light or Shadow take over, or if the secret Harmony sage can restore balance.
✦ Alter the game using tarot cards.
✦ Secretly influence the balance of the scales.
✦ Includes custom tarot deck and guidebook.
3-7 Players 45–90 Minutes Ages 14+

Musikquiz für Kinder und die ganze Familie! Die Kids Hits Edition enthält 250 Playcards mit 1.500 Fragen aus fünf beliebten Kategorien: Kinderlieder, Zeichentrick, Animationsfilme, Familienfilme und Kinderserien. Einfach QR-Code scannen, Song starten und gemeinsam raten. Mit kurzen Spielrunden, spannenden Punkteinsätzen und der PLAY-Taste sorgt das Spiel bei Kindern ab 6 Jahren und Erwachsenen für jede Menge Musik, Wissen und Spaß.

SET5 - Around The World is a set-collection card game with intense player interaction, even though it's not explicitly stated in the mechanics or rulebook. Throughout the game, players organically bluff, block, and negotiate to disrupt opponents, distract strategies, and seize every possible advantage. Set 5 transforms simple set collection into a mind game, with a unique feel and mechanics that create an experience unlike any other game.

Sucht, vergleicht und schnappt euch die Pandas! Der Würfel gibt in jeder Runde vor, welche Bedingung gerade gefragt ist: Soll der Panda möglichst klein, groß, leicht oder schwer sein bzw. sein Bambusstab kurz oder lang? Ihr spielt gleichzeitig und nehmt jeweils eine Panda-Karte aus der Kartenauslage, die euch passend erscheint. Danach dreht ihr eure Karten um und vergleicht die Angaben auf den Rückseiten miteinander. Wer die Bedingung tatsächlich bestmöglich erfüllt hat, behält seine Karte als Punkt. Ihr spielt so lange, bis jemand sich eine bestimmte Anzahl Panda-Karten schnappen konnte.
Their wings could not be heard in the dark of night, their movements were no more than a fleeting shadow against the starlight.

In this tactical dueling game, you must skillfully wield the strengths and abilities of your Mistwings against one another and think outside the box to conquer your opponent's grove. It is a battle of wits rather than one of brute force, for both sides must make the most of the contested terrain in order to win.

Each player has the same 8 units (Mistwings) of strengths 1-8, which each have their own special ability. Mistwings can only capture others of equal or lesser strength and must be moved through at least one of the 8 rings on the corners of the board beforehand. A player wins the game if they have either managed to move one of their Mistwings into the opponent’s grove or have captured all of the opponent’s Mistwings.

Each fox begins with one tail. If a fox gains a total of nine tails, it ascends and becomes a kami. The first player to have helped three foxes ascend wins the game. During your turn, you can either reveal new cards that will form a village, or pick up one of these cards (which will give the foxes a tail or make them wiser by giving them extra traits). At the end of your turn, other players will have the possibility to play Trickery cards, to interfere with your plans or allow them to play some abilities outside of their own turn.
795.theme: You are a forest kami, ancient, powerful, and a friend and mentor to the foxes of the forest. Help your foxes improve their skills, play tricks on rival foxes and villagers, and earn the nine tails they need to ascend and become kami themselves.

description: Grey Eminence: Heart of Europe is a 1-5 player historical grand-strategy board game of politics, conflict, and betrayal in the Holy Roman Empire of 1378. Its core gameplay combines deckbuilding, worker placement, and area control.

Grey Eminence features a unique five-suit card system representing Diplomacy, Military, Intrigue, Religion, and Development. Each suit has its own visible card back, letting you read your rivals’ intentions without knowing exactly what they hold. Shape your deck around your chosen strategy, dispatch emissaries across the Empire, raise armies, construct buildings, claim provinces, and exploit the shifting balance between political influence and military force.

Each player leads one of eight asymmetric medieval powers - Austria, Bohemia, Brandenburg, Burgundy, Holland, Milan, the Palatinate of the Rhine, or Saxony - each with its own strengths and strategic possibilities, competing to become the dominant force at the heart of Europe.
796.theme: Historical, Medieval Europe, Holy Roman Empire

description: Duat is an abstract strategy game for 2 players made entirely of stone. Outmaneuver your opponent in an ancient duel to guide the sun out of the underworld.
✦ A checkmate puzzle with every move.
✦ Three actions per turn, so use them wisely.
✦ First to push an opponent's piece off the board wins!
2 Players 5–10 Minutes Ages 14+

Many Ancient Egyptians believed that the sun was reborn each morning and descended each night into the underworld known as the Duat. While traveling through the Duat, the diminished sun was endangered by forces of darkness. It was guided by a host of gods including a scarab-faced deity named Khepri, god of dawn and the renewal of life. Duat represents Khepri’s never-ending journey through the space between life and death to ensure that the sun will always rise.
Z Horde is a solo dice-placement survival game that condenses a full zombie apocalypse into a pocket-sized experience.

Based on the acclaimed One Card Dungeon system, Z Horde introduces a completely new setting, new mechanics, and a campaign of twelve increasingly challenging scenarios. Choose a team of survivors, explore ruined streets, open crates for precious supplies, buy weapons and equipment between levels, and fight off relentless hordes of undead.

Each turn, energy dice are assigned to Movement, Attack and Defense, forcing players to make difficult tactical decisions. Positioning, line of sight, resource management and character abilities all play a crucial role in survival.

Five unique survivors, a dynamic market system, reusable weapons, consumable items, obstacles, crates and multiple monster types create a highly replayable solo challenge that evolves throughout the entire campaign.
Can you survive all 12 levels and save humanity from the zombie apocalypse?
Based on the One Card Dungeon system, but designed as a standalone game with its own setting, characters, progression and gameplay experience.

Der weltweite Erfolgstitel ist nun auch als Kartenspiel erhältlich. Findet als Schnellster einen passenden Begriff zur Kategorie und dem aufgedeckten Buchstaben. Die gewonnen Karten bringen dir am Spielende (hoffentlich die meisten) Siegpunkte.

IKEBANA ist eine jahrhundertalte japanische Kunst, bei der es um die Anordnung von Blumen und Pflanzen innerhalb eines Gestecks geht. Dabei soll eine Harmonie von Farbe, Größe und Raum entstehen, der die Natur in den Lebensraum der Menschen bringt. Nur wer die Blumen richtig anordnet und dabei möglichst viele Vorgaben erfüllt, wird Meister in dieser Kunstform und Ruhm und Ehre erlangen.

The rules for“MEAT YOUR MATCH” are very simple. It’s a matching(memory) game where you flip over cards that are all face down, and if you match two cards featuring the same meat, you get to keep them.

From the moment the first card is flipped, all players get excited, thinking, “There’s no way we can remember all these!” Yet, within 5 to 10 minutes of play, everyone learns to distinguish the different meats—it’s a game with a truly unique feel.
You can also play using the rules of “Old Meat(Old Maid)” or the traditional Japanese “karuta” game.

Gameplay that’s easy enough for even board game beginners to enjoy without having to think too hard. It’s perfectly balanced for busy modern people who want to open it and have fun right away—whether during lunch breaks, after school, or at a party—whenever and wherever you like.
You are a movie distributor. Your goal is to produce as many hit movies as possible.
What are your studio's strengths? Collect the right genres and create the biggest movie trends of the season!
Become the ultimate Movie Mogul!!

Players take turns playing cards from their hands to form a row, then acquire the two adjacent cards from that row. Be careful not to let your opponents snatch the cards you want, and steal cards from them to prevent them from taking them. Skillfully collect cards to boost your score.
The game ends after a set number of rounds. The player with the highest final score is the winner.
Knallharte Entscheidungen gilt es zu treffen. Lass dich nicht beirren! Vertrete standhaft deine Meinung! Aber sei besser nicht der einzige mit dieser Auffassung...

Killer Questions stellt dich vor die Wahl: Eine Wahl, über die du dir noch nie Gedanken gemacht hast (und deswegen umso schwerer zu treffen ist). Wirst du im Zweifel mit dem Strom schwimmen oder riskierst du mit deiner Ansicht allein zu sein?
Ein Krimi-Ermittlungsspiel mit paranormalem Twist.
Ein rätselhafter Todesfall.
Ein verschrobener Podcaster mit Obsession für Aliens.
Militär, Kornkreise und eine ganze Kleinstadt am Rande der Panik.

Im ersten Fall der Black Cat Files schlüpfst du in die Rolle von Agenten einer streng geheimen Organisation, die verdeckt ermitteln müssen: Was ist mit Ethan Moore geschehen? Welche Wahrheit verbirgt sich hinter seinen letzten Recherchen?

Dieses packende Mystery-Krimispiel verbindet reale Beweismittel mit digitalen Recherchetools. Kombiniere akribische Detektivarbeit mit unheimlichen Phänomenen, durchleuchtet falsche Fährten und stoßt auf Dinge, die nie für deine Augen bestimmt waren.
Doch Achtung: Nicht alles, was du findest, lässt sich rational erklären.
Kannst du die Schatten durchdringen und die Wahrheit ans Licht bringen?
Dann willkommen bei den Black Cats.
Poko Pop! is a simultaneous-selection bluffing card game in which three to five rival thieves compete for treasures inside a sleeping museum.

In each round, Score Cards are placed beside a row of numbered Poko Cards, with the final treasure kept face down. At each Poko, all remaining players secretly choose Wait!, Poko!, or Snatch!, then reveal their cards together. A single player who chooses Poko! claims the current treasure and leaves the round, while multiple Poko! choices cause a clash and penalties. A well-timed Snatch! can steal the treasure from players who chose Poko!, but multiple Snatch! cards cancel one another.

As players claim treasures, the final remaining player receives the hidden treasure at the last Poko. Unclaimed treasures may carry over to the Final Round, where one last simultaneous choice determines how the entire pile is resolved.

Players score the treasures they collect. Score Cards matching their character’s Signature Gem are worth double, while face-down penalty cards are worth −1 point each. The player with the highest total score wins.
805.theme: When the museum falls asleep at night, five thieves sneak in to steal its treasures. But they are all after the same treasures.

description: In the deepest pits of the underworld, the gates of Hell creak open.
Rivers of fire surge and shadows twist, as the Lord of the Inferno rises to claim his dominion, threatening to engulf the realm in endless torment.
Only those brave enough to descend into the abyss and face him in a final battle can hope to seal Hell’s Door forever.
One Card Dungeon: Hell’s Door is a standalone adventure that follows the same setup and rules as the base game and the M’Guf-yn Returns expansion, with some unique new features.
This expansion adds a dungeon card, a boss level dungeon card, 1 new class, 5 new item cards, and the Stone of Perdiction.

Grab the Mic": Das Karaoke-Partyspiel für Leute, die nicht singen können! Wärmt eure Stimmbänder auf, singt ein paar Lieder und lasst euren inneren Superstar raus mit "Grab The Mic!" Dreht eine Textkarte um, denkt an ein Lied, das dieses Wort verwendet, schnappt euch das Mikro und singt den Hit! Worauf wartet ihr also noch?! Schnappt euch eure Freunde und lasst die Musik-Show beginnen! Und denkt daran: Ihr braucht hier keine Engelsstimmen, sondern müsst vor allem schnell und entschlossen sein!

Deae Via is the sacred path of the six goddesses. As a priest vying for the title of High Priest, you must deliver prayers to temples to earn the goddesses' favor, blessings, and Seal Tiles. Your choices—which prayers to offer and which goddess to favor—will define your fame. Who will best harness their divine protection and be chosen by the goddesses?

In this two-player game, players place priest tokens and prayer cubes on a ring of temple spaces. Priests can only occupy spaces of their own color. Goddess boards sit between these spaces, where players engage in a tug-of-war for faith. Gain faith to earn Seal Tiles, or spend prayer cubes to obtain blessing cards. The first player to reach 30 fame points or collect three Seal Tiles wins.

Eure Aufgabe bei Top it ist es, passende Begriffe zu bestimmten Themen zu finden. Diese müssen mit einem der im 3x3-Raster ausliegenden Buchstaben beginnen. Pro Begriff dürft ihr einen eurer Kegel auf das entsprechende Buchstabenplättchen stellen. Ihr spielt gleichzeitig und könnt eure Kegel auch „on top" anderer Kegel setzen, also obendrauf stapeln, wenn ihr einen anderen Begriff mit demselben Anfangsbuchstaben nennen könnt. Für jeden platzierten Kegel bekommt ihr 1 Punkt. Nur der oberste Kegel einer Farbe kann aber eine wertvolle 3er-Reihe bilden. Wer von euch zuerst 50 Punkte erreicht, ist top und gewinnt das Spiel.

Bei diesem Logikspiel mit Naturthema willst du alle deine Plättchen genau an die richtige Stelle legen. Dabei helfen dir die Hinweise auf den unterschiedlichen Arten: Bäume möchten immer neben Bäumen liegen, nur so entseht ja schließlich ein Wald. Die Schlange neben der Maus, das Schilf am Wasser und der Habicht neben einem Baum. Auf dich warten viele Level mit unterschiedlichen Schwierigkeitsstufen, die es zu meistern gilt!
Lama-Alarm - und jetzt kommst du!

Machu Pichu ist ein rasantes und verrücktes Partyspiel, das eure Reflexe und eure Beobachtungsgabe auf die Probe stellt! Versucht, alle eure Karten loszuwerden, indem ihr Lamas mit einem gemeinsamen Accessoire entdeckt. Ein Lama mit Poncho und Federn auf dem Kopf? In Machu Pichu ist alles möglich!

Doch das ist noch nicht alles! Immer wenn ihr eine Karte aufdeckt, müsst ihr das darauf stehende Wort laut ansagen. Entsteht dabei die Reihenfolge MA-CHU-PI, müsst ihr blitzschnell auf die Piñata hauen und „CHU!“ rufen, um das Wort zu vervollständigen. Der langsamste Spieler kassiert alle Karten der anderen ...

Ein simples, lustiges und extrem dynamisches Spiel – perfekt für energiegeladene Runden mit Familie und Freunden. Für 2 bis 10 Spieler ab 8 Jahren. Also, seid ihr bereit, die Lamas von Machu Pichu zu bändigen?
Mechanismus: Schnelligkeit, Beobachtung, Gedächtnis
Ein lustiges, dynamisches und blitzschnelles Lama-Spiel!
200 originelle Fragen warten auf eure Antworten! Dabei gibt es für jede Frage 5 Antwortmöglichkeiten. Ihr müsst nur auf eurem Scoreboard einstellen, ob die Antwort korrekt oder falsch ist.
Einige Antworten sind gefährlicher, da man einen Spielstein verliert, wenn deine Einschätzung falsch ist. Aber genauso kann man dort mit einer richtigen Angabe auch zusätzliche Punkte gewinnen.
Wer mit Feuer spielt, sollte aufpassen, sich nicht die Finger zu verbrennen!

Becoming the greatest gem artisan is no easy task. Deploy miners to collect gems of different shapes and piece them together into intricate shapes. After a puzzle is completed and delivered you may trade them for new mining sites, losing VPs but opening up new possibilities with access to ever bigger shapes.

Each round players pull miners from their bag and deploy them to mining sites with limited slots and restrictions. For each miner placed you will gain 1 gem, but drawing a miner you cannot place incurs a penalty. Then in turn order players can piece together 1 of their puzzles, deliver a completed puzzle for VPs and rewards, or trade in delivered puzzles for more mining sites until all players pass. The game ends on the round a player reaches 15VPs. VPs from puzzles, mining sites, and achievement cards are tallied to determine the winner!
813.theme: Become the greatest gem artisan in Splentia, the Kingdom of Radiance

description: The Dungeons Below expansion continues the Keep the heroes out Story story from where we left off in Boss Battles, but does not require you to also own Boss Battles to be played. It includes 14 meeples, 1 tile, 21 tokens and over 165 cards.

Prepare the new palace, making a tiered “Hina display” consisting of 14 seats. Position the Shiba dogs in their appropriate places to ensure the perfection of the role and color schemes of each tier. The challenge lies in how to arrange them within the limited number of seats to make the most ornate Hina display and win!

2 draw decks of Shiba dog doll cards are placed face up with 3-5 cards placed between them. These cards are available to draft, and every round the lead player determines if drafting will occur by color or by role. From the player to the left of the lead, players must take all cards of 1 type corresponding to the determined draft rule. Dolls have correct placement based on their roles, but objectives may prioritize color and icons as well. After 1 player fills their mat, points are scored based on placement, correct placement, and objectives.
815.theme: Creating a traditional Japanese doll platform

description: Eine Bewerbungsmappe zu befüllen kann doch nicht schwer sein: Für eine Bewerbung im Kindergarten sind vielleicht Erfahrungen als Dompteur nicht verkehrt, auch können Erste-Hilfe-Vorkenntnisse sicherlich helfen. Und ist Schwerhörigkeit hier wirklich eine Schwäche?
Gleichzeitig sucht ihr aus den vorliegenden Bewerbungsmappen eine aus, um eine offene Stelle zu besetzen. Findest du tatsächlich die Person, die sich auf deine Stelle beworben hat?

A game where everyone laughs and has fun, but... what if I cheat a little? In Trampos, cunning borders on cheating, so keep your eyes peeled to see who's sneaking ahead! Be the first to reach the cushion and win the game!
On your turn:
Choose one of the cards in your hand and place it face down to your right.
Everyone together, turn over the played cards.
The person who played the lowest non-repeated card can move their bear.
This way, you'll gradually get closer to the cushion, your goal! The first to reach it will be able to rest all winter!
Play by the rules we are explaining below, but remember...you're allowed to cheat!

Enter the arena of legends with Final Titan — a Draft Battler where the greatest heroes of all time clash in a fight for supremacy! Who will prove themselves as the "Greatest of All Time" and claim the title of the champion?

In this competitive game, players recruit legendary champions from across time, myth, and fantasy, each with unique abilities, stats, and powers. Once recruited, your champions are thrown into the arena, where they'll face off in intense dice duels.
Choose your matchups wisely, support your heroes with power-up cards, and outwit your opponents.
The last champion standing is crowned the final titan, and the player controlling them is victorious!
In addition, the Two-Player Mode will keep you on your toes as you’re always fighting!
The game also includes Solo & Coop Trials. Are you ready to take on this unique challenge?

In Vantage strandet ihr an verschiedenen Orten verstreut auf einem unbekannten Planeten. Ihr seht nur eure eigene Umgebung, aber zum Glück steht ihr noch über Funk in Kontakt. So könnt ihr euch gegenseitig unterstützen, um die gemeinsame Mission zu erfüllen.

Die riesige Spielwelt besteht aus fast 800 vernetzten Ortskarten und mehr als 900 weiteren Karten, die es zu entdecken gilt. Da ihr eure Mission immer je an einem von 126 unterschiedlichen Startorten beginnt, ist jede Partie anders.
Vantage ist kein Kampagnenspiel, aber Wissen aus vorherigen Partien kann euch von Nutzen sein.
Lernt eine neue Welt kennen, erfüllt eure Mission oder findet euer Schicksal in Vantage.
Street Art: Become the Biggest Star on the Street!

Lights, beats and astonished faces: In the card game Street Art, you compete as a fire breather, living statue or juggler against the other players and fight to attract the biggest crowd. Play your cards at the right moment and collect fans!

With every card, your show grows: Create surprises with fireworks and rain to gain an advantage, and use tactical skill to lure the audience away from the competition. Whoever gathers the biggest crowd around them wins the applause!
Street art for 2 to 6 players: Step into the spotlight as a star and thrill the crowd
Quick to learn from age 8: An easy card game with clear rules and a short playing time
Interactive take-that element: Be the most impressive act and steal the audience from the other players
High replay value: Fireworks, rain and other action cards make every game unique
Street Art on Your Game Table

Street Art is an entertaining card game that combines the atmosphere of the street with strategy and a touch of mischievous fun. Whether you are playing with family, friends or on the go, every game is full of surprising twists and turns. Grab your cards, win over the crowd and become the biggest star of the show!
👾 Ein hungriges Monster, clevere Schätzungen und jede Menge Nervenkitzel!
🎲 Kinderleicht zu lernen, rasant zu spielen – monsterstarker Spaß garantiert!
👥 Für spannende, spaßige Spielerunden mit Freunden und Familie oder als Geschenk und Mitbringsel.

Bei „Schätz mal! Das Brettspiel“ wird's brenzlig: Ein niedliches, aber sehr hungriges Monster hat es auf euch abgesehen! Nur wer am besten schätzt und der Wahrheit am nächsten kommt, kann dem gefräßigen, kleinen Ungeheuer entkommen. Die anderen? Nun ja ... lecker!
Step into the role of a fairy tale princess who refuses to marry a slimy prince.
Avoid marriage proposals to win.

A captivating trick-taking game that surprises with a new rule every round. Play as Snow White, the Little Mermaid, Mulan, Little Red Riding Hood, or another beloved princess. Each has a unique ability that can give you the decisive edge.
Adjustable complexity for an easier start.

The Royal Collection brings together the base game and all previously released expansions, with every princess, round card, and the team mode included. Royal components complete the picture: princesses as tiles and large, gilded round cards.
For royal comfort, the revised rulebook is now joined by a royal advisor, making it easy to look up princess and round card effects. Finally, someone in the royal court you can actually trust.
Sisi is the newest addition, and to top it all off, a noble, rebellious ring.
Spicy Pop is a fast-paced card game where ingredients become numbers and every combination matters.

Collect cards from the market and create combinations using exactly two different ingredients: one suit adds positive values while the other subtracts them. Your result must follow the growing numerical sequence, forcing players to carefully plan every turn.
Special Salt cards let you adjust your calculations by ±1, while Pepper cards introduce direct interaction, allowing you to pass trouble to your opponents—or finish a round in spectacular fashion.
End rounds at the perfect moment, manage your hand efficiently, and avoid collecting too much Pop, because the player with the lowest total Pop at the end of the game wins.
Simple rules, quick turns, tactical decisions, and constant player interaction make every game different.
11 promo cards from the years 2024 and 2025.
Contains the following cards:
1. Battle Beetle (Dice Tower Promo)
2. Knightmare (Tournament Promo)
3. Alpacoodle (GameBoy Geek Promo)
4. Steamforger (SPIEL Essen Promo)
5. Wolfman Steve (Secret Cabal Promo)
6. Ivybug (Battlefruit Kingdom Promo)
7. Wheatl-E (Battlefruit Galaxy Promo)
8. Kong Prime (King of Tokyo Promo)
9. Cthulu (King of Tokyo Promo)
10. German Wienner (World Championship Promo)
11. The Pack (World Championship Promo)
A mysterious murder has recently occurred. The investigation has stalled, and the world’s top crime analysts have gathered to uncover the truth.
However, there’s a shocking secret: one of them is the culprit of this very crime, and their memory of the crime has been warped. Now, you must all pursue the truth of the case — or recall it.
Perhaps the culprit is you.
825.illustrators: Elouen Bigot-Pécot/ Anuc Kim/Bingo Kim/ Sai Beppu/ Soguem

description: Condense itAn endless stream of 1s and 0s. If you can’t reproduce the sequence correctly, you won’t make it. But then you realize...it’s not about memorizing them, it’s about keeping track. All you have at your disposal are the 8 cards in your hand. How can you use them to retain as much information as possible? Instead of relying on your memory, arrange your cards and keep track of the sequence through logic. This is not a "memorization" game...it’s a "recordkeeping" game!
The citizens of London do not know.

Among the lords and ladies they admire, the clergymen who guide their faith, the scholars who pursue knowledge, and the dancers who captivate the crowds, there are those who carry darkness in their veins.
Hidden in the shadows for centuries, the vampire bloodlines are engulfed in a constant secret war to control London.
Tempt mortals into your embrace and welcome them into your bloodline.
Turn their influence into the strength of your family.
In the fog-shrouded nights of London, only the family that gathers the most influence will become the city’s true master.
And the citizens will live on, never realizing the truth.

Die neue Ausgabe von „Codenames XXL“ verleiht dem klassischen Spielerlebnis, das die Spieler kennen und lieben, neuen Schwung. Von einer überarbeiteten Wortliste für ein verbessertes Spielerlebnis über wunderschöne Illustrationen und eine brandneue Einlage, die für Ordnung im Spiel sorgt, bis hin zu einer übersichtlichen Spielanleitung, die das Erlernen und Vermitteln der Regeln erleichtert – diese aktualisierte Version wurde entwickelt, um langjährige Fans des Spiels zu begeistern und neue Spieler willkommen zu heißen. Wie schon das vorherige „Codenames XXL“ eignet sich diese Version ideal für Spieler mit Sehbehinderungen sowie für große Gruppen. Die aktualisierte Ausgabe wird in einer kompakteren Schachtel geliefert, die die Aufbewahrung und den Transport erleichtert, doch die für die Wörter verwendete Schrift ist sogar noch größer als zuvor!

Zum Spielen legt man 25 Karten aus, auf denen jeweils ein einzelnes Wort steht. Die Spionagechefs teilen sich eine Schlüsselkarte, die anzeigt, welche Wörter den Agenten der jeweiligen Teams, den unschuldigen Zuschauern und dem Attentäter entsprechen. Anschließend geben sie abwechselnd Ein-Wort-Hinweise, gefolgt von einer Zahl. Der Hinweis sollte sich auf mehrere Karten beziehen, die ihr Team erraten soll, und die Zahl verrät den Teamkollegen, wie viele Karten mit diesem Hinweis verbunden sind.

Die Teamkollegen raten jeweils eine Karte nach der anderen. Wenn sie richtig raten, können sie weitermachen. Wenn sie jedoch eine Karte des gegnerischen Teams oder eines unschuldigen Zuschauers wählen, ist ihr Zug beendet. Und wenn sie den Attentäter wählen? Dann ist das Spiel vorbei.

Das Spiel geht weiter, wobei jeder Spionagechef neue Hinweise gibt, bis ein Team alle seine Agenten erfolgreich identifiziert hat – oder jemand auf tragische Weise den Attentäter entlarvt. Macht euch bereit für clevere Hinweise, gewagte Vermutungen und das ultimative Wettrennen, um die Identität eures Teams aufzudecken.

Simple...or not.Place your bets. If your hand is the highest, you win! However, watch out for the tricky "Kobayakawa" card. The number on the Kobayakawa is added to the lowest card's value, so even if you're holding the highest number, a win is not guaranteed. Despite its simple rules, this is a quick and exciting card game that will test your bravery and bluffing

A fast, clever duel along a beautiful historic road. Step onto Perry Road—a picturesque riverside promenade in Shimoda, Shizuoka. History lingers on these stones, once walked by Commodore Perry during the treaty negotiations that opened Japan to the world. In Shimoda: Perry Road, you serve as a merchant leader in this bustling port town. Your goal? Strategically place shops to attract tourists and bring the promenade to life. Rules learned in under a minute and a playtime of just 15 minutes

Haunted Mouse is a ladder climbing/shedding game where mice not only shed their own fears (cards), but can use the fears of others! After all, why work hard shedding your own fears when your opponents can do it for you? The earlier you get rid of all your fears, the more cheese you get! The first mouse to complete their cheese wheel wins the game and never goes hungry again!

Es gibt nur eine Sache, die noch besser ist als spazieren zu gehen: danach nach Hause zu kommen. Schlendere durch Gassen und kleine Schleichwege, nur um zu sehen, was am Ende darauf wartet, und sei dann rechtzeitig zum Abendessen wieder zurück. Mit etwas Glück findest du eine bessere Beute als dein Rivale.

Das „Schleichwege“-Themen-Deck ist voll von Karten, mit denen du kleine Abenteuer erleben kannst – mit Effekten, die deine Starter-Karten verstärken und es dir ermöglichen, sie immer wieder einzusetzen. Es enthält 24 neue Karten, jede mit einzigartigen Illustrationen und Fähigkeiten, und lässt sich mit dem Grunddeck von „Auf Wilden Wegen“ kombinieren, um neue Erlebnisse und Herausforderungen zu schaffen!
To stay up to date with the production schedule of our games, we recommend visiting this page.

During the Tang dynasty, Chang’an was one of the largest cities in the world. It was a cosmopolitan urban center with thousands of travellers exploring it. Smell its aromas, discover its streets, find our new ways of living and whole new culture…

Chang’an is an engine building and resource management card game where players as important urbanists, will carefully project their plans by placing cards on the top part of their persona boards and to produce resources. Then they will move their cards into the city districts to build amazing buildings and to welcome influential characters on the neighborhood in order to improve the commercial, military, scientific civil, and political fields of Chang’an, Combo systems and game variability are important features in Chang’an.

Cause mayhem, frame your friends, and avoid the Human! Tiny Toe Beans: Ultimate Mischief is a fast-paced strategy game where 2–4 mischievous cats explore a modular mansion, play room-specific Mischief cards, pull pranks on their rivals, and compete to cause the most chaos.
834.theme: Mischievous cats causing chaos in a modular mansion

description: Ironwood: Steel & Spirit introduces two modular expansions that open up new strategies and further deepen the asymmetry between the Ironclad and the Woodwalkers’ gameplay. The two modules can be added to the base game individually or combined for an even richer experience.

When the Ironclad’s reckless excavations uncovered Steel, a powerful new material used to create mighty Constructs and build a vast railway network across the mountains, they also awakened the ancient Primals. These elemental spirits joined the Woodwalkers, who now wield enchanted Lanterns filled with magic, ready to be unleashed on the battlefield.

RAILWAYS & LANTERNS expands the game with new mechanics and 30 additional special action cards. While the Ironclad can now increase their mobility by building railway connections between their settlements, the Woodwalkers can charge their enchanted Lanterns with magic, allowing them to wager two cards during battle instead of one.

CONSTRUCTS & PRIMALS introduces unique new units for each faction: four Constructs that are the pinnacle of the Ironclad engineering genius, while the four elemental Primals represent the unshackled forces of nature on the Woodwalkers’ side. Each Construct and Primal feature distinct abilities that unlock fresh strategies and new tactical possibilities.
Win rounds or exit them in time to gain points. The game ends whenever a player has 25 points or more, and the player with the highest score wins!
Cat and the Tower – Reach New Heights Together

Little cat Yuki gazes up at the sky night after night. Up there, among the stars, he believes he can find his mother again. To reach her, he decides to climb the tallest tower he can find. But the way up is unsteady and dangerous. Yuki can only succeed with the help of his friends!

In Cat and the Tower, you work together to build an ever taller tower. With a steady hand, a little luck and plenty of team spirit, you help Yuki and his friends climb higher and higher. But beware: one wrong move could bring the whole structure tumbling down! Now it is up to you to keep going with patience and teamwork until you reach the stars.

This cooperative dexterity game combines excitement, dexterity and a touching story about courage, hope and friendship. Ideal for families, cat lovers and anyone who enjoys working things out together, laughing and cheering each other on.
Charming cat figures with plenty of heart
Cooperative stacking game with plenty of excitement
An emotional story to touch your heart
Fun for children and adults alike
Help Yuki make his dream come true and climb the tower to the stars side by side!

The Beat: Rockstars of the Galaxy is a cooperative limited communication and hand-management game for 2–4 players where you play as an up and coming Alien band and tour the most legendary venues in the galaxy.

By playing card you work together to build the perfect setlist. Every song can end ON POINT, LOUD, or as a FAIL. Communication is limited, so success depends on reading your bandmates, managing your hand and trusting each other's instincts.

Every of its 26 venues introduces a new rule that changes how the game is played. No two venues play alike and mastering each one is the key to completing the interstellar tour. Event Cards add even more variety, ensuring that no two performances ever unfold the same way.
Can your band perform, adapt and improvise to conquer the greatest stages and become the Rockstars of the Galaxy?

In 17 Dice Bets, you combine your secret personal dice with a shared public pool to bet on high-scoring combos. But here’s the catch: players can force rerolls on the shared dice, changing the odds in real-time. Will you play it safe or manipulate the table to ruin your opponents’ bets? Bluff, bet, and roll your way to victory in this high-stakes casino showdown.
Looking for the next high-margin, fast-turnover 2-player hit?
Meet RESTORE, a premium tactical tile-placement duel designed by renowned authors Gary Kim, Hope Hwang, and Yohan Goh.

RESTORE combines an elegant ecological theme with an innovative cross-intersection drafting mechanism and variable modular boards. Packed into a fast 20-minute play time, it delivers intense depth with zero downtime.
Toshi – Build Your City. Become a Master Planner of the Sengoku Period!

Welcome to Japan during the Sengoku period! In this strategic tile placement game, you create your own Japanese city. With each tile, you add nagaya, or row houses, mise, or shops, teien, or gardens, kōba, or workshops, and many other buildings. Every building comes at a cost and offers unique advantages. By combining them cleverly, you can increase your wealth and help your city flourish. Since everyone plays at the same time, the pace stays fast and the tension builds with every turn.
• Strategic tile placement game for everyone: Ages 8 and up, ideal for families and groups of friends
• Japanese flair: An authentic atmosphere with immersive illustrations
• For 1 to 4 players: Simultaneous play means little waiting and plenty of interaction
• Playing time: Approximately 45 minutes, perfect for exciting and relaxed game nights
With luck and clever planning, build a thriving settlement!
Whoever combines tiles cleverly, builds at the right moment, and designs their city districts with care will win the contest for the most magnificent settlement of the Sengoku period.

Bound by HopeThe Northwest Passage. An elusive sea route along the northern coast of America that's said to link the Pacific and Atlantic oceans. Since the 15th century, expeditions were launched with the dream of discovering it, only to then vanish in the icebergs. This is a cooperative game where you aim to connect 15 cards together while meeting the necessary conditions. But if you veer off course even slighty, your voyage will end in failure. Work together and predict which cards the other players hold, make use of items, and successfully traverse the route that humanity has dreamed of!
Advent mal anders: Schätzen, duellieren, Spaß haben!

Vergesst Schokolade und anderen Schnickschnack! Dieser Adventskalender steckt voller verrückter Schätzfragen, die euch beide ins Schwitzen bringen. Wer schätzt besser? Wer ist näher dran? Und wer gewinnt am Ende das große Schätz-Duell?

Jeden Tag bis Heiligabend wartet ein neues Duell auf euch: Absurde Fragen, bei denen niemand die Antwort wissen kann … Mit vielen abwechslungsreichen Schätzkategorien bleibt es bis zum 24. Dezember spannend und kurzweilig.
Das Beste daran: Ihr braucht kein Vorwissen, keine Vorbereitung!
No Shelf Control - The Book Lover’s Game

Do you love books, but your shelves are bursting at the seams? With the card game No Shelf Control, you can tackle the chaos in a playful way! Stack your bookshelves by matching colours and collect decorative items for bonus points. But be careful: if you stack too high, you risk making the whole shelf collapse. With its clever mix of strategy and humour, this game brings together book lovers who know the never-ending space problem only too well.
Book love: A creative game that presents the challenges of stacking books in a fun way
For 2 to 5 players: Ideal for small groups and sociable game nights
Fun for the whole family: Perfect for children aged 8 and up, teenagers and adults who love books
Playing time of 15 minutes: Quick, exciting and perfect for a short game in between
Plenty of variety: Decorative items, a reading break mechanic and the “unread” pile make every game unique
Book Chaos Meets Card Game Fun
No Shelf Control is the perfect gift for every book lover. Whether you enjoy organising your shelves or simply love tactical games, this lovingly designed card game is guaranteed to make you laugh!

This Expansion features 15 unique characters from the Mindbug Universe, reimagined as Champions. Designed in collaboration with the original creators, these cards offer fresh tactical options and a unique twist for fans of both games.
15 unique and oversized Champion cards and 10 Legendary Upgrade cards.
Just add them to your existing Champion deck. Compatible with base game and other expansions.

There? How!?Eggsposed is a game full of conversation and deduction, where players try to hide their identities and scheme to keep their own eggs in the nest! Night Birds try to sneak their own eggs into someone else's nest. Bright Birds try to prevent that and remove suspicious eggs from their nest. But wait, before you know it, the Night Bird eggs have returned. Who can you believe? Find your fellow birds and make it through this battle for survival!

From the sun-scorched fields of Apulia to the fog-drenched marshes of northern France, the fate of nations once rested on the shoulders of a handful of chosen warriors. In an age when honor was worth more than life, Italian, French, Spanish and English knights stepped forward to fight not for themselves — but for the glory of their people. This is their story. This is Disfida.

Disfida is the new game by Michele Quondam (author of Temple of Horrors, Dominance, Trinidad, Medioevo Universale GX, Virus, Gladiatori, among others) for 1–4 players, reaching up to 8 players with the expansion! A match lasts about 40 minutes.

In Disfida, players choose from four factions — Italian and French (included in the core box), Spanish and English (available as add-ons) — and lead their champions to victory on the battlefield. Its high replayability keeps every clash fresh, with no two battles ever playing out the same way. Easy to learn and intuitive to play, yet rich in tactical depth, Disfida rewards both new players and seasoned commanders.
The game includes a Solo Mode using Bots. Additionally, the "One player, 2 knights" variant allows players to choose from a variety of scenarios and adapt the match to any number of players.
A New Season Arrives at Your Mountain Resort! An Expansion That Brings Even More Depth to the Game
The dice placement game where you don’t roll the dice, Snow Planner, is getting an expansion!

Snow Planner: New Season is an expansion for 1–4 players that adds a wide variety of new elements, including Guest Cards, Event Cards, Talent Cards, and Project Cards, bringing even more strategy and replayability to the base game.
Project Cards have been significantly redesigned, challenging you to take on even more demanding management decisions.
Without drastically changing the rules of the base game, the expansion introduces new tactics and new ways to plan your path to victory.
Snow Planner: New Season offers fresh challenges for experienced players while bringing even greater depth and enjoyment to those discovering the game for the first time.
The base game Snow Planner is required to play.
The spiciness is a powerful sensation.
Many try to find the essence of heat,but most surrender to its devilis taste.
Only the persistent can truly conquer the chillie.
Follow your dreams and manufacture the greatest board games of all time!

In The Game Makers, players are board game manufacturers racing to build the greatest collection of classic modern board games. Build over 300 real-world games from over 100 real-world publishers. You can build Wingspan, Brass: Birmingham, On Mars, Terraforming Mars, Ark Nova, Twilight Imperium: Fourth Edition, and many more!
850.theme: Card, Game Dice, Economic, Industry / Manufacturing

description: 🧟 In this variety-packed trick-taking game, you try to bid wisely and fight your way successfully through a horde of zombies.

Chaos has taken over the kingdom: zombies now rule. These are no ordinary undead, but transformed villagers, knights, and animals, led by princes once scorned by the princesses. Yet you refuse to give up. As a fairy tale princess, it is up to you to save the kingdom from the zombie horde, armed with cunning, courage, and your unique ability.

Zombie Princess is a trick-taking game in which you bid on how many tricks you will win this round, aiming to score as many points as possible. Each princess has a unique ability, and every round follows a different rule. Play alone against each other or in two-person teams.
Zoom through space in the faster-than-light card game Warp 99!
On your turn, play your first card to your engine—it has to be a bigger number than the last one with NO repeating colors. Or score your entire engine and build a new one!

Then play as many cards as you can onto either of the 2 discard piles. You must follow at least one of the three rules of the galaxy. Rules such as Same Color, Plus 1, or Totals 10. Get Stuck? Change the rules! Match extra rules? Get bonus cards! Empty your hand? Get another turn!
Score big points by building bigger engines, or burn through your personal draw deck for a steady stream of 15 points. First to at least 99 points wins the game!

Blättere durch ein Fotoalbum einer Froschfamilie, tanze Stepptanz mit einem Bärtierchen oder nimm am Familienessen einer Bienenfamilie teil – und das alles, ohne deinen Spieltisch zu verlassen, dank des Bildpakets Niedliche Viecher.

Codenames: Niedliche Viecher-Erweiterungspaket ist ein verspieltes Paket mit 40 entzückenden Bildern zum Thema Tiere. Mische die neuen Karten einfach in dein Basisspiel ein und lass diese Niedliche Viecher im Hauptset herumtollen. Oder, wenn du möchtest, kannst du mit den neuen Karten ein vollständiges 20-Karten-Raster auslegen und eine Partie Codenames: Pictures ausschließlich mit Niedliche Viecher spielen.

Horror on the Orient Express: The Board Game lures you into the luxurious Orient Express in the 1920s, taking you on a dangerous train ride into the realm of the Dreamlands. Everything is against you, from monsters attacking the train to murderous cults hiding among the passengers. Worst of all, an eldritch, blood-thirsty vampire hunting down everything that moves. Horror on the Orient Express: The Board Game brings the Call of Cthulhu horror and mystery TTRPG into the board gaming world. Special rules, ongoing character development, and play pieces provide a challenging and exciting gaming experience.

In this cooperative game, you and the other investigators try to survive on the doomed train. To win, you must hunt out the cultists to stop them from performing a hideous ritual and ensure the train reaches its destination. Each of you controls a character who can develop new skills, gather items, talk to the passengers, discover clues, and, ultimately, decide the train's fate. You may even learn a spell or two!
7 Ages is Australian Design Group's ground-breaking game covering 6000 years of human history from 4000 bce to today.

You, as one of the greatest dynasties of all time, must chart a trusty course for each civilisation that is lucky enough to have you as their benign ruler. By advancing your culture, art, science, religion and architecture you will gain glory for yourself and, almost as importantly, your people. And of course you cannot ignore expanding the borders of your realm, not because of any personal greed, of course not, simply so that everyone in the world becomes lucky enough to have you in charge of their, from then on, glorious future.

Facing you is up to 6 venal weak lords who scandalously oppress their own people and snub your every reasonable suggestion. So it won’t be easy but with guile, skill and diplomacy you will emerge triumphant and glorious, joining the immortals in the Elysian fields.

Es ist Partyzeit! Die ganze Stadt ist dabei: Alle haben sich schick gemacht, bringen Geschenke mit und feiern die ganze Nacht durch. Wirst du die beste Party schmeißen – oder wird es dein Rivale sein?

Beim „Heiterkeit“-Themen-Kartensatz dreht sich alles darum, Karten zum richtigen Zeitpunkt, in der richtigen Reihenfolge und am besten alle auf einmal auszuspielen. Er enthält 24 neue Karten mit jeweils einzigartigen Illustrationen und Fähigkeiten und lässt sich mit dem Grundkartensatz von „Auf Wilden Wegen“ kombinieren, um neue Spielerlebnisse und Herausforderungen zu schaffen!
Unleash the power of Ancient Gods! With this exciting expansion, we introduce powerful Gods and their legendary upgrades from mythology.
15 unique and oversized Champion cards and 11 Legendary Upgrade cards.
Just add them to your existing Champion deck. Compatible with base game and other expansions.

Zombie Princess is the sequel to Rebel Princess. Just as Rebel Princess was a thoughtful modern spin on the classic trick-taking card game Hearts, Zombie Princess is a spin on the classic trick-taking card game Spades. As legendary princesses in Zombie Princess, players compete individually or as teams! Each princess is armed with a unique player power, giving her or her teammate much needed flexibility or information. Zombie Princess takes place over four rounds, and each round has a special rule, making each game feel fresh and unique. Princesses bid on how many hordes of zombies they will eliminate... er... save each round. Will you eradicate the resident evil of the land, or will this be the dawn of the dead?
859.theme: Card Game, Fantasy, Horror, Medieval, Zombies

description: The beautiful peninsula of Greenwood is run by a circle of druids and advertised as a sanctuary for magical animals and ideal vacation spot. But that version of Greenwood is a lie.
In Greenwood, you play as Primal Spirits and lead your companions to save Greenwood.

On each turn, you face the difficult decision of whether to use the abilities of your own companions, to use the abilities of other players’ companions, or to send one of your companions into the forest to improve your wayfinding and rescue mystical creatures.

In the advanced game, each clan has a unique ability – a small additional rule that has a major impact on the game. What makes this special is that players can use the unique ability of any clan currently in play, not just their own.
The game is played over the course of 3 nights and whoever scored the most victory points wins.
Erweitere dein Codenames-Spiel um noch mehr Critical Role und erlebe die Abenteuer von Vox Machina!

Codenames: Critical Role Adventures – Vox Machina-Erweiterungspack enthält 42 Begriffe, die thematisch an die erste legendäre Critical Role-Kampagne angelehnt sind, sowie zwei neue Gegenstände und eine neue Vox-Machina-Figur, die du in deinen Exandria Abenteuern einsetzen kannst: Keyleth.
Jedes Jahr wird der angesehene Pokal der Gemeinschaft an das Jungtier verliehen, das seinem Dorf am meisten
zurückgibt. Diesmal ist es ein spannender Wettbewerb, denn außer dir nimmt nur noch ein anderes Jungtier teil!
Unterstütze deine Nachbarn und hilf ihnen bei ihren Vorhaben, dann werden sie sich erkenntlich zeigen. Sei
ein wertvolles Mitglied der Gemeinde, übertrumpfe deinen Rivalen und verdiene den Pokal sowie das Recht,
mit diesem anzugeben!

In unserem Dorf leben Krähen, Kaninchen und Frösche Seite an Seite. Eine jede Tierart bringt ihre eigenen Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten mit sich – so sind die Krähen ausgezeichnete Post- und Paketboten, die Kaninchen aber gewiefte Händler und die Frösche gar abenteuerlustige Gesellen.

Ihr, die ihr in die Rolle eines jungen Vertreters dieser drei Tierarten schlüpft, müsst versuchen, die Gunst der Dorfbewohner in gleichem Maße zu erringen, müsst die örtlichen Gebäude finanziell unterstützen und Relikte sammeln.

Eure ausgespielten Karten (Dorfbewohner, Gebäude und Ausrüstungen) ermöglichen euch mehr Flexibilität in euren Zügen – doch damit ihr bei Spielende Punkte generiert, müsst ihr eure Karten wieder ablegen.

Collect. Connect. Make your play.The numbers 1 to 40 loop around and around. The first number that is played determines the strength for the round. You want to completely empty your hand, but if you win you need to add cards from the table to your hand. In other words, you want to get rid of your cards, but if you win you get more. However, if the numbers on the cards you collect connect, you have a chance to play a huge sequence next time! Should you get more cards? Or pass and let someone else collect them? As the strength keeps changing, you are constantly forced to make tough decisions!
Season have arrived in Agent Avenue!
Enjoy brand new ways to play Agent Avenue and experience all Four Seasons.
The 4 new maps of spring, summer, fall and winter introduce new special spaces with tactical effects to spice up the game.
Also included are 2 new Agent cards and 8 unique Black Market cards, offering even more exciting paths to victory.

Have you ever wanted to photograph a wild animal when you saw one? So, let's photograph the animals in our natural spaces and… shh! Don't make any noise, they are very timid and the picture might be ruined…
Photograph the most animals and win the game.
The guide draws the top card from the deck and looks at the pictured animal (lynx, deer, wolf, owl, or turtle).
They announce aloud the action indicated on the back of the top card of the deck. This is the action they will perform.
They give the players a few seconds to observe the animals, then ask them to close their eyes.
With the players' eyes closed, the guide performs the action on one of the tokens representing the animal on their card
As soon as a player gives a correct answer, they take the Photo card and begin creating their album by placing it in front of them.
The Photo Safari ends when the draw pile is empty.
The player with the most photos in their album wins the game.
Throne of Lies: Tactics, Tension and Magical Rivalries

In the sparkling yet dangerous world of the Fae, six realms vie for influence at the royal court: Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter, Sun and Moon. But their power struggles are not fought on battlefields. Instead, they play out through secret exchanges and cunning intrigues!

Who among you will see through the schemes of the others and turn them to your own advantage? Round by round, the balance of power among the Fae shifts. In the end, only one thing matters: scoring the most points with your cards and securing your dominance.
Magical card game for ages 8 and up: Dive into the fascinating world of the Fae
Tactical fun for 3 to 6 players: Clever exchanges and unexpected events keep the tension high until the very end
Compact playing time: Around 40 minutes filled with surprising twists and strategic decisions
Charming fantasy theme: Atmospheric illustrations create a mysterious atmosphere
Tactics for the Whole Family
Throne of Lies is an accessible and exciting card game filled with clever moves and surprising twists. Perfect for families, groups of friends and anyone who loves fantasy and the Fae!
Game Overview

At the scrap yard on the outskirts of the city, four eccentric scientists rummage through piles of useless trash, competing to see who is the best rocket designer. The task is not easy, and the materials are limited. Which eccentric researcher will be the first to fly into space in their innovative rocket?
Space Craft is a family game in which 2 to 4 players build crazy rockets. The game is for players aged 10+ and takes around 15min per player.

During their turn, players move their pawns on the scrapyard board to collect scrap tiles. Later, they will use those tiles to craft rocket pieces. By collecting specific rocket elements, players will fulfill contracts and those will grant them additional points by the end of the game.
The game ends after one player completes their rocket. The winner is the player with the most points.

Orkney – The Scottish Islands

You sail through the waters off northern Scotland, exploring rugged cliffs and wild coastlines. Place your island tiles carefully, gather valuable resources and build farms, villages and mighty castles. Connect your buildings with trade routes to earn valuable victory points, but in the end, the best strategy will come out on top. Who will keep track of everything, use wool, stone and wood wisely, and complete their secret mission along the way?
Atmospheric setting: Settle the Scottish Orkney Islands, build trade routes and fish along the coast
Strategy meets the spirit of exploration: Gather resources, build wisely and connect your buildings with important trade routes
Family game for 2 to 5 players: Ideal for relaxed game nights with two players or a group of friends
For ages 8 and up: Easy-to-understand rules with plenty of strategic depth
Playing time of around 60 minutes: An engaging building and planning adventure across the Orkney Islands
Explore. Build. Grow.

Orkney is a tactical tile-laying game featuring an ever-expanding island landscape. There are many paths to victory: Will you build the most valuable structures and clever trade routes, or would you rather go fishing and complete your secret objective? Orkney is the perfect game for strategists and builders alike.

Work Together to Make the Slopes a Success! A Major Project for Everyone to Complete Together
The dice placement game where you don’t roll the dice, Snow Planner, now has a cooperative mode!

Snow Planner: New Challenge is an expansion for 1–4 players that adds a cooperative mode to Snow Planner. By working together toward a shared goal, players can experience a whole new kind of challenge and sense of accomplishment.
In cooperative mode, a new type of guest—the Inspectors—arrives at your resort. By satisfying them, you can improve the resort’s reputation and move closer to achieving your shared objective.
The new wooden dog sled piece also allows players to exchange resources with one another. In addition to strategic planning, communication and teamwork become essential to success.
All of the elements introduced in Snow Planner: New Season have also been adapted for cooperative play, offering even more strategic possibilities and fresh challenges every time you play.
This mini-expansion is perfect for anyone looking to experience the world of Snow Planner in a whole new way.
Work together with your fellow players and see if you can create the best ski resort in the mountains!
Both the Snow Planner base game and the Snow Planner: New Season expansion are required to play.

Seit im Naturpark plötzlich eine Goldader entdeckt wurde, herrscht pures Goldfieber! Überall funkelt und glitzert es – und die Elstern, Füchse und Waschbären können einfach nicht widerstehen. Sie haben verschiedene Räuberbanden gebildet und sind fest entschlossen, so viel Gold wie möglich zu ergaunern!

Und jede Bande weiß auch, wo man die meisten Nuggets abgreifen kann: im Nest, am Zeltplatz und beim Gebirgsbach. Doch der Wettbewerb unter den Dieben ist hart! Mit List, Täuschung und cleveren Tricks kannst du deine Gegner überrumpeln und dir das meiste Gold sichern. Aber sei auf der Hut: Auch die anderen Tiere schrecken vor nichts zurück!

Es war einmal, da wanderten Rotkäppchen und Captain Hook nach Oz … Finde heraus, wie die Geschichte weitergeht – im Codenames: Märchen-Erweiterungspack! Das Codenames: Märchen - Erweiterungspack enthält einen thematischen Satz aus 50 Wörtern, die sorgfältig ausgewählt wurden, um dein Spiel Codenames oder Codenames: Duett aufzupeppen. Mischen Sie die neuen Karten einfach in den Grundwortbestand – nach dem Zufallsprinzip oder in einem beliebigen Verhältnis – oder spielen Sie sogar zwei komplette Partien nur mit den 25 Karten aus diesem Paket. Neben den neuen Wörtern enthält das Paket außerdem 3 neue Agentenplättchen (2 für Codenames und 1 für Duett) sowie 4 Bilder zum Thema Märchen für Codenames: Pictures, mit denen Sie Ihre Spiele noch individueller gestalten können.
Designed for players who are already familiar with Snowp, this expansion adds more strategic variety and dynamic gameplay while bringing a festive holiday atmosphere to every match.

The Christmas Tree Board adds a new twist to scoring. At the start of each round, 10 bells are placed on the tree. The more bells of a color there are, the more valuable that color becomes, creating new strategic opportunities and exciting comeback moments.
The expansion also introduces Snowman Tokens. If a player fails to collect a bell on their turn, they place a snowman onto the snowfield, where it acts as a blocker and changes future shots.
#LAZYLUZAAuthentisch . Pur . Ausgeglichen

Unser neuestes Brettspieltisch-Modell ist mal etwas wirklich ganz anderes! Es schlägt ein völlig neues Kapitel auf! Er definiert modernes Wohnen ohne aufdringlich zu sein. Das anmutig geformte Gestell und die Leichtigkeit der Deckplatte ziehen die Ruhe förmlich an.
Letztes Jahr zum 20-Jährigen Firmenjubiläum geteasert . Dieses Jahr LIVE und in Farbe ;-)
Neue Vogelfähigkeiten von Flügelschlag-Fans auf 150 Karten!

Flügelschlag-Autorin Elizabeth Hargrave hat in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Koordinator für Fan-Kreationen Travis Willse und einigen ausgewählten Autor*innen das offizielle Regionen Fan-Set 1 entwickelt. Diese Box enthält 6 Vogelkarten-Packs, die jeweils 25 völlig neue Vögel aus Kontinenten enthalten, die bereits in Flügelschlag vertreten sind, insgesamt also 150 neue Karten. Die enthaltenen 6 Regionen sind: Asien, Großbritannien, Kanada, Kontinentaleuropa, Neuseeland und USA.
Die Illustrationen passen zum allgemeinen Stil aller anderen Karten im Spiel und zeigen die Vögel wie immer in all ihrer Pracht.

"The battle for food truck supremacy has begun! Food Truck Fury is a deck-building battler where you will play as one of a variety of asymmetric food trucks adopting unique strategies to defeat the competition, complete jobs, deliver to customers, and earn points. You will be armed with incredible and wacky contraptions to dominate the city and secure your victory! Will you combat your fellow food truckers or will you tackle the solo mode to defeat the evil V.E.N.D.O. Corp, who is determined to replace good cooking with vending machines? In this flavorful game for 1-4 players, only one food trucker can be the greatest, will it be you?"

How well do you really know each other? This card game from the popular VOLL VERSCHÄTZT series puts you to the test! Countless combinations of categories and questions make for surprising guessing fun.

Let’s head into the next big showdown - this time with heroes and heroines from the legend of King Arthur! In this expansion for Tag Team (which can also be played on its own), you’ll choose from six new, unique fighters: powerful mages, brave knights, or mysterious figures from the world of legend. Assemble your Tag Team of two characters, combine their card decks, and face off against each other in thrilling rounds! Just like in the popular base game, you simultaneously reveal the top card of your battle deck and trigger its effects. But be careful: After each round, you strategically add a new card to any spot in your deck - keeping control over the next exchange of blows. Whoever plans skillfully and lands the decisive blow secures victory!

In Robotland, one of the twenty resident robots has had enough and has made its escape. Together with the remaining robots and your fellow players, can you figure out which one ran away before it is too late?

The aim of the game is to reveal the Runaway Robot. To do so, players take turns playing Robot tiles to figure out each other’s hidden Robots, trying to reveal as much information as possible. If you know each other’s robots, you will figure out the missing robot - but will you do so before you run out of clues?

Turn traffic congestion into a greener commute. In Green City, players build a shared urban network of sidewalks, cycle lanes, bus routes, and tram lines, connecting residents with their destinations.

The scoring puzzle rewards matching the transport mode to the journey: walking and cycling are efficient for short trips, while buses and trams excel over longer distances. Shared infrastructure creates interaction, and bag-drawn scoring tiles keep the timing tense.
Designed by Fabio Lopiano and Mandela Fernández-Grandon, this original 2026 release delivers a compact, highly replayable network-building challenge for 2–6 players.
License available for most regions.
Race to rewild the land in this quick and charming strategy game.
Return species to their native environments, from the Eurasian Lynx to the Burrowing Owl, as you create vital routes between habitats in a shared landscape.

Choose to play in two distinct biomes: the lush Scottish uplands and the windswept shortgrass prairie of Montana, each with their own set of animals to rewild. Secretly champion one species, balancing which animals to release and which to hold back, as you work to restore the eco-system and guide the return of wild, thriving nature.
Sei der mutigste Emberling.

LIGRETTO® jetzt mit massig Torchancen! Zwei Mannschaften treten in einer turbulenten Partie gegeneinander an. Wer legt die Karten am schnellsten ab, bleibt am Ball und schießt die meisten Tore? Geschwindigkeit, gute Kombinationsgabe und schnelles Reaktionsvermögen sind hier gefragt. Auf die Karten, fertig, los

Quartermaster General: West Front is the third entry in the Quartermaster General two-player line. It is played over 23 seasonal game rounds, from Fall 1939 through Spring 1945, with one player controlling the Allies' forces — United Kingdom, United States, and France — and the other playing the Axis: Germany, Italy, and other associated countries (the "Pact", so called after the Tripartite Pact).
