Each player has a unique deck of cards that reflects the capabilities of that side throughout the course of the war: the invasion of Western Europe, the Battle of the Atlantic, and eventually — if the Allies hang on! — D-Day and liberation.
West Front also includes components and rules to create massive, combined games with Quartermaster General: East Front and South Front.
Daemonia is a dark fantasy deck-building game set in a world where fallen angels wage war for dominance.
Players take on the role of powerful Watchers — ancient beings commanding unique factions, each with their own playstyle, abilities, and lore.
Designed for 2–4 players, Daemonia combines deep strategic gameplay with stunning artwork and rich worldbuilding.
Launching on Kickstarter in 2027.
Alles ist besser mit Bingo!
Can your friends read your mind?

S-Tier is a party game where your opinions become the puzzle! Each round, the leader secretly ranks five pictures from S to F according to a random topic. Everyone else tries to figure out exactly how the leader rated them.
Play cooperatively, compete individually, or split into teams depending on your group size. Discuss, debate, and discover just how well you really know each other!

With wide valleys, clear mountain lakes, and rolling hills, Cascadia takes on a whole new dimension. This standalone game set in the world of Cascadia expands the familiar landscape-laying mechanic to include a third level: tiles can be stacked on top of one another, gradually creating impressive 3D landscapes. Animals find their place on different levels, mountain lakes become more valuable the higher they are located, and each additional layer opens up new tactical possibilities for building. The game offers familiar tranquility with increased strategic depth: slightly more challenging, yet clear and calm in its gameplay. Ideal for one to four players ages 12 and up.
Duell zwischen Fälscherin und Agentin
Begebt euch auf eine packende Verfolgungsjagd rund um den Globus! Spielt entweder Angela Farbank, eine geniale Fälscherin, die um die Welt reist,
um gefälschte Schecks im Wert von 1.000.000 Dollar einzulösen, oder Jessah Hope, eine unnachgiebige FBI-Agentin, die davon träumt, Farbank hinter Gitter

zu bringen. Bluffen und Vorausahnen sind die Schlüsselwörter dieser spannenden Verfolgung. Als Angela reist du um die Welt und trägst deine Bewegungen und falschen Identitäten geheim auf deiner persönlichen Weltkarte ein, um im Falle einer Festnahme zu entkommen.

Als Jessah deckst du Angelas Tarnung auf, indem du sie aufspürst und verhaftest, bevor sie ihren Plan vollenden kann - dabei stehen dir die nahezu unbegrenzten Ressourcen des FBI zur Verfügung, denn mit jedem eingelösten Scheck erhältst du von deinen Vorgesetzten neue Mittel.
Unabhängig von eurer Rolle bestimmen 4 zufällig gezogene Aktionskarten die Möglichkeiten jeder Runde: Reisen zu einer nahegelegenen Stadt,
Einlösen eines Schecks aus der Hand, Ziehen eines neuen Schecks oder das Setzen bzw. Entfernen von Radaren und Straßensperren auf der Karte.
So wird gespielt:
Als Angela reist du heimlich um die Welt und bewegst deiner Figur auf deiner eigenen Weltkarte
Als Jessah deckst du Angelas Spur auf und setzt FBI-Ressourcen ein, um sie zu stellen
4 zufällige Aktionskarten legen pro Runde fest, welche Aktionen zur Verfügung stehen
Platziert abwechselnd eure Token, um Zeitpunkt und Art eurer Aktionen zu planen
Das Besondere:
🎭 Asymmetrisches Duell mit völlig unterschiedlichen Rollen
🗺️ Geheime Weltkarte für Angelas Fluchtroute
🕵️ Bluff und Antizipation als zentrale Spielmechanik
🏷️ Kategorie: leichtes Kennerspiel
Book your Bug & Breakfast!

The autumn forest is abuzz with anticipation — a brand new inn is being built… exclusively for BUGS! Bouncing grasshoppers, merry ladybugs, busy bees, and even daydreaming spiders are already gathering in the clearing, waiting for the grand opening.

Buzz Inn is a charming tile-placement puzzle for 2–4 players. Search beneath the leaves for comfy straw pillows and colorful bugs, then build your inn tile by tile. Arrange your rooms carefully — every bug has its own shape and needs enough free pillows to settle in comfortably.

Decide whether to keep the tile you reveal or risk searching for a better one, accommodate as many bugs as possible, and earn decorative roofs by welcoming the right guests. Add Awards and Special Effects for extra challenges once you're ready to make your inn a little more bustling!

Fins up! Get your scaly friends right in front of the laughing Buddha—before the others do or before he wanders off to another shore. Only those who trade smartly and keep a close eye on their fish will win. Can you line up your fish the fastest?
Laden, Fenster, Dach – und eine Straße voller Charme
Stell dir vor: bunte Giebelhäuser, Katzen auf den Fensterbänken, Blumentöpfe an jeder Fassade – deine ganz eigene Gracht mitten am Spieltisch.
In Haushoch! baust du Haus für Haus eine Straße entlang des Amsterdamer Kanals. Mit Karten. Mit Köpfchen. Und mit dem leisen Verdacht,
dass dein Nachbar gerade die Karte bekommt, die du eigentlich wolltest.
Das Prinzip ist schnell erklärt: unten der Laden, darüber Fensterkarten mit Katzen, Vögeln, Fahnen und Blumentöpfen, oben das prächtige Barockdach.
Stockwerk für Stockwerk wächst dein Haus - aber welche Karte spielst du, und welche gibst du lieber weiter, bevor jemand anderes sie kriegt?
Das Besondere:
🏠 Häuser Stockwerk für Stockwerk aufbauen, Bedingungen erfüllen, Punkte kassieren
🐱 Katzen, Vögel, Blumentöpfe - Amsterdam eben
🎨 Farbgruppen verbinden, Straße optimieren

Mega Empires: The Far East – North is a strategy board game for 3 to 5 players that captures the development of ancient empires throughout history. Players lead their empires as they expand, cultivate culture and technology, engage in conflicts, apply diplomacy, and confront calamities.

The objective of the game is to accumulate the highest number of victory points by trading commodities and strategically developing advances, symbolizing each empire’s wealth and glory. A full game guarantees hours of enjoyment to players who love epic board games with a strong historical context. No two games are alike, even with the same empire!

This game is set in East Asia and incorporates many elements from its rich history, including the renowned Chinese dynasties and the Heian period. It features the Great Wall and revolutionary innovations such as the magnetic compass, the pound lock, paper money, and gunpowder.
894.theme: Civilization, History, Asia, Mithology, Economy, Politics

description: Papa Faulus, the wise village elder, has chosen you.
For the village’s grand feast, he needs the rarest ingredients on the island — but he’s grown too old to gather them himself.
You are the youngest and bravest sloths in the village. Roll. Travel. Gather. The first player to complete three food bundles earns the honor of becoming the feast’s head chef.
But beware: push your luck one roll too far, and you might come back empty-pawed.
Fauch & Fertig ist ein cleveres Kartenspiel, bei dem ihr Drachen sammelt, Kombos bildet und versucht, eure Eier schneller loszuwerden als alle anderen.
Seek glory by pleasing Ra, the Sun God and creator of the pantheon of Egyptian deities. Roll and reroll dice to get valuable combinations, but be careful — you might hasten the day of Ra’s judgment!

Heroes II is a standalone expansion to Heroes, a full-fledged strategy game in a compact, portable format. Choose one of six unique factions, each with its own playstyle, abilities, and path to victory. Explore territories, gather resources, build structures, raise armies, capture fortresses, and search for powerful artifacts. Lead your faction to victory and become the sole ruler of the world beyond the Ethereal Gate!

All you need is a faction board and a marker — play at home, on the road, outdoors, or battle with friends via video chat. Heroes II can be played entirely on its own or combined with the original Heroes — mix and match factions from both boxes for even more matchups and strategic possibilities.
Go treasure hunting with the Coalition of Courageous Critters! Explore the crypt of the legendary pharaoh Mewesess, open secret chambers, gather riches, and assemble the finest expedition.

Place your paws on entrance cards to create paths into the crypt, then remove them to trigger powerful card effects. Manage your food, torches, and pickaxes, hire helpful assistants, and open new chambers to earn glory. Build a diverse expedition and leave your mark on the history of the Coalition!
Gather resources — Use card effects to collect food, torches, and pickaxes for your expedition.
Dig into the crypt — Place paws at the entrances and use their intersections to reach new chambers.
Build your expedition — Open chambers, hire assistants, and earn the most glory!
Stamp your way to victory in this clever mix of a memory game and “Connect Four”!

Fill your rows of letters with different stamps and be careful not to pick duplicates. After all, they all look the same from the outside! Whoever has the best memory and cleverly blocks the most sought-after stamps wins and is crowned the Master Snail!
901.theme: Kinderspiel über die Post von Fabelwesen

description: All the strategy. All the wildlife. Packed into a small box.

This standalone travel edition gives the full Kavango experience into a streamlined card game that will slide into backpacks, ready to be taken on adventurous game nights anywhere. Ideal for family holidays - including a kids' rule variant (ages 6+).
Available in English only.

Viking Route is a cooperative adventure where players guide a Viking crew through mythical lands and dangerous seas, striving to achieve their final objective in each scenario while facing enemies that try to thwart their mission. The game features an innovative magnetic navigation system: Odin's Ravens and the Wind spirit influence the Compass, representing the Drakkar, creating dynamic choices.

The 3-D cardboard Drakkar is managed by players and divided into Zones for specific actions. When enemies like Valkyries or monsters reach the Compass on the map, they board the Drakkar, triggering the game’s most direct combat and tactical phase. The different scenarios can be played individually, or linked together in a thrilling campaign.

The Jarl Edition includes exclusive content not available in the normal version of the game: 5 Viking miniatures, 1 additional Viking hero, 2 new scenarios in the lands of Frost and Fire Giants, a custom compass, a log journal to keep track of your campaigns, and additional upgrades for the Drakkar.

Things are getting serious! Flip 7 shows its ruthless side and eliminates any second chances. Take turns collecting cards as the risk grows with every move - whoever draws twice is out. New, interactive action cards trigger nasty effects, while penalty cards result in negative points. And as if that weren’t enough, there are now 13 copies of the number 13 in the card set! Thrills, schadenfreude, and an escalating atmosphere are guaranteed! The question remains: Stop, or one more? A fast-paced, standalone, and devious card game with simple rules for three to eighteen players ages ten and up.

GENERALS OF KALADAN — GLOBAL DEBUT AT SPIEL ESSEN 2026Generals of Kaladan is a competitive fantasy battle game for 2–6 players, making its global release and first-ever public appearance at SPIEL Essen 2026.

Choose your General and enter the battle for Kaladan. Beyond direct confrontation, the flow of play brings together Events, Gold, purchasing and tile control, creating strategic decisions both on and around the battlefield.
Key Features
2–6 players with different battle dynamics at every player count
Free-for-All Elimination — every General fights for themselves
Team Mode — join forces in 2 vs 2 or a full 3 vs 3 battle
Events, Gold & Purchases — changing circumstances and resources influence your decisions throughout the game
Tile Control — compete for control of the battlefield while confronting rival Generals
Multiple ways to play — from a focused two-player confrontation to a full six-player clash
The result is a battle that combines combat, resource decisions and territorial control, with the experience changing dramatically depending on whether you fight alone or alongside allies.
2–6 Players | Free-for-All Elimination | Team Mode: 2 vs 2 & 3 vs 3

War of the Ring - The Card Game is a game inspired by the works of J.R.R. Tolkien, recreating the epic struggle between the Free Peoples and the Shadow as the race to destroy the One Ring and defeat the overwhelming forces of Sauron.

Enhance and personalize your games with the War of the Ring – The Card Game: Deluxe Playmats, featuring six neoprene playmats: three for the Free Peoples (Gandalf, Frodo, and Aragorn) and three for the Shadow (Saruman, the Witch-king, plus a double-sided The Balrog/Bill Ferny playmat). The double-sided design supports every faction combination across all scenarios, from 2 to 6 players.

Each playmat features an illustration of a location from the saga associated with its featured character, finished with finely stitched edges. Elegant markings indicate the draw deck and discard pile positions in the lower-left corner, while the remaining mat area has space for cards in reserve and in play. Every playmat showcases original artwork by John Howe, one of the world's most celebrated Tolkien illustrators.
906.theme: Lord of the Rings, Tolkien, Middle-earth

description: In this hard-fought duel, you build magnificent towers by offering each other Building cards. But beware: if someone slips you a card that causes one of your towers to overshoot its target, a seemingly secure round can quickly be lost.
Hurry! Describe the terms on the card so that your fellow players can guess as many as possible correctly. How you do that is up to you. But hurry—the clock is ticking!

Chirping, rustling, a peek into the nest - a unique habitat for native birds takes shape on the game board. In this family game for two to four players ages ten and up, dice are rolled at the start of each round: White dice grant advantages, while black dice impose restrictions. Next, a bird card is chosen to take birds from the game board into your hand, which can then be used to create new opportunities or placed in your own display. Each bird species possesses one of seven special abilities, such as song, feathers, or migration. Players who skillfully collect symbols or combine multiple birds of the same species earn awards. But be careful: dangers repeatedly put the habitat to the test or steal birds from the display.

Enter the mysterious depths of the ancient pharaoh’s tomb! Legend says that a precious crystal is hidden inside, and you simply must find it. Fight monsters, open chests, dodge traps, and use powerful equipment on your way to fame and fortune!

Monsters of Egypt is a cooperative tabletop platformer where heroes descend through the levels of a sprawling pyramid in search of the Pharaoh’s Crystal. Climb ladders, blast through walls and floors, uncover hidden treasures and threats, and battle a variety of monsters. Your actions can literally reshape the dungeon, opening new paths — or sending heroes tumbling to the levels below.
The double-sided game board offers two different adventures: a relaxed Exploration Mode and a frantic Escape Mode, where a collapsing ceiling constantly pushes the heroes deeper into danger.

But death doesn’t mean you’re out of the game. If your hero dies, you switch sides and take control of the monsters, turning the cooperative adventure into a battle between the surviving heroes and the forces of the tomb. Find the Crystal and escape the pyramid to win!

Sirens wail, lights flash, and somewhere glass shatters—a brazen break-in rocks the casino! Amid roulette balls and playing cards, a race against time begins. Puzzling clues, encrypted codes, and mysterious objects must be deciphered to finally open the safe. This cooperative escape game brings the excitement of a live escape room right to your dining table. This limited-edition anniversary set, housed in a high-quality metal tin, includes exclusive extras in the EXIT® style—a true collector’s item and a must-have for all fans. For one to four players ages 12 and up.
Ressourcen sammeln, Pandas anwerben, das schönste Panda-Dorf bauen

Irgendwo in einer zauberhaften Welt aus Bambus, Bao und Goldreserven liegt die Villa Panda – ein kleines Dorf voller flauschiger Bewohner. Und du willst es führen. Hinter der niedlichen Fassade steckt mehr als man zunächst denkt – wer seine Pandas nicht klug einsetzt, kommt hier nicht weit.

Baue Gebäude, manage deine Ressourcen und stelle ein Team aus Baumeistern, Händlern, Sammlern und Mönchen zusammen. Denn hier entscheidet nicht nur Glück – sondern wer seine Pandas am klügsten einsetzt.
Das Besondere:
🐼 Pandas anwerben, Ressourcen managen, Gebäude errichten
🏯 Mit Kaiser-Variante für noch mehr Tiefe

Molly House ist ein anspruchsvolles historisches Spiel, das euch mitten in die queer Communities Londons zu Beginn des 18. Jahrhunderts versetzt – eine Welt voller Mut, Maskerade und tödlicher Gefahren.

Ihr übernehmt die Rollen der Mollies: Menschen, die gesellschaftliche Geschlechternormen bewusst überschreiten und in verborgenen Häusern, Tavernen und Hinterzimmern Zuflucht, Gemeinschaft und Freude finden. Doch ihr lebt gefährlich. Die selbsternannten Sittenwächter der Gesellschaft zur Reformation der Sitten sind euch stets auf den Fersen.

Im Zentrum steht eine innovative Feier-Mechanik: Anders als in klassischen Kartenspielen besprecht ihr eure Handkarten offen miteinander. Doch jede Information ist ein zweischneidiges Schwert – wer zu viel offenbart, riskiert, sein prunkvolles Fest allein feiern zu müssen. Nur wer die Kunst der Andeutung beherrscht, navigiert erfolgreich durch die komplexen sozialen Dynamiken dieses Spiels.

Mit wachsendem Ruhm eurer Feiern wächst auch der Druck von außen. Die Gesellschaft zur Reformation zwingt euch zur Kooperation – bis hin zum Verrat. Ihr müsst eure Gemeinschaft nie preisgeben, doch manchmal ist der Wunsch nach Sicherheit verführerisch. Achtet darauf: Lasst euch von den anderen Mollies nicht erwischen, wenn euer Kartenhaus zu wanken beginnt.
Ein Spiel von Jo Kelly und Cole Wehrle (Root, Pax Pamir, Arcs); Solo-Modus von Richard Wilkins.

Molly House öffnet ein spielerisches Fenster in eine lebendige, oft übersehene Epoche – historisch fundiert, emotional aufgeladen und strategisch anspruchsvoll. Ein Kennerspiel, das nicht nur fordert, sondern nachhallt.

Who has what it takes to be a dragon rider - and who would rather take on the role of a scribe? In this cooperative communication game, three to six players aged 16 and up ask each other exciting “Who would be most likely to…” questions set in the fascinating world of *Fourth Wing* and discuss their answers together. 180 beautifully designed cards featuring atmospheric illustrations of the Fourth Wing world invite lively conversations about the themes of the bestselling novel. With its elegant cover, the game fits perfectly among your favorite novels on the bookshelf. An ideal communication game for fans of the New Adult book series Fourth Wing who are looking for a sociable and imaginative gaming experience.
Easy: On your turn, place a card on one of the two piles.
Smart: Play multiple bonus actions right in a row!
Mean: Slow down your opponents by changing the color or direction of the cards!
Here’s how it works: Get rid of all your cards and end the round when you think you have the fewest points... But be careful—you don’t know the value of some cards!
Will you take a risk or play it safe?

Wir schicken dir die Fallakte zu einem ungelösten Mordfall! Dabei erhältst du die Möglichkeit, Verdächtige zu verhören, die individuell auf deine Verhörmethoden und Fragen eingehen. Setzt du die Verdächtigen unter Druck oder versuchst du, dich mit ihnen anzufreunden? Finde jetzt heraus, ob du das Zeug zum echten Ermittler hast!

Eine Forschungsstation im ewigen Eis, ein verrückter Wissenschaftler und ein kaltblütiger Mord. Der renommierte Forscher Dr. Johan Fjellberg wird nach einem Stromausfall tot aufgefunden. Kannst du Licht die andauernde Dunkelheit der norwegischen Polarnacht bringen und den Mord aufklären?

A gentle lapping, the sun glistening on the water - magnificent koi swim leisurely in circles. In Koi, an artfully designed garden pond takes shape turn by turn, where elegant fish swim among water lilies and stones. Koi on transparent acrylic tiles are placed in the water, giving the pond a fascinating sense of depth. With skillful planning, players can choose the right pond cards, expand the pond, and create the ideal environment for prized carp. A variety of task cards ensures that every game presents new challenges. Whether playing solo or competitively, this beautifully illustrated game offers tactical variety and atmospheric relaxation for one to four players ages 12 and up.

A lion, a genie, and a penguin walk into a fortune teller's shop. The lion asks the others, "How many horror movies do you know?" "I know three," honked the penguin. "Five!" countered the lion. "THIRTEEN!!!" shouted the genie in a booming voice.
The goat behind the crystal ball grinned: "I see it differently, but good luck!!"

Now you might not be any wiser, but at least you know what this is all about! Pick a topic, place your bets, but don't overreach... or you'll have to deliver! Only the player with energy left at the end takes the win!
This time: with questions for adults!

High 5 18+ by Godot Games is a fast-paced, high-energy party and bluffing game for adult game nights (ages 18 and up). Designed by Stefan Godot, the game focuses on ultra-quick rounds and high dynamic play.
Players & Duration: Designed for 2 to 6 players with a playtime of around 15 minutes.
Gameplay: Fast party game mechanics centered on emotions, direct interaction, and table humor. Two editions are available (a standard version and an explicit 18+ version).
Focus: Typical for Godot Games, the emphasis is on unfiltered entertainment, a provocative tone, and pure party energy.
Alles ist besser mit Bingo!
Hurry! Describe the terms on the card so that your fellow players can guess as many as possible correctly. How you do that is up to you. But hurry—the clock is ticking!

Wir schicken dir alle Unterlagen, die du benötigst, um das perfekte Verbrechen zu planen! Nach Jahren der Ermittlungsarbeit ist es nun an der Zeit, die Seiten zu wechseln. Wolltest du dich schon immer mal wie ein echter Meisterdieb fühlen?

Der erste Coup führt dich ins sonnige Miami, wo ein kürzlich aufgetauchtes Meisterwerk vom berühmten Maler van Gogh für Aufsehen sorgt. Stelle ein Team von Experten zusammen, knacke die Sicherheitsmaßnahmen des Museums und gehe als einer der berüchtigsten Meisterdiebe in die Geschichte ein!

A wide view is guaranteed - with your very own panorama! With each tile, a piece of the landscape takes shape: mountains give way to meadows, and forests stretch out. Players take turns placing a landscape tile to the left or right of their own layout, expanding the picture. Where does it fit best? Animals feel at home where their favorite flowers bloom - and that’s how you earn valuable points. You’ll also need to keep an eye on the bonus scores: Who has the fewest clouds? Who has the longest river? These scores change from round to round, making every game unique and full of variety. A calm and tactical family game with a feel-good factor for two to four players ages eight and up, inviting you to plan and marvel.
Festburg is buzzing! The festival is coming to town, and so are the guests — from traveling minstrels to mystical fortunetellers.
As stewards, you know every visitor has their own quirks. Will you accommodate everyone and create a harmony, or play favorites and risk causing chaos?

Festburg is a strategic card game where collecting and accommodating guests go hand in hand. Choose guests for your personal pile, then place new arrivals on the shared festival area according to their unique preferences. At the end of the game, your collected guests score based on how successfully their groups were accommodated — so every placement can help you or disrupt your rivals.

In BurgerDraft, a Draft & Flip game, you take on the role of creative chefs designing the next signature burger for your restaurant's menu. Combine juicy patties, crisp vegetables, flavorful sauces, and many other ingredients to create unique burgers. Collect scoring cards that reflect the preferences of your taste testers and meet their requirements to earn as many victory points as possible.
Whoever creates the most irresistible burger wins the game!
Alles ist besser mit Bingo!

Barcelona, Paris - and then a quick trip to Amsterdam? A three-week vacation in Europe calls for careful planning. Players select city tiles from three different categories featuring seven popular European destinations and add them to their weekly schedule. The tiles show sights, shopping ideas, cultural highlights, local dishes, and much more. You decide whether to visit a city during the week, on the weekend, or on a specific day. Longer stays earn more points, while choosing the right mode of transportation ensures smooth travel between cities. The best plan is rewarded with victory. For two to four players ages 10 and up who want to put their skills to the test in planning the perfect vacation.
Du baust Reis an, in der japanischen Präfektur Niigata - dort, wo Schlangen als heilige Wesen gelten und dem Reis beim Wachsen helfen.
Je mehr Schlangen, desto reicher die Ernte. Doch nur wer sie im Zaum hält, bringt die Ernte auch ein.

Tanbo ist ein abstraktes Strategiespiel für zwei Personen mit japanischem Thema. Der Hauptmechanismus ähnelt Mancala, das seit der Antike gespielt wird. In Tanbo hat sich dieses Mancala-Prinzip jedoch zu etwas Ungewöhnlichem und Rätselhaftem weiterentwickelt, mit Elementen von Worker Placement und fest vorgegebener Bewegung.
Das Besondere:
🐍 Mancala-Mechanik mit Worker-Placement-Elementen
🏆 Gewinner des Rakuichi Fresh Dragon Award 2023
🎲 Mehrere saisonale Aufbau-Varianten (Regenzeit/Trockenzeit) für Abwechslung

Dive into an adventure at the bottom of the sea! Shelly the clam has lost her sparkling pearls, but Sam the turtle sets out with her to find them. At the other end of the reef, curious sea creatures are waiting—and they’ll only hand over the pearls in exchange for tricky puzzles. Work together to solve exciting challenges and help Sam get the pearls back! Six types of puzzles that can be combined in endless new ways await one to four children ages five and up. The game components are reusable, so EXIT® - The Game for Kids can be played again and again.

Face the ultimate tactical showdown! In Yokai Forest Duel, you face off in fast-paced duels, tournaments, or leagues with 2–8 players. Outsmart your rivals through strategy, deduction, and calculated bluffing in intense best-of-three matches.

No lucky dice rolls, no excuses: you have complete control over your card deck. Every decision counts—not just for the moment, but also thinking ahead to the upcoming rounds. Master your skills, adapt your tactics, and prove who truly rules the spirits of the forest!
Strategy, Deduction & Bluffing: Read your opponents' plans and play your cards at the perfect moment.
Maximum Control: Luck plays virtually no role—every single card and every action is entirely in your hands.
Forward-Thinking Gameplay: Don't just win the current match; evolve your tactics across multiple best-of-three rounds.
Are you ready to take your skills to the next level and claim victory in the duel?

The journey continues: The third standalone in the Forest Shuffle series, Forest Shuffle - Smoky Mountains takes you to this popular North American National Park. Building on the beloved gameplay of the series, it introduces new species and clever twists in mechanics. This keeping the experience as fresh as the bubbling waters on the new terrain cards!
Heres what Forest Shuffle - Smoky Mountains is all about:
New terrain types centered around water, playable solo or as a universal waters under trees.
New synergies between flora and fauna, all revolving around the element of water.
In addition to a variety of species around the water, the game is also home to various large animals, such as black bears or bobcats.

Bonus: like its predecessors, this family friendly card game works with all player counts! Preserve the beauty of the Smoky Mountains in a game with 2-5 players while enjoying the marvellous illustrations by Judit Piella and Toni Llobet. And as usual, all Forest Shuffle games are manufactured from FSC certified material.
930.theme: Nature, Wildlife, USA, National Park, Smoky Mountains

description: The crew has to get moving to find Charlemagne’s lost treasure. With only a few clues, they follow the trail by ship, sled, and other means across five continents and through dangerous habitats. But the competition never sleeps, so every step must be carefully considered and communicated. Over the course of 25 stages, the crew tries to reach the finish line with as few tasks as possible to avoid giving the time marker too much of a head start. Failure, however, doesn’t end the stage; instead, it eventually forces the crew to take a greater risk to achieve the best result. A varied, cooperative adventure with high replay value and unique challenges awaits two to five players ages ten and up.

Mega Empires: The Silk Road is a versatile expansion set for Mega Empires. It includes additional maps that create geographical connections between all games in the series and adds components for 2 more empires, enabling gameplay for any number of players ranging from 3 to 30.

This expansion centers on the legendary Silk Road, which linked the Far East with the Middle East and the Western world. Its maps cover the area north of the Himalayas, incorporating the Tibetan Empire and Zhangzhung Kingdom into the game. These new maps and empires provide many alternative game setups for both The East and The Far East.

Additionally, it includes the Age of Grandeur Module, which is an upgrade to The Special Buildings expansion(s). It adds cards with unique effects to the special buildings of each of the 30 empires, as indicated on large cards that players receive when constructing a special building. Whoever controls the building can use its unique effect to their advantage.

expands.name: Mega Empires: The Far East – North
Mega Empires: The Far East – South

description: Stellt euch den verrücktesten Challenges! Mal im Team – mal ganz allein. Von superleicht bis richtig abgefahren! Doch Achtung: Jede Sekunde zählt! Füttert den sprechenden Timer mit euren Scheinen, denn für jeden Dollar bekommt ihr eine Sekunde Spielzeit. Clever haushalten ist Pflicht – Wechselgeld gibt’s nicht! Schafft ihr es, zusammen 5 Challenges erfolgreich zu meistern? Oder legt ihr noch eine Schippe drauf und zeigt, dass mehr in euch steckt? Timer füttern und starten – Jetzt heißt es TIME TO SCHEIN!

Take a deep breath, aim for the hole and… let the balls roll! Every time you make a shot, you’re faced with a decision: Should you secure the point chip and stop, or keep playing for a more valuable chip? It’s not as easy as it sounds. Because if your last ball misses the target, you walk away empty-handed. And that’s not all: The next player in line gets to play for the chip you left behind. Who will be the first to reach 42 points in this exciting and fun game?

Get together to form your own boy band in the 90s and climb the ranks of the music industry together. Use your charm, your dancing skills and a bit of your singing talent to eventually reach the heights of the pop world. But watch out – challenges such as rival bands and gossip magazines will stand in the way of your big dreams. Will you make it before one of you embarks on a solo career or the record label drops you?

In Everybody Yeah, each of you plays a typical boyband archetype with different abilities, which you can activate by placing dice. Work together to complete the various challenges, support one another by manipulating the other players dice, and make sure that none of you gains significantly more fame than the others.
A monster builder for any fantasy game.
Do you love worlds full of strange monsters? Do you want to create your own? Contained herein are tables, advice and guidance to do just that.
Monsters Unleashed is system agnostic. Some Unleashed engine mechanics are included to ground the guidance and help adapt it to your needs.

Monsters should be weird, unexpected, unknown, twisted and just sometimes familiar. They are sometimes our dark reflections. Other times they are that which we fear and must conquer to obtain our desires (i.e. treasure).
Creating Unique Monsters

The heart of Monsters Unleashed! is its utility as a monster builder to help you create strange monsters. First though, we want to put this in context of our advice on making unique fantasy worlds. Then we provide tables to build monsters for any system, and provide two examples.
We then make an example fantasy world, the Shield Marshes, following our own advice. The final section provides stats for some of the monsters made using the unleashed engine.
Monsters Unleashed is a 20 page zine with 20 randomizable traits for your monsters. It contains example monsters, and a setting where we follow our own advice The Shield Marshes.
It is a compliment to the Dungeons Unleashed booklet, which can currently be downloaded for free.
It’s harvest time on Mallorca.

In La Cosecha (Spanish for “the harvest”), you run your farm in the idyllic hamlet of Alpich near the town of Esporles. Each round, you harvest goods such as olives, grapes, and grain to mark boxes in different areas of your farm sheet. Fields need tending, the barn roof needs covering, and market carts want loading—your farm is full of opportunities!

Often, you’ll need upgraded goods such as food and wine, which you must first produce from harvested goods. You’ll have to balance short-term revenue against long-term planning. In addition, you can acquire tools and farm extensions with special abilities that may give you the decisive edge.
The player who manages to use their revenue most effectively, combine the strongest bonuses, and keep an eye on the competition will earn the greatest renown and win the game.
The intriguing dice/card drafting mechanism offers new options each round.
Resource management, balancing short-term returns with long-term planning.
Two different Farm Sheets, using the same core rules, but each with their unique gameplay twists.
Variable setup means no two games of La Cosecha will play out the same.
Challenging solo mode.
Set in the world of the award-winning “La Granja”.

Whether it’s a llama or a hamster: Everyone here sports a mustache. In the card game Moustache, humorously illustrated animals with impressive facial hair engage in fast-paced team duels. The cards feature cheerful, colorful designs with shiny, metallic-look mustaches: The higher the card value, the more impressive the mustache. The rules are easy to grasp right away, but after just the first round, nothing stays the same: Teams are randomly reassigned, an additional special rule takes effect for the rest of the game, and the cards are reshuffled. Sometimes everything goes as expected, sometimes the color order flips, and sometimes wild cards or card effects lead to unexpected twists. The result is short, lively games with a touch of controlled chaos. Perfect for livening up a game night with three to six friends aged ten and up, or with the whole family.

Midnight has fallen over Gotham City. Sirens echo through the streets, and shadowy figures vanish among the skyscrapers. In this story-driven, cooperative adventure game, players take on the heroic roles of Batman, Batgirl, Batwoman, and Nightwing. Together, they explore buildings, gather clues, and track down supervillains as the story unfolds piece by piece. The game board is open for exploration and allows players to move freely throughout Gotham City. Coordination is key to taking action in multiple locations simultaneously and stopping the threat. Thanks to a starter adventure, the gripping narrative begins right away. For two to four players ages 10 and up.

Die Jahreszeiten wechseln, und diese schrägen Vögel suchen ein neues Zuhause! Die eigensinnigen Uhus genießen bei warmem Wetter Gesellschaft, werden bei Kälte aber zu echten Einzelgängern. Stolze Eisvögel und entschlossene Spechte kommen bei reichhaltigem Nahrungsangebot bestens miteinander aus – doch was geschieht, wenn die Nahrung plötzlich knapp wird? Erschaffe über drei Jahreszeiten hinweg Zufluchtsorte, die ebenso reizvoll sind wie die Vögel selbst, in diesem Spiel, das auf simultanem Drafting und bonusorientiertem Sammeln von Sets basiert.

Erlebe eine neuartige Interpretation des Jahreszeitenwechsels: In jeder Runde rotierst du deine Inselkarten und kannst sie verbessern, um das schwankende Nahrungsangebot abzubilden, während du gleichzeitig geschickt verschiedene Boni abwägst – von Vorteilen durch Vogelfreundschaften bis hin zu Belohnungen für einen vollständigen Vogelschwarm.
Das Besondere:
🦉Drei Jahreszeiten, in denen sich die Bedürfnisse der Vögel wandeln
🏝️Inselkarten werden gedreht und ggf. verbessert - Ressourcen und Lebensräume verändernsich jede Runde
🐦Boni für vollständige Schwärme und Zuneigungen zwischen Vogelarten

In KNIFFEL® – DAS DUELL bleiben die vertrauten Grundregeln des Würfelklassikers KNIFFEL® unverändert, so dass ihr sofort losspielen könnt. Mit 5 Würfeln versucht ihr auch hier die verschiedenen Kombinationen zu erreichen. Seid immer wachsam, welche Bereiche wichtig werden und luchst dem Gegenüber wertvolle Scheiben ab. Wer entscheidet dieses spannende Tauziehen für sich

The year is 1099. The Crusader armies capture Jerusalem, and new Christian states emerge in the Levant. Twelve years later, the Crusader states are still struggling to secure their lands. The Saracen threat looms over their borders, while rival rulers compete for the favor of the Holy See, control of valuable trade, and influence across the region. Their struggle is far from over…

Outremer is a strategy game for 2–4 players set in the early 12th-century Levant. Take control of Jerusalem, Antioch, Tripoli, or Edessa and lead your state through political rivalry, religious influence, economic development, and war.

Plan your orders, develop and fortify your cities, manage valuable goods, raise armies, employ spies, and expand your influence across the Levant. But every decision must account for both your Christian rivals and the Saracen forces that reinforce, raid, and threaten Crusader-controlled lands.
Play individual scenarios or embark on a four-chapter campaign, where your decisions and achievements carry over from one chapter to the next.
The original illustrations for Outremer were drawn by hand in pencil, pen, and ink and decorated with gold leaf before being scanned and retouched for the game.
942.theme: Golden age of the Crusader states in the Middle East

description: …das du nicht siehst! Jede Runde wird ein Begriff aufgedeckt, in dem sich noch viele weitere Wörter verstecken. Es geht aber nicht nur um Schnellig keit: Punkte bekommst du nur für Wörter, die nur du allein entdeckt hast! Ein schneller Wort-Spaß im handlichen Format
Du bist ahnungslos, und die anderen versuchen zu helfen, jedoch ohne sich absprechen zu dürfen: SPELL.

Mega Empires: The Far East – South is a strategy board game for 3 to 5 players that captures the development of ancient empires throughout history. Players lead their empires as they expand, cultivate culture and technology, engage in conflicts, apply diplomacy, and confront calamities.

The objective of the game is to accumulate the highest number of victory points by trading commodities and strategically developing advances, symbolizing each empire’s wealth and glory. A full game guarantees hours of enjoyment to players who love epic board games with a strong historical context. No two games are alike, even with the same empire!

This game is set in continental and maritime Southeast Asia and incorporates many elements from its rich history, including the renowned Khmer and Srivijaya empires. It features revolutionary innovations such as hydraulic engineering, paddy field farming, and refined naval craftsmanship, which contributed to maritime dominance in the region.

Be the first to come up with a word that matches both the letter tiles on the table and the question being read aloud to score points. Choose between 100 trivia and 100 party questions, flip the hourglass, and let the game begin!
Age: 14+
Time: 10+ min
Players: 2+
Contents:
100 party questions
100 trivia questions
60 letter tiles
1 hourglass
1 rulesheet

Quick to learn, quick to play: The popular CATAN experience as a card game in a compact format. With 120 richly illustrated cards, the familiar CATAN gameplay comes to life: Roads are built, settlements grow into towns, which in turn can be expanded into metropolises, and the skillful trading of resources determines success. But watch out for the cunning robbers: If you want to protect your resources wisely, build up a strong force of knights. The card game’s gameplay comes very close to that of CATAN – The Game and offers entertaining, exciting rounds for three to four players ages ten and up.

Embark on all kinds of adventures together in this blend of fantasy role-playing and party game. Let your secret dice roll inspire how you continue the story. Will the others be able to guess what the dice show based on your description? Because if not, things will take a dramatic turn for all of you.
Revenant ist ein kompetitives, atmosphärisches Sci-Fi-Strategiespiel über das Überleben einer Raumflotte am Rand der Vernichtung.
Alles ist besser mit Bingo!

noinoi is the first audio game console for children aged three and up, bringing fresh air to interactive gaming. The game console combines child-friendly gameplay and AI-supported storytelling in a completely new experience.

Children immerse themselves in captivating and exciting adventures with lovable characters. They not only listen actively, but also actively shape the plot. Through decisions and playful interventions, they determine and change the course of the story.

What makes noinoi so special is that with the help of AI, we manage to make every adventure completely fresh and new. Whenever children play with noinoi, they experience a new, previously undiscovered adventure.

Four different play worlds, known as ‘universes’, are planned for the market launch. Each universe features its own characters and worlds, creating a completely unique gaming experience. The ‘Hey Dino!’ starter set takes you into a charming dinosaur world full of adventures – together with little Spinosaurus Spino and his dinosaur friends.

Spino is a cautious little Spinosaurus who sometimes feels very small inside. Together with his dinosaur friends, he goes on adventures in familiar everyday situations, playfully discovers the world and, in the process, learns important values such as courage, patience and teamwork. With a little encouragement, Spino rises to the challenge and realises that there is much more to him than he himself believes.
Wer von euch hat den Mut, hinabzusteigen und die seltensten Zutaten für den mächtigsten Zaubertrank zu finden?

PLAY! Your soundtrack. Your party, your music game! From rock to hip-hop, R&B, and rap, to international hits from the ’90s, 2000s, and 2010s, and the latest chart-toppers—here, guessing is more important than knowing. Put together your own playlist from over 12 music categories and more than 4,000 songs, and play in four different game modes, such as “Walk the Timeline” or “Sooner or Later.” Just get started with your favorite streaming service—Spotify, Apple Music, or YouTube Music. And best of all: You don’t even need an extra app—just launch the game and start the party! The perfect music party game for everyone who loves great beats and wants to share unforgettable moments together.

Hope and Despair is an expansion for War of the Ring – The Card Game that introduces Story cards, a new type of faction card inspired by the most memorable moments and turning points of The Lord of the Rings. Drawing on Tolkien's rich lore and the emotional depth of Middle-earth, Story cards represent the natural and supernatural forces that shape the fate of its peoples, adding new strategic possibilities and thematic depth to every game.

Unlike other faction cards, Story cards are played only to the Reserve and remain there for the rest of the round, providing unique effects that can influence the course of the game. As with Character and Item cards, the same Story card can never be played more than once in a round, encouraging players to carefully plan how and when to use these powerful abilities.

The expansion also includes additional cards for the Northmen, Easterling, and Ruffian factions introduced in the Fire and Swords expansion, to be used in scenarios featuring those factions. With 54 Story cards – including dedicated Shadow Bot cards for solo and cooperative play -, 40 Story tokens, and rules for integrating the new mechanics, Hope and Despair greatly expands the tactical depth, replayability, and narrative experience of War of the Ring – The Card Game.
954.theme: Lord of the Rings, Middle-earth, Tolkien

expands.name: War of the Ring: The Card Game

description: Welcome to Alter Falter! This fast-paced folding quiz cleverly combines trivia questions with origami. Do you know the answer? Then fold your paper so that only the answer is visible! Hurry—the fastest player wins. But be careful: thanks to slanted lines, bright colors, and a jumble of numbers, you’ll be scratching your head faster than you can say “paper airplane.”

10 von 10 ist ein kooperatives Ratespiel, bei dem alle gemeinsam gegen das Spiel antreten. Eine Person muss eine geheime Zahl von 1 bis 10 erraten, während die Mitspielenden passende Begriffe zu einer vorgegebenen Kategorie nennen, die diese Wertung möglichst treffend widerspiegeln.
So funktioniert’s:

In jeder Runde kennen alle außer der ratenden Person die gezogene Zahl. Anschließend wird eine Kategorie aufgedeckt, zu der die Mitspielenden nacheinander jeweils einen passenden Begriff nennen, der die geheime Wertung auf einer Skala von sehr schlecht bis sehr gut widerspiegeln soll. Danach gibt die ratende Person einen Tipp von 1 bis 10 ab. Die Differenz zur tatsächlichen Zahl zählt als Strafpunkte. Nach 10 Runden gewinnt das Team, wenn es insgesamt höchstens 20 Strafpunkte gesammelt hat; bei mehr als 20 Punkten verliert es sofort.
Portus ist ein strategisches Wirtschafts- und Aufbauspiel im antiken Rom, in dem ihr Handel treibt, Produktionsketten entwickelt und euren Einfluss im bedeutendsten Hafen des Imperiums ausbaut.

Woran denkst du bei Party, Nougat und Paris? Vielleicht Essen oder Tanzen? Hatte jemand denselben Gedanken wie du? Dann gibt es funkelnde Edelsteine! Jede Runde kommt ihr euch gedanklich immer näher, bis ihr am Ende hoffentlich alle an dasselbe denkt

Plant an einem spannenden Spieleabend gemeinsam einen echten Gefängnisausbruch! Jeder Hinweis zählt, jede Entscheidung hat Folgen. Nur mit klarer Kommunikation und perfektem Teamwork knackt ihr die Rätsel und findet den Weg in die Freiheit. Wie stark seid ihr als Team wirklich?

Stacheldraht, hohe Mauern, Trostlosigkeit: Das ist der Alltag im Silverton State Prison in den USA. Die Vorstellung, 25 Jahre deines Lebens an diesem Ort zu verbringen, ist für dich unerträglich. Kannst du den perfekten Plan schmieden, um aus dem Hochsicherheitsgefängnis zu entkommen?

A murder rocks the villa - but who is behind it? In this two-player game, one player takes on the role of the murderer, while the other plays the detective. At the start, the murderer secretly decides which of the nine suspects committed the crime, which of the twelve weapons was used, and through which of the eight rooms the villa was entered. The detective has eight rounds to uncover all three secrets by playing cards, skillfully combining information, and ruling out red herrings. Meanwhile, the murderer actively works against the detective, covering their tracks and providing misleading clues. The result is a suspenseful deduction game full of bluffing and logic for two players ages ten and up.

Go West ist ein strategisches Plättchenlegespiel im Wilden Westen, bei dem ihr Siedlungen errichtet, Gebäude geschickt kombiniert und euch auf einer gemeinsamen Landkarte immer stärker in die Quere kommt.

Head out into nature—or bring the adventure into your living room! Together, you’ll build an extraordinary island, piece by piece, using leaves, twigs, stones, and much more. Everyone has secret missions and transforms the collected materials into boats, treasures, or even volcanoes. Indoors, Freiluftwelten provides creative play—outdoors, it becomes an experience like nothing you’ve ever seen before: an adventure that unfolds right in nature!
Fliegen Kriegen ist ein chaotisch-witziges Reaktionsspiel, bei dem ihr eure Bar im Griff behalten müsst, während euch alle anderen mit Fliegen bombardieren.

Gather your friends and family and dive into the world of pop culture with VOLL VERSCHÄTZT—the craziest guessing game ever. Here, you’ll find 350 iconic questions from the colorful world of pop culture that will make even the best guessers break a sweat. Whether you’re a walking encyclopedia or more of a clueless type: It’s all about having fun—knowledge is just a side note!

With every roll of the dice, new possibilities open up on the island of Catan. Roads are built, settlements are established, and resources are skillfully used to help your island grow. A mix of luck and strategy determines the path to victory - whoever lands a great roll moves closer to the finish line. Two exciting game variations with different scoring rules provide even more variety and added fun. High-quality embossed dice with new symbols, a colorful game pad, and four pencils with subtle CATAN embossing make every round a special experience. For families and CATAN fans ages seven and up; ideal for one to four players.

Little dinos play hide-and-seek with their sweet moms all day long, sneaking under their bellies and dashing from one to another. But it’s getting dark and it’s time to go home — and the babies are still too caught up in their game!

Peek-a-saurs is a playful memory game for young children. Hide the baby dinosaurs under four colorful dinomoms and try to remember who is hiding where. On your turn, roll the die, choose a dinomom to lift, and see if you can find the baby dino you’re looking for. Find the right one and take it — the player who gathers the most dinos wins!

But the dinos won’t always stay put! Special die results let players secretly move baby dinos from one mom to another or take one while everyone else closes their eyes, keeping the hiding places changing throughout the game.
Tinctura ist ein atmosphärisches Planungs- und Strategiespiel, in dem ihr als Apotheker:innen eure Arbeitstage clever einteilt, Arzneien herstellt und Patient:innen versorgt.

It’s time to bring some color to this black-and-white world! Explore six exciting locations and make them shine in vibrant colors! Visit the quiet village of Auendorf, marvel at the floating islands of Cloud City, take a train ride through Futuropolis, find the treasure outside the pirate fortress, explore the medieval castle, and search for the genie in the Orient! Turn by turn, you’ll tap to predict which colored balls will roll out of the big mill. Use the colors to fill in the white areas of your pictures. Only by predicting wisely, choosing specific areas to color, and skillfully using special effects can you collect more coins than your opponents and paint your way to victory!
The word game where you have to think fast!
Be the first to come up with a word that matches both the letter tiles on the table and the question being read aloud to score points. Flip the hourglass, and let the game begin!
Age: 14+
Time: 10+ min
Players: 2+
Contents:
200 trivia questions
60 letter tiles
1 hourglass
1 rulesheet
GAME OBJECTIVE
Be the first to shout a word that matches the letter tile on the table and the card being read!

September 2076: Why hasn’t a signal been sent from the Mars Base Alpha for years? The United Earth Government sends a rescue mission to the first settlement on Mars. The team: one to four players ages ten and up. The astronauts have special abilities that must be used during the missions. Step into exciting roles in this analog PC adventure and experience the story for yourself. Search for objects, combine them, and solve puzzles: Many challenges await over 100 million kilometers away. The thrilling sci-fi story is fully audible with the free Kosmos Explanation App.

In STADT LAND VOLLPFOSTEN Countdown, every second counts: Find as many terms as possible for a given category in one minute. But watch out—the sand of time keeps trickling away unseen! Will you stop early, or will you risk it all and use up every last second?
Zutaten sammeln, Gerichte zubereiten, Rivalen das Rezept versauen

PapaDrino hat die seltsamsten Charaktere Südamerikas an den Tisch geladen: Patricia & Avocaldo, Lima Kahlo, Onion Musk, Tomathor und Ají Styles. Alle mit einem Ziel – die köstlichste Guacamole zu zaubern. Aber natürlich nicht, ohne dabei ordentlich Chaos anzurichten.

In Guacamole sammelst du Zutatenkarten und kombinierst sie zu Gerichten: gleiche Charaktere, gleiche Zahlen oder eine Zahlenfolge. Klingt entspannt? Ist es nicht. Jede Zutat hat eine Fähigkeit – und die sorgt dafür, dass Zutaten gestohlen, Gerichte sabotiert und sorgfältig aufgebaute Kombinationen im letzten Moment zunichtegemacht werden.
Das Besondere:
🥑 Zutaten sammeln, Gerichte kombinieren, Guacamole vollenden
🌶️ Mit fünf Charakteren, die alle ihre eigenen Pläne haben

Melochs Duell kombiniert die Spiele Scythe und Expeditions. Eine Fraktion verwendet die Regeln von Scythe, die zweite die Regeln von Expeditions (als Variante könnt ihr sogar auch Scythe gegen Scythe bzw. Expeditions gegen Expeditions spielen). Das Duell findet auf engem Raum statt, sodass jeder Zug entscheidend ist.

Alle Nationen und Spielertableaus aus Scythe sowie alle Mechs, Charaktere und Begleiter aus Expeditions können für Melochs Duell verwendet werden. Ebenso kann das Spielmaterial aus Melochs Duell in Scythe und Expeditions verwendet werden.
Melochs Duell ist also sowohl ein eigenständiges Spiel als auch eine Erweiterung zu den Spielen Scythe und Expeditions.

Verlegt ist ein turbulentes Legespiel, bei dem alle gleichzeitig versuchen, ihre Karten möglichst schnell in eine gemeinsame, immer größer werdende Auslage einzubauen. Wer geschickt passende Farbüberlagerungen findet und seine Karten zuerst loswird, sammelt möglichst wenige Minuspunkte und hat nach fünf Runden die besten Gewinnchancen.

Ausgehend von zwei Startkarten in der Mitte versuchen alle gleichzeitig, ihre Karten an die bestehende Auslage anzulegen. Eine Karte darf nur gelegt werden, wenn exakt zwei Felder farbgleich überdeckt werden. Dadurch wächst auf dem Tisch eine immer neue Legefläche, in die alle gleichzeitig hineinspielen. Sobald jemand nur noch fünf Karten besitzt, wird die Runde beendet und nicht abgelegte Karten werden als Minuspunkte gewertet. Nach insgesamt fünf Runden gewinnt die Person mit den wenigsten Minuspunkten.

noinoi is the first audio game console for children aged three and up, bringing fresh air to interactive gaming. The game console combines child-friendly gameplay and AI-supported storytelling in a completely new experience.

Children immerse themselves in captivating and exciting adventures with lovable characters. They not only listen actively, but also actively shape the plot. Through decisions and playful interventions, they determine and change the course of the story.

What makes noinoi so special is that with the help of AI, we manage to make every adventure completely fresh and new. Whenever children play with noinoi, they experience a new, previously undiscovered adventure.

Four different play worlds, known as ‘universes’, are planned for the market launch. Each universe features its own characters and worlds, creating a completely unique gaming experience. The ‘Nina Yaga’ starter set takes you into a fantastical fairy-tale world full of magic and adventure – together with the young witch Nina and her talking hobby horse, Horsi.

Nina Yaga is the daughter of the witch Baba Yaga. She lives with her mother in the mysterious witch house on chicken legs, but Nina is very different from her gloomy mother. Instead of black robes, she prefers to wear pink dresses and colourful hats. Instead of a broomstick, she happily rides her talking hobby horse Horsi, who has the head of a unicorn with a rainbow-coloured mane. Curious, courageous and full of adventure, Nina roams the fairy-tale world, always ready to help others.
In a distant galaxy, PuffiNova is on the brink of destruction!
A massive meteor has shattered the planet and hurled its adorable inhabitants into space. Rescue them, rebuild PuffiNova, and collect the most stars to win the game!

At the start of the game, during setup, players decide what type of game they want to play. As many decks are included as there are players. In the family game version, only the easy family decks are used. For a more challenging game mode, the number of family decks is reduced, and players may choose to add the construction deck, which brings victory point multipliers to the game, the lightning deck, which adds immediate effects, or the buddy deck, which introduces player interaction.
Hurry! Describe the terms on the card so that your fellow players can guess as many as possible correctly. How you do that is up to you. But hurry—the clock is ticking!

Who is guilty, who is innocent? As members of a jury, two to five players aged 14 and older deliver their verdict in an extraordinary criminal trial. A man died on a fishing boat while out fishing—with signs of severe injuries and evidence of strangulation. The prosecution subsequently filed charges against all crew members. Was it self-defense or murder? Over the course of three rounds, the group discusses the case, shares doubts and insights, and listens to audio recordings from the courtroom: closing arguments from the prosecution and defense, as well as questioning of witnesses, police officers, and medical examiners, provide clues. Together, the players reconstruct what happened during the man’s final hours—and ultimately reach their verdict. Interactive true-crime suspense for fans of crime podcasts and courtroom shows.

A unicorn or a pirate? Who can put together the coolest fantasy story? In this imaginative game from the creator of “Sky Team,” two players compete to create the best fantasy characters for their book. Round after round, players take turns selecting a die from the shared die pool and placing it on a fantasy creature to bring it to life. Who will be the first to complete 20 chapters or collect 7 symbols of one color and score points with the coolest fantasy creatures? The lovingly illustrated cards and plenty of interaction keep the excitement going until the very last die. For two players ages 10 and up.

A ghost, a coffee junkie, and a frog walk into a bar. The frog asks the others, "Do you know the drinks on the menu?" "I know three," booed the ghost. "Five!" croaked the frog. "Thirteen!!!" shouted Espresso Pete, his eyes twitching. The shark behind the bar leaned forward with a grin: "Well then, let's hear 'em!"

Now you might not be any wiser, but at least you know what this is all about! Pick a topic, place your bets, but don't overreach... or you'll have to deliver! Only the player with energy left at the end takes the win!
High 5 by Godot Games is a fast-paced, high-energy party and bluffing game for the whole family. Designed by Stefan Godot, it delivers ultra-quick rounds and non-stop action at the table.
Players & Duration: Built for 2 to 6 players, lasting around 15 minutes per game.
Gameplay: High-intensity party mechanics centered on risk-taking, direct interaction, and fast laughter.
The ‘Reasons to Resign’ Booster Pack makes Burnout even more ruthless and chaotic.
The 32-card Booster Pack includes:
8 Project Roadblock Cards: A brand new type of card that keeps you scrambling
8 Dual-Effect Scope Change Cards: A brand new type of card that adds a new layer of decision-making and strategy
4 Work Smart Cards: Now you can deflect attacks to other coworkers
8 Backstabbing Cards: New ways to get ahead of your coworkers
4 Company Announcement Cards: Introduces information asymmetry and new strategies like forming alliances and bluffing
The ‘Reasons to Resign’ Booster Pack was launched along with Burnout on Kickstarter in April 2026, together securing over S$126,000 (~US$100,000). It will be delivered to backers by Q1 2027.
At SPIEL Essen 2026, we will showcase the ‘Reasons to Resign’ Booster Pack and will be taking pre-orders which will be delivered by Q1 2027.

Welcome to Mountween, where nothing is quite what it seems. Here, it’s hard to tell monsters from trinkets — or peaceful folk from villains. A mystical power has created the Flipside, a twisted reflection of the world where anyone or anything that slips through a breach may emerge… changed.

Flipside is a cooperative story-driven adventure game for 1–4 players. Step into the shoes of a unique character with their own backstory, abilities, and personal quests, then explore Mountween together as a series of strange events unfolds around you.

Travel across the map, meet peculiar residents, gather useful stuff, develop your character, and embark on branching adventures where your choices and successes shape what happens next. Each scenario leads the group toward a cooperative Final Adventure — but every hero has personal goals of their own to pursue along the way.
Scenarios can unfold differently depending on your decisions, and your character continues to grow as you gain experience and unlock new abilities.
982.theme: Fantasy adventure in the twisted world of Mountween and the Flipside

description: The circus is in town! In this deck-building game, the traveling circus whisks you away to an enchanting world full of unique performers. Each round, players choose both the city where their circus will perform next and a new attraction. For each performance, they must also set a minimum number of performers, which earns points when met. Then the show begins! To do this, one to six players lay their cards end-to-end using the domino principle to form long, high-scoring chains. This tactical card game for ages 10 and up is full of wondrous and exciting twists: Who will score the most points and put on the best circus show?

Test your luck in this fast-paced dice game: Roll the dice and score as many points as possible. But watch out—if you roll the same number a second time, it’s all over! Roll boldly, play your action cards wisely, and hope the owls come to your rescue. Do you dare to keep rolling? Only those who love the thrill and don’t take too many risks at the right moment will become top players! Fun guaranteed!
NONSTOP CARDS – The modern card game with an app
If you love classic categories games, you'll love NONSTOP CARDS: a fast, funny and creative word game with letter cards, the classic categories game reinvented with an app.

Instead of reading long rules or playing the same questions over and over, you just open the app, deal the cards and go. The app guides you through the game, reads out fresh topics automatically, and keeps things moving with a timer and playful twists that bring speed, surprises and plenty of laughter to the table.
Your task: find words that match the topic and start with the letters on your cards. Think fast, get creative, come up with the right words – and you'll be the first to get rid of your cards and win.
Quick to learn, different every time

NONSTOP CARDS is perfect for anyone who doesn't want a long setup. Open the app, pick a category, deal the cards – and you're off. The game is understood in minutes and immediately sparks lively rounds, spontaneous answers and unforgettable moments.
Ideal when game night needs to get going fast – whether with friends, family, as a two-player game, on holiday, or as a quick game in between.
No two rounds are ever exactly the same
Many party and word games wear out over time because the topics repeat. NONSTOP CARDS solves exactly that problem with more than 1,750 topics and actions across five categories.

That keeps every round varied: sometimes creative, sometimes chaotic, sometimes silly, sometimes surprising. And because new content is added regularly, NONSTOP CARDS still feels fresh even after many game nights.
We'd also love to hear your ideas for new topics and actions – the best suggestions make it into the game.
5 categories for different kinds of rounds
Original – the best all-round topic mix
Party – for fun nights with friends
Family – family-friendly topics for playing together
Kids – child-appropriate topics for children aged 10 and up
Football – 260 extra topics for true football fans (available since June 2026)
So you can tailor NONSTOP CARDS to your group: relaxed with the family, wilder with friends, easier with kids, or perfectly on theme for football night.
NONSTOP CARDS suits all kinds of occasions and brings fast, easygoing entertainment to the table – which also makes it a great gift idea.
How to play

Every player gets 8 letter cards. The app calls out a topic, and everyone simultaneously looks for matching words that begin with the letters on their cards. Say a matching word, and you get to discard that card. When time runs out, the next topic is read out automatically. Playful actions add extra twists and make sure no two rounds are alike.
The goal is to get rid of all your cards as fast as possible and reach 10 points. But NONSTOP CARDS also plays wonderfully "just for fun," with no need to keep score.
Handy: there's no need to shuffle – played cards simply go back under the pile. Thanks to the double-sided letter cards, they shuffle themselves as you play, so you can keep going right away.
The role of the app in the game

NONSTOP CARDS is played with an app – but not in a way that means someone is constantly on their phone. Above all, the app takes on the practical role of game master: it reads out new topics, controls the timer and throws in playful actions along the way.

The phone or tablet just sits somewhere on the table. When time runs out, the next topic starts automatically. No one has to operate the app continuously, scan cards or hold the device. You only tap the app occasionally, mainly to pause or resume the game.
That keeps the focus on playing together, quick answers and funny moments – while the app takes care of structure, pace and variety.
What makes NONSTOP CARDS special
✓ A modern take on the classic categories-game principle, with an app
✓ Quick to explain and instantly playable (with a how-to video)
✓ 1,750+ topics and actions
✓ Five categories: Original, Party, Family, Kids & Football
✓ New Football category with 260 extra topics (since June 2026)
✓ For small and large groups of up to 8 players
✓ Plays very well with just two people
✓ The app reads out topics and guides you through the game
✓ Double-sided letter cards = never shuffle again
✓ Playable in German, English and French (more to come)
✓ Buy once and keep getting new topic and category updates
985.theme: A modern take on the classic categories word game: find words against the clock – with letter cards and an app packed with over 1,750 creative topics and actions

description: Der Kampf der Tierclans

LEDA – In der vergessenen Welt von Leda sind die großen Spezies erwacht: Katzen, Pandas, Haie, Skorpione und viele mehr. Jeder Tierclan hat seine eigene Zivilisation, Sprache und Ambitionen entwickelt. Durch ein seltsames Energienetz, das im Rhythmus der Welt pulsiert, bauen, entwickeln und bekämpfen sie sich – und versuchen, ihre Vision der Zukunft durchzusetzen. In dieser Welt, die auf Messers Schneide balanciert, ist Krieg nicht alles; List, Anpassungsfähigkeit, Gedächtnis und tiefe Verbindungen zur Natur sind die Schlüssel zum Triumph. Wer wird sich einen Namen unter den Legenden von Leda machen?

LEDA ist ein asymmetrisches Kartenspiel für zwei Spieler, in dem jeder Spieler einen Tierclan mit eigenen Regeln, Zielen und Spielweise verkörpert. Jeder Spieler beginnt mit einem 4x4-Raster aus Grundplättchen, das im Spielverlauf durch Upgrades und das Ausspielen von Clan-Karten verändert wird. In jedem Zug bestimmt das Aktionsplättchen eine Zone des Rasters, die aktiviert wird und die dort liegenden Effekte auslöst. Die Spieler müssen ihre Aktivierungen optimieren, ihre Nahrung (die Hauptressource) verwalten und ihre Engine verbessern, um die einzigartige Siegbedingung ihres Clans zu erfüllen - und dabei gleichzeitig um den militärischen Sieg wetteifern.
So wird gespielt:
Du startest mit einem 4x4-Raster, das du durch Aufwertungen und Clankarten weiterentwickelst
Ein Aktionsplättchen bestimmt, welcher Bereich deines Rasters aktiviert wird
Verwalte Nahrung als Hauptressource und baue deine Engine aus
Jeder Clan hat sein eigenes Ziel – der militärische Sieg lauert immer parallel
Das Besondere:
🐾 Asymmetrisches Duell mit eigenen Regeln pro Clan
⚡ Aktivierungssystem über das eigene Raster
⚔️ Mehrere Wege zum Sieg
NATERA ist ein strategisches Aufbau- und Erkundungsspiel, in dem intelligente Tierstämme die Ruinen der Menschheit erforschen und um die Vorherrschaft in einer neuen Welt konkurrieren.
Can you and your team escape the infamous Filipino haunted house?

In this one-of-a-kind dynamic co-operative adventure game, you and your team attempt to escape the Purple House by flipping over doors in the correct sequence. Luckily, you are able to mark the doors with red paint to remember them - but will your teammates understand your markings? And will you be able to avoid the White Lady?

Team Poker! Now in a Deluxe Edition with improved and special game components, plus all previously available expansions. It also includes a brand-new expansion—the “Dealer Button.” The notorious “The Gang” is planning a series of heists and must crack three safes before the alarm goes off three times. Perfect coordination and the right positioning within the gang are crucial. Three to ten players ages ten and up can take on this challenge and play poker cooperatively. However, they’re not allowed to discuss their hole cards. An exciting gaming experience based on the familiar principles of poker, featuring poker chips and coolly designed cards.
On the recommendation list for the 2025 Kennerspiel des Jahres award.

Prestige ist ein anspruchsvolles Worker-Placement-Spiel, in dem ihr als Schlossbesitzende Rohstoffe beschafft, Handwerker entwickelt und euer Anwesen innen wie außen zu einem beeindruckenden Rokoko-Schloss ausbaut.
Die vierte Erweiterung lässt euch die Vögel Mexikos, Mittelamerikas (inkl. Karibik) und Südamerikas entdecken.

Kolibris machen etwa ein Zehntel der Vogelarten Lateinamerikas aus und begeistern Vogelfans mit ihren schnellen Bewegungen und schillernden Federn. In dieser Erweiterung stehen sie mit einem speziellen Kartensatz im Mittelpunkt, der einen neuen Kniff zum bekannten Spielverlauf hinzufügt. Die Kolibris kommen mit ihrem ganz eigenen Material daher: einem neuen Tableau „Kolibri-Garten“, Kolibri-Auflagen für eure Spielertableaus, Kolibri-Punktetafeln und Kolibrimarkern.

Mit über 3000 Vogelarten, die in diesen artenreichen und vielfältigen Regionen beheimatet sind, gibt es aber natürlich auch jede Menge neue Vögel in dieser Erweiterung, die keine Kolibris sind, und die darauf warten, von euch in ihre bevorzugten Lebensräume gespielt zu werden.
In Viking Sheep, 2-4 players compete as Viking Sheep to become the new Jarl of the legendary flock.

Forget everything you think you know about ordinary sheep. Viking Sheep wear helmets, battle for influence, and dream of glory. The flock follows only the strongest leader, the sheep with the greatest heroic deeds and the most impressive tales to tell around the campfire.
Plan your moves wisely, earn the flock's influence, and outsmart your rivals. In the end, only one Viking Sheep can be crowned Jarl.

The Friendgrad metro grand opening is here! The celebration must go according to plan, so the K9 Secret Police is sniffing out any sign of dissent. But the Wolf Resistance has other plans — they’ve stolen compromising evidence and must deliver it before escaping the city.

Sobakistan: Land of Dogs is an asymmetric one-vs-many game of hidden movement, deduction, and secret communication. One player takes the role of the Senior Bloodhound, commanding K9 Secret Police squads and hunting the Resistance across the metro. The other players become the Liaison and the Wolves: the Liaison guides the team using carefully chosen word associations, while the Wolves secretly move from station to station, trying to deliver the evidence and escape without revealing their locations.
Will the Wolves outsmart the Secret Police and make it out of Friendgrad — or will the Senior Bloodhound track them down first?
993.theme: Based on the Sobakistan comic book universe

description: The path to becoming a dragon rider begins at Basgiath War College. In three consecutive trials, players must demonstrate strength, courage, intelligence, and balance—each challenge requires different decisions and playstyles. After the trials, Impression tokens are distributed, which ultimately determine the dragon bond, as each dragon responds to different traits. Special dragon dice add excitement and unpredictable twists. Only those who excel in the trials will win a dragon’s trust and be chosen. An atmospheric fan game based on the “Flammengeküsst” New Adult book series for two to four players ages eight and up.

Das beliebte Kartenspiel in einer neuen Dimension. Nach dem erfolgreichen Kartenspiel geht es jetzt auf den Spielplan! Gemeinsam legt ihr eure Plättchen, um die abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben zu erfüllen. Doch der Platz wird schnell knapp – also heißt es: clever sta peln und in die Höhe bauen! Schade nur, dass ihr nicht über eure Plättchen sprechen dürft… Da hilft nur gutes Teamwork und ein bisschen Mut zur Lücke, bevor euch die Plättchen ausgehen. Könnt ihr aufeinander bauen?
Battle across the Solar System through a branching narrative campaign in this deck-building game for 2 or 4 players.

Asteroid belt – RareMetal Ventures mining facility, 2205 CE. For five years, conflict between the Lunar Frontier Authority and a resistance movement known as the Breakers has destroyed peace across the solar system. Their war has drawn in the Galilean Federation, and now threatens settlements and bases on Mars, the Moon, and even on Earth. The epic battle is about to begin: it's time to choose your side.

Decide the fate of our solar system in Undaunted 2200: Revolution, a standalone deck-building game. Play through branching, four-scenario-long narrative arcs, or pick up any of the 15 scenarios for a quick battle. Master the skies and control the planet surface, in this innovative integration of aerial and ground combat. Varied terrain types affect line of sight and manoeuvrability, offering both challenges and opportunities.
Arm your mechs and launch your fighters. It's time to finish this.
Ages: 14+
Players: 2/4
Playing Time: 45-60 minutes
Contents: 3 double-sided boards, 15 map tiles, 120+ playing cards, 50+ tokens, 4 dice, 3 rulebooks, 30 narrative cards

Das geniale Spiel mit Suchtfaktor bekommt zum 10-jährigen Jubiläum „NOCH MAL!®“ Nachschub! Wer schafft es zuerst seine 10 Chips loszuwerden? Dies ist über das bewährte vervollständigen von Spalten und Zeilen möglich. Aber auch über ganz neue Bereiche sowie die innovative Pass-Leiste. „NOCH X-MAL!®“ bleibt in den Grundregeln einfach wie das Original, aber bietet viel Neues zum Entdecken. Für alle „NOCH MAL!®“-Fans ein absolutes MUSS

Langeweile auf dem Bauernhof? Fehlanzeige bei dieser Schweine-Matsch-Party. Hier geht es hoch her und alle haben matschmäßigen Spaß. Mit Karten bewegt ihr eure Schweine über den Spielplan und sammelt Matschklumpen. Je mehr Matsch, desto dreckiger werden die Schweine – und desto schneller füllt ihr eure Sammelplättchen. Ein gekonnter Sprung von der Planke bringt euch besonders viele Matschklumpen ein, aber auch die anderen können davon profitieren. Wer alle eigenen Sammelplättchen zuerst füllt, gewinnt
Aus der beliebten Zeichentrickserie wird ein actionreiches Wettrennen um Futter: Füllt eure Vorräte, bevor Grizzy die Oberhand gewinnt und der Ranger eurem Abenteuer ein Ende setzt!

Ihr teilt die Würfel unter euch auf und jagt mit euren Lemmingen über das Spielfeld, um Futter zu ergattern. Bonusfelder bringen Extra-Tempo: Hier dürft ihr noch einmal spielen oder euch sofort Futter für euren Vorrat sichern. Doch Vorsicht – der letzte Würfel gehört Grizzy! Je nach gezogener Karte schnappt er sich seinen Weg näher an eure Lemminge heran, und wer ihm nicht schnell genug entkommt, verliert einen Teil seines mühsam gesammelten Futters.
Ist euer Vorrat gefüllt, könnt ihr euren Team-Kollegen unter die Arme greifen, damit ihr am Ende alle gemeinsam triumphiert – bevor der Ranger auftaucht und der wilden Verfolgungsjagd ein Ende setzt.
Das Besondere:
🐻 Kooperatives Kinderspiel mit dem Bären Grizzy und seinen frechen Lemmingen
🎲 Würfel geschickt verteilen und flitzen, bevor Grizzy zuschnappt
🎯 Verschiedene Schwierigkeitsstufen für jedes Alter
🤝 Zusammenarbeit ist der Schlüssel zum gemeinsamen Sieg

Every night, the fluffy Kringels wake up in the house and start doing their daily chores: gathering dust, collecting fluff and nibbling on crumbs. But recently, a serious threat has emerged: a machine that wreaks havoc every night, collecting the precious dust with a soft hum and beep. There is only one solution: a clan of Kringels must be elected to stand in the monster’s way. Will you gather enough supporters and votes to win the election?

Kleine Clans is a unique blend of a deck-building and a flip-and-write game, in which you must skilfully expand and manipulate your deck to unlock the best combinations and effects on your sheets. And so, hopefully, you’ll fulfil the most requests and secure the most votes for your own little clan.

You are space enthusiast and artist, looking through your telescope at the universe and drawing what you see as a mural on your wall. You take photos, trace constellations, observe rocket launches, and journal every experience along the way to craft your beautiful artwork.

In Star Gazers, you select tiles and tokens from the universe board that represent a collection of different observations you make through your telescope. Those tiles and tokens are then placed into your mural to create different connection points and features to score a variety of drafted objectives. Create the most beautiful and well-designed mural to celebrate your love of the cosmos!
KIN-SOKU-CHI: a forbidden land, cursed since ancient times. No place for the living. And yet, here you are.

Your only way out is to visit each sacred site and make the offerings in precisely the right order. But every attempt must be made alone. One player ventures in while the others close their eyes, and anyone who gets the order wrong is struck down.
