The fallen have ten seconds to scrawl a message with their weaker hand, then stay silent while the survivors work it out. No explanations. Just the note.

Kinsokuchi is a cooperative deduction game built on two distinct challenges: the logic of cracking the correct sequence, and the human intuition needed to decode what your teammates were trying to say. When an unreadable scrawl suddenly unlocks everything, the table erupts.
A rich, dramatic experience for family who want more than just a casual game night.
Eiskalte Kombos, clevere Nutzung fremder Würfel und ein spannender Wettlauf um den perfekten Eisbecher.
Whoa — look at all these treats! Quick, squirrels, grab your rakes and rake up your snacks before someone else gets their paws on them!

Sweepers is a fast-paced game of observation, precision, and dexterity where everyone plays at once. Reveal the top card from your deck, find the Stash token that matches both the treat and background color, and use your rake to carefully sweep it off your side of the meadow. Then reveal your next card and keep going — the first player to correctly collect all seven treats wins!

Be quick, but be careful: knock the wrong token off the meadow or grab the wrong treat, and you'll lose precious time fixing your mistake. For a different challenge, switch to Quick Paws, a cooperative mode where everyone works together to collect all their treats before the 90-second timer runs out.

During the War of the Ring, the strongholds of the Free Peoples faced their darkest hour, under assault by the relentless armies of the Shadow. Siege towers advanced against mighty walls; catapults battered the defenders day after day. Yet these assaults – those that took place, and those that might have – were decided not only by swords and engines of war, but by the endurance and courage of the brave souls standing against overwhelming odds.

Sieges Of Middle-Earth is the fourth expansion for the War of The Ring: Second Edition board game, focusing on the siege battles against the main strongholds of the Free Peoples. New game mechanisms bring those desperate battles to the forefront of the conflict: the Shadow player can field powerful siege engines to smash fortifications and spread despair among the defenders, while the Free Peoples player may attempt heroic feats, lead bold sorties, and inspire last stands that can turn the tide of battle.
New components include plastic figures, special dice, tokens, and cards to add to the core game, expanding the strategic options of both players and enhancing storytelling possibilities.
1005.theme: Lord of the Rings, Middle-earth, Tolkien

expands.name: War of the Ring: Second Edition

description: Compete for glory in the ultimate crab claw-down. Seize control of arenas, forge alliances, backstab combatants, and unleash your rage to win.

Every year, millions of salivating crustaceans from all over the world tune in for the wildest showdown on the planet! Five of the most legendary CRAB RAGE! teams will compete for the ultimate crown of decapod glory: THE GOLDEN CLAW.

CRAB RAGE! is a quick, cut-throat, zany area control game. Use your pent-up rage to perform devastating actions and execute stylish signature moves. Build, break, and leverage alliances in a fierce tug-of-war for control. Keep the action fresh and the crowd hyped to become the most adored crab crew this side of the archipelago.
Snip snap. It's rage time!
Players: 3-5
Ages: 14+
Playing time: 30-45 minutes
Contents: 20+ dice, 16 cards, 4 arena tiles, 5 team boards, 100+ tokens, rulebook

How well do you really know each other? This card game from the popular VOLL VERSCHÄTZT series puts you to the test! Countless combinations of categories and questions make for surprising guessing fun.

Die 1608 von Samuel de Champlain gegründete Stadt Québec ist zweifellos eine der historisch bedeutendsten Städte Nordamerikas. Im Laufe ihrer über vierhundertjährigen Geschichte wurde ihr Schicksal von jenen menschlichen Bestrebungen gelenkt, die das Fundament der westlichen Welt bilden. Ob Religion oder Politik, Wirtschaft oder Kultur. All diese Bereiche haben die Entwicklung der Stadt, die heute zum UNESCO-Weltkulturerbe gehört, entscheidend geprägt.

In Québec seid ihr für die Entwicklung und den Ausbau der Stadt verantwortlich. In jedem der vier Jahrhunderte ringt ihr um die Mehrheit in den fünf Einflusszonen Zitadelle, Religion, Politik, Wirtschaft und Kultur . Dazu eröffnet ihr mit eurem Architekten neue Baustellen und entsendet Arbeiter, um den Bau dieser Gebäude voranzutreiben. Entsendet ihr Arbeiter zu einer Baustelle eines fremden Architekten, dürft ihr zusätzliche die Aktion des zugehörigen Bezirks nutzen, steigert damit jedoch den Wert dieses fremden Gebäudes. Hier gilt es stets zwischen kurzfristigen Vorteilen und langfristiger Strategie abzuwägen. Bei Fertigstellung eines Gebäudes, werden die Arbeiter von dort auf das Einflussrondell versetzt.

Am Ende jedes Jahrhunderts erhaltet ihr Siegpunkte für eure Arbeiter in den 5 Zonen des Einflussrondells. Dann findet eine „kaskadierende“ Wertung statt: Wer in einer Zone die Mehrheit hat, verschiebt die Hälfte der eigenen Arbeiter in die nächste Zone. Dies ermöglicht, dieselben Arbeiter mehrfach zu werten, was zu einer mächtigen Punktekaskade führen kann.
Québec hat
Hohe strategische Tiefe bei schlanken Regeln
Einfache Mechaniken erzeugen komplexe Entscheidungsprozesse, ohne die Personen zu überfordern.
Hohe Interaktion ohne direkten Konflikt
Der Wettbewerb um Aktionen und Mehrheiten in Bereichen sorgt dafür, dass alle während des gesamten Spiels eingebunden bleiben.
Mehrere aufeinander aufbauende Wertungsphasen
Wiederholte Wertungen belohnen Anpassungsfähigkeit und langfristige strategische Planung statt Optimierung im letzten Zug.
Ausgewogene Risiko–Belohnungs-Ökonomie
Ein zu starker Einsatz von Ressourcen kann sehr starke Aktionen sichern, schränkt jedoch die zukünftige Flexibilität ein.
In Tea & Rum, strive for victory by serving the Crown or by becoming the greatest King of Pirates!
Within 5 rounds, upgrade your resources and carefully place and un-place your workers to fulfill your ambitions.

Will you prove your allegiance to the Crown, or will you join the rebellion and rule the seas? Be careful to keep your intentions hidden: angering the Crown or the people could compromize your chances.
At the end of the game, only two players will win the game… and two will be defeated.

Manila, 1821. A seemingly ordinary wooden boat arrives at the pier. As merchants, we must secretly load precious silk and ginseng, navigating through rough waves and avoiding pirates to reach the harbor safely. Welcome to a thrilling world of high stakes, where you either make a fortune or lose everything—there is no in-between.

Inside the Box :Game Board, 3 Boats, 20 Accomplice Markers, 20 Share Cards(44 x 67mm), Commodity Cargo Tiles, Dice, Price Track Tokens, Coins (1 Peso: 22, 2 Pesos: 18, 5 Pesos: 16, 10 Pesos: 15, 20 Pesos: 9)

Die Welt ist aus den Fugen geraten: Eine Hiobsbotschaft jagt die nächste und gemäß selbst ernannter Zukunftsexperten steht der Homo sapiens sapiens kurz vor dem Aussterben. Da bleibt nur die Flucht – entweder mit Musk auf den Mars, dank psychoaktiven Substanzen ins Nirwana oder mit dieser Erweiterung in den schwarzen Humor.

Take turns placing fence tiles one by one to expand your territory. The only rule is that the touching points between tiles must match in color. Close off the fence and occupy the empty area before your opponent does. Naturally, the player who claims the most territory wins the game!
Inside the Box : 60 fence tiles, 21 area markers
Central Europe, around 1670 A.D.
The Plague which has raged for centuries has finally been overcome.

The civilized world is revitalized. People are upgrading and extending their simple Wooden Houses. Fields must be plowed, sowed, and harvested. People are living off millet Grain, Bread, and Vegetables. The famine of the previous years has also encouraged them to eat more meat (a habit that we continue to this day as our wealth is growing).
In the end, the wealthiest player wins. Interestingly enough, animals that you do not eat contribute to your wealth.

Each player tries to collect as many cards as possible in two colors and to avoid the cards in the other two colors. Only cards in two of the colors will be counted towards the score. The player who plays the highest card in the leading suit has first choice when a trick is split, while the player who played the lowest card in another suit takes the rest. The two winners of a trick share the cards, but it is naturally an advantage to have first choice and leave the wrong colors to the second player.
Inside the Box : 84 cards (56 x 87mm)
Can't Win!
Bid your tricks — then choose which cards you can't win with.

Can't Win! is a bidding trick-taking game with a devilish twist. At the start of every round, you look at your hand and predict exactly how many tricks you will take — and then you choose your own "Can't Win" rule: a constraint that decides which cards cannot win a trick for you this round.

That choice is a double-edged sword. Lock away the right cards and your hand becomes easy to control; pick wrong and a perfectly planned bid falls apart. The core is instantly familiar to any trick-taking fan — must-follow, trumps, 48 cards — but the constraint turns every hand into a fresh puzzle of hand-reading and self-restraint. You score for the tricks you win and for hitting your bid, and at the end of the game the two totals are multiplied, so neither can be neglected. A beginner variant with support tokens makes the first game easy to learn.

Designed by Taiki Shinzawa (luz, Maskmen), one of Japan's most inventive trick-taking designers, and illustrated in charming 16-bit dungeon-crawl pixel art by Sai Beppu (Nokosu Dice, Ghost Lift). The new title from Engames, publisher of Nokosu Dice and Ghost Lift.
1017.theme: Self-imposed challenges in retro video games

description: The battle of Moytura has begun. As a leader of the Tuatha Dé Danann, spread your influence across the land to succeed in your quest to become High Ruler of Ireland, invoking the powerful deities of the Tuatha Dé Danann to aid you in your cause with their command of water, travel, war, and creation — but the road will not be easy for in your path to legend stand the sinister Fomorians and other mythical beings hungry for battle, not to mention a rival clan with ambitions of their own. Steel yourself and prepare for a legendary struggle. Rewrite the myths of Ireland, chieftain, and take your place as the true High King!

In Moytura, you and your opponent command competing factions of the Tuatha Dé Danann, but you are not the only ones struggling for control of ancient Ireland. Three enemy clans act together as a third opponent faction that competes with the players and scores points. Points are gained by having the most influence across Ancient Ireland at the end of each era. Within each of the eleven regions, the faction with the most or second most units across all the spaces of a region will score the indicated points. After two eras, the faction with the most points wins.

Each round, the two players and the enemy faction each take a turn. On their turn, a player selects a deity tile (possibly spending worship tokens to reach it), then performs that deity's actions. When used, a deity tile resets to the most expensive position in the track. Deity tiles let players expand their influence and battle enemies according to the deity's unique abilities On the enemy faction's turn, an activation card is revealed from the deck that expands one of the three clans. Some activation cards are stronger than others, and players must carefully track which clans are most likely to attack and where. Only the player who cleverly outmaneuvers their opponent while carefully keeping the enemy faction in check will be able to secure the victory.

Moytura features seven map set-ups for any combination of clans. The game also includes three special enemy clans that replace 1-3 of the standard Fomorian clans. These special clans introduce more challenging foes with asymmetric abilities: the Ellén Trechends (three-headed beasts) expand in all directions, the Oilliphéist (sea serpents) expand rapidly along the coast, and the Banshees invade targeted regions instead of spreading out from their largest group.

You can also enjoy a solo / cooperative variant if you prefer playing that way! Thanks to the intuitive enemy faction system built into the main game, Moytura lends itself easily to these optional variants.
THIS GAME BY FROSTED GAMES IS ONLY AVAILABLE IN GERMAN LANGUAGE. For other language versions, please check the APP for availabilty at SPIEL26.

Hoplomachus: Victorum ist ein Solo-Strategiespiel ab 14 Jahren von Adam Carlson, Josh J. Carlson und Logan Glannini. Als Champion zieht ihr durch eine antike Fantasy-Welt, stellt euch Prüfungen und kämpft euch durch eine Kampagne zu einem von acht mächtigen Endgegnern. Taktische Kämpfe auf Hexfeldern bilden den Kern: Positionierung, Timing und der Einsatz individueller Fähigkeiten entscheiden über Sieg und Niederlage. Die Kampagne verläuft über vier Akte und erlaubt es, den Champion weiterzuentwickeln und Entscheidungen mit Auswirkungen auf die Reise zu treffen.

The city of Berlin is looking for the best architect to optimize its transport network. Develop your different lines by making the best use of your interchanges. Connect the two sides of the city by linking your lines together to accumulate as many points as possible!

As you solve puzzles while enjoying beautiful scenery, your very own calendar comes together. Discover stunning views from cities around the world! A daily puzzle game where a new challenge awaits every day.
Inside the Box : 1 frame, 12 building blocks from various cities

Du bist ein Führer der Traumwege und hast die Aufgabe, den geflügelten Bären des wilden Waldes, den verwurzelten Axolotl des unruhigen Flusses und die Wolkengans des hohen Nebels zurück in ihre Gebiete zu bringen.

Indem du die Kräfte der Geistwesen zu harmonischen Zusammenkünften verwebst, stellst du ihre Verbindung zu den Lebensräumen wieder her. Doch nur der Führer, der Circadia am meisten ins Gleichgewicht bringt, wird als Hüter des ewigen Kreislaufs in Erinnerung bleiben.

Circadia ist ein taktisches Kartenspiel, in dem die Spieler als Führer der Traumwege Geistwesen (Bär, Axolotl und Gans) sammeln und zu passenden Lebensräumen zurückführen. Dazu spielen sie Geistwesen-Karten in bis zu drei Sets aus, erweitern diese mit aufsteigenden Werten und lösen mit fertigen Sets Habitat-Karten aus. Jede Habitat-Karte bringt Gleichgewichtspunkte – sobald ein Spieler 15 Punkte erreicht, endet die Partie nach einer letzten Runde, und wer dann die meisten Punkte hat, gewinnt.

Mystling Academy throws you into the fray! Experience fast-paced duels and become the champion of the arena. Inside the box, you will find two Mystlings that will introduce you to the enchanting world of the Dragon Eclipse. This Starting set is Mid Difficulty level. You can mix with other Mystlings.

Galileo’s Truth is a competitive euro game from 1 to 4 players by Virginio Gigli and Flaminia Brasini. As scholars in the dawn of modern science, observe the sky, write persuasive treatises, and build inventions to reshape the future. The game features worker placement, deck building, and resource management. Pursuing knowledge may cost your freedom, even your life, but the stars remain silent without it.
1024.theme: Galileo’s Truth is set in early 17th-century, amid the clash between emerging scientific discovery and the dogmatic authority of the Catholic Church

Das Vermächtnis der Ahnen ist eine Kampagnen-Erweiterung für Earthborne Rangers und führt die Geschichte in eine unterirdische Welt. Eine neue Karte der Arkologie ersetzt die reguläre Tal-Karte und teilt die Unterwelt in mehrere Tiefenabschnitte. Mechanische Hindernisse wie Überflutungen und Überwucherungen versperren Wege, die Dunkelheit wird zum Gegenspieler und Licht eröffnet neue Möglichkeiten. Neue Pfad-, Orts-, Belohnungs-, Wetter- und Missionskarten erweitern die Kampagne. Die Erweiterung kann an die bestehende Geschichte angeschlossen oder als neue Kampagne begonnen werden.
Wer bringt seine Capybara Herde als Erste zum großen Badeteich?

Bei Capybara Run & Fun schickt ihr eure Capybaras auf ein turbulentes Rennen rund um den Teich. Euer Ziel ist es, mit der gesamten eigenen Herde einmal die Rennstrecke zu umrunden und anschließend den sicheren Weg in den Badeteich zu erreichen. Doch eure Mitspieler haben natürlich genau dasselbe vor.

In eurem Zug würfelt ihr und entscheidet, welches Capybara ihr bewegt. Trefft ihr unterwegs auf ein Capybara aus eurer eigenen Herde, könnt ihr die Figuren aufeinanderstapeln und gemeinsam als Gruppe weiterziehen. Dabei können Gruppen aus zwei, drei oder sogar vier Capybaras entstehen. Ihr könnt eure Gruppe später auch wieder aufteilen und die gewürfelten Schritte auf mehrere Capybaras verteilen.

Besonders spannend wird es, wenn sich verschiedene Herden auf der Rennstrecke begegnen: Landet ihr auf einem gegnerischen Capybara und seid stark genug, könnt ihr es von seinem Platz vertreiben. Das arme Capybara muss zurück in seinen Tümpel und seine Reise noch einmal von vorne beginnen. So kann sich das Rennen jederzeit komplett drehen.

Zum Glück gibt es auch eine kleine Verschnaufpause. Auf den Mandarinenfeldern dürfen sich eure Capybaras ausruhen und können dort nicht von anderen Herden vertrieben werden. Wer eine 6 würfelt, kann außerdem ein weiteres Capybara aus dem Tümpel ins Rennen schicken und ist anschließend direkt noch einmal am Zug.

Nach einer vollständigen Runde geht es für eure Capybaras auf den letzten Weg zum Badeteich. Hier müssen sie einzeln und mit der passenden Würfelzahl ins Ziel gebracht werden. Sobald eure gesamte Herde den Weg zum Teich erreicht hat, habt ihr das Rennen gewonnen!

Capybara Run & Fun verbindet einen leicht verständlichen Würfelmechanismus mit überraschend vielen taktischen Entscheidungen. Stapelt eure Herde geschickt, entscheidet im richtigen Moment zwischen Angriff und Vorsprung und versucht, euren Mitspielern immer eine Capybara Nasenlänge voraus zu sein.
Game night with friends should never feel repetitive.

If your usual game night with friends has turned into the same old card games, Disaster Draft is here to fix that. This party card game turns every round into debates, bad decisions, and the kind of laughter that makes everyone beg for “just one more round.”
Assemble your squad. Get judged. Regret everything.
Disaster Draft makes game night with friends fun again!

No complicated rules, no hour-long setup, and no one needs to pretend they understand the instructions. It’s built for simple, replay-able fun that gets people talking, laughing, and debating over the world’s worst survival plans.
You and your friends build the weirdest dream teams imaginable. Superheroes, memes, horror villains, historical figures, celebrities, and yes, even your grandma if that's your thing.
Throw them into ridiculous disaster scenarios and let our custom-built AI Judge, J.A.N.E.T. (Judgment and Analysis Nexus for Evaluating Teams), roast your choices and decide your fate.
You don’t really win. J.A.N.E.T. just decides who loses the least.
Whether it’s family, your partner, or your most chaotic group chat, Disaster Draft makes every game night with friends feel fresh, hilarious, and impossible to end after just one round.
How It Works
Play with physical cards
Face ridiculous disaster scenarios and test your luck.
Submit your team through the AI interface
Draft anyone, real or fictional, and try to outwit your opponents.
Get judged instantly by J.A.N.E.T.

100 Scenario Cards
1 J.A.N.E.T. Interface Code (QR + Game Code)
Game Specs
2–8 Players
Ages 8+
15–45 Minutes per game (Multi-round game play)
1 device per player
Internet required
No subscription fee
HEEEEELLLLpppp!
Wombat Tower is under attack!
There’s not a minute to lose – grab whatever you can and fight off the attackers!
Look, roll…
and fight them off!
Goal of the game
Play as a team to fight off all the attackers.
If the game board has no monsters left on it, the players win!
In POPOPOP, players compete to win the discs placed in the center of the table.
On their turn, players flick one of their dice, trying to land it on a disc—or dislodge an opponent's die off its target!

If a die lands on a disc showing its "Instant Win" face, that disc is claimed immediately. And if two of a player's dice show the same face, they must shout "POPOPOP!!!" to retrieve one of their dice.
The game ends as soon as a player has collected 4 discs.
The "dexterity element" is balanced by the unpredictable roll of dice, making POPOPOP accessible and enjoyable for players of all ages and skill levels.
An optional variant introduces rule changes during the game, for more tension and unexpected twists.
A team-play variant brings an extra layer of strategy to the game, for players looking for a deeper challenge.

Five mice work as a team to race toward the tasty Gouda cheese. Throw your dice. A green face lets you move a mouse forward, a red face backward, and a yellow face has no effect. Simple, But nothing is ever easy. In Gouda! Gouda!, other players can move your mice, too! Can you manage to get the most cheese?
Inside the Box : 1 singLe board, 5 player markers, 5 custom dice, 6 cheese tiles, 25 wooden mice, 1 wooden cat

When midnight strikes, the monsters come hungry! In Monster Munch: Midnight Madness, 2–4 players run paranormal food trucks, scavenge strange ingredients, and craft outrageous dishes to satisfy every creature’s cravings. Upgrade your kitchen, unleash clever combos, and become the midnight market’s top chef—all in 30–45 deliciously chaotic minutes.
1032.theme: A whimsical midnight food-truck market where paranormal chefs serve bizarre dishes to hungry monsters.

description: ROAD RAGE ist ein chaotisches Kartenspiel, bei dem es nicht ums Ankommen geht – sondern darum, sich über alles und jeden so richtig aufzuregen.
Wer schafft es, auf der Straße komplett auszurasten, ohne sich von Snacks, Pillen oder einer netten Beifahrerin beruhigen zu lassen?
SPIELZIEL
Über 6 Runden sammelst du so viele Wutpunkte wie möglich. Wer am Ende die meisten Wutpunkte hat, gewinnt.
SO FUNKTIONIERT‘S

Alle Fahrer decken gleichzeitig Karten von ihrem Kartenstapel auf. Du entscheidest selbst, wenn du keine weiteren Karten mehr aufdecken willst. Falls sich zwei Entspannungskarten in deiner Auslage befinden, bist du tiefenentspannt und kriegst keine Wutpunkte.
INHALT
• 1 Spielanleitung und 1 Wertungsblock
• 6 Übersichtskarten
• 147 Spielkarten

In 19th-century North America, players take on the roles of wealthy entrepreneurs investing in the dawn of the railway industry. As each company’s rail network expands to reach the remote corners of the continent, players seek to maximize their profits by purchasing shares. Experience an economic game that combines simple rules with profound strategic depth.
Inside the Box : 30 share cards(44 x 67 mm), 41 city cards(44 x 67 mm), paper money(44 x 67 mm), 10 company tokens, starting player marker

The alien invasion has begun, and humans are in a rush to escape Earth before it’s too late! The only problem is that aliens are disguised as humans! Our only hope is to weed out the aliens via the power of … multiple choice questions!

While the aliens know how to blend in and look like us, they don’t quite understand human culture. These questions are carefully crafted to help expose the space invaders. All you have to do is answer like any normal human would. It’s that easy! It’s only the fate of humanity at stake … Don’t sweat it!

In Totally Human, players are given hidden identities (human or alien) and must answer three multiple-choice questions as "human-like" as possible, but aliens don't understand human culture completely and face restrictions on how they can respond.
The humans’ goal is to escape on the biggest alien-free rocket to form a new colony out in the stars.
The aliens’ goal is to blend in and sneak onto any rocket with humans for a tasty, post-invasion snack.
Both aliens and humans can achieve their goals on different rockets, but it's also possible that nobody wins. Be careful who you trust!
We’re building the tallest pizza tower in the world! Stack one pizza slice at a time using the pizza saver. Whoever topples the tower loses — and the previous player wins!
Inside the Box : 8 Pizzas, Pizza Savers
THIS GAME BY FROSTED GAMES IS ONLY AVAILABLE IN GERMAN LANGUAGE. For other language versions, please check the APP for availabilty at SPIEL26.

Horologium – Die Orloj von Prag ist ein anspruchsvolles Expertenspiel von Abraham Sanchez Hermida und Paloma J. Pascual für 1 bis 4 Personen ab 14 Jahren. Als mittelalterliche Baumeister arbeitet ihr an der Fertigstellung des Kalendariums der Prager astronomischen Uhr und verwaltet dabei Ressourcen und Apostel-Figuren. Im Mittelpunkt steht ein dynamisches Rondell in Form zweier Zifferblätter. Die beiden Scheiben können in entgegengesetzte Richtungen gedreht werden und verändern dadurch verfügbare Aktionen und Boni. Wer Aktionen zeitlich geschickt plant, Ressourcen effizient einsetzt und die Pläne der Mitspielenden berücksichtigt, kann das komplexe System meistern.

In Mythologies führt jeder Spieler eine junge Stadt, deren Glaube von den großen Mythologien der Welt geprägt wird. Aus den Legenden verschiedener Kulturen ruft ihr mächtige Gottheiten und sagenhafte Kreaturen an, um euer eigenes Pantheon zu formen und ihre Gunst zu gewinnen.

Doch nicht nur die Wahl der Wesen zählt, sondern auch ihr Platz im Pantheon. Zwischen himmlischer, irdischer und Abgrundebene entstehen mächtige Kombinationen, Opfer und Prüfungen. Nur wer die richtigen Wesen im richtigen Moment auswählt und klug im eigenen Tableau einsetzt, wird am Ende die meiste Gunst erringen.
Mythologies ist ein taktisches Familienspiel rund um den Aufbau eines eigenen Pantheons. Die Spieler über-

nehmen die Rolle junger Städte, deren Glaube von den Mythologien großer Weltzivilisationen geprägt wird. Aus einem gemeinsamen Heiligtum draften sie Gottheiten und legendäre Kreaturen, platzieren sie im eigenen Pantheon und sammeln über clevere Effekte, Edelsteine und Gunst.

Besonders reizvoll ist die Kombination aus offener Kartenauswahl, Positionierung und Timing: Je nachdem, in welcher Ebene (Reihe) oder Spalte eine Karte ins Pantheon gelegt wird, verändert sich ihre Belohnung und ihr Zusammenspiel mit den übrigen Karten. Nach vier Runden gewinnt, wer die meiste Gunst der Mythologien auf sich vereinen konnte.

Leaflings is a clever two-player strategy game where every move shapes your opponent’s next one. Place your Leaflings to create lines of three, while using their unique abilities to control where your rival can play. With simple rules, no luck and plenty of tactical twists, every tiny move can grow into a big problem for your opponent.
THIS GAME BY FROSTED GAMES IS ONLY AVAILABLE IN GERMAN LANGUAGE. For other language versions, please check the APP for availabilty at SPIEL26.

Wuselige Wiesen ist ein zugängliches und wunderschön gestaltetes Plättchenlegespiel für 2 bis 4 Personen ab 8 Jahren von Brett J. Gilbert und Trevor Benjamin. Ihr legt euren eigenen Garten an und versucht, durch cleveres Platzieren von Lebensräumen möglichst viele Bienen, Kolibris und andere Wiesenbewohner anzulocken. Pro Zug wird ein Plättchen aus der offenen Auslage gewählt und an den eigenen Garten angelegt. Zusammenhängende Landschaftsflächen bringen Tiere, zusätzliche Karten geben Muster und Kombinationen vor. Dadurch bleibt das Spiel leicht zugänglich, bietet aber durch die räumlichen Puzzle-Entscheidungen taktische Tiefe.

Ich bin Walküre, eine himmlische Jungfrau, deren Aufgabe es ist, die Seelen gefallener Krieger zu ihrem ewigen Lohn zu führen. Hoffentlich stirbt jemand, damit mein Besuch in Grimheim nicht umsonst war …

In Godins Augen ist alles eine potenzielle Zutat und alles muss ausprobiert werden, bevor man es verwirft. So sind viele seiner experimentellen Mixturen entstanden – manche berühmt, manche berüchtigt. Eines ist jedoch sicher:
Wenn man ein Schmerzmittel braucht, ist seine Brauerei immer geöffnet und seine Mixturen betäuben alles … wochenlang.
Die Erweiterung Valkyria & Godin führt 2 neue Helden ins Spiel ein.
Valkyria ist eine Walküre aus Walhalla. Sie ist eine starke Heilerin und Nahkämpferin.
Godin ist ein Meister der Tränke. Er braut sie, um seine Gefährten auf verschiedene Weise zu unterstützen: er verleiht ihnen Schnelligkeit, heilt sie, gibt ihnen unermessliche Stärke u. v m.
THIS GAME BY FROSTED GAMES IS ONLY AVAILABLE IN GERMAN LANGUAGE. For other language versions, please check the APP for availabilty at SPIEL26.

Thunder Road Vendetta: Willkommen in der Wrackedrale erweitert Thunder Road Vendetta: Maximum Chrome um einen neuen Arena-Modus. Statt nur auf einer langen Straße um den Sieg zu fahren, kämpft ihr in Arenen um Chrom und Ruhm. Gegner werden gerammt, ausgeschaltet oder durch Manöver überlistet. Hexfelder ermöglichen andere Bewegungen und bieten Extras wie Ballonplättchen und Superwaffen. Turbo Tina verändert über Gebote die Regeln der nächsten Runde.

Bei ROLLYMPICS tretet ihr in sechs verrückten Challenges gegeneinander an – in einer Olympiade mit Würfeln, bei der es gar nicht so sehr auf das Würfelglück ankommt! Stellt eure Geschicklichkeit, euer Timing und manchmal auch eure Nerven auf die Probe, sammelt Applaus und kämpft um den Sieg. Jede Challenge bringt neue Aufgaben, jede Menge Gelächter und spannende Wettkämpfe. Doch Vorsicht: Im großen Finale kann sich alles noch einmal wenden!
Mit bis zu 5 Personen erlebt ihr die spannenden Wettkämpfe. Das farbenfrohe Spielmaterial und die leichten Regeln sorgen für Spielspaß bei der ganzen Familie – und das nicht nur für Würfelfans!
Welcome to the legendary Quazarys galaxy space race!

Your mission is to reach your home base before your opponents reach theirs. Careful though: they will try to give you a bumpy ride! Be fast, clever, and ready to overcome obstacles in the emptiness of space.

Hacker Girls (Infinite Loop of Fate) is a twist-and-pull party board game. Players take on the role of cyberpunk girls, earning chips based on their offensive power in each round. When they reach four or more chips, they win. This is a deck-based game where the deck's abilities constantly change, altering the calculations. Players rely on their understanding of the deck and their hacking skills to quickly achieve victory.
Background:

In 2049, humanity has fully entered the information age. People navigate the information flows of the cyberpunk world. Many of these girls are weapons, friends, forces of darkness, means of peace, and eternally recurring fates. Breaking this fate requires sufficient computing power to break free from its shackles. Collect computing chips and escape this world!

Build 3D Spires and Defend the Elemental Realm!Where cooperative strategy rises above the table.The realm of Elementis is under siege! Elemental Aether fiends are draining the aethercore, causing chaos to reign. You and your companions must work together as heroes, building towering 3D spires by stacking floor tiles strategically above the table.
Complete all four elemental spires to unleash devastating resurgences and restore balance. But beware - if the aethercore is depleted or you take too long, chaos will overtake your world forever!
What Makes It Special:• Revolutionary 3D tile placement mechanics
• Cooperative tower defense with elemental strategy
• True vertical gameplay - strategy rises above the table
• Perfect for 1-4 players working as a team
• Innovative "3D Strategy" gaming dimension

Driving Me Crazy! Route 66 is a fast-paced family card game about the chaos of the classic road trip. Race along Route 66 toward your holiday destination while using action cards to speed yourself up, slow your rivals down, and turn their best-laid plans upside down.
Simple rules and constant player interaction keep everyone involved, while reactive cards create unexpected counters, reversals and plenty of memorable moments.
2–6 players · Ages 8+ · 15 minutes · Family card game
The Route 66 edition was nominated for the Judge’s Choice Best Variant Award at UK Games Expo 2026.
1047.theme: Driving American Road Trip - Cartoon creatures

description: Entdeckt beim Tauchen neue Fischarten mit spannenden neuen Fähigkeiten und kümmert euch um die Korallenriffe an euren Tauchstellen.

Haie & Riffe lässt euch noch tiefer in das marine Ökosystem von Flossenschlag eintauchen. Diese Erweiterung bringt neue Korallenriff-Lebensräume und weitere fantastische Haie mit furchteinflößenden neuen Fähigkeiten in eure Ozeane.
Die Haie können eure Schwärme von Jungfischen zerstreuen (die an anderer Stelle noch mehr Schwärme bilden) und hinterlassen Futterreste, die jeder Fisch in eurem Ozean verzehren kann.

Außerdem könnt ihr farbenfrohe Korallenriffe an euren Tauchstellen pflegen, wobei gesunde Riffe es euch erlauben, die neuen (und starken) Rifffische auszuspielen sowie Boni bei Fischfähigkeiten und am Ende des Spiels zu erhalten.

Bei Out of Words: Music & Movies dreht sich alles um Schauspieler, Filmtitel, Künstler und Songs. Doch einfach erklären wäre viel zu leicht: Für jeden Hinweis müsst ihr einen Buchstaben aus der Auslage wählen und genau ein Wortnennen, das mit diesem Buchstaben beginnt.

Zu Beginn wählt ihr sechs Kategorien aus – zum Beispiel Stadt, Land, Fluss, Promi, Film, Brettspiel, Songtitel oder sogar eine eigene Wunschkategorie. Danach erhält jede Person einen Stapel Buchstaben-Karten. In der Tischmitte liegt die aktuelle Kategorie bereit – noch verdeckt. Dann heißt es: „3, 2, 1, Fast Out!“

Sobald die Kategorie aufgedeckt wird, müsst ihr blitzschnell einen passenden Begriff finden, der mit dem Buchstaben eurer obersten Karte beginnt. Wer zuerst einen korrekten Begriff laut nennt, darf seine Karte in die Mitte legen – und legt damit sofort die nächste Kategorie fest. Ohne Pause geht es weiter!

Geometric Art is a drawing-driven co-op party game in which everyone take turns to draw and guess. The ultimate goal is to understand each others' artworks. However, you may finish your "Artwork" merely with limited strokes and geometric symbols.

In Geometric Art, players take turns drawing and guessing in the same round. In the beginning of each round, you will receive theme cards respectively and write down your answer at the back of your paper and hope that the player on your right, which is the guesser, understands you well. Then the rest of you will work together to finish each others' artwork within 2-3 minutes. Players will travel through Gaudí's life and work, earning Victory Points in the three pillars that shaped his works: Nature, Catalonia, and Religion. To succeed, players must keep their progress balanced, because only their two lowest VP scores among the three pillars will count toward final scoring. Points are gained by playing cards and placing 'Trencadís' tiles on their personal boards. 'Trencadís' is a Catalan word that means “a lot of little broken things”.

While playing, you’ll discover some of these intricate details depicted on the cards and experience the creative joy of arranging your own trencadís patterns on your personal board). Each pillar awards VP differently: Nature points are mainly earned through Nature cards, Catalonia points are mostly scored at the end of each round, and Religion points are primarily tallied at the end of the game.

The game unfolds over three rounds. In each round, players take turns moving around the central Chandelier on the main board, carefully choosing where to stop in order to perform key actions—drawing cards and collecting various types of Trencadís tiles. These resources are then used to play cards and progress up the Chimneys on their personal boards. Each round concludes once all players have completed a full circuit around the Chandelier. At the end of the third round, the player with the highest and most balanced combination of VP will be declared the winner!
In Ilan – Expedition ins ewige Eis erforschst du die vielfältigen Lebensformen des faszinierenden antarktischen Kontinents.

In diesem taktischen Kartenspiel gilt es, Algen und Tiere geschickt zu Nahrungsketten zu verknüpfen, um das ökologische Gleichgewicht aufrechtzuerhalten. Aber Achtung! Deine Mitspieler können ihre Ökosysteme gegen deines wenden und Organismen austauschen oder gar fressen.
So wird gespielt:
Kombiniere Tiere und Algen zu Nahrungsketten und nutze ihre einzigartigen Fähigkeiten zu deinem Vorteil. Jede deiner Entscheidungen beeinflusst das fragile Ökosystem.
Vervollständige deine Nahrungskette, bevor deine Gegner sie wieder zerstören und komme dem Ziel Schritt für Schritt näher.
Ziehe eine neue Karte und plane deine Strategie für den nächsten Zug. Der Weg zum Sieg liegt in deiner Hand!
Erlebe das dynamische Zusammenspiel der Umwelt, der Tierarten und ihren Kampf ums Überleben!
English
A hit in Japan. Now coming to the world.100% funded in just one day. ¥2.66 million raised. 266% funded.
Cat years is a cute, joyful, and bittersweet board game where you experience the entire life of a cat—from kitten to senior.
After receiving an overwhelming response with its Japanese prototype at SPIEL Essen 2025, Cat years returns in 2026 with its English & German edition—available for the first time at SPIEL Essen.
A Kickstarter campaign featuring an exclusive edition will also launch in October.
Live a whole cat’s life. One roll at a time.
Roll the dice and live the life of a cat.
The gameplay is simple:
Roll the dice, move your cat, experience the story on each space, and collect Happiness and Items along the way.
The first milk you ever tasted.
A cicada or lizard you proudly brought home for your human.
You might even fall in love in a dream.
Every space tells a story.Every space features a carefully written story from a cat’s point of view—like a scene from a picture book or novel.
These stories aren’t just background flavor. They are an essential part of the game itself. Where you land and what you experience shape a different life for every cat.
Three life stages. A game that grows with you.In Cat years, a cat’s life is divided into three life stages:
Kitten → Adult → Senior
And as your cat grows, not only the story, but the rules themselves begin to change.
As a kitten, your worried human follows behind as you explore the world without a care.
As an adult, the two of you become a perfect team and move together.
And when you become a senior, even if you roll a 6, you can only move 3 spaces. Now older, you and your human slow down and walk at the same gentle pace.
As your relationship changes, so do the rules.
Items become Memories.The Items you collect as a kitten and adult also take on a new meaning when you become a senior.
Your first milk.
A cardboard box.
A cicada caught in the garden.
Turn the cards over, and the Items you collected throughout your life become irreplaceable Memories.
They’re the same cards—but somehow, they no longer feel the same.
And as Memories, they bring you even more Happiness than they did as Items.
Simple rules. A whole life within them.Roll the dice. Move your cat. Experience the stories. Collect Happiness.
The rules are simple.
But as your cat grows older, the meaning of the game—and even the meaning of everything you experienced along the way—begins to change.
Simple rules. A whole life within them.

Please note: The video shows Japanese prototype components under the former title “Cat’s Life.” The final product title is “Cat years.”

Ein Erfolg in Japan. Jetzt kommt Cat years in die Welt.In nur einem Tag zu 100 % finanziert. 2,66 Millionen Yen gesammelt. 266 % finanziert.
Cat years ist ein niedliches, fröhliches und zugleich berührendes Brettspiel, in dem du ein ganzes Katzenleben erlebst – vom Kätzchen bis zum Senior.
Nach der überwältigenden Resonanz auf den japanischen Prototyp bei der SPIEL Essen 2025 kehrt Cat years 2026 zurück – mit der englisch-deutschen Edition, erstmals erhältlich auf der SPIEL Essen.
Im Oktober startet außerdem eine Kickstarter-Kampagne mit einer exklusiven Edition.
Erlebe ein ganzes Katzenleben. Würfel für Würfel.
Würfle und erlebe ein ganzes Katzenleben.
Das Spielprinzip ist einfach:
Würfle, ziehe deine Katze weiter, erlebe die Geschichte auf jedem Feld und sammle dabei Glück und Gegenstände.
Die erste Milch, die du je getrunken hast.
Eine Zikade oder Eidechse, die du deinem Menschen stolz nach Hause gebracht hast.
Vielleicht verliebst du dich sogar in einem Traum.
Jedes Feld erzählt eine Geschichte.Auf jedem einzelnen Feld wartet eine sorgfältig geschriebene Geschichte aus der Sicht einer Katze – wie eine Szene aus einem Bilderbuch oder Roman.
Diese Geschichten sind nicht bloß Hintergrund. Sie sind ein wesentlicher Bestandteil des Spiels. Je nachdem, wo du landest und was du erlebst, entsteht für jede Katze ein ganz eigenes Leben.
Drei Lebensphasen. Ein Spiel, das sich mit dir verändert.In Cat years ist ein Katzenleben in drei Lebensphasen unterteilt:
Kätzchen → erwachsene Katze → Senior
Und mit dem Älterwerden verändert sich nicht nur die Geschichte – auch die Spielregeln selbst verändern sich.
Als Kätzchen folgt dir dein besorgter Mensch, während du unbekümmert die Welt erkundest.
Als erwachsene Katze seid ihr ein eingespieltes Team und bewegt euch gemeinsam.
Und als Senior kannst du selbst bei einer gewürfelten 6 nur noch 3 Felder weiterziehen. Ihr seid beide älter geworden und geht nun langsam, Schritt für Schritt, gemeinsam weiter.
Eure Beziehung verändert sich – und mit ihr die Regeln.
Gegenstände werden zu Erinnerungen.Auch die Gegenstände, die du als Kätzchen und erwachsene Katze sammelst, bekommen im Seniorenalter eine neue Bedeutung.
Deine erste Milch.
Ein Pappkarton.
Eine Zikade aus dem Garten.
Drehst du die Karten um, werden die Gegenstände, die du im Laufe deines Lebens gesammelt hast, zu unersetzlichen Erinnerungen.
Es sind noch dieselben Karten – und doch fühlen sie sich plötzlich ganz anders an.
Als Erinnerungen schenken sie dir sogar noch mehr Glück als zuvor.
Einfache Regeln. Ein ganzes Leben darin.Würfeln. Deine Katze bewegen. Geschichten erleben. Glück sammeln.
Die Regeln sind einfach.
Doch je älter deine Katze wird, desto mehr verändert sich die Bedeutung des Spiels – und sogar die Bedeutung all der kleinen Erlebnisse, die hinter dir liegen.
Einfache Regeln. Ein ganzes Leben darin.

description: Ports of Call: The Board Game is based on the classic computer game from 1987 created by Rolf-Dieter Klein and Martin Ulrich.
In the board game, players compete to build and expand their own shipping empires. They do so by buying, transporting, and selling containers filled with goods across the globe.

As the game progresses, players grow their fleets, establish factories in major port cities, and produce goods for the world market, while dealing with pirates, rats, hard weather, closed harbours, and smuggling.
The winner is the player who, by the end of the game, has managed to build the most valuable shipping company.

In this strategy game, you will guide the expansion of your family's farm beyond the known boundaries of the forest. As your settlement grows, more people will gather under your banner. You will cultivate the land, build new communities, and shape the future. However, you must proceed with caution. Your expansion may unsettle the spirits that still dwell in the wilderness. The yokai are vigilant, and their mischief can hinder your plans if you fail to recognize their presence. Increase your influence, adapt your strategies, and attract the right people to your settlement to gain victory points.

In Shugendo, each player has their own personal deck of cards. During the game, you will improve your deck by replacing your weaker starting cards with more powerful settler cards. In each round, players play three phases: reveal, action, and recruitment. In the first phase, they will reveal cards until they decide to stop or until they 'explode' by revealing 7 or more yokai icons. If this happens, they can only play either the action phase or the recruitment phase. In the action phase, players increase their meters based on the revealed cards and perform one of the main actions (explore, expand, or develop). Finally, in the recruitment phase, players receive various bonuses based on the revealed cards and recruit cards from the unlocked eras.
The colorful edition of the cult game STADT LAND VOLLPFOSTEN, featuring all the colors of the rainbow.
Who are you when you’re free to play?

Are you turned on by being in control – making someone squirm and then rewarding them exactly when you feel like it? Or does that arrogant look –the way they eye you mockingly, while you know full well that they could do almost anything with you right now – excite you? Or do you love a good fight and that intense feeling when their resistance melts away?

Kinky Intentions guides you deeper into these fantasies. Experience BDSM without the clichés and without the fancy equipment, and with all the more intent. Together, you’ll discover a dynamic that fills dominance with calm and natural ease, rather than forcing it with crude harshness. Embrace unconventional erotic adventures and discover an intensity that goes far beyond the physical.
Your safe space for curiosity and desire:
37 cue cards: Guide you from negotiating your boundaries all the way to loving aftercare.
18 archetypes: Tyrant, Toy, Predator or Prey? Discover which roles appeal to you and find your favourite matches.
55 scenarios: Bring your matches to life – with exciting scenes that make your dynamic tangible.
Hourglass: Five minutes to immerse yourselves fully – without pressure to perform and without having to think about what comes next.

The first ever trick-taking deck builder. You take on the role of pirates setting out on a series of three voyages in search of treasure and citrus. Return to Tortuga to hire new crew members, purchase items for your ship including citrus reserves (you can never have too much citrus), or even increase the number of crew that can sail with you to each island increasing your chance at taking even more tricks. But beware, the threat of Scurvy! and other pirates aren't the only dangers lurking across the high seas. The islands may have active event cards for better or worse and they may even have their own mechanics that can either aid or hinder your voyages.

You are a volunteer at a bird sanctuary, cooperating to rehabilitate nervous birds by keeping them calm as they are introduced to the flock. One player is The Handler, posing their hands as necessary to receive each incoming bird and to balance the growing flock.
The rest of the crew? Easy. Draw a card, wait for the Handler's signal, and give 'em the bird. The game ends when the crew takes 3 bird droppings.

The Bird is a silly but challengin dexterity party game that uses fun plastic balancing birds from your childhood. The twist is you must push your luck, posing and reposing your hands, to balance as many birds as you can.

Winner of the Kennerspiel des Jahres, nominated for the As d’Or, the Golden Geek Awards and a top Game of the Year for many, Rebirth has become a true classic in the Mighty Boards catalogue! The game now has a brand new international edition: same game, at a more accessible price point!

Soundcheck challenges your ears—it’s not about song titles, release years, or artists! Read the categories, listen to the songs, and think outside the box—who will figure out the answer the fastest and claim the victory?

The head of the family has passed away, leaving behind a lifetime of treasured collections and real estate. As heirs to the estate, each player secretly considers how to secure the greatest possible inheritance.

Over several rounds, players compete to claim their share of the estate, but each player may claim at most 1 inheritance lot per round. At the end of the game, players score the cards they have collected. The player with the highest total score wins.
MAKE THE HANGRY PENGUIN THEIR PROBLEM.
Not This Penguin is a card game of strategy, sabotage, and bluffing. Every round, scheme, read other players, and redirect the chaos so hangry penguin ends up with the other team.
Each round is played in 3 phases:
- Phase 1 - Choose your giveaway card: pick 1 secret card to give to the player on your left. Will it be the hangry penguin?
- Phase 2 - Play penguin powers: take turns playing cards to peek, steal, swap, bounce, and mess with where the Hangry Penguin ends up.
- Phase 3 - Pass the cards - giveaway cards move left. Whoever ends up with the hangry penguin feeds it a fish or faces its wrath.
How to win: when someone who no longer has a fish ends up with the hangry penguin, they lose and the other team wins.

Carl von Linné is a strategic board game set in the early 18th century, where players take on the roles of natural historians inspired by the work of Carl Linnaeus and his contemporaries. Through exploring distant regions, collecting and researching specimens, cultivating botanical gardens, corresponding with scientific institutions, and publishing influential books, players gradually build knowledge and reputation. By carefully managing actions through a unique lens system and balancing fieldwork with scholarly study, players compete to contribute most to the emerging system of taxonomy and leave a lasting mark on the history of natural science.
2 new heroes for Fate: Defenders of Grimheim - the cooperative tower defence adventure!
Either play Godin, the druid with the strong hands and expertise in mixing magic potions for himself and his friends.
Or discover Valkyria, an angelic warrior with no patience for just waiting for fallen soldiers to bring to Valhalla…
Godin and Valkyria brings more fun and replayability to the struggle for Grimheim…

Hi there, I’m Manni, the seagull. I live in the coastal town of Nordersiel, and I need your help solving a crime. Just before Christmas is one of the most important days of the year for the seal sanctuary: the big fundraiser for the baby seals. But the well-filled donation jar has suddenly vanished without a trace. Help me find out who stole the money and where it is, so we can buy food for the seals again!

In Lords of Heaven, every choice matters. Expand cities, forge alliances, lead crusades, or betray your companions in the name of faith and dominion. Command your armies, invoke divine powers, and write your own history in a land torn between heaven and earth. Will your faction ascend to glory, or fall to ruin?

Lords of Heaven is a grand strategy board game for 2–4 players set during the time of the Crusades. Players take command of one of four rival factions, the Crusaders, Byzantines, Seljuks, or the Caliphate, each striving to dominate the Holy Land through faith, diplomacy, and warfare.

The game combines card-driven action management with layered systems of influence, development, and conflict. Each faction has unique abilities that shape its playstyle — from the wealth of Byzantium and the zeal of the Crusaders to the cunning of the Seljuks and the devotion of the Caliphate.
Lords of Heaven also includes three modular expansions: Scenarios, Fleets, and Leaders, offering historical setups, naval warfare, and legendary figures that enhance replayability and thematic depth.

Your path of vengeance has led you to Sweet Haven, Arizona. You know the necromancer who ruined your life has made the cemetery his base of operations, and you're going to stop him at all costs. You face Lord Overkill, a supernatural being, but your skill as a player goes far beyond sleight of hand. Channel your magic through poker moves to eliminate Lord Overkill's minions one by one and descend into Hell itself to duel the monster who ruined your life.

Designed by Benjamín Amorín and illustrated by David Rubín, one of Spain's most internationally renowned artists, Ace of Spades is a single-player game, or a two-player game if you prefer cooperative play, that uses poker mechanics to resolve perilous duels against the worst spawn of Hell. Set in a wild American West with demonic creatures, this game offers varying levels of difficulty and even a series of challenges to overcome, beyond simply winning.

In Ace of Spades, you'll have to defeat 12 enemies of increasing difficulty. You'll have a limited number of moves to defeat each enemy, but some of them, once defeated, will grant you powerful abilities. To win each duel, you'll have to play combinations with a classic French deck (but specially illustrated for this game) and make poker plays. A pair will inflict one point of damage, but if you manage to form a straight flush, your shot will cause 10 hits at once.

The first game designed by Benja Amorín, whom many will know as one of Devir's most recognizable faces, presents a fun and challenging experience. The production is meticulously crafted, from the magnetically closed box to the cards featuring David Rubín's unmistakable artwork. In addition, the game offers a curated soundtrack playlist that will add an epic feel to every match. Will you execute your revenge and vanquish all of Hell's minions?
Only the Mythos Division can save Arkham! Roll the dice, record your investigation and work together to seal the portals before it’s too late.

In Cthulhu Rift, players become agents of a secret Division investigating strange events across Arkham. Explore locations, confront Mythos creatures and gather the clues needed to close the dimensional rifts threatening the city. A cooperative roll-and-write adventure set in the Cthulhu Mythos, where every decision brings you closer to saving Arkham… or awakening something that should have remained hidden.

Can you figure out the right order? Solve fun challenges, reveal your answer with a “rock–paper–scissors” gesture, and mark your points on the bingo board! Easy to learn and a lot of fun to play! Includes 100 unique tasks to test your mind. Combine two IQ Bingo games to create a super 4-player version!
TURBO6 is a fast-paced dice game where every roll can turn the game around, and every card you claim brings you one step closer to victory.

Chase the perfect dice combinations, snatch valuable cards right from under your opponents’ noses, and cash them in for an extra die that can open up even more possibilities in your hunt for those all-important points.
But watch out – luck alone won’t be enough. You’ll need to think fast, choose wisely, and go for the right cards at exactly the right moment.

The balance between luck, strategy, timing, and sometimes a little patience means that no two rounds ever play out the same – and the excitement lasts right up to the final roll. Because you never know when a player might suddenly pull off the ultimate roll: a “TURBO6” – six of a kind with six dice.
Do that, and victory is instantly yours – no matter how many points anyone has collected along the way!
Snake Clash – Tile-laying fighting game
Age: 10+ | Players: 2–4 | Playtime: 25 min. | Languages: LT / EN

Snake Clash is a fast-paced tile-laying fighting game for 2 to 4 players, where strategy, cunning, and a bit of luck determine who rules the board. Each player controls a Snake, moving across the gameboard in pursuit of ancient Relics while facing off against rival Snakes. Timing, positioning, and clever tile placement are key – block your opponents, steal their Relics, or set up devastating combos to gain the upper hand.

The game ends when a player completes the Quest by collecting enough Relics and reaching the Altar, or when only one Snake remains alive. Players can enjoy a straightforward game with the basic rules, or dive into Incarnation Mode, which introduces 14 unique Snake powers. Each power gives your Snake special abilities, from sneaky movement to direct attacks, allowing for deeper strategy and unpredictable encounters.
Gameplay Highlights:
Lay tiles to create paths, block opponents, and control territory.
Engage in tense stand-offs and steal opponents’ Relics.
Use unique Snake powers in Incarnation Mode for extra strategy.
Balance risk and reward as you race to complete your Quest.
Quick, intense rounds with high replayability.
In the box you will find:
112 cardboard tiles
14 Incarnation cards (for each language)
Two-sided gameboard
2 rulebooks in LT and ENG

Snake Clash combines tactical thinking, quick decisions, and competitive fun for players who love strategy, chaos, and a bit of serpentine mischief. Will your Snake outwit the others and claim the ultimate victory?
1159.theme: Ancient Aztec mythology + giant mystical snakes + relic hunting + territorial combat

description: You take on the role of a new student at Monster Elementary during their first day. It's lunch time and you're trying to encourage other students to sit at your table. From designer Manny Vega and artist Sandara, the game is a tableau builder with a Liar's Dice variant built in, because what better way to make friends in Elementary School than gambling? You'll use your dice to pay for Snax matching what your new friend's are in search of and place them at one of the seats at your table. Once a player has filled their tableau of 8 the end game is triggered and after everyone else has been able to spend the rest of their resources, players tally up their scores.

Railway Porters is a push-your-luck dice game for 2 to 4 players. You play as a porter, placing luggage dice onto station boards, but deciding when to keep rolling and when to stop is the key. There are 6 different station boards to place your dice on, each with its own unique scoring system, so there is an abundant variety of things to enjoy. This is a family game, that is also highly recommended for people brand new to dice games.
A push-your-luck dice game about getting passengers' luggage to the platform!
Place luggage dice that match one of the dispatch dice onto your station board!
Earn tips from passengers and bonus points, too!
Be Careful! If you drop a suitcase your score will be halved!
There are 6 different station boards. Leverage the unique features of each board to score big points!
Purchase at SPIEL and receive a two-player promotional board as a bonus (while supplies last).
1161.theme: You are a railway porter in the early 20th century, moving passengers' luggage. Can you transport the most luggage to the train platform, safely, and become an adored porter by pleasing your passengers?

description: Draft one card and play one each turn, or activate the Zero Keeper. Build your resources around shared scoring conditions. Once activated, the Zero Keeper cannot be cancelled and remains active until the end of the game. During scoring, any condition where exactly one player scores zero is cancelled for everyone.
Saga: Vikings vs Anglo-Saxons is a fast-paced strategy game for 2 players built around area control and action management.
Each player takes control of one side, Vikings or Anglo-Saxons, each with unique victory conditions and strategic priorities.
At the heart of the game lies the action tile system. Each round, players select actions that will define their turn — but choices are limited, and timing is everything.
Each round is divided into four phases: selecting tiles, resolving actions, combat, and end of round.
Players will:
– move units and fight for control of regions,
– recruit and manage their forces,
– develop economy through strongholds and resources,
– use special actions to disrupt and outmaneuver the opponent.
Combat is not just about strength, it’s about preparation, hidden information, and the moment you choose to reveal your leaders’ abilities.
Vikings rely on mobility and pressure, gaining resources and pushing forward.
Anglo-Saxons build defense, manage economy, and try to withstand the invasion.
The game is quick, but every decision matters.
There is no room for mistakes. Only for better choices.

Carpet Racers is a chaotic racing game where players control cars without knowing which one is theirs. By playing movement cards, setting traps, and gathering clues, you must outmaneuver opponents while uncovering your own identity. It’s a fast-paced mix of bluffing, strategy, and clever deduction, where the real challenge isn’t just racing, but figuring out which car is yours before the finish line.
Im verwitterten Grand Hotel Arcadia soll es spuken - haben die Geister den glücklosen Clown Beppo geholt, oder wieso hat er so unvermittelt das Zeitliche gesegnet?
Die Spiritistinnen, die nebenan angeblich mit dem Jenseits kommunizieren, wollen ausgerechnet diesmal nichts gehört haben.
Kannst du den Fall als Agent der streng geheimen Organisation der Black Cats lösen?

Deep within the enchanted forest, your gnome village was flattened after a devastating troll raid. Now, you must race to forge a new home--one strong enough to withstand relentless enemies and stand above the rest. Outwit the trolls, out-build your rivals, and build the legendary town of Gnomeville!

Gnomeville is a captivating bag-building game for 1-4 players that brings a fresh twist by blending strategic tile placement, dopamine boosts from match-3 puzzles, with the tactical depth of tower defense. This is all wrapped up with a layer of press-your-luck, simultaneous bag-building play we all know and love for a uniquely magical experience.
Choose your build sites, prepare for the upcoming troll’s attack, spawn new gnomes and graduate them from academy, craft some swords and hammers, and prove that your village can withstand any attack!

Think fast and build in 3D... before time runs out! A creative building game where words turn into shapes! Build your word with the building blocks, while the others guess what you are creating. Choose the right challenge level and let your imagination run free. Reach the finish first to win! Includes 40 top-quality wooden pieces.
Fish' em Up – Catch, Compete, and Outsmart Friends
Age: 8+ | Players: 2–6 | Playtime: 25 min. | Languages: LT / EN

In Fish ’em Up, you and your friends take on the role of daring fishermen, casting a massive net in hopes of hauling in the biggest catch. Each player wants to prove their skill, outsmart their opponents, and impress the locals. Will you return with a legendary haul, or end up with nothing but a net full of trash and disappointment?

Players take turns adding cards to the shared Net, stacking them strategically on top of the existing cards. Each card type triggers special effects, such as gaining points, stealing points from rivals, or stealing cards. The more cards of the same type connected to the Net, the stronger their effects become. Players can also cover specific images to neutralize opponents’ cards, creating opportunities for clever combos, surprise reversals, and dramatic last-minute swings.

The game ends when the Boat card is drawn, and the player with the most points wins, crowned the ultimate fisherman. With each round, players must balance risk and reward, decide when to cooperate or betray, and adapt to the constantly changing Net.
Gameplay Highlights:
Add cards to the Net to score points or sabotage opponents.
Chain effects for maximum impact.
Cover cards to block opponents’ strategies.
Quick, tactical turns with high player interaction.
Easy to learn, but with deep strategic possibilities.
In the box you will find:
55 unique round cards
30 fishing point tokens
1 wooden jellyfish token
2 rulebooks in Lithuanian and English
Fish ’em Up is perfect for players who love clever card play, strategic thinking, and playful rivalry. Will you land the big catch… or get tangled in your own net?

Loony Clues is a lively party word game where players hide behind secret identities and try to guess who’s who. Use clever hints, uncover the masks, and score points by figuring out the identities of your fellow players.

At the start of the game, players are randomly assigned one of the 12 secret identities on the game board. Each round, players ask one another a simple question using cards. "Are you colorful?" "Are you flat?" Yes or no answers help players find the right identity! Will you be courageous and guess quickly, or would you rather wait for more clues? And is sushi washable, really? The interpretation is entirely up to the players, but don't try to be sneaky, as you also score points when someone guesses you correctly!
With simple rules and a variety of word cards, every round is fresh, fun, and endlessly replayable.

The award-winning CluePuzzle – Wonderbox of Alice is a wooden puzzle box inspired by the fantastical world of Alice in Wonderland. Players are drawn into an exciting story and must open the box step by step by assembling puzzle images and solving mechanical challenges.

The Wonderbox of Alice continues the innovative CLUEPUZZLE concept first introduced with our original game, Pyramid of the Sun. This time, we’ve taken the gameplay to the next level, creating a puzzle experience with the complexity of a CLUEBOX. Its innovative concept earned it the ToyAward 2026.
Discover more

Describe tricky terms to your team without falling into the trap: The opposing team is just waiting in the sidelines for you to get all tangled up in your words and blurt out one of their answer words! Then the points will pour in—but for the other team! A fast-paced party guessing game full of schadenfreude, thrills, and laughter.

Kingdom Legacy: Exploration is an expansion to Kingdom Legacy that opens up many different paths to develop your kingdom. Are you looking for seafaring cards to bring to Distant Lands. Or more livestock to boost with the Merchants? More castles and fortresses, or maybe a swamp witch to help you get rid of the most annoying cards in your deck?
As brave witches and wizards, you’ll collect six magical ingredients: the red belladonna seed, the blue dragon’s tear, the brown
pipe mushroom, the green bubber leaf, the yellow dino claw, and the mysterious pink blast bean.
The potion-brewing race begins: Each of you must find the right spots in the cellar to collect the desired ingredients. Who still remembers the exact locations?
Who can reach for them with precision in the dark—and who will just scare away that annoying bat?
Are you ready for the potion race in the castle cellar?
Then grab your witch’s hat, open the heavy cellar door, and let the magic begin!
The Jailbreak is a cooperative deduction game where your perspective and clever communication will be needed to carry out your escape.

Work together with your teammates over 44 challenges broken up across 11 pivotal days of your jailbreak. Each day gets more challenging as you take on more risks in planning and executing your escape.

During the game, each player holds a hand of double-sided tools and each tool has a non-overlapping front/back pairing. Your perspective at the table may help you give clever clues to your teammates to help them, with some deduction, play their tools to the right spot and complete the challenge.
Be careful - if you get it wrong you risk being caught by the guards.

Tief im Wald sammeln die Eichhörnchen fleißig Eicheln für ihren Wintervorrat. Doch der alte Schatzbaum ist unberechenbar – wenn man die Eicheln hineinwirft, landen sie manchmal an unerwarteten Plätzen! Du brauchst nur etwas Strategie und eine Prise Glück, um die meisten Eicheln zu sammeln, bevor der Winter kommt!

Millimemory is a fast-paced estimation game where players test their sense of scale by guessing the size of everyday objects. Each round, a Question Card shows a familiar object, such as a battery, coin, etc. All players secretly predict the object's size by lengthening or shortening their Prediction Card. When the correct size is revealed, players score points based on how close their guess was. The closer your prediction, the more points you earn! The game continues until one or more players reach 10 points, at which point the game ends and the winner is declared the Millimemory Master!
Dump the problem before the Llama gets you!

Play a bigger combo or PASS. Sounds easy... until passing forces you to draw. The stronger the combo you pass on, the more cards you must draw. Somewhere in the deck are deadly Llamas. Draw one, and you're instantly out! Simple rules, zero mercy. Slam huge combos onto your friends and watch the chaos unfold. As players get dragged out one by one, can you be the last one laughing?
Welcome to the annual Aquarium Festival!
At this grand event, aquarium shops from all over showcase their finest collections, each trying to stand out among fierce competitors.
Observe how other shops present their displays, adjust the composition of your aquatic collection, and seize the right moment to take advantage of sponsor support to make your exhibit shine.
Among representatives from aquariums around the world, only the shop that demonstrates the most impressive collection will earn the prestigious title of “Aquarium Tycoon.”
"Aquarium Festival" is a ladder climbing game supported by shared dice.

During each competition, players take turns playing card combinations, gradually increasing the strength of the current play to gain the advantage. At key moments, players may also use the shared dice in the center of the table to help complete their combinations.
A full game consists of several competitions. In each competition, the first player to play all of their cards wins that competition.
The first player to win three competitions wins the game.

Legend says that Jack would go into the saloon every night in search of a little entertainment and something to wet his whistle. One day, he walked in on his old friend who owned the saloon in the process of watering down the whisky. This betrayal was so unforgivable that Jack killed the man on the spot, drowning him in a filthy watering hole.

But his rage was not quenched, and he vowed to master dark magic so he could bring the bartender back to life and kill him anew every night until his thirst for vengeance was satisfied. He has been at it for 723 nights, and he ain’t gotten tired of it yet. The moral of the story: never water down the customer’s whisky! Anyway, his wicked powers have led to his being proclaimed the Hellbilly Zombie Master, with his very own army of zombies ready to do his bidding. You are the only one who can put him and his putrefied horde of living dead in the grave.

The first expansion for Ace of Spades includes 15 new zombie enemy cards with 4 versions of the Hellbilly zombie master. In this expansion, the Enemies work slightly differently from how they do in the base game. When play them, cards in your Hand combinations will be "captured". This means that 1 (or 2) of the cards that damaged the Enemy will be linked to that particular guy and can never be used again. Enemies are zombies, so they never die. If you survive long enough, you will face a horde of undead.

1902 veröffentlichte der Illusionist Georges Méliès mit Le Voyage dans la Lune einen der ersten Science-Fiction-Filme der Geschichte, dessen 13.375 Einzelbilder in aufwendiger Kleinstarbeit von Hand koloriert wurden. Fasziniert von den Möglichkeiten des Kinematographen der Brüder Lumière wurde Méliès zum Pionier des Kinos und legte mit seinen visuellen Effekten den Grundstein der modernen Filmtechnik.

Werde Regieassistent von Méliès und hilf dabei, ruhende Bilder zum Leben zu erwecken. Bereite das Filmset vor, setze spektakuläre Spezialeffekte ein, positioniere die Schauspieler, drehe Szenen und koloriere sie, um daraus Fantastisches zu erschaffen.
Lass dich von der Magie des frühen Kinos verzaubern und begib dich auf die Reise zum Mond!

In “Reactor Rescue” schlüpfen die SpielerInnen in die Rolle von Ingenieuren, deren Raumschiffe auf dem Weg zur Reperatur eines ausfallenden Reaktors in der Stadt Electra eine Panne erlitten haben. Jeder Spieler muss sein eigenes Raumschiff reparieren, indem er echte elektronische Schaltkreise zusammenbaut, bevor er in die Stadt zurückkehren kann. Nur ein Ingenieur wird seine Mission erfüllen.
“Reactor Rescue” ist spielerisch einfach in fünf Minuten zu erlernen und spricht sowohl Familien als auch erfahrene Spieler an.
Players: 2-6| Playing time: 15-30 min | Age: 8+ |
The most fearless chili eaters have gathered for a fiery challenge… and only iron stomachs will survive!

In All You Can Chili, every player secretly controls a character with a different tolerance for spice. Round after round, you’ll serve increasingly fiery dishes to your opponents, trying to push them past their limit and make them tap out, all without revealing your own identity too soon.

Because that’s the real game: your rivals are watching every dish you serve and every one you swallow, looking for clues about how much heat you can really take. Serve too aggressively and you’ll expose yourself; play it too safe and someone else will control the table.
A fast-paced game of bluffing, deduction, and risk management, where knowing when to stop matters just as much as knowing when to strike. How far will you push it?

Independence: Patriots vs The Crown is a deck-building strategy game for 2 players depicting the American War of Independence. One player takes on the role of the newly founded United States (blue; the American player), struggling to make their new nation a reality, while the other takes on the role of the British Empire (red; the British player), determined to suppress the rebellion in their American colonies.

Schlüpfe auf der Kesselküste, einer Insel, die einst die Heimat der Hexen gewesen sein soll, in die Rolle des aufgeweckten Mädchens Reni und erkunde gemeinsam mit ihrer Katze eine lebhaft gestaltete Welt voller Rätsel, Begegnungen und Geheimnisse. Sammle Gegenstände, braue Tränke, lerne Zauber, kämpfe gegen fiese Monster und tauche ein in eine magische Welt voller Überraschungen … und Muffins!

Im Stil von klassischen Point-and-Click-Adventures und Indie-Videospielen bestimmen deine Entscheidungen in diesem liebevoll illustrierten Solospiel, das sich auch toll gemeinsam erleben lässt, wohin dich deine Reise führt. Im Ortsbuch erkundest du Schauplätze im Dorf und in der Wildnis, suchst dort versteckte Hinweise und trägst alles, was du findest und erlebst, auf deinem Spielbogen ein. Das Eintragsbuch führt dich durch die Geschichte, die dich bis zu 30 Stunden lang fesselt.

This expansion for Railway Porters includes 4 new Station Boards, 6 Additional Rule Tiles, and more. Enjoy the expanded world of Railway Porters! (This expansion cannot be played on its own. You will need the Railway Porters base game.)

The new Station Boards are played together with the Station Boards from the base game. Each features its own new scoring system and rules, offering a different kind of enjoyment from the base game's Station Boards.
The Additional Rule Tiles bring a fresh feel to each game by applying a special rule that lasts for the entire game.
You can play only adding the new Station Boards, just as before, or you can add an Additional Rule Tile as well.
Purchase at SPIEL and receive a promotional tile as a bonus (while supplies last).
1188.theme: This expansion for Railway Porters includes 4 new Station Boards, 6 Additional Rule Tiles, and more. Enjoy the expanded world of Railway Porters!

description: Brabbelkrabben von Noris ist das perfekte Sprachspiel für Kinder, Familien und Partyrunden. Wer schafft es, die Zungenbrecher fehlerfrei zu sprechen und dabei mit den beiliegenden Kastagnetten im richtigen Moment zu klappern? Das erfordert Konzentration, Sprachwitz und gutes Timing – denn wer patzt, bekommt ein Klammer-Krönchen. Einfache Regeln, aber große Wirkung: Mit jeder Runde steigt die Spannung und der Spaß. BRABBELKRABBEN ist ideal für Kinder ab 8 Jahren und sorgt in Familienrunden, auf Geburtstagen oder bei Spieleabenden mit Freunden für laute Lacher und schnelle Reaktionen. Sprachförderung und Spielspaß gehen hier Hand in Hand – für eine spielerische Förderung von Konzentration, Rhythmusgefühl und Teamgeist. Ob als Kinderspiel oder als witzige Party-Challenge – Brabbelkrabben bringt alle an den Tisch!
1189.theme: Brabbelkrabben - Sprachspiel für Kinder, Familien und Partyrunden

description: Wer sind deine Freunde wirklich – und was würden sie nie zugeben?
LASS ES RAUS! knackt Oberflächen mit 148 grenzwertigen Fragen rund um Vorurteile, Gewalt und Drogen.
Das Spiel ist kombinierbar mit dem Original LASS ES RAUS!, aber auch eigenständig spielbar.
INHALT
148 Fragekarten
Anleitung

Mit „Was tue ich?“, „Finde etwas!“ und „Mach es nach!“ präsentiert Noris drei abwechslungsreiche Kartenspiele für Kinder ab 4 Jahren. Die leicht verständlichen Spielideen laden zum Darstellen, Entdecken und Bewegen ein und eignen sich für zu Hause, unterwegs oder für Kita-Gruppen.

Bei „Was tue ich?“ stellen die Kinder Begriffe pantomimisch dar, während die Mitspieler erraten, welche Tätigkeit gesucht wird. „Finde etwas!“ macht die Umgebung zum Suchfeld: Passend zur gezogenen Motivkarte gilt es, einen entsprechenden Gegenstand zu entdecken. Bei „Mach es nach!“ werden kindgerechte Yogaübungen und Körperhaltungen betrachtet und nachgemacht. So fördern die Spiele Fantasie, Beobachtungsgabe, Konzentration und Körpergefühl.

Jedes Spiel enthält 39 farbenfroh illustrierte Motivkarten sowie eine Spielregel und ist für 2 bis 10 Kinder geeignet. Die handliche Metalldose mit einer Größe von etwa 8 × 11 Zentimetern macht die Spiele zu praktischen Begleitern für Ausflüge, Reisen und gemeinsame Spielrunden.
1191.theme: „Was tue ich?“, „Finde etwas!“ und „Mach es nach!“ Drei kompakte Mitmachspiele mit Bewegung, Kreativität und jeder Menge Spielspaß von Noris

description: Du möchtest dein hart erarbeitetes Wissen mit sehr fragwürdigen Fakten rund um Sex, Gewalt und Tod überschreiben?
ZWANZIG ZENTIMETER beantwortet alle Fragen, die du dir noch nie gestellt hast. Und die du trotzdem nie mehr
vergessen wirst. Das Spiel ist kombinierbar mit dem Original ZWANZIG ZENTIMETER, aber auch eigenständig spielbar.
INHALT
124 Fragekarten
24 Antwortkarten

Northern Hawk-cuckoo, Chestnut-winged Cuckoo, Great Spotted Cuckoo, Black-headed Duck, and Kingfisher.
Additionally, it includes the Secretarybird variant rule.
Note: This is an expansion set. "Sky Garden" base game is required to play.

Part of the Garden Trilogy series, which shares the same core system as Aqua Garden, Dino Garden is a mid-weight game where you collect dinosaurs and build your very own dinosaur park!
Players work to raise their roaming dinosaurs in the right environments, striving to create the most captivating dinosaur park of all!
The key to running a successful dinosaur park is the "food chain."

By having carnivorous dinosaurs prey on the meat produced by herbivorous dinosaurs, you can earn bonuses and victory points. But to pull off efficient feeding, you'll need to carefully manage the movements of your feeders!
Compared to its sister title, Aqua Garden, Dino Garden features stronger player interaction, making for a more dynamic gameplay experience.
Triceratops, Pteranodon, Tyrannosaurus rex... the dinosaurs you marveled at in books as a child are now adorable tokens waiting in your hands.
Feel the dry Jurassic breeze as you build a dinosaur paradise right on your tabletop!
