Aqua Garden, the beloved fish-filled favorite featuring adorable little fish tokens, is back in a brand new edition!

Become the director of your very own aquarium, collect fish, and build a more captivating aquarium than anyone else. To create the perfect aquarium, you'll need to think carefully about eye-catching fish combinations for your advertisements, as well as the oxygen levels in each tank. Oh, and watch out — you can't put sharks in a tank with your other swimming fish!

By the end of the game, you'll have crafted an aquarium so beautiful you'll want to share photos of it. Enjoy the satisfying tension of each meaningful decision, paired with vibrant and gorgeous visuals.
Perfect for experienced gamers and beginners alike — a great first mid-weight game for newcomers to the hobby. Why not create your very own aquarium at your table?
New Edition Features:
① Refreshed package design and size!
② Aquarium boards are now double-layered!
③ Includes an insert that fits all expansion sets!

You’re at a party full of laughter, friends, and great music; the atmosphere is buzzing with energy and fun. This is the perfect moment to show off your best moves on the dance floor and get everyone moving to your beat. The lights spin to the beat of the latest hits, while every step adds excitement to the night. Let your creativity flow and become the life of the party. Are you ready to show off your best moves, shine under the party lights, and make everyone envy your rhythm? It’s time to dance!

In Let’s Dance, you’ll dance with your cards. Play them in front of you to form your dance floor with different choreographed sequences. Play different dance moves, stomp on another player, draw new cards, or refresh your hand. The game nears its end when someone reveals the “End of the Party” card, which kicks off the final round. Play your dance moves wisely to get the most out of them; make combinations or interrupt other players’ dances—all to score the most points. The player with the most points at the end of the party is the winner.

Designed by Abel Molero and illustrated by Alex Gallego, Let’s Dance is part of Devir’s Pocket collection, a line specializing in small-format card games that are affordably priced and ideal for taking anywhere. With varied themes and interesting mechanics, the Pocket games fit into any game library and suit any group of players.

The engines are starting to roar! At the starting line, the drivers are getting ready to push the limits of the track, aware of the danger that lies in every turn and knowing that courage is their most valuable asset. In this race, the drivers must balance and manage tire wear and fuel consumption, juggling speed with the conservation of resources.

Designed by Ferran Renalias and Guillem Coll and illustrated by Meeple Foundry, in Nascard, 1 to 6 players drive a vehicle in a NASCAR race over two laps, with the goal of crossing the finish line first and winning the race.

To move their vehicle, drivers will use cards from their hand. If they play the trump suit (which is revealed at the start of each round), they’ll engage in aggressive driving, burning rubber and advancing several spaces around the track. They can also opt for tactical driving by playing a card from another suit, which, while allowing them to advance fewer spaces, will activate a bonus associated with that suit. Finally, drivers can also stop in the pits, which allows them to replenish their hand.

Nascard is a game from Devir’s Pocket Collection, a line known for its compact size—ideal for taking anywhere—affordable price, and varied themes that fit into any game collection. Will you manage to win the race by managing your hand of cards in the best possible way?

Brachiosaurus, Fukuisaurus, Therizinosaurus, and Ankylosaurus.
Additionally, it includes the Dinosaur Egg variant rule.
Note: This is an expansion set. "Dino Garden" base game is required to play.

Face the judgment of the end times completely alone! Your goal is to break the seals of an ancient scroll and defy the wrath of a supreme being who has unleashed a horde of furious beasts and demons intent on annihilating humanity. Use your dice wisely and prove you can convince the Great Creator to grant humanity a second chance.

Designed by Julio Falagán and illustrated by Will Kirkby, 7th Seal is a solo game for players aged 10 and up, with sessions lasting 30 to 45 minutes. Your objective is to break the seven seals that enclose the book of the Supreme Being and face the apocalyptic judgment written within. To do so, you will have to overcome four waves; in each wave, you must defeat an Overlord and, if possible, the Minions that accompany him. If you fail to eliminate the Minions, they will hinder your mission. Each seal you open brings you a little closer to humanity's ultimate fate.

At the start of your turn, you roll your available dice and then assign the results to cards to perform actions, such as attacking, defending, regaining health, or using abilities. If you defeat minions, you can keep their dice and gain a one-time ability. After your turn, the enemy plays. Both the minions and the Overlord will activate their abilities and attack you. If you survive, you get another turn. If you manage to reduce the Overlord's health to zero, you've cleared the wave. You gain a permanent ability and the chance to start the next wave. You achieve final victory by defeating the Overlord of the fourth wave.

With Ear Candy, it's time for your songs to take center stage! The first expansion for Rock Hard: 1977 (which requires the base game to play) lets you use your Life Experiences to compose singles in various styles. Promoting these singles will get them played on the radio and propel you up the charts, giving you an additional way to gain Fame. The expansion also includes two new characters, two new managers, two new types of Candy, and additional cards for each deck. Do you have what it takes to be number one?

Designed by the legendary Jackie Fox (of the 70s rock band The Runaways) and illustrated by Jennifer Giner, Rock Hard: 1977 allows for games for 2 to 5 players, ages 14 and up, in sessions of 45 to 90 minutes. Through worker placement mechanics and events, players will take on the role of a rising rock star and compete to accumulate the most Fame points over several rounds.

Rock Hard: 1977 is played over a maximum of nine rounds, each representing a typical day in a month from 1977, from April to December. You win the game by accumulating the most Fame… And how do you score Fame? By increasing your reputation, your skills, and the quality of your songs; by earning production, performance, and publicity bonuses; by securing record deals and collecting royalties; by playing gigs; and by hanging out at the hottest nightclubs.

Take Daggerheart to new levels with an expansion offering new options for everyone at the table (GMs and players!) and bringing Daggerheart into even more genres than before.
The Daggerheart: Hope & Fear standard edition comes with a book (around 200 pages) and a box containing cards and 2 rip pads of blank adversary sheets!
Inside the book, you’ll find:
New character options, including 4 new classes: the Witch, Warlock, Brawler, and Assassin, each with 2 unique subclasses!
130+ new adversaries and 28 environments, plus a rip pad of blank adversary sheets to help you easily create your own
100+ weapons, armor, item, and consumable options
4 new Campaign Frames introducing new worlds and settings for you to explore
The huskies are back and the race is on! Unlock exciting new tactics with new huskies and a twist in the race track!
It includes:
24 husky cards with 4 new husky abilities,
4 special landscape cards.
Part of the Garden Trilogy series, which shares the same core system as Aqua Garden, Sky Garden is a mid-weight game where you collect birds and build your very own aviary.

To create the finest aviary in town, there's a whole lot to do! Skillfully direct your staff, release birds into the right environments, and secure income through events and advertising... but most importantly, don't forget about "breeding"!
When a bird pair is nesting and you land on the breeding space, eggs are produced — giving you the chance to earn even more victory points!
How well can you match up your bird pairs and get them breeding?
Compared to its sister title, Aqua Garden, Sky Garden features stronger player interaction, making for a more dynamic gameplay experience.
Swans, toucans, long-tailed tits... adorable wooden bird tokens spread their wings and await your visit to the aviary!

description: Tauche ein in eine wunderbare Welt voller Mythen und Drachen.
Draconis ist ein auf 5e-basierendes Pen&Paper-Rollenspiel … aber es ist anders.

Draconis ist ein friedvolles Rollenspiel, das kreative Lösungen bei Herausforderungen ins Zentrum stellt. Statt zu Kämpfen, geht es hier um Entdeckungen, das Verstehen anderer und die friedliche Lösung von Konflikten.

Mit vorgefertigten Charakteren und einer stimmungsvollen, spannenden Kampagne erlebst und lernst du die Regeln nach und nach im Spiel – von ersten Fertigkeitsproben bis hin zum Einsatz von Magie. So ist Draconis mit seinem opulenten Spielmaterial und vielen Tipps sowohl etwas für den Einstieg ins Rollenspiel – als auch für erfahrene Gruppen, die in eine atmosphärisch dichte Welt eintauchen wollen, wo Kampf und Gewalt hinten andstehen, auch wenn die Herausforderungen, Geheimnisse und Gefahren nicht kleiner werden.

Dilophosaurus, Allosaurus, Carnotaurus, Dimetrodon, and Ichthyosaurus.

Expand the strategic possibilities of The White Castle! This expansion, which requires the base game to play, includes Time Passage Track tiles, which add new rewards; Daimyo Gift tokens, with objectives that can provide points at the end of the game; and the Privilege card deck, which grants permanent bonuses during the game.

The White Castle Boeki can be enjoyed with both the base game and Matcha, the first expansion for The White Castle. Among the new features added by Boeki are the 20 Privilege cards, which players can obtain as they advance along the new Time Passage Track. These cards grant special bonuses that alter certain requirements, such as dice rolls or the costs of certain actions.

Another new feature is the Daimyo Gift tokens, which are taken at the beginning of the game during the initial card selection. These tokens offer objectives that will be scored at the end of the game if the corresponding space on the Time Passage Track has been reached. Ready to return to Himeji Castle and make your clan the most influential?
What happens when gravity is no longer where you expect it to be?

SUPERA is a fast-paced competitive strategy game where players race to grow their own tree higher than their opponents on a shared three-dimensional structure. Five different TETRIS-inspired wooden shapes, tilted planes and constantly changing points of balance turn every move into a new spatial challenge.

The rules are simple. The challenge is anything but. Roll the die to determine your shape, find a matching place for your colour and extend your tree. But as the structure grows, familiar ideas of "up" and "down" start to disappear. With nothing reliably horizontal or vertical, players must constantly rediscover gravity, rethink their plans and decide how much risk they are willing to take.

SUPERA combines strategy, spatial thinking and physical skill in a game that is easy enough for children and newcomers, yet exciting enough to challenge experienced players. Its handcrafted wooden pieces and striking, ever-growing structure make it as beautiful on the table as it is engaging to play.
And when you're playing alone, SUPERA reveals another challenge: can you fit all the pieces back into the tin? The game's storage becomes a satisfying 3D puzzle of its own.
Come to Spiel Essen and see how high you can grow—without bringing the forest down.

A great American city awaits your vision! In this completely standalone version of Cities, you'll find the essence of the original game, but with new mechanics, including skyscrapers, bridges, and highways. Designed by Phil Walker-Harding and Steve Finn, this edition features artwork by Kwanchai Moriya. Cities USA can be enjoyed solo or in groups of up to 4 players, ages 10 and up, in games lasting approximately 45 minutes. With the goal of scoring the most points over a series of rounds, players will place their workers in different areas of the board to acquire objective cards or valuable pieces and tiles to plan their district.

Step into the shoes of an urban planner and take on the challenge of transforming a vibrant metropolis into a modern masterpiece. Erect gleaming skyscrapers, build bridges that connect highways, and design green spaces and waterfront areas to create a city that will stand the test of time. Every decision matters; every building, every street, every neighborhood is part of your legacy. Gather the right materials, out-plan your rivals, and claim your place as the architect of the future. Smart planning leads to amazing results.
Travel across Japan as it was 150 years ago!
The Travels of Isabella Lucy Bird is a roll-and-write game that retraces the journeys of Isabella Lucy Bird, the real-life British explorer.

Players draft dice to choose their actions, tracing their travel routes across a map of old Japan while completing journal cards. Higher-value dice allow more powerful actions, but using the dice of each color in ascending order earns a large bonus at the end of the game. Players must therefore think carefully about which dice to use, and in what order.

As they travel, players deepen their knowledge of nature, culture, and faith, gathering materials to complete their journals and score points. In addition, when a town they have actually visited matches the town on a completed journal card, they earn extra points.
Planning your journey while making the right dice choices each round is the key to victory.

Mit „Was tue ich?“, „Finde etwas!“ und „Mach es nach!“ präsentiert Noris drei abwechslungsreiche Kartenspiele für Kinder ab 4 Jahren. Die leicht verständlichen Spielideen laden zum Darstellen, Entdecken und Bewegen ein und eignen sich für zu Hause, unterwegs oder für Kita-Gruppen.

Bei „Was tue ich?“ stellen die Kinder Begriffe pantomimisch dar, während die Mitspieler erraten, welche Tätigkeit gesucht wird. „Finde etwas!“ macht die Umgebung zum Suchfeld: Passend zur gezogenen Motivkarte gilt es, einen entsprechenden Gegenstand zu entdecken. Bei „Mach es nach!“ werden kindgerechte Yogaübungen und Körperhaltungen betrachtet und nachgemacht. So fördern die Spiele Fantasie, Beobachtungsgabe, Konzentration und Körpergefühl.

Jedes Spiel enthält 39 farbenfroh illustrierte Motivkarten sowie eine Spielregel und ist für 2 bis 10 Kinder geeignet. Die handliche Metalldose mit einer Größe von etwa 8 × 11 Zentimetern macht die Spiele zu praktischen Begleitern für Ausflüge, Reisen und gemeinsame Spielrunden.
1212.theme: „Was tue ich?“, „Finde etwas!“ und „Mach es nach!“ Drei kompakte Mitmachspiele mit Bewegung, Kreativität und jeder Menge Spielspaß von Noris

description: A new unified packaging for the BlackHole and Glyphon expansions! Play up to 6 players and unleash 8 new sponsored asteroids and 1 additional Destiny Ammo for extra mayhem.
BlackHole pirate ships can damage nearby vessels without directly hitting them with a laser beam.
Glyphon laser beams, on the other hand, deal damage even if they narrowly miss the target.
Discordia Germanicus is a tilesheet containing 6 Germanic tiles to add to the game.
3 of them are only playable with the Discordia Diana expansion; the other 3 can also be mixed together with those from the base game.

In Movers & Shakers, you take on the role of an ambitious railway magnate in 19th-century Bengal. Compete to transport goods between Benares and Calcutta, fulfil lucrative contracts and invest your profits wisely as you build an increasingly powerful railway empire. You can load goods onto your own freight cars—or those belonging to your rivals—creating clever opportunities, tense decisions and unexpected chain reactions.
Careful planning and good timing are essential. Manage your workforce, unlock new company actions and react to your opponents’ plans as you strive to become Bengal’s most successful railway tycoon.

The Master Print edition is available in two versions. The Industrial Edition includes the complete game and all unlocked campaign content, featuring detailed 3D freight-car miniatures made from durable, environmentally conscious Fibrowood. The Imperial Freight Edition contains exactly the same gameplay content, but upgrades the Fibrowood miniatures with a beautiful Sundrop finish, adding natural-looking shadows and highlights for a more striking appearance on the table.

Spy Team is a team-based trick-taking game for four players, played two against two. Two elite spy agencies, C.A.T. and B.I.R.D., compete to prove which of them is the finest. Success depends on trust and coordination — yet partners are never allowed to discuss their plans.

At the start of each round, players receive a hand of cards that may not be rearranged. Cards can only be played from either end of the hand, and while the card backs show each card's color, its number stays hidden from the other players. Playing one card per trick, players try to coordinate with their partner while reading the opposing team's intentions. Each mission calls for a specific split of tricks between the two teammates — one partner takes exactly 1 trick and the other 5, or 2 and 4, or 3 and 3.
A round ends the moment a team completes its current mission, or blocks the opposing team from completing theirs. Complete all three of your team's missions before your rivals do, and your team wins.
Designed by Mukai, a rising Japanese designer whose previous titles include Banana Governance.

Be the first Dino to cross the FINISH line. You advance by reading the pack correctly: make bold Boasts about the cards hidden in everyone’s hands or call a rival’s Boast with a Challenge. Each time a Boast is Challenged, the Dinos who read it right Dash ahead while the rest Crash and go nowhere!
What you see is not what you build!

Puzzlide: Oz is a 1000-piece interactive puzzle game where completing the jigsaw is only the beginning. Once assembled, use the included 40 game cards to search for characters, objects and hidden details throughout the illustration.

But there is another surprise: some areas of the completed puzzle are different from the image shown on the box. Discover what has changed, explore the unexpected scenes and solve all the search challenges hidden in the wonderful world of Oz.
Build the puzzle. Search the image. Discover the unexpected.

Welcome to the most luxurious birthday party of the year aboard the yacht "Eclipse Noir". Then the unthinkable happens: blood is found on the sun deck, one of the guests has vanished - and the captain is missing too.
Every player takes on a role, dresses up and plays it all evening. No app, no game master, no preparation: open the box, hand out the character booklets and start. For 4 to 6 players aged 16 and up.
1219.theme: Luxury yacht, birthday party in the Mediterranean

description: Quashars is a trick-taking game where every Trick you win can help—or hurt—your prediction.

At the start of each game, four Condition Cards are revealed, each rewarding different ways of winning Tricks. Before play begins, every player predicts how many times they will meet those conditions. During the game, you return a Chip each time you satisfy a condition. The challenge is to return exactly all of your Chips by the end of the game.

Because multiple conditions can be met with a single Trick, every victory becomes a puzzle. Should you win now, avoid winning, or save the perfect card for later? Read the table, adapt to the changing conditions, and make your prediction come true.
New Muses have arrived—and some of them have four fur!

Meet Fritz, the mysterious mouse; Constance, the endlessly patient cat; and Tulsi, the wandering dog. These animal companions can become an unexpected part of your creative journey, sometimes helping you along the way and sometimes creating a little chaos.
But hardship is back—and this time, it’s darker.

New cards such as Depression, Paranoia, and Panic Attack bring a harsher side of the artistic life into focus, reminding you that creativity isn’t always about inspiration, recognition, and applause. Sometimes, simply getting through the day is an achievement.
And now, Events change everything!

At the beginning of each round, an Event card is revealed, introducing a new circumstance that affects every player. Whether it’s A Sunny Day in Montmartre, Riots in the Streets, or The World’s Fair 1889, each round brings its own challenges, opportunities, and unexpected stories.
ABROAD

A card-driven journey across Europe for 1–4 players. Collect real-destination location cards, chart your own route, and score the trip of a lifetime — a game so immersive that players have booked real vacations inspired by it.
Take on the role of jungle clans vying for dominance in the heights of Kumata!
Cover your opponents’ dominoes, protect your own, and build a colorful 3D canopy where every level counts. A simple, clever, and highly interactive domino game.

On your turn, play a domino from the top of your personal stack and place it on the board. Be careful: to be placed, each space on your domino must cover another space of the same value, regardless of clan: a 1 covers a 1, a 3 covers a 3, and so on. Empty spaces are wild: they can cover or be covered by any value. Once per game, you may play your totem to protect one of your dominoes and gain bonus points. The game ends as soon as a player can no longer play. The clan with the most visible points then wins the game.
The game includes two modes : Duel mode for tense head-to-head battles (2 players) and Multiplayer mode for more chaos (3-4 players).
To add variety to your games, you can also play two variants : Maze mode, which introduces new tactical challenges, and Alliance mode, for tense 2-vs-2 team play.
Lead your army into enemy territory and fight your way to the Necronomicon!

In Cthulhu Crusades, players command rival armies in a fast-paced battle to conquer the enemy castle and seize the legendary Necronomicon. Deploy your forces, advance across the battlefield and use their different abilities to overcome your opponent and reach the forbidden book first.
A tactical two-player game combining strategy, confrontation and the Cthulhu Mythos in quick and accessible battles.
The only way out of the Cursed Casino is to uncover the secrets hidden inside its six slot machines.

Strange Slot Simulator is a real-time deduction card game for 2 to 5 players. Each of the six slot machines has its own unique "Settings" — a distinct combination of eight symbol card types — and no one knows which machine has which Settings when the game begins.

Each round, players claim one machine and have four minutes to repeatedly draw cards and record what they find. Drawing bonus symbol cards (Bonus, Cherry Bonus, or Watermelon Bonus) advances your Bonus line, unlocking skills that let you draw even more cards per turn. After time is up, players analyze their notes and write down their best guess for each machine's Settings. The player who correctly identifies the most Settings across all four rounds wins.

With everyone acting simultaneously, tension runs high — rivals may grab the machine you were eyeing, and the clock is always ticking. Easy Mode eases newcomers into the deduction process, while Expert, Cooperative, and Solo modes offer fresh challenges for seasoned players.
Have your dance troupe learn to dance like the performers from the Gujarat region of India in this joyful game of dice drafting, set collection & engine building!

Immerse your troupe in the heart of the celebration by learning from skilled dancers on the central dance floor. Outfit them in traditional, eye-catching attire and equip them with vibrant dandiya sticks to dazzle the crowd. Inspire love to blossom between dancers during performances to unlock powerful bonuses. Balance these competing objectives, all while trying to match them to the dance skills acquired throughout the game. Does your dance troupe have what it takes to become the best on the dance floor?

Return to the garden of your childhood to build a tableau of Ladybird Cards! The roses are overgrown, the orchard is crawling with aphids, and only your old friends — the ladybirds — can help restore the garden to its former beauty. Over five summer days you’ll place cards to grow your tableau of ladybird types and rekindle old memories.

Each round, players simultaneously reveal a card, place it into one of five colored columns, then perform one of the available garden actions. Completing a full ladybird life cycle (egg → larva → pupa → adult) or clearing aphids from orchard cards boosts the value of your ladybirds. Tension builds as players compete for the right ladybird type and color before opponents snag them first.
Score bonus points by completing sets of all five colors, feeding specific ladybird types, and unlocking forgotten childhood memories.

Between vicious conquest raids and lengthy trade journeys, the best way Vikings knew how to unwind was by thrashing friends and rivals in a few tense games of Drakkard. From mead halls to the Drakkar ship’s prow, Drakkard steeled Viking hearts and minds. Jarls and sprogs, warlords and farmhands alike—bound by the North Sea’s wild call, they roared to battle when war-drums rolled like thunder o’er the frost-rimed shores.

Your objective is to command a mighty Viking fleet in Drakkard, a tactical clash of wits and warfare on the high seas. Build the largest fleet over the course of the game or strand your opponent for a decisive victory. Overlap Reinforcement cards to grow your naval power while sinking your opponent. Raid enemy vessels and call on Sea Monsters to trap the enemy Flagship and protect your own.
Fast to learn and fierce to master, a strategic duel of skill and cunning awaits you, Steed of the Sea...

Mix and match any two CoverUp sets to unleash entirely new ways to wage war. Face off in crossover battles, where rival clans from different worlds collide in volatile duels on a battlefield stitched together from both Reinforcement decks! Or rally up to 4 players for team battles, where you and an ally coordinate powerful combos across sprawling twin maps to break your challenger and claim total dominance!
Take on the role of Ivy, the courageous new owner of a magical inn. Build your bewitching B&B to best suit your eccentric guests while cultivating the ivy covering your walls.
Each turn, carefully place each card in a grid. Assign guests, noting their preferences (things like "diagonally adjacent", "same row", "surrounded" etc.) to score them at the end of the game.
In Story Mode, earn rewards for meeting point goals and completing unique challenges.

Three Sisters Harvest Edition packs all the decisions and fun of a full gaming experience into an efficient and innovative package. Use your garden, yard, apiary and shed or visit the farmer’s market while you grow corn, beans, pumpkins, perennials and more. Three Sisters Harvest Edition features the award-winning gameplay of the original edition, along with a twelve chapter campaign mode that includes new content, gameplay and components. The new content can also be used as expansion modules for endless replayability.
Three Sisters Harvest Edition is a fully standalone new edition of Three Sisters

The forest never sleeps. It grows, changes, and requires constant adaptation from those who manage it. Growing Forward expands Forestry with new asymmetric characters, additional harvesting and transport mechanics, and modules focused on infestation management and long-term planning. The expansion increases strategic variability through unique player abilities, asymmetric starts, and new ways to optimize forest development and resource flow.
World Wonders: Europa Wonders Pack adds ten new wondrous monuments from Europa to World Wonders, along with a new gameplay mode.
This mode features 2 secret, own wonders at the beginning, which could only be built by you. With this different requirements all games get more variety.
The expansion also comes with cards to use the new wonders in the normal game mode.
Adds: Alhambra, Arc de Triomphe, Caravel, Saint Basil's Cathedral, Windmills, Notre-Dame, Palace of Westminster, Brandenburg Gate, Belém Tower and Tower of Pisa.
English
Maximum fun in minimum time. A game series inspired by Japan’s “Taipa” culture.
“Taipa” is a Japanese abbreviation of “time performance.”
It means getting as much enjoyment and value as possible in as little time as possible.
The Taipa Supremacy series takes the best parts of classic games and turns them into experiences you can enjoy in a much shorter time.
Go all-in in 5 minutes
I want to hit a Royal Straight Flush.
The rules are just like poker.
But here, strong hands come one after another.
Flip a card and try not to grin.
Good luck keeping your poker face.
“All-in!” Just the best parts of Poker.
Look at your cards.
Read your opponents.
Bet your chips.
Bluff.
And when the moment is right, go “All-in!”
The goal isn’t to master every detail of Poker.
Even complete beginners can quickly enjoy the tension of betting, the thrill of bluffing, and the excitement of revealing their hand.
Whether you’re an experienced Poker player or sitting at the table for the first time, everyone can play together right away.
From 52 cards to 28. Strong hands everywhere.
Taipa Supremacy: Quick Poker cuts the standard 52-card deck down to just 28 cards.
The deck contains only:8, 9, 10, J, Q, K, and A.
That means strong hands appear much more often than in regular Poker.
Straights.
Flushes.
Full Houses.
And even the hand everyone dreams of making: a Royal Flush.
Hands that are extremely rare in regular Poker become real possibilities here.
Poker excitement, packed into just 5 minutes.Big hands.
Big bluffs.
Big bets.
But you don’t need hours to experience them.
Taipa Supremacy: Quick Poker condenses the excitement of Poker into a fast, easy-to-learn game that anyone can enjoy.
Five minutes. One table. Go all-in.
ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
Deutsch
Maximaler Spielspaß in minimaler Zeit. Eine Spielereihe, inspiriert von Japans „Taipa“-Kultur.
„Taipa“ ist eine japanische Abkürzung für „Time Performance“.
Gemeint ist damit, in möglichst kurzer Zeit möglichst viel Spaß und Erlebnis zu bekommen.
Die Taipa-Supremacy-Reihe nimmt die besten Elemente klassischer Spiele und macht daraus Spielerlebnisse, die sich in deutlich kürzerer Zeit genießen lassen.
In nur 5 Minuten All-in gehen.
Ich will endlich einen Royal Flush schaffen.
Die Regeln sind wie beim Poker.
Doch hier folgt eine starke Hand auf die nächste.
Deckt eine Karte auf und versucht, euch das Grinsen zu verkneifen.
Viel Glück dabei, euer Pokerface zu bewahren.
„All-in!“ Einfach die besten Seiten von Poker.
Schaut euch eure Karten an.
Versucht, eure Gegner zu lesen.
Setzt eure Chips.
Blufft.
Und wenn der richtige Moment gekommen ist, geht „All-in!“
Bei diesem Spiel geht es nicht darum, jedes Detail von Poker perfekt zu beherrschen.
Selbst absolute Anfänger können schnell die Spannung beim Setzen, den Nervenkitzel des Bluffens und den aufregenden Moment genießen, wenn die eigene Hand aufgedeckt wird.
Egal, ob ihr erfahrene Pokerspieler seid oder zum ersten Mal am Tisch sitzt: Alle können sofort gemeinsam losspielen.
Von 52 auf 28 Karten. Starke Hände am laufenden Band.
Taipa Supremacy: Quick Poker reduziert das klassische 52-Karten-Deck auf nur 28 Karten.
Das Deck enthält ausschließlich 8, 9, 10, J, Q, K und A.
Dadurch entstehen starke Hände deutlich häufiger als beim normalen Poker.
Straights.
Flushes.
Full Houses.
Und sogar die Hand, von der jeder Pokerspieler träumt: ein Royal Flush.
Hände, die beim normalen Poker extrem selten sind, werden hier zu echten Möglichkeiten.
Poker-Spannung in nur 5 Minuten.
Starke Hände.
Große Bluffs.
Große Entscheidungen.
Dafür braucht ihr keine Stunden.
Taipa Supremacy: Quick Poker packt den Nervenkitzel von Poker in ein schnelles, leicht zugängliches Spiel, bei dem jeder sofort mitmachen kann.
Fünf Minuten. Ein Tisch. All-in.

There’s only one thing better than going for a walk, coming home after. Take a daunder down vennels and wee stony paths just to see what’s at the end, then make it back in time for dinner. With any luck, you’ll find better loot than your rival.

The Byways Theme deck is full of cards that let you go on small adventures, with effects that build up your Starters and let you use them over and over. It contains 24 new cards, each with unique art and abilities, and can be combined with the Core deck of A Wild Venture to create fresh experiences and new challenges!
In Letter Up, your goal is to cleverly place words to reach the edges of the playing area and claim territories.
In the two-player mode, the first player to place all 6 of their territory tokens wins the game.
In solo mode, your objective is to achieve the highest score possible.
1235.theme: Letter Up is a tactical word and territory-control game. Cleverly place your words to reach the edges of the playing area and claim territories. Nothing is ever secured: overlap letters, reshape words, and seize the advantage.

description: Each turn, roll and combine dice to race up the mountain. Get to the top to score, but don’t get knocked off! If you roll the goat symbol, activate new abilities — powers that rotate every mission. As your story progresses, you’ll unlock even more powerful abilities and face tougher challenges. The mountain itself might even transform beneath your feet.

Mountain Goats: Legacy combines dice rolling/combining and events into a longer version of Mountain Goats. But, after the first session, more and more hazards and gameplay tweaks show up. The dice now have a goat symbol — when rolled, you’ll get to use one of the unlocked player powers. These can change with every session! There’s also a new system called “Courage” that greatly affects your ability to mitigate luck and refine your dice rolls.

This game can be played as either a single session or a legacy game. As a legacy game, it is fully replayable and resettable. You will not be asked to destroy or modify components. The first session can also be combined with the original Mountain Goats game.
Meeple King enters the Arena as a sponsored asteroid!
Regular subscribers are the best: Each time a spaceship mines this asteroid, it extracts 1 extra mineral for every earlier initiative in which the same player already mined it.

Set during the height of the Portuguese spice trade in the early 16th century, Goa places you in the role of an ambitious merchant seeking wealth and influence across the Indian Ocean. Through its distinctive and highly interactive auction system, you will acquire plantations, ships and valuable opportunities while carefully managing your resources and planning for the long term.

Develop your colony, expand your shipping network and invest in increasingly powerful abilities. Every auction presents difficult decisions: bid too cautiously and a rival may secure exactly what they need, but spend too freely and you may lack the resources required to execute your own plans.

This definitive Master Print Edition gives Rüdiger Dorn’s celebrated strategy game completely renewed artwork, refined rules, a dedicated solo mode and all twelve unlocked campaign upgrades. These include triple-layered player boards, metal progress markers, upgraded cards and boards, and the new Stories and Gambit modules.

The game is available in two versions. The Merchant Edition features beautifully printed hardwood tiles with a classic, tactile feel. The Governor Edition contains the same gameplay content but replaces them with vibrant premium acrylic tiles for a sleek, modern appearance and striking table presence.
Carcassonne is celebrating its 25th anniversary with a special edition featuring a pixelated design.

Embark on a journey through time and discover brightly coloured pixel meeples and unique landscape tiles. This limited edition includes the base game, the ‘The River’ mini-expansion, and the new ‘The Pixel Fountains’ mini-expansion.
A party game of stealing goats!

Every player starts off with a small number of goats and has one aim — to be the first to get six of them into their own enclosure. The problem is that the only way to obtain them is by getting them from the other players. On your turn you draw one of the 104 Game Cards and then read out the task. This might involve flicking a goat into the target that is printed on the lid of the box. The players could stack the goats one at a time until one of the towers collapses. Other tasks include shooting a rubber band, spinning a coin, balancing, tossing or simply finding the goat that the Drawer has hidden in plain sight before fifteen seconds have elapsed. Some of the cards put two players into a challenge, others involve a third person, some include all the players at the table, and some leave you to deal with a goat-related consequence on your own.
Should you win, you take one of the other player's goats and bring it into your own enclosure; if you lose, then one of your own goats will escape.

The goats that are in your enclosure must not be touched. As for the goats that are still in your herd, they can be taken by other people. If you have six penned goats, then you are the G.O.A.T., but should you lose your last goat, all the others will win together.
Look! Your friend Lino the mammoth has found wood, stones, berries and even rare crystals! It clatters and clinks as he rolls everything down the hill.

Paleolino is a cooperative game for up to four children. Shake the hand axe to get resources. Throw the resource tokens down the mountain and remember where they land. Can you work together to build ten inventions before the hand axe is empty?
In Long live the King, your hand of cards represents your kingdom.
Hide your units cunningly to protect your King efficiently; do not let the Wrath of the people rise and destroy the opposing kingdoms.
If you lose your last Crowned head, you are out of the game.
Be the last standing kingdom to win the game!

All too often, your brave tribe has been struck by misfortune. The elders suspect that dark forces are at work and seek guidance from their ancestors. You establish ritual sites and create sacred artefacts to help you avoid danger and plan ahead.
An expansion for the game “Paleo”. In this 2021 ‘Kennerspiel des Jahres’ co-operative game, you work together as a Stone Age tribe to brave dangers and ensure your survival.
The Dice Tower enters the Arena as a sponsored asteroid!
During each initiative, the spaceships mining the most minerals from this asteroid gain the seal of excellence and score 2 extra points for it.

Tanglung is a tactical duel of quiet competition amidst glowing lanterns. Players move their matchboxes to light up lanterns and jostle for control i n an interplay of positioning, timing, and good fortune where illumination and disruption go hand in hand!
Goal: Be first to win 2 matches
3 Ways to win a match:
1. Light up the last Tanglung
2. The other player cannot move
3. Bump the other player's Matchbox twice
On your turn, choose either:
A ROOSTER ACTION
Move your Matchbox + Place the Fan
A LANTERN ACTION
Move your Matchbox + Bump the other player's Matchbox
After taking an Action,
check if any of the 3 winning conditions is met.

A silent, wordless co-op game for 2 players. Guide two trapped robots out of a hostile factory using secret action cards and a single "BEEP" warning token — talking is forbidden. Five linked campaigns, upgradeable robots, and 31 escape scenarios make every playthrough different. World premiere at Essen Spiel 2026.
Terraces of Kanoa is a tactical tile-laying game where resources and nature intertwine to shape terraces and bring a magnificent landscape to life.

To do so, you must collect resources from the shared area, then strategically place your Landscape tiles to build your own territory. Create terraces and build trees, waterfalls, and houses, placing them harmoniously to maximize your points.
Players freely build and stack tiles, watching their territory quickly evolve in height and relief.
As soon as a terrace is created (when a tile is isolated through stacking), trees, waterfalls, and houses can be built, depending on the type of landscape.
Every action has an immediate and visible impact, making the game intuitive and highly satisfying.
1247.theme: Tropical island, nature and landscape building

description: Fire is the ultimate cleansing tool: everything that has come into contact with sickness must burn. These pyromaniacs and extremists purify the cities by burning away disease and eradicating corruption. They travel from city to city, laying waste to the streets with their ruthless flames. If there is any sign of contamination, they will not hesitate to set cars ablaze—or even buildings full of people—because in their eyes the sick are already dead, and they are doing humanity a favour by stopping the spread. The Purifiers are devoted to their goal, and if anyone or anything gets in the way, it will burn too.

Neuroshima Hex: Purifiers is a new faction expansion to the best-selling Portal Games evergreen title Neuroshima Hex. The strength of this army is its ability to blanket the board in fire, making it hard for the enemy to manoeuvre without burning to a crisp. The Purifiers have many ways to add Fire to the board—Flamethrower attacks and abilities that leave Fire wherever a unit, friendly or enemy, perishes. Most units have high Initiative and a Fire Shield, letting them move through the flames unharmed.
The Arena goes bananas with the first expansion for a board game available in all fruit and vegetable shops!
Place a banana in the arena to activate Banana Mode and make yellow lasers fire backwards! They do not hit the ship that fired them.
It works with any banana. With the official one, though, you still have one to eat.

Every decision you make in Container shapes the market. During play, you build factories, produce containers, set prices, negotiate with your rivals, sail across the sea to trade, and (obviously) buy low, and sell high. At least that's the goal — but can you make it happen?

The rules for Container are simple; the real challenge is understanding and timing the market. Players build machines, warehouses, and containers, then sail your containers to the island and auction them off. Be careful with your money — in the closed economy, money's tight and your opponents are cutthroat!

At the beginning of the game, container value cards are secretly dealt to all players. Because these values aren’t shown, you’ll have to suss out what your opponents are going for throughout the game! But at final scoring, these come into play. The player with the most money wins.
Each constellation tells a story — its distinctive arrangement of stars reflecting the mythology, values, and imagination of the civilization that defined it.
Modern astronomers refine our star maps with advanced technology, while continuing that timeless quest to understand our place in the cosmos.
Two new and powerful factions are vying for supremacy in Cardia. They control the tides and unleash storms upon the city.
The Archipelago’s seafarers are deeply connected to the sea. Their ships set sail for mysterious islands that grant you decisive advantages.
The Expedition is a nomadic community of inquisitive souls who have learnt to harness the power of the wind. With their magical vials, they can unleash extraordinary powers.

Cardia - Tide & Storm is the standalone sequel to Duel for Cardia and uses the same basic rules. ‘Cardia’ is a fast-paced, strategic card game for two players: Choose your cards wisely to win every encounter against your opponent. Each player uses one of two decks, each consisting of the same cards. The cards have values ranging from 1 to 16 and possess unique abilities. Play your cards when your opponent least expects it, and use their abilities skilfully to outwit them!
Players place their gemstones across the tower's ten levels.
Each level can be opened individually by gradually "taking the tower apart." However, if an overly full level is exposed to daylight, the tower spills everything back out...

The tower's modular levels are taken apart during each turn and then reassembled in a completely different order. Players who aren't too confused by these "shifting" levels can follow the flow of the gemstones and open a level only where there is no risk of an overflow triggering a "refund." You defeat the tower by successfully depositing all your own gemstones into it.
It’s party time! Everyone in town is showing up; wearing their best, bringing gifts, and celebrating the night away. Will you be the one who throws the best party, or will it be your rival?

The Revelry Theme deck is all about playing cards at the right time, in the right order, and preferably all at once. It contains 24 new cards, each with unique art and abilities, and can be combined with the Core deck of A Wild Venture to create fresh experiences and new challenges!

Four hourglasses with different running times are hidden under cups. On their turn, a player uses a colored die to identify one of them and guesses whether its sand has run out. If they think it's still running, they say "No," do nothing, and pass the die. But... they could be wrong!
Doubters who "sense the end of time" shout "Yes!" and prove that this hourglass has already run out of sand. To do this, they lift the cup and... "Ohh!"... only time is ever right!

The hourglasses are turned over after each "test"—even if they are still running. The colored die also ensures that the hidden timers constantly change positions. This blurs the lines between space and time in some players' minds. True time management is rewarded with victory at the end of the game.
In 1703, Czar Peter founded a city that was to become Russia’s ‘window to Europe’: Saint Petersburg. It quickly developed into a centre of politics, trade and culture.
In Saint Petersburg, you’ll immerse yourselves in this historic era:
You’ll employ craftsmen, construct magnificent buildings and use the roubles you’ve earned to gain the influence of the nobility.
The classic strategy game in all its new splendour:
This graphically revamped new edition of St Petersburg, first published in 2004, includes the base game as well as the newly compiled expansion ‘Hope for a New Society’.

Puzzlide: Kaiju is a 1000-piece interactive puzzle game where completing the jigsaw is only the beginning. Once assembled, use the included 40 game cards to search for characters, objects and hidden details throughout the illustration.

But watch out: some areas of the completed puzzle are different from the image shown on the box. Discover the unexpected scenes, find what has changed and solve all the search challenges hidden in a city under attack by giant monsters!
Build the puzzle. Search the image. Discover the unexpected.

In Crescendo you will try to be the first to organize your cards in perfect order, from the lowest to the highest number. More than just having a good memory, you will have to use logic and interact with the other players in order to be the first to claim Crescendo. Draw a card or use the special power that is available. Take a chance, react quickly, and start your engines! Memorize, Sort, Gamble (Risk), React Quickly and Interact!

Deep underground lies the diamond mine. There, players drive their minecarts into the darkness to collect what no one can see. Through intuitive observation and clever maneuvering, young and old "miners" manage to steer their hidden carts to bring to light the... hopefully... most valuable collection of gemstones.

Through eight deep mine shafts, the diamonds are spectacularly transported to the subterranean vehicles, which, to the amazement of all involved, pull them out of the tunnel. Those who carefully remember where their own minecarts move in the underground labyrinth—even during the moves of their opponents—can guide them back to the surface, laden with diamonds, and thus win the game.

An archaeological team sweats their way through the excavation of a medieval English castle, hoping to find artifacts tantalizing enough to keep their research funded. When they dig up the body of one of Britain’s most infamous nobles, Baron Robert “the Cat” Graves, the team has struck gold.
Inside the case file, you'll find archaeological reports from our investigation, original documents from the 1300s (handle with care!), photos of medieval art and artifacts, plus plenty more.

In addition to the physical evidence supplied inside of the case files, you'll access additional evidence via an inbox that might aid you in proving the prime suspect innocent or guilty - but it's not easy...you'll need to be a smart investigator to get the password!

With approximately 3 hours of play time (depending on your skill level) and a difficulty rating of 4/5, this "whodunnit" style thriller will provide a fun night in for all who choose to participate. If you can't crack the case without a secret clue, hints and answers are available.

A compact, portable box contains a wobbly, rocking platform on which 2-4 players take on the roles of "high-flyers." As the game progresses ever higher, the "builders" decide whether to opt out of the lofty endeavor early to collect some "star points"—or whether to continue contributing to the thrill of a "total crash" for the lure of higher rewards.

Those who act with excessive recklessness ensure that gravity brings the entire structure—and their own ambitions—down. But those who lack courage will hardly reach for the promising stars with any profit.
Stelle dich in diesem kooperativen Brettspiel-Abenteuer den legendären Gegnern aus Dungeons & Dragons!

Horrified: Dungeons & Dragons – Neue Monster, neue Helden, neue Herausforderungen! Erlebe die spannende Fortsetzung mit 4 neuen Monstern, frischen Heldenklassen, einer neuen Kulisse und innovativem Gameplay. Nutze Teamwork, individuelle Klassenfähigkeiten und den speziellen W20-Würfel, um die Monster zu besiegen – inspiriert von der legendären D&D-Welt.

Deine Mission gegen das Böse beginnt! Tauche ein in ein eigenständiges, kooperatives Brettspiel voller Spannung und Strategie. In Horrified: Dungeons & Dragons 2 stellst du dich vier neuen, einzigartigen Monstern und verteidigst eine neue Spielwelt – inspiriert von der legendären D&D-Welt.

Wähle eine von fünf ikonischen Heldenklassen und nutze deine besonderen Fähigkeiten, um gemeinsam mit deinem Team die Monster zu besiegen. In der Heldenphase sammelst du Gegenstände, rettest Dorfbewohner und entwickelst clevere Taktiken. Doch Vorsicht: In der Monsterphase schlagen die Kreaturen zurück und bringen Chaos ins Spiel!
Nur mit Teamwork, Strategie und Mut kannst du die Rätsel jedes Monsters lösen – bevor die Angst überhandnimmt.

Step into the serene world of Kano, a tactical board game where 2 to 4 players step into the shoes of traditional Japanese artists. Your grand objective? To craft the most breathtaking Emakimono—vibrant, painted handscrolls. By navigating a shared central market, you must skillfully claim and arrange brilliant paint pots, perfectly balancing spatial puzzle-solving with clever resource management.
Mastering the Brush: Precision & Patience
Every turn demands calculated decisions as you bring your canvas to life:
Shift the Palette: Swap adjacent paint pots on the central mat to engineer the ultimate combo.
Harvest Pigments: Draft a single pot, or sweep up multiple matching colors if they line up horizontally or vertically.
Embrace Gravity: Color placement requires foresight—newly acquired paint pots always slide down to the lowest open space in a column.
Avoid Wasted Paint: Efficiency is key. Ending your turn with more than four active paint pots forces you to turn the excess into "Cloud" tiles. They fill your board, but offer zero points.
The Path to Prestige
Completing patterns allows you to transform raw pigments into stunning Artwork Tiles, unlocking points based on the scale of your ambition:
Standard Artworks: The grander the piece, the higher the reward (e.g., a 3-space masterpiece yields 7 points).
Secret Commissions: Fulfill hidden Masterpiece cards to claim a massive 12-point bonus.
The Shogun’s Mandate: Dynamic "Red" and "White" objective sheets change every game, heavily rewarding artists who adapt to the court's shifting desires.
The game concludes in a dramatic final scoring round the moment one artist completely fills their scroll. Who will adapt, optimize, and be named the Shogun's Master Artist?
Honeypot is a quick and simple I Stack, You Choose game for 1-6 players with delightful artwork by Kwanchai Moriya!

In Honeypot, players take on the role of secret agent bears trying to gather the best intel and spy supplies without getting stung! Players arrange secret caches for their opponents and carefully sift through the secret caches passed to them. The question is: how far to dig for valuable intel and spy supplies? Have your opponents passed you the sweetest honey, or a swarm of bees? In this thrilling game of setting traps and trying to avoid them, only the agent with the best instincts will capture the best set of items to come out on top!

Honeypot is a set collection game featuring a massive deck of cards so each round the combination of items is a new puzzle. Your goal is to arrange cards into groupings that will encourage your opponents to take the combinations that harm them, while also trying to determine how they have arranged the cards for you. It’s a delightfully interactive puzzle that evolves as the game progresses and your tableau of cards grows – try to collect the best intel and supplies, but beware, you may end up with items that detract from your score based on the other items you have collected.

From the team that brought you the Calico, Cascadia, and Point Salad series, this quick and simple card game has all of the stand-up moments of victory and betrayal while still being easy to teach and perfect to share with your friends and family!

Erlebt euer eigenes Abenteuer auf dem Martinshof mit Bibi und Tina! Das kleine Kälbchen Käthe ist verschwunden und nur ihr könnt das Rätsel lösen. Begebt euch auf die Suche und bringt es rechtzeitig zum Martinshof zurück.
Das Abenteuerspiel für die ganze Familie!
1) Wähle deinen Charakter
2) Entdecke deine Kreativität als Erzählerin oder Erzähler
3) Erlebe ein aufregendes Abenteuer

Bibi Blocksberg und ihre Eltern sind eine Schöpfung von Elfie Donnelly.

Star Trek: Space Hunt is an intense, real-time hidden movement game for 2 to 4 players driven by the critically acclaimed Captain Sonar system. In the vastness of the cosmos, survival demands flawless coordination, split-second communication, and razor-sharp deduction.
Asymmetric Warfare & Legendary Duos
Divided into two opposing crews, players square off in a high-stakes hunt across the stars:

Iconic Starships: Take command of legendary vessels pulled straight from the franchise’s storied history. Every ship features entirely unique builds and systems, delivering a deeply tactical, asymmetric gameplay experience.

Cross-Generational Sagas: Step into the boots of sci-fi history’s greatest pairings. Whether you choose to lead with the brilliant synergy of Captain Kirk and Spock, the analytical prowess of Captain Picard and Data, or the ruthless ambition of Khan and Joachim, the fate of the quadrant is in your hands.
Man your stations, arm the photon torpedoes, and hunt down your target before they find you!
1269.illustrators: Marc Aspinall / Oliver Barrett / Piotr Forkasiewicz / Sylvain Leroy

description: In MicroMacro Kids you are the investigators. Mysterious things are happening on the huge hidden picture map:
How did the arrow get into Harold’s hat?
Who stole the gold digger’s treasure?
And is Bigfoot really roaming the forest?
To solve these cases, you will work together as a team. You will follow clues, solve puzzles and pursue suspects – just like real detectives.
The children's version of MicroMacro, awarded Spiel des Jahres 2021.

Willkommen bei Capy Cabana! Der neue Wasserpark im Dschungel hat geöffnet und jedes Tier will eine Runde im Strömungskanal drehen! Gemeinsam helft ihr der Capybara-Badeaufsicht, den Fluss am Laufen zu halten. Stellt sicher, dass niemand heimlich eine zweite Runde dreht. Nutzt euer Gedächtnis, um doppelte Tiere unter den Blättern aufzudecken. Wenn ihr aber zu viele Fehler macht, oder der Kanal überläuft, ist das Spiel vorbei. Capy Cabana ist ein kooperatives Gedächtnisspiel voller Teamwork, Überraschungen und tropischem Spaß!

Howdy, Fremder! Willkommen im Wilden Westen! Das öde Land sieht vielleicht noch nicht nach viel aus, aber mit euch wird es im Handumdrehen florieren! Überall in der Umgebung schießen neue Siedlungen aus dem Boden, also schnell handeln, wer am Ende die beste Stadt im Westen haben will.
Es gibt viel zu tun: Gebäude errichten, Rinder eintreiben, Banditen vertreiben … und natürlich Gold schürfen. Trefft schlaue Entscheidungen, um richtig reich zu werden!

In WILED TILED WEST zählt jede Entscheidung. Baut in 16 Runden eigene Siedlungen mit den passende Plättchen und macht sie Schritt für Schritt stärker und wertvoller. Die Würfel entscheiden, welche Landschaftsplättchen ihr selbst und welche die Mitspielenden nutzen können. Beim Platzieren kommt es darauf an, Gebäude, Effekte und Gelände clever miteinander zu kombinieren.
Gleichzeitig müsst ihr euch gegen Banditen behaupten und die Stadt mit Sheriffs sichern. So entsteht ein taktisches Spielgefühl, bei dem Planung, Risiko und Anpassung eng miteinander verbunden sind.

Apocalypse is a trick-taking game where the goal is to score the fewest points by playing cards and influencing Apocalypse tokens. If all tokens are flipped, the rules change and chaos ensues. It is a redesign of Saika Banrai featuring a 5th suit, a 2-player variant, and upgraded components.

Joko Winterscheidt präsentiert: Die brandneue Buzzer-Edition mit spannenden und rasanten Spielen für einen abwechslungsreichen Spieleabend Zuhause. Das beliebte Brettspiel zur ProSieben-Show „Wer stiehlt mir die Show?" geht in die nächste Runde. Buzzert euch Runde um Runde zum Sieg und sammelt wertvolle Münzen. Stellt euch der Herausforderung und seid mal Moderator mal Kandidat.

Wie in der TV-Sendung dreht sich alles um die Frage „Wer stiehlt mir die Show?". Denn wer eine Quiz-Kategorie gewinnt, moderiert die nächste Stufe und bekommt eine wertvolle Münze. Als Moderator darf man die nächste Kategorie moderieren, und es den anderen so möglichst schwer machen, zu punkten. Nach sechs Runden zieht der beste Kandidat vorzeitig ins Finale ein und verteidigt die Show in Joko-Manier. Der Verteidiger moderiert eine letzte Gewinnstufe, in der sein Herausforderer fürs Finale bestimmt wird. Hier entscheidet sich dann, wer die Show stiehlt. Die Buzzer-Edition lässt sich eigenständig spielen oder mit dem Grundspiel kombinieren und bietet so noch mehr Abwechslung.

Erlebt euer eigenes Abenteuer auf dem Martinshof mit Bibi und Tina! In Falkenstein hat es kräftig geschneit und das große Weihnachtswettreiten steht an. Reitet um die Wette und genießt die Winterzeit auf Schloss Falkenstein!

The pack hunts. The pack fights. The pack is united. The pack needs a leader—a leader stronger than all the others, a leader more cunning than all the others, a leader who will prevail in every duel. Will you be worthy of leading The Pack?

Win duels in a row to take control of the pack. Every duel you win brings you closer to Alpha status. Win a duel as the Alpha to eliminate your opponent. Be the last Alpha left in the game to become the leader of the pack and win the game!

In this competitive version of Legendary, players seek to claim the ultimate prize: the Iron Throne! Take control of one of the great houses of Westeros with fan-favorite characters and locations. Brand new game content including Masterminds, Heroes, Villains, and more! All cards will contain original art based on the characters from the Game of Thrones! 550 cards, a rule book, deluxe play mat, player boards and everything you will need to play!

Winter is coming, and the houses of Westeros are locked in a bitter battle. Experience a thrilling world of epic warfare with Legendary: Game of Thrones Deck Building Game, in which you play as one of the Great Houses, with your own heroes to recruit and masterminds to protect. No matter who you choose, be prepared! It will take more than brute strength to prevail. You will need skill, guile, and a steady hand if you are to sit on the Iron Throne!

When the planet Chimera Prime is invaded by an unknown alien horde, the Human Planetary Sphere deploys the elite F.T.A. soldiers to turn the tide. However, what seemed like a straightforward mission quickly becomes a deadly trap for the battle‑hardened troops. Outnumbered and overwhelmed, only a suicide mission can lead them to victory. If humanity’s last squad manages to eliminate every leader of the invading force, they might escape alive — and stop the alien advance.

The Last Squadron is a card‑management game where the player faces an alien invasion. To defeat the attackers, they must position their soldiers in a way that allows them to eliminate the invading Aliens within the planet. Each Alien defeated grants immediate benefits the player can use right away. The game ends in defeat if the player runs out of soldiers, and in victory if they manage to eliminate all the Aliens.
Brettspieltisch mit abgesenkter Spielfläche und 2 Metallkufen. Durch Abdeckplatten leicht in Alltagstisch umzuwandeln.

Unterkonstruktion als integrierter Stauraum für Ablagen. Vielseitige Aufbau- und Verwendungsmöglichkeiten. Holzwerkstoff Buche sorgt für eine besonders hohe Härte und Langlebigkeit. Oberfläche ist stumpfmatt lackiert (nicht glänzend), was dem Möbelstück sowohl optisch als auch haptisch einen natürlichen Holzeffekt verleiht. Über die Varianten Farbupgrade ist alternativ auch eine Lackfinish in seidenmatt (leicht glänzend) möglich. Inklusive Spielmatte für geräuscharmes Würfeln und perfektes Gleiten deiner Spielkarten.

Turn your next game night into a chaotic, hilarious experience with Match My Beat, the ultimate party game for adults that combines music, creativity and wild debates. This is not your typical music quiz, you don’t need to know artists or release dates, just bring your sense of humor and imagination. With 400 situation cards and 200 songs across four themed playlists, no two rounds are ever the same. Each round, players match songs to different situations, from finding the perfect breakup anthem to debating the best soundtrack for an incredibly awkward moment. All you need is a phone and your favorite music app. Deal the cards, scan the QR code and let the chaos begin perfect for game nights, parties and groups of friends.
CAN YOU MATCH MY BEAT?

Das Violette Schwert ist ein immersives Rätselspiel mit spannenden Hörspielen und thematischen Rätseln. Ihr öffnet mysteriöse Umschläge mit Rätselgegenständen, die wirken, als wären sie aus einem echten EscapeRoom. Zwischendurch lest ihr Dialoge in verteilten Rollen und trefft wegweisende Entscheidungen.

Story: Ein beeindruckendes Schiff. Eine hinterhältige Crew. Ein geheimnisvoller Sarg. Auf der Fahrt von Marseille nach Rio de Janeiro spielen fünf Künstler:innen auf allen Bühnen der Ocean’s Magic, dem luxuriösen Kreuzfahrtschiff der Parzival-Schwestern - Zwillingen mit fragwürdigen Vorstellungen von Moral und Rechtschaffenheit. Welchen Crewmitgliedern könnt ihr vertrauen? Und welchen Zweck hat das antike Schwert mit der violetten Klinge, das in einem mysteriösen Sarg versteckt liegt, wirklich?
Shift the harvest from beans to pumpkins, challenging players to spread their gardens wide instead of tall while fending off beetles that threaten to devour their hard-earned leaves.

Adds a 5th playable faction - the Fey, making the game 2-5 player. Also adds a host of new content and upgrades. Expand your Core Avalon: The Riven Veil Game with the Core Myths and Monsters Box. This includes 1 Two-Tone Lord Miniatures, 10 large Mythical Beasts, 10 Faction Miniatures, 1 Double Sided Player Board, over 200 Unique Cards and over 50 other component upgrades including the Holy Grail and Excalibur Miniatures.

Diese Erweiterung enthält neue Inhalte, darunter eine Zoe-Spielfigur und Regeln für deren Einsatz im Spiel. Der Großteil der Erweiterung befindet sich jedoch in den über 12 Schachteln mit gesperrten Inhalten. Jedes Mal, wenn ein Spieler einen der 12 Meilensteine erreicht, wird eine neue Box mit Inhalten für alle freigeschaltet, wobei der Spieler, der den Meilenstein erreicht hat, seinen Namen in die Annalen der Geschichte einträgt. Einige dieser Belohnungen sind neue Varianten bekannter Elemente, wie beispielsweise neue Agenda-Karten sowie spezielle Cockpits und Antriebe. Andere sind brandneue Innovationen, darunter geheime Zielkarten und asymmetrische Charaktere.

Magische Spiegel ist ein witziges Suchspiel für 2-6 findige Kinder ab 5 Jahren. Mit Hilfe von Spiegeln suchen alle gleichzeitig halbe Dinge auf großen wimmeligen Bildkarten. Wer schafft es am schnellsten das halbe Bild durch den Spiegel ganz erscheinen zu lassen? Mit seinen drei Spielvarianten bietet das Spiel viel Abwechselung. Auch ideal als Geschenk zum Geburtstag, zu Ostern oder zu Weihnachten.

Auf den ersten Blick sind es nur bunte Karten, doch auf jeder sind viele Dinge versteckt. Wer sie entdeckt kann sie mit den magischen Spiegelkarten ganz erscheinen lassen und so einen Punkt gewinnen. Wer als erstes 10 halbe Dinge mit Hilfe der Spiegel entdeckt hat, gewinnt. Ob Löwe, Brille oder Schmetterling: Es gibt viel zu entdecken.

Macht euch bereit für ein spannendes Höhlenabenteuer! Gemeinsam erkundet ihr eine riesige Höhle. Wie im weltbekannten Videospiel warten dort Gefahren wie zum Beispiel Monster auf euch! Könnt ihr Diamanten finden und die Endermen besiegen, bevor euer Vorrat an Fackeln aufgebraucht ist? Findet nützliche Gegenstände und trefft riskante Entscheidungen. Mit 3 Leveln!

Zu Beginn jedes Durchgangs entscheidet ihr euch, ob ihr euch tiefer in die Höhle traut oder lieber zu eurer sicheren Basis zurückkehren möchtet. Bleibt ihr in der Höhle, könnt ihr Fackeln benutzen, um Licht ins Dunkel zu bringen! Leuchtet die Höhlengänge aus, um sie sicherer zu machen. Aber denkt an euren begrenzten Vorrat an Fackeln! Deckt dann der Reihe nach die Höhlenkarten vor euch auf, um zu schauen, was es dort zu entdecken gibt. Nützliche Gegenstände, Erze, Lava, tiefe Abgründe oder Monster, es kann alles sein! Setzt eure Schwerter und Spitzhacken ein, um die Höhlenkarten zu lösen. Teilt euch auf, um schneller voran zu kommen, oder seid gemeinsam stark! Buddelt euch ganz in die Tiefe, um eure Ziele zu erreichen, bevor euer Vorrat an Fackeln aufgebraucht ist - denn dann habt ihr das Spiel sofort verloren.

Mit welchen Problemen kämpfte Spock-Darsteller Zachary Quinto? Wie nennt man chinesische Astronauten? Wieviel Dollar brachte das teuerste Spielzeug der Welt bei einer Versteigerung ein? „Level Up! - Das Nerd-Quiz – 2026er Edition“ enthält erneut 99 Karten mit kuriosen Fragen aus der Nerd-Kultur: Von Science-Fiction bis Fantasy, von Computerwissen bis Geschichte, von Comics bis Wissenschaften - alles Bereiche, in denen sich ein Nerd auskennt. „Level Up!“ eignet sich am besten als Table-Quiz für größere Gruppen. Im Freundeskreis, auf Partys - oder einfach für die Raterunde zwischendurch.

Die Lemminge sind los! Der Weg zur Klippe gleicht einem Drama, denn es wird geschubst und gestochen. Jeder Lemming will ganz vorne stehen, aber nicht abstürzen. In diesem humorvollen Stichspiel ist jede gespielte Karte entscheidend. Wer Stiche gewinnt, kommt der Klippe näher. Doch wer zu weit läuft, stürzt ab! Das taktische Kartenspiel für 3-6 Personen ab 10 Jahren eignet sich perfekt als Geschenk für Draufgänger und Spielefans.

Über vier gespielte Akte ändern sich mehrfach die Laufregeln der Lemminge. Mal gilt es, viele Stiche zu gewinnen, ein andermal, sie zu vermeiden. So bietet das Spiel besonders viel Abwechslung und lang anhaltenden Spielspaß. Für etwas Schadenfreude ist ebenfalls gesorgt, denn fremde Lemminge über die Klippe zu schubsen sorgt stets für Lacher am Spieletisch. Dank einfacher Regeln und großer Varianz eignet sich Last Lemming perfekt für Familien, Stichspiel-Begeisterte und solche, die es werden wollen.

The ultimate rock and metal anthems, curated by Wacken Radio by RADIO BOB! Get ready for pure metal power! This playlist brings together rock, metal, hard rock and heavy metal classics inspired by the legendary Wacken Open Air. Featuring hand-picked hits from across the decades, including iconic international artists and bands from the festival and beyond. Put the songs in chronological order and create your own metal timeline. Play HITSTER WACKEN on its own or combine it with other HITSTER editions for even more musical fun.

Das entlaufene Schwein rennt über den Hof! Jetzt gibt es keine Zeit mehr zu verlieren. Wer kann das wuselnde Schwein mit Hilfe der Zäune fangen, bevor es deine Felder leer frisst? Schnell, locke es mit Karotten und Kartoffeln in deine Falle! Der Würfel entscheidet, welches Zaunteil umgedreht wird. Werden die Zäune geschickt gedreht, kann das Schwein in einer Falle gefangen werden. Wer die Schweinefalle besitzt, bekommt einen Chip. Wer das Schwein fünfmal fängt, gewinnt!

Das Ausgangslabyrinth der Zäune kann bei jeder neuen Spielrunde variiert werden – letztendlich beweist das Schwein aber immer wieder, dass es einen eigenen Kopf hat und ganz anders abbiegt, als erwartet! Minecraft Kakerlakak ist eine rasante und lustige Jagd mit original BrushBug® im Design des Minecraft Schweins! Das Originalspiel Kakerlakak wurde mit mehreren Preisen ausgezeichnet, unter anderem mit dem Deutschen Spielepreis als Bestes Kinderspiel 2013.

Städte auf dem Mond! Endlich nicht mehr an die Erde gebunden – der Mond, ein Sprungbrett zu den Sternen. Die Raketen sind mit Vorräten und Kolonisten beladen, die Roboter sind programmiert. Alles wurde bis ins kleinste Detail geplant es kann also nichts schief gehen ...

Moon Colony Bloodbath ist ein Engine-Builder Kartenspiel. Im Spielverlauf baut ihr euch eure Mondbasis auf. Ab einem gewissen Zeitpunkt spielen manche Roboter verrückt und "bauen eure Basis wieder ab".

AEG is proud to co-publish Cascadia: Alpine Lakes with our friends at Flatout Games. The Flatout Games team has also designed Point Salad, TEN and Truffle Shuffle for AEG and co-published Verdant, Cascadia and Calico.

In this puzzly tile-layering game, players continue the journey started in Cascadia to create the most diverse Pacific Northwest environment as they draft new double-hexagon habitat tiles and unique new wildlife tokens to build out — and up — their beautiful landscape mosaic.

Each game of Cascadia: Alpine Lakes features unique combinations of scoring objectives linked to how the five wildlife species are arranged across three different alpine habitats. Players also score for how well surrounded and elevated their lakes and wildlife are. Habitat and environment scoring cards add unique scoring conditions so that each game provides a new spatial challenge with thousands of possible combinations.

Turns are simple: Choose a habitat tile and wildlife token pair, then place them into your expanding environment. This time, each habitat tile is a double-hexagon and tiles can be stacked. Many of the core game mechanisms are similar to Cascadia, but the twist is that each habitat scores in different ways and your environment is now a three-dimensional spatial puzzle with new stacking and adjacency challenges.

Tap 4: the fast-paced, exciting, and thoroughly tactical card game for everyone ages 10 and up. Getting rid of cards from your hand sounds easy? It is! But what if you have to play cards face down? Then it’s time to cross your fingers, grit your teeth, and trust in luck. If the card is higher, the whole stack goes into your hand! That’s definitely not the way to get rid of your cards… Fast-paced rounds and hilarious moments make Tap 4 a fantastic experience you’ll never forget.

Die angeschrägte Tischplatte lässt den Tisch leichter wirken, betont den schwebenden Charakter und macht ihn noch wohnlicher. Der Spielkomfort bleibt gleich und die Abdeckplatten können weiterhin direkt im Tisch verstaut werden.
Unser ALTAR ist ein Brettspieltisch mit abgesenkter Spielfläche. Durch Abdeckplatten leicht in einen Alltagstisch umzuwandeln. Die Unterkonstruktion dient als integrierter Stauraum für Ablagen.

Vielseitige Aufbau- und Verwendungsmöglichkeiten. Mehr Beinfreiheit dank Säulenfuß. Holzwerkstoff Buche sorgt für eine besonders hohe Härte und Langlebigkeit. Oberfläche ist entweder stumpfmatt (nicht glänzend) lackiert, was dem Möbelstück sowohl optisch als auch haptisch einen natürlichen Holzeffekt verleiht. Alternativ lackieren wir die Oberfläche in seidenmatt (leicht glänzend), was dem Möbelstück eine sehr glatte Oberfläche verleiht, die als besonders handschmeichelnd empfunden wird. Inklusive Spielmatte für geräuscharmes Würfeln und perfektes Gleiten deiner Spielkarten.
Auch in Asteiche sowie wahlweise in einfarbig oder zweifarbig erhältlich.
Die Hörner im Norden rufen zum Krieg!
Die Zeit der Eroberungen ist gekommen!

Schärft eure Äxte und schickt eure Plündertrupps in die Schlacht, um Außenposten unter eure Kontrolle zu bringen. Ein früher Erfolg mag euch Ruhm versprechen … doch während Raganrök werden die Arsen selbst eingreifen.
Nur wer seine Feinde überlistet, wird am Ende den Sieg erringen!

Willkommen zu einem der rätselhaftesten Fälle in der Geschichte von Wasgij! Dieses besondere Set erweckt einen Mordfall in drei Puzzles zum Leben, die jeweils auf einem der originellen Rätselkonzepte von Wasgij basieren: Statt ein Bild zu puzzeln, müssen Vorstellungskraft und die bereitgestellten Hinweise genutzt werden, um das Puzzle zu vollenden. Die Handlung verbindet eine Flusskreuzfahrt im Jahr 2000 mit einem Wiedersehen in der Gegenwart, das eine tödliche Wendung nimmt. Unterstütze die Ermittler bei der Suche nach Hinweisen. Finde heraus, wer der Täter ist, während an Bord des Schiffes und an Land das Chaos ausbricht.
Inhalt: zwei Puzzles mit jeweils 500 Teilen, ein abschließendes Puzzle mit 1000 Teilen und zwei mit Hinweisen gefüllte Hefte, den Ermittlungsnotizen und der Fallakte von Inspektor Wasgij.
Are you ready for a mission in Europe? Dive into the world of Spy Guy and discover just how fascinating the map of Europe can be! Join Spy Guy and Spy Girl on an exciting journey through Europe!

This dynamic board game takes kids and adults alike to Europe’s biggest cities, where tourist treasures, puzzles, and a race against time await you. Split into two teams and see who can find the hidden trophies first-they’re scattered across a map full of details and colorful illustrations. Search for the treasures, choose smart routes, and don’t let your opponents pass you by-every second and every decision counts!

Forage is a puzzly tableau-building roll-and-write game for 1-6 players with gorgeous artwork by Beth Sobel! It is designed and developed by the team that brought you the Calico, Cascadia, and Point Salad series of games!

Rules are simple: Roll the forage dice and reveal a unique journey tile each round. Choose a combination of dice and carry out one of the actions: exploring, storing, or gift-giving. As you carry out actions, you’ll earn bonuses that allow you to power up your future actions or make additional moves to complete your goals! Use your time wisely – there are several journeys you can take to collect knowledge, experience, and prestige. Once you have completed your turn, you’ll choose one of the three types of cards to draw and add to your tableau giving you more ways to combo and complete goals!

Start your engines and race to 1,000 km! In this fast-paced Mario Kart–style card game, speed ahead with distance cards, block your rivals, and strike at the perfect moment. Every turn is packed with strategy, surprises, and epic comebacks. Outsmart your opponents, dodge attacks, and keep your lead. Only one player reaches the finish line first!

In diesem Kartenspiel liegt die Zukunft eures Teams in euren Händen. Folgt eurer gemeinsamen Vision und spielt eure Karten geschickt aus. Wer nur noch eine Karte hat, gewinnt den Durchgang für das eigene Team. Doch wer darf Karten ablegen und wer muss wieder Karten zurück auf die Hand nehmen? Das wissen nur die Karten.

Ein Team gewinnt, wenn es zwei Durchgänge gewonnen hat. Um das zu erreichen müssen alle ihre Karten geschickt zum richtigen Zeitpunkt ausspielen. Nach jeder Runde werden die ausgespielten Karten mit ihren 30 einzigartigen Effekten ausgewertet. Nur das Team, das eine wirklich gemeinsame Vision hat ohne sich abzusprechen, kann die Zukunft für sich gewinnen.
Backstab Heroes im hinterlistigen Team-Format!

In Backstab Heroes spielst du verdeckt Karten, um mit List und Trickreichtum den anderen Spielern die Schätze vor der Nase wegzuschnappen, während sie die Monster bekämpfen. In Zeit der Drachen lootet es sich nun gemeinsam am besten! Doch wer gehört eigentlich zu deiner Gilde und wen schubst du am besten vor die Monster? Gehe in den Dungeon und finde heraus, wer in diesem semi-kooperativen Kartenspiel Freund oder Feind ist. Denn nur die reichste Gilde gewinnt!
Zeit der Drachen funktioniert als Stand-alone. Für ein besonders hinterlistiges Erlebnis können die Karten aber zusätzlich mit anderen Backstab Heroes-Boxen gemischt werden.

Wer bei „Nobody is perfect Music Edition“ merkwürdige und skurrile Fakten über Musik und Bands glaubwürdig erklärt, kuriose Ereignisse überzeugend weiterspinnt und Zitate von Musikerinnen und Musikern genial vervollständigt, hat die besten Chancen auf den Sieg. Das witzige Musik-Quiz-Partyspiel eignet sich perfekt für 3 bis 6 Spieler.

Wer weiß schon, was mit "Dizi" gemeint ist? Welche Sängerin hat 13 Geschwister? Und welches Instrument hat jedes Jahr im April einen Feiertag? Welcher Musiker hatte einen Puma als Haustier? Wer keine Ahnung hat, dafür aber auf alles eine Antwort aus dem Ärmel schüttelt, ist hier genau richtig. Denn auch hier gilt: Wer besser spinnt, gewinnt. Kreativ sein und einen tollen Musik-Spieleabend mit Freunden haben.
The party game where speed meets music!

“Flying Mic” is the latest Hitster edition, featuring the biggest hits from the past decades. Listen to the song, grab the microphone and compete against your fellow players to win the card. The game is played in two teams. Both start with a starting card and take turns scanning songs using the free Hitster app. Whoever knows the song hits the pink buzzer on the microphone – sending it flying into the air! Whoever catches it gets to answer. The illuminated color reveals the game category. If the answer is correct, the team can place the card in the right spot on their timeline, just like in classic Hitster. Complete your timeline with eight songs and become the new Hitster! Play this edition on its own or combine it with any other Hitster edition.
as passiert, wenn das verrückte Labyrinth auf Carcassonne trifft?
