Alle Karten werden gemischt. Die Kurierkaninchen müssen jetzt die Einladung finden, damit sie zum Gast ausgeliefert werden kann.
Kommen genug Gäste zusammen, bevor die Woche vorbei ist, habt ihr das Spiel gemeinsam gewonnen.

Dixit Kids überträgt das Spielprinzip seines großen Bruders perfekt in eine kindgerechte Version. Die 84 neuen, speziell für Kinder illustrierten Karten, sind mit allen weiteren Spielen aus dem Dixit-Universum kompatibel.

In One Piece: Das Merkspiel versucht ihr, zusammenpassende Paare der ikonischsten One Piece-Charaktere zu finden, bevor es eure Mitspieler tun. Aber Achtung, versucht es den anderen nicht zu einfach zu machen, indem ihr ihnen versehentlich Vorlagen liefert. 50 Karten mit den beliebten Charakteren aus One Piece stellen euch dabei auf die Probe. Mit 2 unterschiedlichen Schwierigkeitsstufen, die euch so richtig herausfordern.

CRACK THE CLUES AND BE THE FIRST TO GUESS THE SECRET WORD!Find the correct word before your opponents by carefully analyzing the clues and making logical guesses. Up to 9 Clue cards of different types are used to reveal letters of the word. The type of clue you get depends on the color of the card.
During each round, take notes of the clue on your player board and make guesses by cross-referencing it with the previous ones.
The fewer clues you need to find the correct word, the more points you score, but don’t be too greedy or you might not win anything at all!
You can adapt the difficulty of the game by using a different number of Clue card of each type.
KEY POINTSA competitive family word and guessing game
Be the fastest to analyze the clues and pull your conclusions
Clues of adaptable difficulties for a high replayability

Aventuria: Kelche der Macht ist eine epische, vollständig kooperative Abenteuerkampagne im Aventuria-Universum. In 11 großen Abenteuern mit über 30 Akten und rund 60 Stunden Spielzeit stellt ihr euch einem Wettlauf gegen finstere Mächte um die sieben magischen Kelche.

Wählt aus 12 einzigartigen Helden und Heldinnen, entdeckt neue Pfade, erlebt Entscheidungen mit Folgen und bekämpft eure Widersacher mit maßgeschneiderten Heldendecks voller Ausrüstung, Zauber und Fähigkeiten. Jede besiegte Bedrohung bringt neue Belohnungen: Schatzkarten, Begleiter und neue Fähigkeiten erweitern eure Möglichkeiten – ganz im Stil eines Rollenspiels, aber in Form eines erzählerisch starken Brettspiels.
Über 900 Karten enthalten – kein weiteres Spielmaterial notwendig.

In Good Fortune, every tile you place is a strategic choice, every connected charm can bring luck and move you closer to victory. A duel that is both intense and contemplative — but don’t let the beauty of the lucky charms distract you from your strategy, because one small mistake and fortune will turn. Designed as a pocket game, accessible within minutes, Good Fortune follows in the tradition of clever and fast-paced head-to-head games that create suspended moments you’ll want to replay again and again.
Horrible Couple ist ein Partyspiel, bei dem ihr sehr unangenehme Comics zum Thema Liebe zusammenstellt.

Quietbell is a story-driven mystery adventure inspired by the works of Howard Phillips Lovecraft. You’ll experience an engaging interactive narrative whose outcome depends entirely on your choices and actions. As you play, you will assemble a picture step by step and unravel the tangle of fates and events that once shook the enigmatic town of Quietbell.
The game features a "nonlinear communication" mechanic, allowing the player to interact with various in-game characters on different topics at their discretion.

In uralten Zeiten wurde die Welt von Drachen und Dämonen beherrscht. Sie waren die Urkräfte, von denen die Welt und ihre urtümliche Materie geformt wurden. Sie waren die gegensätzlichen Grundprinzipien der Welt: Recht und Ordnung gegen Chaos und Wahnsinn. Drachen gegen Dämonen.

Dragonbane ist ein Fantasy-Rollenspiel voller Magie, alter Geheimnisse und Abenteuer – von Grund auf konzipiert als ein schnelles und rasantes Spiel ohne lange Vorbereitungszeit und mit einfach zu leitenden Abenteuern.

Dieses Buch enthält die kompletten W20-basierten Dragonbane-Regeln für Charaktererschaffung, Fertigkeiten, Kampf und Magie. Zudem eine Auswahl von Gegnern und Monstern, Hinweise und Werkzeuge für die Spielleitung zur Gestaltung eigener Abenteuer sowie das Einstiegsabenteuer Die Burg des Raubritters.

Im humorvollen Partyspiel Let’s Match versucht ihr und euer Teampartner, das perfekte Paar zu werden. Anhand eines von hunderten spannenden Themen wählt ihr dazu aberwitzige Bildkarten aus euren identischen Kartendecks aus, von denen ihr glaubt, dass sie am besten zum Thema passen. Je ähnlicher eure Auswahl ist, desto mehr Punkte bekommt ihr. Was passt besser zum Thema „Albtraum“ als die traurige Braut – vielleicht doch das grinsende Clownsgesicht? Da sind Missverständnisse, Überraschungen und viele Lacher garantiert! Sammelt die meisten Punkte und rennt den gegnerischen Teams davon! Denn es kann nur ein perfektes Paar geben, und das seid ihr, oder?

Mit den Unlock! Short Adventures können Rätselfans den ganzen Spielspaß von Unlock! in einer kürzeren, aber genauso aufregenden Version erleben. Die vielfältigen Abenteuer dauern circa 30 – 45 Minuten, haben drei Schwierigkeitsgrade und sind dank handlicher Verpackung ideal als Mitbringsel oder zum Mitnehmen geeignet.
In dem Fall Der Aufstieg besteigt ihr den Berg Celestine, um euren verschollenen Großvater zu finden.

Oshi Push is a one-of-a-kind trading card game that puts you in the spotlight as a VTuber competing for online fame. Choose your Persona and build a deck full of unique Content, Action, and Upgrade cards to boost your influence and dominate Platforms.
Your goal? To amass 1,000,000 Subscribers and become the ultimate online sensation!

Each Persona is inspired by the vibrant world of VTubing, with gameplay mechanics that reflect the creativity, strategy, and energy that make VTubers so beloved. Whether you’re producing viral Content, battling for control of Platforms, or upgrading your Persona’s abilities, every turn feels like a new step in your journey to digital stardom.

Hidden Links is the new expansion for Oshi Push, featuring Indie Vtubers and fun new game mechanics, such as Collab cards and Premium Talent cards. In addition, we have many cards with great new abilities to try out and keep the game fun and interesting!

Im Familienspiel Carnuta geht es darum, durch geschicktes Sammeln von Zutaten, strategische Planung und den Einsatz von Sonne- und Mond-Runen die besten Zaubertränke zu brauen. Jeder Spieler führt in seinem Zug zwei Aktionen aus, wie das Sammeln von Zutatenkarten, das Platzieren von Runen oder das Ausspielen von Zutatenkarten. Das Spiel endet, sobald ein Spieler 11 Karten vor sich ausliegen hat, gefolgt von der finalen Punktewertung.
Nutze deine Runen weise, indem du sie zum richtigen Zeitpunkt umdrehst und stelle die optimale Zutatenmischung zusammen, um den höchsten Punktestand zu erreichen.

Thomas, Malia und Ken lieben es, Starport-Abenteuer zu erleben – ganz besonders dann, wenn sie von Thomas‘ Vater geleitet werden. Dieses Abenteuer ist jedoch anders als alle, die sie je zuvor erlebt haben.

Die drei Kinder müssen als ihre tapferen Spielercharaktere Blaze, Angel und Orion in das Drachenreich reisen, um ein Ei zu retten, das von einem Kristalldrachen gestohlen wurde. Das Reich ist voll von widerlichen Kreaturen, herausfordernden Rätseln, wunderschönen Flüssen, köstlichen Früchten, wilden Dschungeln und atemberaubenden Bergen.

Diese Geschichte spielt in der einmaligen Welt von Starport. Sie nimmt euch mit auf eine spannungsgeladene Reise und fördert dabei gleichzeitig die Entwicklung von kooperativem Verhalten, Problemlösungskompetenzen, kritischem Denken und vielem mehr!
Geschrieben von spielenden Lehrenden – Ein Brückenschlag zwischen Schule und Spiel.
Dieses Buch enthält die folgenden neuen Inhalte, die in dem Starport-Rollenspiel verwendet werden können:
Neue Kreaturen
Neue Ausrüstung
Neue Tiergefährten
Neue Rätsel, Gedankenspiele und Witze

"War for Eterna" is set in the same world as the dungeon-crawling pen-and-paper RPG "Everrealms of Eterna." Connections between the two games are therefore intentional—such as shared class names and thematically similar abilities.

Demons have plunged the world of Everrealms of Eterna into chaos. Where flourishing lands once stood, a demonic void now reigns. As the leader of one of four unique classes, you and your fellow players must restore the shattered world, summon powerful creatures, and lead your armies to victory.

Explore the map, establish territories, and secure mana and powerful bonuses. Assemble armies of up to five creatures and utilize their unique abilities to defeat your opponents. Combat outcomes are determined by attack, defense, and a d20 roll—yet your positioning and strategy are crucial.

After every round, the demons turn against you: event cards summon new enemies, destroy lands, unleash powerful spells, or force demons to attack. You decide which events and demons enter the game and how many events are triggered per round—thereby determining the match's difficulty level.

Im abstrakten Duell-Spiel Qomet müsst ihr wortwörtlich dafür sorgen, dass eure Sterne günstig stehen. Platziert eure Sterne auf dem Spielbrett und bewegt sie so, dass ihr euren Gegner überrascht. Wer zuerst ein Quadrat aus vier seiner Sterne bilden kann, gewinnt.

Beim schlüpfrigen Partyspiel Du kleiner Freak lernt ihr gegenseitig eure schmutzigsten Geheimnisse kennen. Zuerst beantwortet ihr brisante Fragen, indem ihr euch auf einer Skala von 1 bis 5 einordnet, ohne dass die anderen es sehen können, und dann versuchen alle anderen, eure Antworten zu erraten. Habt ihr die Antwort richtig auf dem Freak-O-Meter eingeordnet? Super, ihr wisst ganz schön viel übereinander! Ihr liegt richtig daneben? Dann steckt in euren Freunden wohl mehr Freak, als ihr gedacht habt … Ihr spielt als Team, also gewinnt oder verliert ihr alle gemeinsam!

If we are able to maintain the health and diversity of our garden, then it will fill up with life and become a refuge for fascinating creatures. Hummingbirds and bees are the first to arrive, filling the air with color and movement, but if we stop and observe with more attention, we will discover a hidden and unknown world: tiny inhabitants abound in the mushrooms, puddles, and foliage. They are under our feet, living out their lives without being perceived...until we decide to look under the leaves.
Each turn in Under the Leaves is played in two phases: the placement of a garden tile, then the possible arrival of new beings. Whoever gets the most pieces in total wins.

Bloops ist ein lustiges Partykartenspiel für die ganze Familie. Tauche ein ins Spiel und merke dir drei deiner Karten. Fische nach guten Karten und wirf die zurück ins Wasser, die du nicht brauchst... ohne sie zu verwechseln!

Im kooperativen Kinderspiel wollt ihr die namensgebende Fritzi Vogelscheuche wieder aufbauen, nachdem ein Sturm leider alles durcheinandergebracht hat. Die Karten auf der Vogelscheuchen-Tafel zeigen euch, aus welchen Bausteinen die Vogelscheuche besteht und in welcher Reihenfolge sie gestapelt werden müssen. Das müsst ihr im Auge behalten und euch merken, welche Bausteine in euren Beutel gewandert sind, um sie zum richtigen Zeitpunkt herauszuziehen. Nehmt euch dabei in Acht vor den Vögeln, die das Spiel schneller beenden können, als euch lieb ist. Schafft ihr es, Fritzi rechtzeitig wieder aufzurichten?
Mit tollem Holzmaterial und innovativen Mechanismen sorgt Fritzi Vogelscheuche für kurzweiligen kooperativen Spielspaß und fördert das Gedächtnis sowie das Erkennen und Erfühlen von Formen.

As a science journalist hosting a symposium on the chambered nautilus, you're counting on a renowned expert to close the show. When they mysteriously fail to appear, you must balance running the event with searching the aquarium. Can you find the missing expert and save the symposium before time runs out?

Endangered Rescue: Chambered Nautilus is an 18Escape adventure created in partnership with Science Friday to support Cephalopod Week. Every game purchased supports independent science journalism. Stay connected to the awe and joy of science all year with Science Friday's flagship newsletter Week in Science.
This entry in the series takes about an hour to solve, and is rated 2 out of 3 in difficulty.
Al-Kahuf is an adventure detective game inspired by the works of Howard Phillips Lovecraft.

You’ll experience an engaging interactive story whose outcome depends entirely on you and your choices. You are about to set out in the footsteps of a missing expedition that had been exploring the area near the town of Al-Kahuf before vanishing in the scorching sands of Egypt. Talk to characters, explore locations, carry out excavations. The outcome of the story will depend on your actions, choices, and deductions.
The game features a "nonlinear communication" mechanic, allowing the player to interact with various in-game characters on different topics at their discretion.

The environment is at a tipping point. Australia’s wildlife habitats face devastation, but with your leadership, their future can be rewritten. It's time for you to take action and restore balance before it’s too late!

Step into the most ambitious Endangered expansion yet, packed with Bold new characters, Immersive new scenarios, Groundbreaking mechanics, Strategy deeper than ever before. Every scenario is a battle for survival. Each one more intricate, more demanding, more thrilling than the last.
Endangered: Australia includes:
The Great Barrier Reef – Defend one of the world’s natural wonders! Guard predator-prey chains, restore coral health, and protect an ecosystem in constant flux.
The Giant Barred Frog – For the first time, you must remove animals to heal the balance. Stop invasive Cane Toads before they drown the land in chaos.
The Koala – Fuzzy, iconic, and game-changing. Koalas bring Attachments, a brand-new mechanic that forces you to rethink every move.
The Prime Minister – Wield the might of government itself! Eight unique cards give you unparalleled authority to sway the course of history.
New Ambassador Type – A power broker unlike any other, building influence automatically and unlocking daring new tactics for victory.

Als einer der drei Monde über Lorakis barst, blickten die unterdrückten Völker furchtsam gen Himmel, um das unheimliche Schauspiel zu betrachten. Zu diesem Zeitpunkt ahnte noch niemand, dass unter dem Splittermond eine neue Ära anbrechen sollte, die sie von den Ketten ihrer Drachlingsherrscher befreien und die Völker von Lorakis in ein neues Zeitalter führen sollte.

Dieser Schnellstarter bietet einen vereinfachten Einstieg in die Splittermond-Regeln, einen Überblick über die Spielwelt Lorakis, 6 vorgefertigte Abenteurer und ein vollständiges Abenteuer, das Ihre Gruppe in das dreigeteilte Reich Zhoujiang führt.

Aventuria – Beschwörer der Elemente ist ein Heldenset für die zweite Edition von Aventuria – Das Abenteuerbrettspiel. Es enthält das komplette Heldendeck des Konzilsmagiers Kilgor Hazenthag sowie eine alternative Heldenversion mit Beliseth sal Sadia. Mit 70 Karten und einem eigenen Erfahrungsschatz bringt dieses Set einen vielseitigen, zaubermächtigen Charakter ins Spiel – perfekt für alle, die Elementarkräfte und fintenreiche Spielzüge lieben.

Do you dare venture into the Tricky Forest? In the shade of the trees, gangs of field mice, tree frogs, lizards, and finches are planning their next raids. New alliances form in every trick round, and every decision can change the course of the game. Four wittily illustrated animal teams—each with numerical values from one to ten and special abilities—ensure surprising twists and turns. Whoever joins the winning team at the right moment collects silver coins. Fast-paced rounds keep the excitement high and make the game an entertaining experience for trick-taking fans, families, groups of friends, and anyone who wants to combine a dose of team spirit with a bit of strategy. After four raids, the player who has hoarded the most silver coins wins. Ages 10 and up.
Unlock! Risky Adventures bringt drei neue, riskante Abenteuer in der beliebten Escape-Reihe Unlock!.
Im ersten Fall lauscht ihr den spannenden Erzählungen eures Opas und begebt euch mit ihm auf die abenteuerliche Suche nach Königin Altipias Krone.
Ihr spielt als Herr Hase, dem kultigen Helden aus den Comics von Lewis Trondheim. Ihr habt ein unvergessliches Date mit eurer Freundin, doch nichts läuft wie geplant!
In Undercover in Little Italy plant eine der mächtigsten Mafias von New York einen großen Coup.

In Live-Escape-Rooms werden die Teilnehmer eingeschlossen und müssen es innerhalb von 60 Minuten schaffen, den Raum zu verlassen. Die Spiele der Unlock!-Reihe lassen euch dieses kooperative Erlebnis, unterstützt durch eine App, am heimischen Spieltisch erleben.

Gyges bringt den abstrakten Klassiker 40 Jahre nach Ersterscheinung in einer neuen, edlen Auflage auf den Tisch. In einem strategischen Duell der Extraklasse gilt es, zuerst einen Ring auf die gegnerische Seite des Spielbretts zu bringen. Dabei muss man sehr gut aufpassen, keine Steilvorlage für den Gegner zu geben, denn alle Ringe können von beiden Spielern bewegt werden.

Trotz einfacher Regeln bietet Gyges eine unglaubliche strategische Tiefe, bei der jede Partie bis zum Schluss spannend bleibt. Das atemberaubende Material mit Metallringen und graviertem Spielbrett rundet das Spielerlebnis perfekt ab.

Der Gefallene Fürst ist besiegt. Die Gefahr für Wintholt und den Immersommerwald ist gebannt. Vorerst. Denn die Geschehnisse aus Ein Hauch von Frost haben auch Erkenntnisse zu Tage gefördert, aus denen hervorgeht, dass eine noch viel größere Gefahr droht – für Wintholt, und vielleicht für ganz Dragorea.
Es ist an der Zeit, den Rastlosen zur letzten Ruhe zu betten.

Dieses Buch ist der zweite Teil der Kampagne Das Ende des Sommers, mit der wir das 10-jährige Jubiläum von Splittermond feiern. Der zweite Band enthält die Abenteuer Wissen ist Nacht und Die letzte Rast, in denen die Ereignisse aus dem ersten Band zu einem Ende geführt werden.

In den Tiefen der Reißzahnfeste stoßen die Abenteurer auf Geheimnisse, die niemandem in Lorakis bekannt sind. Aber um die Gefahr endgültig zu bannen, reicht die Kraft der Abenteurer nicht aus. Um sich ihren Feinden zu stellen, brauchen sie Verbündete. Diese gilt es jetzt zu finden, denn eines ist klar: Im Licht des letzten Wintermondes wird sich das Schicksal von Wintholt entscheiden.

Sunfield Farm is renowned for the quality of its vegetables and its charming animals! Expand your farm by placing Field tiles, grow your vegetables, rear your animals and fulfil the village’s requests. It’s up to you to organise your plots and manage your resources as effectively as possible to become the most popular farmer!

Most of your turns begin by taking a Field tile from those available on the central board. Depending on the position of the tile you choose, you will either need to plant seeds or be able to collect them. You then place the tile in your Plot and grow the Vegetables found there on adjacent Fields or those of the same colour. When a tile is completed, you harvest all the Vegetables on it and place them in your Wheelbarrow. The harvested Vegetables allow you to fulfil Customer orders and score victory points. A completed Field also becomes a Pasture, which can accommodate an Animal that you can deliver in sets of three to earn points. Collecting the right Customer cards will earn you extra points from medals and Reputation tiles. As soon as either the Field or Customer draw piles is empty, the game ends!

The game’s Advanced mode introduces several new mechanics! Livestock pens grant access to a track of asymmetric powers that are unlocked by delivering Animals. In this mode, you’ll also score points by optimising your Pasture area.

Im Kennerspiel The Witcher: Pfad des Schicksals Ronin spielt ihr als die Ronin-Versionen von Geralt, Ciri, Yennefer, Rittersporn, Vesemir, Triss oder Yuki Onna und nutzt ihre Spezialfertigkeiten sowie einzigartigen Karten, um furchtlos den Pfad des Schicksals zu beschreiten.

Es ist ein kompetitives Spiel, in dem ihr euer Tableau mit Karten aufbaut. Ihr übernehmt jeweils die Rolle von einem Charakter aus einer einzigartigen alternativen Version des Witcher-Universums und schmiedet zerbrechliche Allianzen. Spielt Karten aus und nutzt Spezialeffekte, um Symbole zu sammeln, die eure Entscheidungen repräsentieren. Ihr seid zwar Mitglieder ein und desselben Teams, dennoch werdet ihr gegeneinander antreten, um euren Namen in den Geschichtsbüchern zu verewigen.
The Witcher: Pfad des Schicksals Ronin ist ein eigenständiges Spiel und nicht kompatibel mit The Witcher: Pfad des Schicksals oder seinen Erweiterungen.

June 27, 1898, Baler, Principe District, Luzon Island (Philippines). With the arrival of the Filipino insurgents from the Katipunan and in the midst of the Spanish-American War, a Spanish detachment made up of 53 soldiers and the local priest took refuge behind the walls of the town church, remaining completely isolated. Thus began one of the longest sieges in history that lasted 337 days, where the Spanish, despite suffering so many hardships, defended the last Spanish overseas position with great heroism. It would not be until June 2, 1899, when the act of capitulation was signed. Discover and enter a siege so unique to this exciting.
Heroes of Baler

On April 27, the US fleet of the Asiatic Squadron, commanded by Commodore Dewey, left Hong Kong for the Philippines. On May 1, he reached Manila Bay and defeated the Spanish fleet, commanded by Admiral Montojo, resulting in its entirety being sunk. The Cavite arsenal and plaza surrendered to the Americans the next day. The Battle of Cavite marked the beginning of the end of the Spanish presence in the Philippines. On May 19, Aguinaldo returned to the Philippines on a US ship to lead the revolution, which spread throughout the island of Luzon. At the end of May, news reached Baler about the start of the war against the United States and the defeat of the Spanish fleet in Cavite. These were some of the last news received by land from abroad since the rebels prevented the passage of news through the mountains. The Spanish in Baler were completely cut off.

The Filipinos tried at all costs to demonstrate to the Spanish detachment that the war had ended, but despite the numerous attempts at parliament that occurred during the months of siege, the Spanish refused to capitulate and surrender the plaza outright.

After numerous attacks and attempts to take over the church by the Filipinos, it would not be until the morning of June 2 when Martín Cerezo began to reread the newspapers that Aguilar had left behind and those, he thought were Filipino forgeries in order to confuse them. for them to give up. In one of them, he found a small review that made him see that the newspapers were true, as well as his news: he realized that the war was over and that there was no point in continuing to fight. The review, within the section of military destinations, was the announcement of the new destination in Malaga of the lieutenant of the scale of the Infantry reserve Francisco Díaz Navarro. Martín Cerezo had coincided with the officer, of whom he was a close friend, before he was assigned to Cuba. Díaz had told him that at the end of the campaign he planned to request a transfer to the Andalusian capital, where his girlfriend and her family lived, so Martín Cerezo accepted the news as true and, by extension, all the newspapers and news that Aguilar had left for the that finally, that same day, the capitulation of the Spanish detachment took place.
THE GAME

Heroes of Baler is a tactical game where players will take control of one of the two available sides (Spanish or Filipino). Both sides are asymmetrical so that the victory conditions and the way of playing are different for each side. Throughout the game the players (besieger and besieged) will try to achieve victory by carrying out firefights, raids, artillery attacks, repairs, trench construction...

This is a game for 1 to 2 players with a game length within one and two hours. In the two-player game each player will take the role of besieger (Filipino) or besieged (Spanish). In the solitary mode, the player will take the control of the Spanish as besieged faction.

Each game turn represents approximately two months of siege. The main panel represents the town of Baler with the church that the Spanish defended in the center and around it the Filipino bahays and trenches. In addition, the board shows two exclusive areas one for each player.

Based on an game system which mix hand management and action points, the turn begins with the initiative phase where each side will try to seize the initiative in turn order. Next, in turn order the players will play their event phase where they may play up to two event cards and may play support cards to power up the played event(s) if they meet the requirements. Once this phase is finished, the events phase takes place where the Spanish player will have to deal with the lack of food that triggers the beriberi epidemic and the desertions while the Filipino side will have to deal with the supply of supplies and from the turn 4 with E.E.U.U. The player with the initiative will proceed to perform a mandatory firefight phase. After this phase comes the action phase. In turn order, players will play the rest of the cards in their hand as action points. The player second in turn order will proceed with the second phase of mandatory shootouts. Finally, a maintenance phase is carried out where the players will check victory conditions, take enemy fog of war cards and decide whether to give them to the enemy in exchange for a common card or keep them in their discard and prevent the enemy from obtaining that card. Finally, the military units are replaced in empty guard posts and detachment area, leader check rolls are made, and the next turn is prepared finally.
1455.theme: Embrace history to discover and recreate this heroic siege unknown to many

description: Who can resist the sweet scent of honey filling the woods? The bears of Bear Sting are certainly blown away by it and start their search for the liquid gold. The more bees surround them, the closer they get! But beware: Coming too close to the beehive will earn you quite a few stings!

WHAT’S NEXT?! Europäische Städte is the latest addition to our WHAT‘S NEXT?! series. It is a quiz based on a special concept: 5 European cities are placed face-up in the middle. Then, another European city card is added to the cluster. Now you have to guess which of these 5 cities is geographically closest to the 6th. If your guess is the best, you gain points!
1457.theme: Cities, Europe, Geography, Quiz, Knowledge, Guessing

description: Dieses Würfelset für Midgard – Legenden von Damatu enthält 6 Würfel – je 2 dreiseitige, sechsseitige und zwanzigseitige Würfel in der Farbe Damatus Flüsse.

Das Fantasy-Rollenspiel Midgard – Legenden von Damatu versetzt euch in eine aufregende Welt im Umbruch. Stürzt euch ins Abenteuer – und werdet selbst zu Legenden von Damatu! Zum Spielen wird das Grundregelwerk von Midgard – Legenden von Damatu benötigt.

Mutabo Family & Kids brings you over 100.000 new, funny, little stories! Going round, you draw a picture for a sentence, then write a sentence for another picture. At the end, you get your sheet back. When you unfold your story, you will see how unexpected and funny your story developed.

In Leafwork, there’s plenty to discover beneath the fallen leaves of this forest teeming with creatures scurrying and crawling everywhere! Use your magnifiers strategically and find as many matching forest creatures as you can under the leaves. You might even come across some fruits or mushrooms. Only with the right strategy you will master Leafwork!

Schicksalsmünzen verleihen deiner Spielfigur die Fähigkeit, ihr Schicksal zu beeinflussen. Diese Münzen für Midgard – Legenden von Damatu helfen dir dabei, den Überblick über deinen Vorrat an Schicksalsmünzen zu bewahren und dein Spiel immersiver zu gestalten.
Das Fantasy-Rollenspiel Midgard – Legenden von Damatu versetzt euch in eine aufregende Welt im Umbruch. Stürzt euch ins Abenteuer – und werdet selbst zu Legenden von Damatu!
Ausreichend für 4-5 Spielende. Zum Spielen wird das Grundregelwerk von Midgard – Legenden von Damatu benötigt.

Welcome to Moonstone Magic Academy. Your final trial will begin at sunset. Prove that you can master spells and harness the power of the runes. But beware – someone is scheming in the shadows to sabotage you!
1462.theme: Magic School, Wizards, Witches, Escape Room, Riddles, Logic

description: In Fadenfroh, you place fabric cards in your display. You receive victory points for the colors and symbols on the fabric cards in your display. When and for what exactly you receive victory points depends on the scoring cards of the current round.

However, your opponents are competing with you for fabric cards and useful materials. So, every round you have to decide anew: How long can I take materials before someone snatches up the ideal fabric cards?
Whoever has the most victory points at the end of the game wins!

Welcome to YENA: Succession War, a space-opera simultaneous action-bidding and worker-placement board game set in the chaotic but charismatic Star Systems. After the death of your mafia state's leader, you must fight your way to the top by any means necessary. Build your criminal faction, recruit unique allies, take on dangerous contracts and expand your influence across the galaxy.

At the criminal heart of the Star Systems lies YENA - a colossal deep-space vessel the size of a small city. Feared across the galaxy but beloved by those who call it home, YENA sets the scene for the galaxy's ultimate Succession War.
Your goal is to become the next leader of YENA by contributing the most to the federation.
Language-independent remake of Japanese original “Once Upon a Time in Phlogiston”.
1464.theme: Original sci-fi anime universe; Pyreswill Chronicles

description: Tsukuyumi – Leadership Cards Wave 2
The Leadership Cards Wave 2 expand the Standee Edition of Tsukuyumi with the Leadership Cards for factions that have been released over the past few years.
Leadership Cards are included for:
⏳ Chronomasters
☀️ Circle of the Sun
✝️ Dark Crusade
🛡️ First Guardians
🌊 Reef Collective
⚔️ Sisters of Seven
🎪 Moon Circus
The set contains a total of 21 cards, including the 2-player cards for Dark Crusade.
This expansion is primarily intended for owners of the Tsukuyumi Standee Edition. In the Miniature Edition, the corresponding Leadership Cards are already included in the respective faction boxes.
Contents: 21 cards
Language: English
Version: Standee
Requirement: A Tsukuyumi base game is required to play.
Dieses Kartendeck für Midgard – Legenden von Damatu enthält einhundert individuelle Spielkarten mit je einer der hundert Schicksalsgaben aus dem Grundregelwerk.

Verleiht den legendären Fähigkeiten eurer Spielfiguren noch mehr Gewicht, indem ihr eure Schicksalsgaben verdeckt zieht und im richtigen Moment ausspielt! Dieses Kartendeck erleichtert euch sowohl die Verwaltung von als auch das Spiel mit euren Legenden.

Das Fantasy-Rollenspiel Midgard – Legenden von Damatu versetzt euch in eine aufregende Welt im Umbruch. Stürzt euch ins Abenteuer – und werdet selbst zu Legenden von Damatu! Zum Spielen wird das Grundregelwerk von Midgard – Legenden von Damatu benötigt.

Terravista is a fast and accessible roll-and-write game for 1–6 players, where every line you draw shapes your path to victory. Designed by Eilif Svensson (Trails of Tucana) and Åsmund Svensson, it combines simple rules with rewarding route-building decisions.

Each player receives an asymmetric map and sets out to build roads connecting olives, oranges, and strawberries to their markets, while also linking matching market pairs for additional progress. With virtually no setup time, the game begins in seconds but offers meaningful choices from the very first roll.

Each round, two dice determine which terrain types can be connected, and all players simultaneously draw a road between adjacent spaces on their own map. Completing connections advances players along shared tracks, unlocking bonus spaces that can trigger satisfying chain reactions of additional roads.

The asymmetric maps and the uneven distribution of terrain combinations on the dice create a subtle puzzle: some connections are easier to complete than others, rewarding players who plan ahead and adapt their routes as the game unfolds.
The first player to complete three connections on all four tracks wins the game.
Terravista includes 12 unique maps across 6 double-sided boards, special dice, dry-erase markers, and multiple game modes, including solo play, point-based scoring, and a tournament variant.
DREH DIE KARTE – DREH DAS SPIEL!
WENDO – DAS FAMILIENSPIEL, BEI DEM JEDE KARTE ALLES DREHEN KANN!
° SUPER EINFACHE REGELN
° SPANNUNG BEIM UMDREHEN JEDER KARTE

A streamlined, peaceful civilization game where you play from stone age to space age in 90 minutes .
Recruit historical persons, create inventions, explore, and make your own history.
Timespan | Board Game | BoardGameGeek
Navigate the board strategically, equip powerful weapons and equipment, mount trusty steeds, and use action cards wisely to outmaneuver your opponents in tactical showdowns.
Every location offers new opportunities. Every card drawn could change your fate. Every die roll could be your last.

Wild World is a dynamic 1–4 player strategy game that blends worker placement, multi-use cards, engine-building, and tactical monster combat into one seamless, combo-driven experience. Set across five elemental realms — Forest, Ocean, Fire, Frost, and Magic — players gather fantastical creatures, explore vivid regions, evolve their champions, and brew powerful potions as they race to score the most points over three rounds.

What makes Wild World stand out is the freedom and flexibility baked into every turn. You may perform a number of different free actions — placing cards to strengthen your engine, traveling through realms for rewards and prestige, or discarding for resources — allowing each turn to unfold as a meaningful puzzle. Every card has multiple uses, and clever sequencing often triggers reward chains that lead to explosive, satisfying combos.

At the heart of the game are the mighty monsters guarding the world. Defeating them will give you permanent abilities, immediate bonuses, scoring conditions, new workers, and prestige, but reaching them requires smart planning: evolving creatures, upgrading your potion-brewing, unlocking stronger foes, and assembling the perfect moment to strike.

With multiple strategic paths, escalating tension, and thrilling bursts of synergy, Wild World offers a richly re-playable adventure in which every decision matters — and every turn can become something special.
1943. Europa brennt.
Ihr seid eine Elite-Einheit von Vampir:innen.
Eure Mission: Adolf Hitler in Paris finden, austrinken und damit die Nazi-Kriegsmaschine aufhalten.

Ein schnelles, leicht zu lernendes und brutales Rollenspiel, in dem man sich als Vampire in einer alternierenden Vergangenheit durch das Paris des zweiten Weltkrieges metzelt, Nazis besiegt und letztendlich den Krieg beendet.
*BLOOOOOOM* is a very easy but very deep and fun path planning game. Focus and variate in your path to collect the best flowers.
The goal is simple: be the last one standing.

Each player must manage the Revolver tokens and their three Skill tokens. The Skill tokens represent both the player’s abilities and their remaining lives, which they must preserve to stay in the game. This game is not for the faint of heart...
On your turn, either shoot (the stack of tokens has 7 "clicks" and 1 "bang!") or activate one of your 3 skills (which will be turned face down).
Skills can range from passing the turn to another person and reordering the stack of shots to cancelling another skill or making someone shoot twice.
If you reveal a "click" when shooting, you will turn one of your skill tokens face up. If you reveal a "bang!", you will lose one of your face-up skill tokens.
A player will be eliminated if they reveal a "bang!" and all their tokens are face down or if they have no tokens left... until only one player remains.
Your head makes all the decisions, but your heart has the final say.
Florence, 15th century.
The greatest cathedral of the Renaissance is under construction, and only the most skilled master builders will leave their mark on history.
Take part in the construction of the Opera Magna and become the most renowned master builder of the Renaissance.
Travel across the markets of the Mediterranean to acquire precious goods, refine them in your workshop, and deliver them to the grand construction site. Every decision shapes your path to glory.
PLAN, BUILD, AND LEAVE YOUR MARK.
Balance workshop upgrades and deliveries to become the most prestigious builder of your age.
AN ELEGANT AND DYNAMIC MARKET SYSTEM
Where the value of resources changes with every action.

Opera Magna is the result of a collaboration between two of the most respected names in the Italian board game scene: Tommaso Battista (designer of Barrage and D.E.I.) and Stefano Castelli (creator of Potion Explosion and Chamber of Wonders).
The game is a resource-management Eurogame built around mechanical elegance, delivering a deep and layered gameplay experience within a streamlined playtime.

Set in 15th-century Florence, the game casts players as merchants supplying the grand construction site of the Basilica. At the heart of the experience lies a dynamic market system in which resource values shift with every action, and where managing what you leave to your opponents is just as crucial as choosing what to bring into your own workshop.

In Padventure: Paddy entdeckt den Wald begleiten die Spieler Paddy auf einem Abenteuer durch den Wald und entdecken und sammeln dabei verschiedene Pflanzen, Tiere und andere Schätze. Das Besondere dabei: Das Spiel wird direkt auf einem Blatt Papier gespielt, das im Laufe des Abenteuers nach und nach zerschnitten wird.

In jedem Zug machen die Spieler zwei Schnitte und trennen dabei Felder vom Rand ihres Blattes ab. Dabei müssen sie darauf achten, dass der verbleibende Teil des Blattes zusammenhängend bleibt. Auf den abgetrennten Bereichen befinden sich verschiedene Waldmotive, die die Spieler im Laufe des Spiels sammeln. Die Wahl der richtigen Schnitte ist entscheidend: Die Spieler müssen überlegen, welche Motive sie sammeln möchten, und gleichzeitig vorausschauend planen, damit sie später noch an besonders wertvolle Bereiche gelangen können.

Das Spiel endet, sobald nur noch zwei Felder übrig sind. Anschließend vergleichen die Spieler ihre Sammlungen für jedes der verschiedenen Waldmotive. Punkte gibt es jeweils für die größte und die zweitgrößte Sammlung eines Motivs. Wer am Ende die meisten Punkte gesammelt hat, gewinnt das Spiel.

In Padventure: Paddy Discovers the Forest, players join Paddy on an adventure through the forest, discovering and collecting different plants, animals, and other treasures along the way. The unusual twist is that the game is played directly on a paper sheet that is gradually cut apart as the adventure progresses.

On each turn, players make two cuts, removing squares from the edge of their sheet while making sure the remaining part stays connected. The removed sections contain different forest motifs that players collect throughout the game. Choosing what to cut is important: players must decide which motifs they want to collect while also planning their cuts carefully so they can still reach valuable areas later.

The game ends when only two squares remain. Players compare their collections for each of the different forest motifs. Points are awarded for having the largest and second-largest collections of each motif. The player who scores the most points wins the game.

Zombie Days is a fantastic two-player game by Gareth Edwards. It's one in a collection of themed games that are great to breakout after school, while traveling, or as an ice breaker at game night. An easy, two player card game where players are trying to get a creature on every day of the week. The player who has the most points at the end of the game wins. But be careful because your opponent is looking to sabotage your collection so they can finish first!
Dungeon Cube is the first adventure game to use a twisty puzzle cube as its main game component, combining the challenge of a logic puzzle with the excitement of a fantasy adventure.

Choose your hero, follow the story and manipulate the physical cube to connect characters, objects and symbols. Complete missions, overcome enemies and make decisions that shape your journey. A companion web app guides the narrative, manages your character sheet and saves your progress, while the cube always remains at the heart of the gameplay.

Dungeon Cube features three game modes: a solo Story mode with branching paths and multiple endings, a competitive Challenge mode, and a Cooperative mode in which players share resources and equipment.
One cube. Countless combinations. A whole adventure in your hands.

Im herbstlichen Fox Grove beginnt der Wettlauf um die besten Wintervorräte. Als Tiere des Waldes sammelt ihr Holz, Nüsse und Ahornblätter, um eure Ressourcen an drei Waldhäuser zu liefern und euch optimal auf die kalte Jahreszeit vorzubereiten. Doch nur wer die Stiche klug plant und seine Fähigkeiten effizient einsetzt, wird am Ende die meisten Punkte erzielen.

Das Herzstück des Spiels ist ein spannendes Stichspiel mit vier Farben – darunter gelbe Trumpfkarten. Jede Karte bringt beim Gewinnen eines Stichs oder beim geschickten Abwerfen wertvolle Belohnungen: Ressourcen für den Ausbau der Waldhäuser, Brombeeren als flexible Joker oder sogar direkte Aufstiege durch besonders starke Karten. Timing und Handmanagement spielen dabei eine zentrale Rolle.

Nach neun ausgespielten Stichen folgt die Lieferphase. Jetzt zeigt sich, wer seine Vorräte clever eingesetzt hat. Schritt für Schritt steigt ihr in den Waldhäusern auf, bezahlt die geforderten Ressourcen und setzt eure Tiermarker höher. Jede erreichte Stufe bringt Punkte – und oft auch Bonusaktionen. Diese ermöglichen euch zusätzliche Brombeeren oder das Reaktivieren eurer Eulen.

Die Eulen sind dabei ein entscheidender strategischer Faktor. Jede besitzt eine einzigartige Fähigkeit: Ressourcen vergünstigen, umwandeln, verdoppeln oder sogar zwei Karten aus einem Stich wählen. Doch jede Fähigkeit ist nur einmal einsetzbar, bis sie wieder aktiviert wird. So entsteht ein spannendes Ressourcen- und Timing-Puzzle.

Besonders clever: Am Spielende zählt nicht nur, wie hoch ihr in den Waldhäusern aufgestiegen seid – auch eure niedrigste erreichte Stufe fließt in die Wertung ein. Wer sich also nur auf ein Gebäude konzentriert, riskiert wertvolle Punkte. Zusätzlich bringen gesammelte Brombeeren verdeckte Siegpunkte.

Mit variablen Waldhaus-Seiten, unterschiedlichen Eulenkombinationen, einer Profi-Variante und einer speziellen Zwei-Personen-Regel bietet Fox Grove hohe Wiederspielbarkeit und strategische Tiefe – verpackt in ein atmosphärisches Waldthema.

During the Tang dynasty, Chang’an was one of the largest cities in the world. It was a cosmopolitan urban center with thousands of travelers exploring it. As an important urbanist, compete against other players to build the best districts of Chang’an and to get the favors of the court.

In Chang’an, players take on the role of skilled urbanists striving to construct the most impressive districts while earning favor from the imperial court. Through careful planning and strategic decision-making, players place cards onto their personal boards, known as gates, to prepare future actions. These cards are then moved into the city districts to construct buildings and attract influential characters who bring valuable abilities and rewards. Each turn offers meaningful choices, as players must decide between researching new opportunities, managing resources and activating character effects, or building structures that contribute to their growing city. Every card added to the districts provides unique privileges and victory points, creating a layered and rewarding gameplay experience.

The game progresses as players expand their districts, with the end triggered once a player successfully builds nine or more cards into their city. At that point, the competition concludes, and the player with the highest number of victory points is crowned the greatest urbanist of Chang’an.

With its blend of strategic planning, resource management, and historical theme, Chang’an offers engaging gameplay that is easy to learn yet rich in depth. Perfect for families, teens, and adult players, this game delivers high replay value and a compelling balance of competition and strategy, making it an excellent addition to any board game collection.
The battle to crown the greatest women’s wrestler of all time begins!

For the first time, the women take center stage in All Time Wrestling. This 1–2 player expansion brings together the heroes of WOW – Women of Wrestling and an incredible roster of wrestling superstars and legends, including Jordynne Grace, Taya Valkyrie, and The IInspiration.

Settle the ultimate inter-promotional rivalry in the new Survivor War mode — a brutal team-vs-team elimination match where only one side can reign supreme. Or step into a massive branching Solo Campaign, filled with rivalries, choices, matches, and hundreds of possible storylines.
Every wrestler features their own unique attacks, abilities, signatures, and finishers and is fully compatible with other All Time Wrestling releases.

Welcome to Pet Avenue, where every window hides a clue and every resident could be the culprit!

Pet Detective is a family-friendly deduction game in which players observe the building, gather information and use logic to solve a mysterious case. Follow the clues floor by floor, identify the guilty resident and check your answer using the QR code.

Pet Detective is available in two standalone versions. In Pet Detective Day, someone has used far too much detergent and covered the building in foam. In Pet Detective Night, a mysterious trombone player has awakened the entire neighbourhood in the middle of the night.
Look carefully, connect the clues and discover which mischievous pet is responsible!
Add Gail Kim as a playable wrestler.
Contains 2 profile cards, 1 player board and 16 attack cards.
You will require ATW: Women's Edition
Two new Operas, two new ways to play:
Piazza dei Miracoli and St. Mark's Basilica each introduce a different Worksite layout, dedicated rules, and unique gameplay.
Run out of cards by remembering how much you fed each animal… and how much it pooped.

CAGONES is a game where you'll repeatedly question whether what you remember with absolute clarity is true or not, and you just hope no one challenges you so you can finally find out. Your goal is to get rid of all your cards, and to do so, you'll have to feed a polar bear and a rabbit and remember how much they've eaten… and pooped.

Each turn, you can play a certain number of fish cards onto the polar bear. You can make it poop those fish or challenge someone to guess how many fish it's eaten, but be careful, because if that person has a challenge card, they can challenge you back. When the polar bear goes to sleep, you'll have to turn over all the cards in your hand to feed the rabbit, which has a smaller stomach and sometimes eats in halves.
Of course, when the rabbit goes to sleep, you'll have to feed the bear again. Does anyone remember how many fish it went to sleep with?

Palace Quest is the new cooperative adventure for 1–6 players from Emanuele Ornella (designer of Ronin) and Dirk Henn (designer of Alhambra). The Sultan has bestowed upon you the monumental task of constructing his dream palace, but his vision is exacting. You must work together as a team to assemble the perfect Alhambra.

Palace Quest is played over 8 rounds. At the beginning, each player receives a stack of gems used to finance the construction of the buildings. Each round the role of the master builder changes, and this player decides which 3 buildings can be placed that round. Together, players may reveal 5 gem cards one after another — they decide whether to try their luck again and discard the previous card to draw a suitable one. If the team runs out of gem cards, they lose the game.

In the first 3 rounds, the team builds the basic framework for the Alhambra. After that, each round one of the Sultan's wishes must be fulfilled — wishes range from the length of the outer wall to the number of buildings or their arrangement. Failing a wish can lead to losing the game. At the start of each game, the wishes and consequences are randomly redistributed, so no two games play the same.

To make construction easier, players form neighborhoods of buildings of the same type, which earns action tiles that allow drawing additional cards, rotating building sites, or changing gem colors. Seeing all of the Sultan's wishes upfront and the consequences for failing creates a uniquely tense decision space — devise a master strategy, but pivot tactically when the cards aren't in your favor.
Terminator 2: The Board Game is an officially licensed board game from STUDIOCANAL that puts players in the middle of the struggle to prevent Judgment Day.

Players take on the roles of Sarah Connor, John Connor, and the reprogrammed T-800, working together to survive and stop Skynet’s rise. The game can be played cooperatively (1–3 players) against an automated T-1000 opponent, or in a 1-vs-many mode where one player controls the relentless T-1000 hunting the heroes.

The game takes place across modular locations representing Los Angeles. Players move their miniatures between locations to attempt missions, resolve encounters, gather intelligence, and avoid the T-1000. Missions and encounters are resolved through a dice-based system using Combat, Skill, and Persuasion dice. Players roll dice to generate successes while managing the noise their actions create, as too much noise may attract the T-1000 or trigger dangerous consequences.
Throughout the game, heroes upgrade and expand their dice pools, acquire weapons, equipment, allies, and special abilities, and adapt their strategy as the story unfolds.

To win, the heroes must complete objectives that unlock a Final Mission to prevent Skynet’s rise. The T-1000 wins if the heroes falter along the way or if John Connor, humanity’s future leader, is eliminated.

New Mage and fearsome creatures are exploring the Black Rose Lodge!
Mathemagics is the new expansion for the Black Rose Wars line.
A new Magister enters the Lodge, accompanied by two alternative rooms, a new Forgotten Spell, new Event cards, and alternative Nigredo summons.

Are you ready for the next challenges within the Lodge?

The volcano has erupted and the lava is closing in. Can you reach the ship before it is too late?

Lava Run is an exciting roll-and-write adventure in which players use dice and simple calculations to escape from a volcanic island. Choose how to use the results, plan your route and race towards safety while collecting diamonds and recovering the pieces of a mysterious talisman.
But every roll brings new danger: the lava continues to advance, and if it reaches a skull, the game is over!
With Basic and Advanced rules, Lava Run can be played solo or cooperatively. Children practise addition, subtraction and logical thinking naturally as they make strategic decisions together.
Run, calculate and escape before the lava catches you!

With the issue #13 of Ashes you will get 2 stunning miniatures, plus a 40-page magazine, where you’ll discover exclusive content, new scenarios, and behind-the-scenes insights from the Nova Aetas Chronicles. This Special Edition celebrates creativity and community with fresh gameplay material, interviews, and a look at upcoming projects

Shyfinngames Oy is a Finnish indie game studio that designs small but big games. This year, we’re bringing Fluffypede – a card game for the whole family that’s been in development for 2.5 years – to Essen. In the game, players take on the role of toy makers, working together but competing to create Fluffypede plushie toys. Behind the game’s super-cute artwork lies a tactical game that challenges you to think about your cards in a whole new way. Make use of special tools and the toy makers’ unique abilities in a game where it’s not just the winner that’s remembered, but all the incredible moves made throughout the game. 2–5 players Playing time: 25 minutes Ages 8+ English, Spanish, Finnish Language-neutral components No Gen-AI art used!

Dawn of Democracy is a family strategic board game for 2 players that takes you into a prehistoric world of politics and competition. Players take on opposing sides, seeking to build their influence and establish their dominance.
Throughout the game, players have to manage their resources: stone, meat, fruit, water and brawn, gather supports, and control key territories.
The goal is to achieve the most support at the end of the game to become chief.
Spread your influence across the land, outmaneuver your rival, and earn the tribe's trust to be the dominant at the Dawn of Democracy.
Ragnarok the Board Game: Ceremony of Prontera is a thematic strategy board game that recreates the beloved world and sense of adventure of the classic MMORPG, Ragnarok Online.

Players begin by creating their characters and choosing their favorite first job classes before setting out to explore the lands surrounding Prontera. Along the way, they will undertake quests from familiar NPCs, advance to second job classes, collect valuable equipment and resources, and eventually challenge powerful MVP monsters.

Designed as an accessible adventure RPG, the game combines dungeon-crawling combat with card-based skill mechanics inspired by the iconic abilities from *Ragnarok Online*. Each monster features its own unique behaviors and mechanics, while every scenario introduces different objectives and challenges that require players to carefully plan their actions.
Players must make clever use of their skills, equipment, and party composition to overcome the obstacles ahead.
Choose your class, develop your character, and discover whether your party has what it takes to defeat the most formidable MVPs in the world of Rune-Midgard.
Price starts at $79(USD)
Manage an anime studio and take your team to the top!In JISOGI: Anime Studio Tycoon, you step into the role of a new manager, tasked with reversing the fortunes of a struggling anime studio.

Build powerful synergetic work teams from 52 unique Staff Cards. Create Anime stories by mixing and matching uniquely themed and illustrated Script Parts across 5 key genres that follow anime trends represented on 20 beautifully illustrated foil tarot cards.

Manage your income from anime releases against your debts, and your team’s growing abilities and salaries, to become increasingly profitable. Chase scoring opportunities each round based on your achievements.

Sengoku era Japan, and you are a cat carpenter with ambitions. Win tricks, then slide the cards you captured under your castle board. Each wing takes one colour and one colour only, up to a strict limit: hit it exactly and you score big, go over it and your castle costs you points. Anticipate the colours, read your opponents, and build the finest castle in the land.
Preorder link : https://forms.gle/g7DHtFhCUp4B1j789

FOUNDATION – Isaac Asimov is a mid-weight strategic Euro game that brings Isaac Asimov’s legendary science-fiction saga to the tabletop, combining deep strategic gameplay with a strong thematic and narrative dimension.

Lead one of the great Factions shaping the future of the Galaxy. Expand your presence across different worlds, develop your capabilities and build your strategy through cards, Agents and the unique strengths of your Faction, as centuries pass and the balance of power continues to change.

At the heart of the game are the Seldon Crises, pivotal moments in history predicted by psychohistory. Players must decide how to face each Crisis, carefully managing their actions and the passage of Time. Resolving a Crisis can shape the future of the Galaxy, but sometimes allowing history to move forward may open entirely different strategic opportunities.

The game is designed to recreate the extraordinary scale of Asimov’s universe: generations pass, characters enter and leave history, political powers rise and fall, and the consequences of your decisions unfold across centuries.
Alongside the main competitive game, a dedicated Narrative Module expands the experience with stories, events and choices that bring players even deeper into the world of Foundation.
At SPIEL Essen, you can experience the final pre-production version of FOUNDATION – Isaac Asimov, ahead of its upcoming Gamefound campaign.

A trick-taking game where you must not follow suit. Play your heroes, collect the sets you need, and watch out for the time paradoxes: play two identical heroes and the timeline collapses, cutting the round short for everyone. Easy to teach, sharp to master, and never quite the same twice. Winner of a Seal of Excellence.
Preorder link : https://forms.gle/bWTuU3vbEiy8XvWg7

Build a solarpunk city in the clouds.In Skyward Republic, two face-up cards per player are dealt into piles for all players to contest. Each player is also dealt two unknown cards. On your turn will you pick a pile of cards that fits your strategy before others do, or flip and place one of your dealt cards in a pile to stay in expanding draft so as to pick a bigger or better pile later? Pick early for likely fewer cards but more control, then reveal your remaining cards and place them in the remaining piles. Or hold out till last pick to likely get more but somewhat random cards, yet gain a wild resource and become the first player.

Players then build cards they can afford to build, each with interconnected scoring abilities. Then attempt to claim powerful benefactors to gain victory points and special abilities. A player’s eighth building triggers the end of the game and the player with the highest score wins.
Frog Tower is a family game where luck, simple strategy, and courage hold the key to victory.

Take turns flipping frogs from the pond of face down cards, trying to collect different colours for your frog towers. Push your luck for more colourful frogs, but avoid flipping matching colours or you will go bust and your flipped cards will hop around the table to rival players. Or maybe that's what you want!
Setting yourself up with only 1 spare lily pad allows you the choice of whether to take or deny a frog you do or don't want.
More colours in your towers gets you more points. But if you can somehow make a tower of all matching colour frogs you instantly win the game!

This is a reimplementation of the 2024 Japanese game カエルタワー (Frog Tower) from Sunny Bird Games via localization from Japanese / English to English only. It changes the box size and design, removes some components, removes some optional scoring mechanisms and their icons from cards, and changes other key mechanisms in the game.

Jetzt liegt der Fall in euren Händen. Ihr prüft Aussagen, sammelt Beweise, deckt Widersprüche auf und rekonstruiert die Tatnacht. Analoge Hinweise treffen auf digitale Spuren: Websites, Zeugenaussagen und multimediale Inhalte sorgen für echte Ermittlungsstimmung.

MORD IM LUXUSWOHNHAUS – Thomas Martinelli liegt tot in der Wohnung seiner Nachbarin Sabrina Winter. Doch Winter behauptet, zur Tatzeit nicht im Gebäude gewesen zu sein. Auch die übrigen Bewohner der vierten Etage präsentieren scheinbar schlüssige Alibis.

ERMITTELT WIE EIN TRUE-CRIME-TEAM – Als Unterstützer des Podcasts „Mörderische Heimat“ nehmt ihr die Ermittlungen auf, befragt Zeugen, prüft Aussagen und folgt den Spuren durch das Haus und bis ins nächtliche Frankfurt.
DIE GESTALT MIT DER SCHWEINEMASKE – In der Tatnacht wurde eine ominöse Person im Gebäude gesehen. Wer steckt hinter der Maske – und was hat sie mit dem Mord zu tun?

MULTIMEDIALE ERMITTLUNG MIT DIGITALEN SPUREN – Analoge Hinweise treffen auf Websites, digitale Inhalte, Zeugenaussagen und weitere Spuren. Keine App, kein Account und keine Anmeldung notwendig.

description: “And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see. And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.” (Apocalypse 6:7-8)

Apocalypse is a trick-taking game where the goal is to score the fewest points. Each round, you play cards and influence the Apocalypse tokens at the center of the table. Watch them carefully: if they are all flipped, the rules change and the round descends into chaos!

It's time to build, Architect!
Welcome to Sunleaf Grove, where a community of animal residents work paw-in-paw/fin/hoof/claw to build a home in harmony with nature – and they need your help!

As a Grove Architect, you’ll plan projects, organize supply lines, and transform timber into beautiful, sustainable structures. Gather fallen wood from the forest floor, float it downstream, shape it into sturdy planks, and raise buildings of every size – from snug burrows to towering treetop apartments.
Collect, craft, build: it's a peaceful, puzzle-y cycle!

Oakspire is a cozy tableau-building game where you'll carefully select Project Cards that represent different stages of wood crafting. These cards can be used in a multitude of ways: Turn them into Reclaimed Wood to fuel your production chain, play them as Company Actions to move, process, or upgrade your resources on supply lines, or blueprint them to start working on a new building! You'll only get 3 actions per turn, so the key is optimising your supply line and minimising the amount of actions you take to grow your tableau of project cards.

Each completed project increases your crafting capabilities, and as the game progresses, so does our woodland city, as cozy cafés and riverside markets transform it into a bustling metropolis of nature. But you can't just focus on your own projects! When community actions are triggered each round, they may give you a helpful boost or nudge your plans in an unexpected direction - so keep an eye on the Community Board!

The race is on to be the first to build a certain number of projects for the city, securing their reputation as the best architect and carpenter in the city. Maybe you'll even get a statue made of you in the city centre...

Will you risk all for your Kingdom to reign in the dangerous world of Ethera?Lead your Kingdom to victory over your rivals in this asymetric and highly replayable Kingdom builder and battler. Form your 3 heroes into a line of succession. Then step out into the dangerous continent of Ethera to equip powerful items, learn skills, explore, battle heroes and conquer strongholds in the race to win any 2 of 4 paths to victory.

A cooperative adventure through a whimsical kingdom threatened by the Lyken vines. Yami mixes trick-taking, polyomino tile placement and limited communication into 15 minute missions that build into a full campaign. An open world to explore, a 90s JRPG spirit and a Ghibli inspired art style. Quick to learn, surprisingly deep.

Lassen Sie sich von diesem genialen Spiel mitreißen! Der beliebte Dauerbrenner als große Deluxe-Variante mit variablem Spielbrett und Spielfiguren aus Holz. Shrinkopolis: Worksites introduces 4 double-sided Worksite cards that replace players' starting city cards.
During final scoring, a Worksite can count as any one reward card type for objectives. Animal Worksites are even more flexible, counting as any animal type and helping complete animal sets.

The expansion also adds a new once-per-game Relocation action. A player may cover their Worksite with a previously placed card, repositioning part of their city, creating new connections, and gaining resources from newly formed links.
Worksites add new tactical opportunities and greater flexibility when planning and developing your city.
Contents:
4 double-sided Worksite cards
1 rules card

At the races, you are both the jockey and the bettor. Follow suit to win the tricks, but place your bets first, because the odds shift with every hand. Ride to win, or ride to lose and cash in on someone else's victory. A trick-taking game with a double role and a delicious amount of second-guessing.

5 Missions, 5 Codes, 0 Words

Do you dare to take on the ultimate heist? In the Safe, you and your team face the greatest challenge of your careers: cracking five heavily secured safes. But there’s a catch… Communication is strictly forbidden! Without saying a single word, you must work together flawlessly to decipher the hidden codes. How do you become a master safecracker?

Play cards in the correct order — ascending or descending — to gradually discover which number is missing for each color. Do you have the nerves of steel it takes? Every successful mission brings you closer to victory, but beware: the challenge keeps growing! After every cracked safe, the game becomes harder: certain colors become mandatory, some rows may only increase or decrease, and sometimes only even or odd numbers are allowed.
Why you need this game:
– Thrilling cooperative gameplay: work together under pressure, where every card can make the difference.
– Increasing challenge: five consecutive missions that become more tactical and demanding each time.
– Endless variety: use restriction tokens and color cards to create a unique experience in every game.
One small mistake and the alarm goes off. Do you have what it takes to crack the code?

MANIPULATION - ALLIANCES - DECEPTION.
The friendliest treason game!
The enigmatic Cuckoo Island, lost in the middle of the Pacific Ocean, is ruled by the 7 members of the Council of the Wise.

As evil spirits of the Island, you must tighten your grip and the influence you hold over the Council members in order to accomplish your darkest plans. Beware, for you cannot act alone... nor directly...
MAD is a game of influence, alliances and treason. Players try to influence 3 council members but need to do so through other players' actions.

On a turn, a player chooses an Influence card and gives it to another player. They order which Council Member should receive that card. If that player agrees, they place the card face-down on that character... or they can place it on any other character face-up. 2 rounds, 4 turns per round. You need to find your allies as quickly as possible if you want to win.

Compete to ride the most waves and claim glory. You decide whether to go all in or back off in time. Here, pushing your luck is part of the game. If you want to conquer Tiburón Beach, surf the waves wisely—but beware of the surfer shark. Will you be the one to master the waves and grab the best boards?
The City of Kanashī is calling!

As urban designers, the mayor is asking you to build to new green district of the city. They will retain the services of the designer that will most show their know-how and will grow the most plants and trees around the district’s important buildings.
Toshi Tōshi is an area control game with a trick-taking mechanism in which you need to win or lose tricks at the right moment. You play only ONE hand of 10 cards, so make them count!
The winner of the trick decides which buildings are constructed in which sectors. On the other hand, the non-winners will place Nature tokens around the buildings to increase their influence.
At the end of the game, the player that has the most tokens connected to a building will win that building.
The farm is in a mess! Tom needs your help to gather the animals into the pens before the wolves scare them away.
Watch the cards, find trios or pairs—but don’t make a mistake or you’ll end up in the watering trough!
A perfect game for preschoolers!

A strange storm is brewing, and animals start falling from the sky. You play a kid trying to catch them, in a clever mix of trick-taking, programming and set collection. Before each round you program your cards to anticipate the tricks to come, but the weather has other plans. Catch as many FAFROTSKIES as you can, and remember: winning too often puts you in danger and might cost you the game. Cheeky, tactical and full of twists, by two acclaimed Japanese designers.
Probably Illegal - The World's Most Dangerous Card Game.. Probably is the storytelling card game of chaos and betrayal. Win over the Judge - or torch your rivals and watch it all burn 🔥

This is the party game that goes beyond party games - built around wild scenarios, crazy objects, and ridiculous skills that players combine on the fly. If you can’t win, backstab your loved ones! Your friendships will never be the same again…
Dark humor. Bad decisions. Great parties. That's Probably Illegal (17+)

They say every magnificent city has its dark side. It is the year 1257 AC where corruption has risen in the city. Life has become hard, so you have to find illegal ways in order to survive. You have 4 thieves whom you can rely on to steal some jewelry from the richies. However, you are not the only one who tries to survive in the city. So you will have a dirty competition. Whoever steals the most will live the most.
Watch, flip, rotate… and race to complete the pattern before anyone else!

In Buzzle, all players compete to be the first to recreate the insect pattern shown on the central card. Sounds easy? Think again. You'll need to position your insects correctly, matching their orientation, sometimes flipping or rotating them—and even challenging your instincts with special rules and surprise effects.

When you think you’ve got it right, slap your hand on the central card and prove it! If you’re correct, you earn the card as a point and move one step closer to victory. If you’re wrong, you’ll have to wait while the others keep playing.
Some pattern cards hide tricky visual challenges or extra twists, so stay sharp, keep your eyes focused, and be the first to complete three patterns to win the game.

We would like to congratulate you on your last mission. Yes, that one. The one that, officially, never happened. But the secret services need you again. One of our best spies has been compromised. Certain individuals are trying to blackmail us, threatening to reveal the spy’s identity to our enemies.

Our spy has limited means of communication and observation, but you must work together to identify the moles and stop them from talking. Each success will prevent the loss of millions of dollars. Failure is not an option. The survival of the agency depends on you. Operation Kitala is underway!

In Kitala, one player (Spy) as a secret card representing a character that other players (Agents) must identify. By asking yes/no questions as fast as they can, they must identify the character through a bunch of card stacks.
But they can only hold of those stacks at any time.
And the Agent cards and Spy cards do not have the same colors.
And it's all in real-time.
And they cannot ask some specific questions.
Need we go on?
You need to identify the most characters within the alloted time frame, so... Good luck with that!

Dribble’n’Dice is a tactical football board game for two players, in which you build your own team from players with special animal abilities – for example, a cheetah for speed or a wild boar for powerful tackling. These animal traits shape each player’s style and create strong differences between them.
Each turn consists of three actions – such as moving, passing, dribbling or shooting. Some actions, like dribbling or taking a shot on goal, have to be resolved with dice.
You can also push your actions by adding risk dice. This can improve your chances, but it also increases the risk of negative effects.

If you manage to complete two actions successfully in a row, you activate Momentum and gain a bonus action as a reward. That extra action can make the difference between keeping possession and taking a decisive shot on goal. This creates dramatic sequences of play.
The rules are modular: you can start with just a few rules and later add elements such as offside, off-the-ball movement or special actions.
Dribble’n’Dice is fast, exciting and surprisingly tactical – ideal for football fans who also like to think one step ahead at the gaming table.

Have you seen the mochi? Where did we leave the bubble tea? Become a pastry chef with Kawaii Chef and prepare delicious menus… but the kitchen is an adorable mess! A terrifying legend circulates among pirate crews: a ghost ship keeps sailing the seas, carrying a huge treasure. You might try to claim it but if you fail the trials and can’t solve the enigma, you will join the crew… as one of the dead. Do you dare unfold the map?
This is an immersive escape game inspired by the Internet creepypasta “The Backrooms”, combining a strong narrative element with ingenious puzzle-solving.

As the main feature, you will unfold a massive map of the creepy, labyrinthine location you must escape from, but you will also have access to other objects and even a pop-up recreation of the terrifying place.
Find a missing person, solve puzzle, and navigate rooms full of dangers to escape alive from this place that shouldn’t exist.

Aridnyk is a family board game based on the stories and legends of the Carpathian highlanders of Ukraine, the Hutsuls. In this game, you play as shepherds: you will explore the Carpathians, trade with powerful spirits, fulfill intricate plots, and use magical trinkets. The player with the largest flock at the end of the game will be declared the winner!

Since the dawn of time, the Carpathian land has been known for its magic and wonders. The shepherds who tend their flocks in the vast polonyna meadows are ancestrally familiar with the local spirits, enchanted treasures, and powerful spells; hence, they always profit greatly from their craft. Their paths lead to the land where Drizd is herding his magical sheep, the giant Vovk is roaming around the cliffs, and, chained amongst the cloudy peaks, the four-eyed Aley is sleeping… And when the shepherds return from the polonynas, they shall see whose flock is the biggest, the most cared for, and the victor will be showered with the highest praise and honor.
Base game included four game modes: Competitive, Solo, Cooperative, Family game

In einem ruhigen Kleingartenverein wird ein Wasseringenieur tot in seiner Laube gefunden. Zuerst sieht es nach einem tragischen Unfall aus. Dann tritt der Verfassungsschutz auf den Plan, über der Stadt kreist eine Drohne, und Kommissarin Annika Heidel merkt schnell: Hier geht es um mehr als einen Todesfall. Jetzt zählt jede Stunde.
Das Besondere:
In Zusammenarbeit mit dem Verfassungsschutz entwickelt: Der Fall entstand gemeinsam mit dem Inlandsnachrichtendienst und gibt einen seltenen Einblick in dessen Arbeit.
Ermitteln Seite an Seite mit einem Agenten: Ab dem zweiten Umschlag bekommen die Spieler vertrauliche Unterlagen und stoßen auf eine Spur, die weit über den Kleingartenverein hinausreicht.
Vier Umschläge, vier Ermittlungsphasen: Der Fall wird immer größer, vom Todesfall in der Gartenlaube bis zur Bedrohung für die ganze Stadt.
Über 30 echt wirkende Beweisstücke: Tatortprotokoll, Zeitung, Chatverläufe, Tagebuch, Stadtkarte, Fotos und eine transparente Folie, die man über die Karte legt.
Analog und digital verzahnt: Rechtsmedizin-Portal, Websites der Verdächtigen und Beweise per QR-Code machen die Ermittlung interaktiv.
Ohne Vorwissen spielbar: Wie alle Hidden-Games-Fälle in sich abgeschlossen.
Slumdogs: Die schnelle Fantasy-Cyberpunk-Variante.

Mit einem einheitlichen Würfelpool-System und schneller Charakter-Erschaffung kann es innerhalb kürzester Zeit losgehen.

Slumdogs – das schnelle und unkomplizierte Cyberpunk-Rollenspiel von Seba und Carl.
Was erwartet dich bei Slumdogs?
Schnelles Cyberpunk-Feeling: Erlebe spannende Abenteuer in einer dystopischen Zukunft, ohne dich durch seitenlange Regeln kämpfen zu müssen.

100 % human made
